Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 The Business Analyst-Security Operations will support the OSM team within Security Operations by documenting requirements, coordinating operational deliverables, improving reporting processes, and helping convert Security Operations data into actionable management insights.
 
 The role will partner with technology and business stakeholders to improve clarity, consistency, and execution for Security Operations initiatives. 
 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 Gathering, documenting, and validating business requirements for SecOps metrics, dashboards, workflow improvements, and governance routines. 
 Supporting OSM reporting packages, KPI / KRI tracking, action item follow-up, and recurring management updates. 
 Maintaining process documentation, meeting artifacts, intake trackers, and evidence packages for audit, exam, and leadership requests. 
 Partnering with technical teams to translate operational needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation-ready requirements. 
 Identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve data quality, and reduce manual reporting effort across Security Operations. 
 Coordinating across stakeholders to track dependencies, risks, decisions, and deliverables through completion. 
 
 The ideal candidate should have a fair amount of the following skills & experience: 
 Prior experience as a business analyst, operations analyst, project analyst, or similar role in technology, cybersecurity, risk, or financial services. 
 Strong written communication skills with the ability to summarize complex operational information for management audiences. 
 Working knowledge of requirements documentation, process mapping, KPI / metrics reporting, and stakeholder coordination. 
 Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple workstreams in a fast-paced operational environment.

 Reasonable Accommodation

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.  Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field (to be completed before starting date)

description:

Overview
Dalata Academy

Graduate Programme
Dalata Graduate Programme
The Dalata Graduate Programme is well known for its fast progression, genuine opportunity, and excellent training.
An excellent track record
Our graduate programme has been very successful over the last eight years and has seen many managers start their Dalata journey from the programme. We have over 5,000 employees and we are on a very exciting journey, expanding to new locations and hotels, which makes Dalata the ideal place for you to begin your career in hospitality.
What’s it like to be on the programme?
This well-structured programme will offer the successful graduates an opportunity to build on their recent qualifications and gain excellent, relevant experience to assist their career progression.
The programme is a blend of on-the-job training to support your educational learning with real work experience in your chosen field, training workshops, and social events to ensure you can get to know your graduate colleagues. To validate your learning, we also assign structured project work that will allow you to investigate a business case and much, much more…
At the end of the programme, we expect the graduates to be ready for a management position in one of our hotels.
Define Your Path
We offer a number of streams for the graduate programme. Explore the types of streams we offer, the length of time each takes, and what’s involved below:
Progress at pace
At Dalata, we really focus on internal development and succession planning, which is essential to the success of our expansion plan and great news for your fledgling career in hospitality and business. The graduate programme is an excellent way of ensuring you are ready for the next step into a management role. It’s a high profile fast-track training programme offering graduates tailored professional development, perfectly suited to their skills and knowledge.

About this job:
We are seeking a highly motivated Data Analyst to join our Life & Health Operations and Administration team in Dublin. Reporting to the Data Management Team Lead – Life & Health, EMELA, you will play a key role in managing and analysing data that supports critical business processes across the Life & Health reinsurance portfolio.
Role Summary:
In this role, you will manage the end-to-end data lifecycle for the Life & Health Reinsurance portfolio, ensuring the integrity, quality, and availability of data that underpins critical underwriting, actuarial, finance, and portfolio management activities. Working closely with cedants and cross-functional stakeholders, you will help deliver trusted data that supports sound business decisions, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence while driving continuous improvements in data quality and governance.
Key Responsibilities:
Ensuring data quality by validating that data received from cedants is complete, accurate, consistent and compliant with treaty terms.
Extract, transform and load (ETL) data into our internal tools; while investigating, escalating and resolving any data issues with cedants.
Support onboarding and implementation of new treaties by defining, reviewing, and validating data requirements with Underwriting, Operations, and cedants.
Perform detailed data analysis, quality checks, and reconciliations against treaty conditions and Statement of Account (SoA).
Support quarterly closing activities and ensuring compliance with ICFR and internal control standards.
Investigate data quality issues, perform root cause analysis, and recommend sustainable solutions to improve data quality over time.
Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data is available, accurate and fit for purpose.
Monitor client accounts and producing summary reports highlighting trends, exceptions and key issues.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of data management processes, controls and standards.
Participate in projects and ad hoc tasks as required.
Work Experience, Skills & Competencies:
2-5 years of experience in data analytics, technical accounting within the Insurance or Reinsurance industry (Life & Health experience is a strong plus).
A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Data Analytics, Computer Science or a related field.
Understanding of data governance principles and metadata management.
Experience querying and manipulating large datasets using SQL.
Exposure to scripting languages such as R or Python would be advantageous.
Experience developing reports and dashboards in Power BI.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in data validation, reconciliation, trend analysis and deriving actionable insights.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage across multiple levels of the organisation.
Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
Fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Additional Information

PartnerRe provides a working environment in which diversity is valued, where all employees feel welcome, respected, and empowered to perform at their best. We invite you to  learn more about D&I at PartnerRe.

title: Graduate Programme 2027 | BDO Ireland LLP Limerick
description:
The BDO Ireland LLP Limerick Graduate Programme 2027 is seeking applications across our Audit, Tax and Corporate Governance Departments. 

 AUDIT JOB DESCRIPTION
 

 The BDO Audit Graduate Programme is designed for graduates who are eager to build a career in accountancy and gain hands-on experience working with a broad range of clients. 

 As part of the Audit team, you will work alongside experienced professionals while supporting our clients. You will be involved in assisting in the preparation of financial statements, analysing financial information, and helping clients meet their reporting and compliance obligations. The role will give you exposure to different clients, business models, and financial challenges, allowing you to develop both your technical knowledge and commercial awareness. 

 From the outset, you will be trusted with meaningful responsibilities while receiving the training, mentoring, and support needed to help you grow professionally. As you progress, you will develop strong client relationship skills, gain practical experience in financial reporting and assurance, and work towards your recognised professional qualification (ACA or ACCA). 

 This programme offers an excellent foundation for graduates looking to develop a long-term career in audit and professional services or later move into industry. As part of the programme, graduates will be assigned to one of BDO's specialist audit teams, providing the opportunity to develop sector-specific expertise and build strong client relationships.  

 Our audit teams serve a diverse range of industries, including Financial Services, Manufacturing and Distribution, Telecommunications, Media and Technology; Charities, Non-Profit Organisations; Construction and Real Estate.  

 Working within a dedicated team, graduates will gain valuable hands-on experience, develop strong technical and commercial skills, and contribute to the delivery of high-quality audit and assurance services to clients. 
 
TAX JOB DESCRIPTION 
 

 The BDO Tax Graduate Programme offers graduates the opportunity to develop a career in a fast-paced and dynamic area of professional services. Working as part of our Tax Department, you will help clients meet their compliance obligations while supporting them in understanding and managing the tax implications of their business and personal affairs. 

 Throughout the programme, you will gain exposure to a broad range of tax matters, work with clients across different industries, and develop a practical understanding of Irish tax legislation. You will be involved in both compliance and advisory work, giving you the opportunity to build strong technical skills while developing commercial awareness and client relationship experience. 
 
With support from experienced colleagues, structured training, and assistance towards completing a professional qualification, including the Irish Tax Institute (ITI) Chartered Tax Adviser (CTA) programme, this graduate programme provides an excellent foundation for graduates looking to build a long-term career in tax. 

 CORPORATE GOVERNANCE JOB DESCRIPTION

 The BDO Ireland LLP Corporate Governance Graduate Programme offers graduates the opportunity to develop a career at the heart of how organisations are governed and managed. 

 As part of the Corporate Governance team, you will work closely with clients to help them meet their regulatory and statutory obligations while supporting effective governance practices. You will gain exposure to a range of company secretarial and compliance activities, working with organisations of various sizes and across different sectors. 

 The role provides valuable insight into corporate structures, board operations, regulatory requirements, and governance frameworks. You will work alongside experienced professionals, developing your technical knowledge, attention to detail, and client relationship skills while gaining a strong understanding of the governance environment in which organisations operate. 

 With structured training, mentoring, and ongoing professional development support, this programme provides an excellent foundation for graduates looking to build a long-term career in corporate governance and professional services.

Role Overview
The Bid Operations Executive plays a critical role in supporting the successful delivery of the Cpl Group Bids & Tenders function. The role owns the operational coordination and infrastructure that enables the business to identify, manage, and submit high-quality tender responses in a structured and efficient manner. Acting as the central coordination point across the full bid lifecycle, the Bid Operations Executive ensures tender opportunities are identified, logged, and progressed through the pipeline, while maintaining oversight of timelines, documentation, compliance requirements, and submission processes. This role requires excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple concurrent processes while coordinating input from a wide range of internal stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Tender Opportunity Management
Monitor relevant tender portals and procurement platforms to identify new public and private sector opportunities.
Review tender notices and determine applicability in collaboration with the Bids & Tenders team.
Log all relevant opportunities in Salesforce and internal tracking tools such as Monday.com.
Own and maintain the central bid pipeline tracker, ensuring all opportunities are accurately recorded and kept up to date.
Central Mailbox Management
Manage the central Bids & Tenders mailbox(s), ensuring all incoming communications, tender alerts, documentation requests, and queries are reviewed and actioned promptly.
Prioritise and distribute items to bid owners or appropriate stakeholders.
Ensure no opportunities, deadlines, or key communications are missed.
Bid Process Coordination
Schedule and coordinate bid planning meetings, progress reviews, and submission sign-off meetings.
Attend meetings, capture notes, actions, and timelines, and circulate these to relevant stakeholders.
Monitor tender timelines and proactively track progress across active bids.
Follow up with relevant teams to ensure deadlines are met and required inputs are delivered on time.
Stakeholder Coordination
Support the bid writer in coordinating the gathering of content, messaging, and supporting materials to ensure responses are clear, accurate, and aligned with company positioning.
Track outstanding content contributions and follow up proactively where required.
Identify and flag risks where timelines or submission quality may be impacted, escalating to the Senior Manager where necessary.
Compliance & Documentation Management
Maintain the organisation’s mandatory tender documentation library, including insurance certificates, company policies, accreditations and certifications, and standard company information and responses.
Track renewal dates and ensure documentation remains current and readily available.
Conduct bid compliance checks prior to submission to ensure all required sections are completed, mandatory documentation is included, files are correctly formatted, and portal submission requirements are met.
Tender Submission Coordination
Coordinate the final submission of tender responses across procurement portals and client systems.
Ensure documents are correctly formatted, labelled, and uploaded in accordance with tender instructions.
Maintain organised records of submitted tenders and supporting documentation.
Bid Intelligence & Reporting
Maintain accurate bid data across systems to support pipeline visibility and reporting.
Support the preparation of bid activity and performance reports.
Track bid outcomes, submission activity, and win/loss data to support future bidding strategy.
Process Improvement & Operational Excellence
Contribute ideas and practical solutions to improve bid workflows, documentation management, and cross-team collaboration.
Support initiatives aimed at building a world-class Bids & Tenders function through improved processes, systems, and governance.
Assist with file organisation, documentation structures, and operational improvements to enhance efficiency.
Skills & Experience
Experience in quality, operations, project management, marketing, or commercial support role within a fast-paced business environment.
Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail and strong document management capabilities.
Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

Internship Programme
The Maples Group’s Internship Programme provides interns with the opportunity to see what it is really like to work in a global law firm. During their time with us, interns will be involved in legal work, including meetings, drafting and research. They will also have the chance to meet trainees, solicitors and partners across all practice areas. We are committed to making sure that interns receive excellent training and develop their skills. Of course, they also get to enjoy the social side of life, with many events and activities which allow them to connect with other interns and the entire firm.
The programme runs for four weeks during the month of June each year. You will primarily be based in our Dublin office, however, you will be involved with international transactions, clients and advice. The programme includes a mix of training; department, committee and global talks; various workshops, Q&A sessions and a number of social activities to ensure a holistic experience for all our interns.
Our Internship Programme is the foundation of our Traineeship Programme as it allows us to identify our future Trainees. The Internship Programme is the first step in your career with the Maples Group and gives you the opportunity to experience life here with us. We are committed to developing the future generation of lawyers. If shaping the future of law is something that you would like to be a part of, apply for our programme today!

description:
Contact Claims Help

Marketing & Customer Insight Analyst

Sandyford Dublin 18 Ravenscourt Office Park

Full-time
Chill Insurance are currently on the lookout for a Marketing and Customer Insight Analyst to join our team.
About the Company
Chill Insurance Limited (“Chill”) is a multi-channel insurance intermediary regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland. Founded in 2007, Chill has scaled to become one of Ireland’s leading insurance intermediaries. Chill Insurance is backed by Private Equity house Livingbridge and having invested significantly in the infrastructure and operational teams in the business we are now in a position to take advantage of a number of opportunities (both organic and acquisitive) which should lead to a more than doubling in the size of the business in the coming few years.
Chill’s sister companies include Quote Devil Insurance, an insurance intermediary, and Ivernia Insurance Ltd, an MGA insurer . The customer insight team support all three businesses and this role will provide support across the full group.
Purpose
Own and embed TRG’s behavioural segmentation and customer decisioning frameworks, ensuring they translate into clear, commercially impactful CRM strategies. This role acts as the internal authority on how customer behaviour is defined, segmented, and activated—driving the shift towards data-led personalisation, next-best-action (NBA), and propensity-driven marketing across the customer lifecycle.
Operating as a senior individual contributor, the role provides analytical leadership and decisioning frameworks that directly shape CRM performance and commercial outcomes.
Key Responsibilities
Behavioural Segmentation Ownership
Act as the internal SME and owner of TRG's behavioural segmentation model.
Validate, challenge, and approve segmentation methodology, outputs, and ongoing evolution.
Translate segments into clear commercial strategies across acquisition, conversion, retention, and cross-sell.
Ensure segmentation is consistently and effectively applied across CRM and marketing activity.
Decisioning, NBA & Personalisation
Define and evolve next-best-action (NBA) frameworks and decisioning logic.
Establish how behavioural data, segmentation, and context drive: Targeting; Timing; Message and proposition
Develop scalable personalisation approaches that move beyond static campaigns to behaviour-led journeys.
Ensure decisioning logic is embedded within CRM execution.
Propensity Modelling & Activation
Identify and prioritise key propensity use cases (e.g. conversion, churn, cross-sell).
Translate model outputs into actionable CRM rules, triggers, and journey design.
Ensure propensity-led strategies are measurable and continuously optimised.
Insight-Led Optimisation & Testing
Define and lead the test-and-learn roadmap, ensuring strong hypotheses and statistical rigour.
Analyse customer journeys to identify drop-offs, triggers, and optimisation opportunities.
Provide clear recommendations to improve enquiry generation, conversion, and retention.
Performance & Commercial Insight
Develop performance frameworks linking segments, decisioning, and campaigns to commercial outcomes.
Produce clear, actionable insight on what is driving performance and where to focus next.
Evaluate effectiveness of segmentation, NBA, and propensity approaches.
Data & Martech Enablement
Define requirements for data and Martech to support segmentation, decisioning, and personalisation.
Ensure data structures enable accurate targeting, measurement, and optimisation.
Partner with technical teams to embed decisioning into CRM workflows.
Cross-Functional Influence
Act as the go-to expert on behavioural insight and customer decisioning.
Influence CRM, Data, and Marketing teams to adopt segmentation-led and test-and-learn approaches.
Support the successful activation of segmentation within day-to-day CRM delivery.
Core Skills
Strong analytical capability - confident with SQL and data visualisation.
Working knowledge of Python or similar tools to explore data, validate outputs, and interrogate model performance (not required to build models from scratch).
Strong understanding of propensity modelling, predictive analytics, and AI-driven decisioning concepts (e.g. classification models, uplift modelling, next-best-action frameworks).
Familiarity with AI-enabled marketing approaches (e.g. real-time decisioning, recommendation engines, automated content optimisation).
Ability to interpret, challenge, and refine model outputs and ensure they translate into practical marketing applications.
Experience translating segmentation, behavioural data, and model outputs into CRM strategies and journeys.
Understanding of personalisation and decisioning systems, including how rules and models interact in execution.
Strong commercial mindset - able to prioritise activity based on value impact.
Excellent communicator - able to simplify complex analytics into clear business actions.
Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
If you would like to join our team, or would like to find out more about the role, please send an email to careers@chill.ie . Before applying, please take a look at our job applicant privacy policy .
Please Note: We do not require the assistance of recruitment agencies or consultancies.

What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. title: Early Careers Manufacturing Technician
description:
Job Details: 
 
 Job Description:  The Role and Impact: 
Become an integral part of Intel's manufacturing operations, where innovation meets precision. As a Manufacturing Technician, you will play a pivotal role in crafting high-quality products that drive the future of technology. Working alongside a dynamic, high-performing team, you will ensure the seamless operation of production processes, helping Intel maintain its position as an industry leader. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge equipment, optimize production efficiencies, and see the tangible impact of your contributions on the world around you.
 
 This role is a shift based role. Candidates must have ability to work on a monthly rotating shift pattern. Exact shift details are shared during interview stage. 

 Key Responsibilities :
 Operate and monitor production equipment to ensure adherence to manufacturing standards and procedures.

 Conduct routine maintenance, diagnostics, and troubleshooting of manufacturing equipment to resolve production challenges effectively.

 Perform functions associated with wafer production, including equipment handling, process training, and defect reduction.

 Implement adjustments to machinery and equipment settings to optimize production efficiency and output quality.

 Collaborate with peers and management to meet production targets and escalate issues promptly when output schedules are at risk.

 Maintain production logs and required documentation following Standard Operating Procedures.

 Drive quality improvements and cost optimization efforts in partnership with engineering teams.

 Conduct quality control evaluations, including inspections of raw materials and finished products, to ensure compliance with established standards.

 Utilize technical manuals, schematics, and diagnostic tools to perform tasks with precision.

 Support the installation, qualification, maintenance, and training activities for new or reused production equipment.

 
 
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications: 
 NFQ Certificate (Level 6) or Diploma/Ord Bachelors/Higher Certificate (Level 7) or (Level 8) in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Electrical/Electronic, Aircraft Systems, Process Technology, Physics, Instrumentation, Advanced Manufacturing, Industrial Automation, Maths, or Chemical Process, or completion of a Trades Apprenticeship.

 0-4 years of relevant work experience.

title: Trainee Accountant
description:
At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but.

About the role

You’ll join the Finance team at Flipdish, supporting a fast-moving, multi-entity environment where accurate financial information, strong controls, and clear reporting help the business make better decisions. This is a hands-on trainee role with exposure across accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end support, audit preparation, and reporting.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business, building the foundations for a successful ACA / ACCA / CIMA training path while taking on more responsibility as you develop. This role follows our hub model, with a healthy blend of hub and home working: 2 days per week from our Sandyford office.

What you’ll own

  • Support core AP and AR processes, including invoice processing, supplier and customer queries, payment support, reconciliations, and maintaining accurate finance records across multiple entities.
  • Assist with month-end close, audit, tax, and statutory reporting requests by preparing journals, schedules, accruals, prepayments, balance sheet reconciliations, and clear supporting documentation.
  • Investigate and resolve reconciling items, unusual balances, and transaction queries; work with Finance and wider business stakeholders to improve financial information and recurring processes.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility — prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

What success looks like

  • You understand Flipdish’s finance processes, systems, month-end timetable, and key stakeholders.
  • You are confidently supporting core AP and AR tasks with good accuracy, attention to detail, and clear supporting documentation.
  • You are preparing basic reconciliations and month-end schedules with improving independence.
  • You are asking good questions, learning quickly, and escalating issues early when something does not look right.
  • You are identifying small process improvements or ways to make recurring tasks more efficient.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a strong academic record, ideally with a degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related discipline.
  • Are eager to commence, or have recently commenced, ACA / ACCA / CIMA.
  • Have strong numerical ability, attention to detail, and pride in producing accurate, well-supported work.
  • Are highly organised, dependable, and able to follow through on tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communicate clearly, collaborate well with others, and are willing to ask questions.
  • Have good working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets, with a willingness to keep improving quickly.
  • Take ownership of your work: you do not wait to be told what to do when you can spot the next useful step.

The following would help you stand out:

  • Some finance, accounting, bookkeeping, internship, or office experience.
  • Exposure to accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end, or financial reporting.
  • Experience working with finance systems, spreadsheets, or structured data.

What you get

We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!

  • Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office)
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays + company days (e.g. Summer Fridays, seasonal)
  • Private healthcare: IE cover (provided through Laya Healthcare)
  • Pension: Retirement savings support (IE)
  • Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events
  • Commuter supports: TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available)

Here’s what you can expect throughout the interview process.

  1. Recruiter screening call (15 minutes)
  2. Hiring manager interview (60 minutes)
  3. Competency / technical stage (60 minutes)
  4. Reference checks

Our Culture

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.

Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.

Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.

If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
 
 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
 
 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
 
 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.
 
 For our business, for clients, and for you
 
 
 Role:   Regulatory Reporting Officer   

 Department:   Regulatory Reporting   

 Reports to:   Regulatory   & Investor Reporting Manager   

 Apex Risk Technologies (ART) is a leading fintech firm and a critical part of the Apex Group, a global financial services provider. ART clients include alternative investment funds, banks, and fund management companies (ManCo’s).   At ART, we have a passion for finance and technology with a strong commitment to research and development to continuously innovate and improve client solutions within an open and collegiate environment. ART’s core solution is RiskMonitor®, which provides an independent appraisal of investment risk compliance and financial risk exposures. RiskMonitor® produces customisable risk reporting suitable for boards, risk committees and investors as well as risk data required for regulatory submissions.     

 
 ART is a fast-growing business and we are looking for a   Regulatory Reporting Officer   to join our team in   Limerick, Ireland . In this role, you will liaise with Portfolio Managers, Risk Managers and Investment Analysts to onboard their funds in RiskMonitor®,   produce regulatory reports in accordance with UCITS and AIFMD directives   and be involved in the daily maintenance of their accounts. In addition, you will closely work with the quantitative development team in Barcelona and Apex technology management colleagues globally to ensure the successful evolution of the ART business unit within Apex. Lastly, you will collaborate with business partners, technology vendors, client counterparties, and colleagues within the Apex Group. This role would suit someone who’s seeking a career in finance and technology with a keen and demonstrable interest in   regulatory reporting .     

 In this role, you will be responsible for:   

 Draft , c oordinate   and review of   UCITS   and PRIIP   Key Investor Information documentation , including risk indicator, monthly performance scenarios.   

 
 Prepare, r eview   of   quarterly/annual AIF,   AIFMD   returns   under ESMA /FCA   requirements . (Annex IV reporting)   

 
   

 Set up and p repare   investor   M onthly   F actsheets for   I nvestment   F unds.   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European PRIIP (EPT) and European MIFID Templates (EMT)   

 
 Prepare, coordinate and review of European ESG templates (EET) in accordance with SFDR and SFDR 2.0   requirements.   

 
 Prepare/review other re porting   required by   the regulators in Luxembourg (CSSF) ,   Ireland (CBI) and United Kingdom (FCA).   

 
 Follow-up with clients and service providers regarding any issues raised until resolution .   

 
 Collaborate with Promoters of each   ART   client to ensure compliance with UCITS V I,   MIFID, KIID , AIFMD   2.0   and overall corporate governance .   

 
 Keep up to date with new regulations.   Support in inter pretation of new regulations on   how the fund/investors will be affected .   

 
 Actively participate in quarterly, monthly service review meetings   

 
 Assist with any ad hoc queries received from clients .   

 
 Ensure supporting procedures are accurate and kept up to date .   

 

 The ideal candidate will possess:   

 Strong academic background including a MSC in   Accounting /Finance/Economics /IT   or related field;   

 
 Proven in-depth knowledge   of European Regulated In vestment Products, UCITS, AIFMD and Fund regulatory requirements .   

 
 Proven experience in   Regulator y   Reporting, Financial Reporting   or Audit   environment   

 
 Excellent communication, analytic al and critical thinking skills   

 
 Ability to work under own initiative   

 
 Ability multi-task and work under pressure   and to deadlines   

 
 Fluent English (written and spoken).

Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.

 An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Client Service Executive to join Davy. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Provide general administrative support to a team of Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Private Client Advisers.
 Act as the first point of contact to clients; dealing promptly and efficiently with client’s queries.
 Prepare investment presentations and collation of documentation for client meetings; auditing customer relationship management system to ensure records and supporting documents are accurate & compliant in preparation of client meetings.
 Manage follow up activities from client meetings; completion of minutes of meetings and monitoring completion of tasks.
 Update and monitor the CRM system on an ongoing basis; preparing documentation to comply with legislative requirements in data management for our clients
 Facilitate client requests by liaising with internal departments to ensure operational procedures and compliance obligations are met executing tasks; acting as the primary point of contact with all internal departments.
 Manage reporting and operation of tasks in conjunction with other team members; implementing and communicating company practice in carrying out tasks.
 Liaise with Tax Advisers, Solicitors, Brokers and Life Offices on behalf of servicing our clients.
 Assist with administrative tasks involved with planning and preparation of various client events and conferences; provide on-site support and hospitality at such events. Occasional out of office hours.
 Participate in interdepartmental projects to identify best practice to enhance servicing our clients; facilitate deployment and communication of new applications to the team.
 Work with the team on the completion and follow up of Investor Policy Statement.
 Contribute in company campaign workshops.
 Comply with the Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures associated with the role
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills;
 Degree in Business/Finance related area
 A strong and proven administration background with the below qualities
 High level of proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
 A flexible, positive attitude towards work
 Excellent attention to detail
 An ability to work effectively as part of a team
 A professional telephone manner
 Excellent organisational skills
 An ability to prioritise own workload
 Benefits 
 What we offer 
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements. 
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.
 
 The Risk Consulting Graduate Programme launches in the period June -September 2027 dependant on the availability of the successful candidate. 

 As a Broker in training you will be responsible for building, maintaining and servicing a book of commercial lines insurances in line with our prospecting strategy. You will learn the craft whilst developing strong relationships with clients, teammates and insurers.

 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Apply our sales methodology i.e. the three-meeting process to all aspects of the role, including team selling.
 Source prospects/leads as per team/leadership discussions.
 Analyse prospects/leads needs and current insurance programs and find opportunities to strengthen their insurance programs.
 Liaise and negotiate with insurance companies to ensure the best possible outcome for clients.
 Ensure timely collection of all premiums, in line with our credit terms.
 Upload and update all prospects and secured clients on internal systems,  Microsoft Dynamics, Relay or equivalents.  
 At all times maintain a professional image and provide an excellent service experience to our clients.
 Take personal responsibility for delivering accurate, high-quality, right first-time outputs.
 Provide support to service / marketing teams as required.  
 Actively seek and avail of personal development opportunities, in team projects, teammate mentoring, assisting with large renewals and new business prospects.
 In all aspects of the role ensure compliance with all legal requirements, Central Bank codes and O’Leary Insurances procedures and business ethics.
 Continuously strive to build strong relationships both internally and externally. Attend internal sales, client/prospect and insurer meetings, in person as required. Avail of networking opportunities as they arise.
 ‘Learn your craft’ – via CPD, insurer training, policy wording reviews and stay up to date on Commercial insurance products/rates and general competitor activity in the market.
 Any ad-hoc tasks that may arise.
 
 OUTCOMES 
 What the role has to deliver 
 Agreed financial objectives
 Acquire new profitable business
 Retain existing Commercial lines business
 Build and maintain strong customer relationships
 Maintain files and documentation
 Meet all compliance and regulatory requirements
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Income and new business figures
 Existing business and retention of figures
 Margin, conversion and retention rates
 Credit control and aged debt analysis
 Compliance audits
 SYSTEMS AND CONTROLS Relay
 MS Office 
 MS Dynamics
 Workday
 Insurer quote and bind systems 
 

 SKILLS / KNOWLEDGE / EXPERIENCE Ability to work as part of a team and on own initiative
 Positive attitude towards change
 Sales acumen including professional presentation
 Strong desire to develop and actively seek line manager feedback
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills
 Negotiation skills
 Ability to multitask and prioritise
 Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with all key stakeholders.
 Strong attention to detail
 Problem solving ability.
 Quantitative skills; ability to understand the relationship of numbers.
 Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality
 
 This job description is not meant to be an all inclusive statement of the duties of the position listed above.  Other appropriate duties may be required from time to time. 
 
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We take pride in the diversity of our team and seek diversity in our applicants.

title: Consultant, Transfer Agency (51391)
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 TRANSFORMATION CONSULTANT
 
 Investor Experience, Quality & Continuous Improvement  |  Limerick  |  Hybrid 
 
 ROLE PURPOSE  Drive structured, measurable change that improves operational performance, efficiency and the investor experience, using data, emerging tools and technology to turn opportunities into sustainable outcomes.
 Working Model
 
 Hybrid. We have a balanced hybrid working model to provide flexibility, with the successful candidate spending time between the office and working from home.
 Role / Department 
 The Transformation Consultant will be a key member of the Investor Experience, Quality & Continuous Improvement team. The role will add structure, discipline and momentum to change across Investor Services, taking opportunities from initial insight through assessment, prioritisation, delivery and benefits realisation.
 Working across operational teams and enabling functions, the Consultant will translate business challenges into well-defined change initiatives, establish clear ownership and governance, and use data, emerging tools and approved technology to enhance performance, efficiency, control and experience.
 This is an opportunity for a practical transformation professional who combines strong change delivery capability with curiosity, sound judgement and a focus on measurable impact.
 Key Responsibilities Change Intake, Governance & Prioritisation Co-own and strengthen the Central Change Channel as the structured route for capturing, assessing, prioritising and progressing Investor Services change opportunities.
 Define clear problem statements, scope, desired outcomes, owners, dependencies, risks, resource needs and success measures before initiatives progress.
 Maintain a transparent change portfolio and delivery cadence, enabling informed prioritisation against business strategy, client impact, operational risk, capacity and expected benefit.
 Prepare and facilitate governance forums, clearly communicating decisions, actions, risks, dependencies and escalations.
 Transformation Delivery & Benefits Realisation Lead selected change initiatives from opportunity identification through implementation, operational readiness, adoption and post-implementation review.
 Translate operational pain points, quality insights, complaints, escalations, failures and partner feedback into practical improvement actions.
 Apply appropriate root-cause analysis, process mapping and continuous improvement techniques to address underlying issues rather than symptoms.
 Establish outcome-based measures for each initiative, tracking timeliness, adoption and realised impact on efficiency, quality, risk, client or partner experience.
 Ensure changes are embedded through clear ownership, procedures, controls, training, communications and handover into business-as-usual operations.
 Data, Technology & Innovation Identify and assess opportunities to use approved emerging tools, automation, self-service, AI and platform capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve performance and experience.
 Partner with Technology, Data, Privacy, Risk and operational stakeholders to shape viable solutions and progress required approvals.
 Use operational, quality and knowledge data to identify trends, target interventions and support evidence-based decision-making.
 Promote responsible adoption by ensuring technology-enabled change is designed with appropriate controls, privacy safeguards, user readiness and measurable value.
 Support experimentation and piloting within agreed governance, capturing learning and scaling solutions where benefits are demonstrated.
 Operational Performance, Quality & Risk Use insights from Quality Assurance, Quality Control, sampling, service levels and operational performance to identify and deliver improvement opportunities.
 Challenge existing processes constructively, simplifying activity, removing non-value-added work and strengthening end-to-end accountability.
 Embed a risk-management mindset throughout change delivery, including impact assessment, control design, testing, implementation readiness and issue escalation.
 Maintain and improve relevant procedures, checklists and governance artefacts to support consistency, compliance and sustainable execution.
 Stakeholder Engagement & Change Adoption Build trusted relationships across Investor Services and cross-functional teams, influencing progress without reliance on direct reporting lines.
 Create clear, concise updates for senior stakeholders that explain the problem, proposed action, delivery status, decisions required and measurable impact.
 Act as an advocate for enablement and a champion of change, helping teams understand the purpose of change and their role in successful adoption.
 Share tools, methods and learning that strengthen change capability and encourage teams to identify and act on improvement opportunities.
 Success Measures Success in the role will be evidenced through a balanced set of delivery and outcome measures, including:
 Quality and clarity of opportunities entering the change process.
 Throughput, timeliness and predictability of initiatives progressed through the Central Change Channel.
 Measurable benefits realised across efficiency, productivity, quality, risk, client experience and partner experience.
 Adoption and sustainable embedding of new processes, tools and technology.
 Transparency of reporting, decision-making, ownership, risk and dependencies.
 Stakeholder confidence in the structure, pace and impact of change delivery.
 Skills / Qualifications The successful candidate will benefit from having:
 Proven experience delivering change, transformation, continuous improvement or operational excellence within financial services or another regulated environment.
 Demonstrated ability to move initiatives from insight and problem definition through delivery, adoption and benefits realisation.
 Practical knowledge of change governance, project delivery, process improvement, root-cause analysis and risk management techniques.
 Strong analytical capability, with the ability to interpret operational and quality data and translate insight into focused action.
 Experience assessing or implementing workflow, automation, self-service, AI or other technology-enabled improvements.
 An understanding of responsible technology adoption, including privacy, control, risk and operational-readiness considerations.
 Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills, including the ability to influence across functions and levels.
 Strong organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and maintain delivery discipline.
 A results-oriented, curious and pragmatic approach, with the confidence to challenge constructively and the judgement to escalate appropriately.
 Experience in Investor Services, Transfer Agency, fund administration, quality or client servicing is an advantage.
 Working with Us As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability embolden us to explore new ideas. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve. Join a workplace with a greater purpose.
 Role Profile at a Glance 
 Primary mandate 
 Turn strategic and operational opportunities into structured, measurable and sustainable change.
 
 Core delivery channel 
 Central Change Channel and associated change governance.
 
 Key outcomes 
 Improved performance, efficiency, quality, control and experience.
 
 Ways of working 
 Data-led, cross-functional, risk-aware, technology-enabled and accountable.
 
 Candidate profile 
 A hands-on transformation professional who can create structure and deliver impact.

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Date: 6 Oct 2026
Location:
Dublin, IE, SE11 5RH
Company:
Glanbia
DAM Business Analyst
Glanbia Enterprise Solutions
Role Overview
The DAM (Digital Asset Management) Business Analyst acts as a key bridge between the Business and IT by translating Business needs into detailed requirements and technology-enabled use cases. They develop a deep understanding of the opportunities, risks, and issues facing the Business, and advise on how technology solutions can be used to achieve / resolve them.
This permanent opportunity reports to the Foundation Tech Product Manager.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Alignment & Business Engagement
Collaborate with the Product Manager to define and execute the DAM strategy aligned with business objectives.
Act as the subject matter expert for the DAM ecosystem, promoting best practices and driving adoption across global teams.
Advise stakeholders on the impact of business process decisions on technology, cost, and complexity to enable informed decision-making.
Requirements Gathering & Backlog Management
Elicit, document, and manage detailed business requirements (features, user stories) and translate them into actionable technology solutions.
Prioritize and manage the product backlog in partnership with the Scrum Master, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
Conduct workshops with business teams to validate requirements and identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
System Design, Configuration & AI Enablement
Document current and future state processes, identifying areas for improvement and automation.
Configure and maintain multiple workflows within the DAM application to support business needs.
Leverage the DAM applications AI capabilities to automate metadata tagging, asset classification, and other repetitive tasks.
Technical Delivery & Quality Assurance
Support development and testing teams by clarifying requirements and expected system behaviour.
Perform functional testing for new features, integrations, and upgrades to ensure solutions meet business needs.
Governance & Compliance
Ensure data governance standards are applied within DAM, including security and compliance considerations for sensitive assets.
Establish and maintain Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity plans for the DAM ecosystem.
Training & Adoption
Develop user guides and training materials; deliver training sessions for key users and support teams.
Monitor and report on application usage and adoption to ensure ROI realization.
Continuous Improvement
Identify and implement automation opportunities within DAM and related processes.
Support & Escalation
Act as the point of escalation for complex issues raised by the Application Support team.
Provide expert guidance on troubleshooting and resolution.
The skills you will bring to the team
Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
Career experience in Food & Beverage or other related industry highly desirable.
Proven experience in eliciting and managing detailed business requirements.
Good business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), and how the opportunities, risks, and issues in these domains can be addressed by technology.
Experience in analysing business challenges using structured frameworks and methodologies.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for developing technology-enabled use cases and analysing Business needs.
Experience in modelling system processes; knowledge of common notational standards is beneficial (e.g., BPMN).
Able to design and execute functional tests, with experience managing bugs / defects through to remediation.
Basic knowledge of software engineering, information risk, security standards, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
Hands-on experience in Agile methodologies and practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban) is beneficial.
Good communication skills with an ability to build rapport with a wide range of different Business and IS stakeholders.
Where and how you will work
The opportunity will be based in Vauxhall, London with   hybrid working arrangements available which offer you a greater choice in how you work and live, giving you a better work-life balance.
What we would like to offer you!
The opportunity to develop your career on a global stage, continuous learning through an on-demand learning platform, and a competitive compensation package including staff discounts, generous family leave policy, competitive salary.
About Glanbia
Glanbia is a better nutrition company with three divisions: Performance Nutrition, Health & Nutrition and Dairy Nutrition. Collectively and with our partners we offer an incredible breadth of expertise in nutrition. We employ a team of 5800 people, work with global food and beverage companies, and sell our award-winning and market-leading brands and ingredients in more than 100 countries worldwide
At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a variety of candidates, we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
At Glanbia, our culture celebrates individuality, knowing that together we are more.

title: Client Service Executive
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future. 
 At Davy, you are the difference.  
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors. 
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Client Service Executive to join Davy. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Provide general administrative support to a team of Directors, Associate Directors and Senior Private Client Advisers.
 Act as the first point of contact to clients; dealing promptly and efficiently with client’s queries.
 Prepare investment presentations and collation of documentation for client meetings; auditing customer relationship management system to ensure records and supporting documents are accurate & compliant in preparation of client meetings.
 Manage follow up activities from client meetings; completion of minutes of meetings and monitoring completion of tasks.
 Update and monitor the CRM system on an ongoing basis; preparing documentation to comply with legislative requirements in data management for our clients
 Facilitate client requests by liaising with internal departments to ensure operational procedures and compliance obligations are met executing tasks; acting as the primary point of contact with all internal departments.
 Manage reporting and operation of tasks in conjunction with other team members; implementing and communicating company practice in carrying out tasks.
 Liaise with Tax Advisers, Solicitors, Brokers and Life Offices on behalf of servicing our clients.
 Assist with administrative tasks involved with planning and preparation of various client events and conferences; provide on-site support and hospitality at such events. Occasional out of office hours.
 Participate in interdepartmental projects to identify best practice to enhance servicing our clients; facilitate deployment and communication of new applications to the team.
 Work with the team on the completion and follow up of Investor Policy Statement.
 Contribute in company campaign workshops.
 Comply with the Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures associated with the role
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills;
 A strong and proven administration background with the below qualities
 High level of proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint
 A flexible, positive attitude towards work
 Excellent attention to detail
 An ability to work effectively as part of a team
 A professional telephone manner
 Excellent organisational skills
 An ability to prioritise own workload
 Degree in Business/Finance related area
 Benefits 
 What we offer 
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements. 
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

title: Business Analyst
description:
About us 
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 Job Overview:  
We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join our Enterprise Transformation Team. This role focuses on improving Sales & Marketing operations through process analysis, system configuration, and automation. We value foundations in systems integration or large programme delivery, followed by hands-on BA work inside a product or enterprise setting. This is not a pure admin position; core BA skills are required to analyse problems, design future-state processes, and drive change. 
 You will work with Salesforce, Marketo, Gong, and other tools —partnering with Sales & Marketing, analytics, and digital transformation teams to deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, and user experience. 
 Key Responsibilities:  
 Analyse, map, and redesign Sales & Marketing processes using lean principles to drive operational efficiency. 
 Identify and implement process improvement opportunities across systems, workflows, and teams. 
 Act as the business lead on system enhancements and new feature implementations across Salesforce, Marketo, Gong and related tools. 
 Gather business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for system configuration or automation. 
 Lead tool rationalisation initiatives, identifying overlaps and proposing streamlined, cost-effective solutions. 
 Collaborate closely with Sales & Marketing, operations, and digital transformation teams to deliver integrated solutions. 
 Facilitate cross-functional workshops to identify pain points and design future-state processes and systems. 
 Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and standard operating procedures. 
 Lead user training, onboarding, and change management activities to drive adoption and effective usage of tools. 
 Monitor system performance and user feedback to identify enhancement opportunities. 
 Stay current on trends in Sales & Marketing systems, process automation, and CRM innovation, bringing new ideas into the team. 
 Requirements 
 Qualifications:  
 Bachelor's degree in business Information Systems, or related field. 
 Experience working with CRM and marketing related systems (e.g. Marketo, Salesforce and Gong. 
 Proven experience leading or contributing to process improvement or transformation initiatives. 
 Strong understanding of finance processes and their interdependencies with systems. 
 Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills. 
 Strong communicator with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences. 
 Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma or other process mapping tools/methodologies is a strong plus. 
 Benefits 
 Our promise to you   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.   
 Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best 
 Outcomes: Drive Success in every engagement  
 Respect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging 
 Excellence: Continuously raising the bar 
 
 What's in it for you? 
 
 Health insurance 
 Annual leave plus, 3 company days
 Work From Home set-up allowance
 Exposure to our local wide partner community 
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work-from-home policy, sports and social committee and much more
 Extensive training programs, through ‘Fenergo University' where you will be certified in all of the Fenergo products 
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest tools and technologies harnessing AI
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you to see and assess your own career development and progress

 
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity

 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
 
 Recruitment Safety  
 For information on our recruitment process and how to verify communications from Fenergo, please visit our Careers page.
