title: R&D Software Engineering Graduate Program - September 2027
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid 
 
 Stryker are delighted to be hiring talented Software Engineers for our “R&D Graduate Programme” – to begin in September 2027.  
 
 Applications close: Friday 24th October 2026.  
 Please ensure your CV includes your academic results or current trending results (if final results are not yet available). 
 
 The “R&D Graduate Programme” is a 24-month structured graduate development programme in the R&D function. The programme rotates on a 6-month rotating assignment basis in order to learn and develop the basic knowledge and skills in the various engineering areas of expertise. The position rotates on a 6 monthly assignment basis:  
 Design   

 Advanced Operations / Research and Technology Development  

 Advanced Quality Engineering   

 Engineering Services (CAD/Prototype/Test Lab)  

 
 What Are We Looking For?  
 Dedicated achievers : People who thrive in a fast-paced environment and will stop at nothing to ensure a project is complete and meets regulations and expectations.  

 Curious learners . People who seek out cutting-edge research and information to expand and enhance their ability to develop new ideas into reality.  

 Collaborative partners . People who build and leverage cross-functional relationships to bring together ideas, information, use cases, and industry analyses to develop best practices.  

 
 During each rotational assignment participants will be responsible for: 

 Software: 
 Translating user needs to design inputs/specifications and producing component and sub-system level designs.

 Owning the design, implementation, and testing of software modules, and performing associated software development tasks (configuration management, issue/bug tracking, and risk management).

 Using version control to keep an easily traceable and documented history of development.

 Using standard software methodologies to ensure code is readable, understandable and maintainable.

 Investigation, design, development and implementation of new manufacturing processes and technology.   

 Handover of new processes from development to production.  

 Debugging and correcting design issues using independent judgment.

 Independently balancing design trade-offs while designing a component of the system.

 
 What You Need?  
 Candidates must have already attained or be on course to attain a 2.1 result in a Level 8 or above Software/ Computer Engineering Engineering course or related discipline.  

 Candidates must have/will have attained the above between June 2025 and Sept 2027 .  

 Self-starter with demonstrated efficient work methods, analytical & problem-solving skills, and ability to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.  

 The individual should enjoy working in a fast paced, dynamic and results orientated team environment.  

 Strong communication skills with the ability to effectively work cross-functionally and with global teams.  

 
 Benefits of Working in Stryker:   

   

 Secure a place on our Graduate Programme and you’ll enjoy a remuneration package that is unsurpassed, including:    

 Permanent Contract .   

 Annual Target Bonus .   

 Share Option Scheme .   

 Pension Scheme .   

 Health Care .   

 E xcellent opportunity for Progression and Development.   

 Hybrid Working. 

 Employee Assistance Programme. 

 Employee Resource Groups, and Sports and Social Groups. 

 Training and support with a dedicated mentor from day one .   

 
   

 Stryker   

   
 Stryker is one of the world’s leading medical technology companies and is dedicated to helping healthcare professionals perform their jobs more efficiently while enhancing patient care. Stryker is committed to delivering exceptional results to patients so they can continue to live healthy, active lifestyles. 
 
A wide and diverse range of Stryker products are manufactured in Ireland including hip and knee system implants, bone cement, surgical blades and micro-rotary burs which are used for cutting, drilling, burring, and shaping bone and soft tissue during orthopaedic, spine, ear, nose and throat plastic surgery. Our neurovascular Ireland product pipeline represents a broad offering of detachable coils for the treatment of haemorrhagic stroke (the rupture of a blood vessel in the brain) and ischemic stroke (a blockage in a blood vessel in the brain). 
 
Stryker offers results-driven people a place where they can make a difference. It is our privilege to create medical technology that exceeds our customers’ expectations and improves peoples’ lives around the world. 
 
We give employees the opportunity to develop their career based on each individual’s strengths, performance and potential, including the possibility to move geographically, functionally, laterally, and vertically. Stryker is a career destination for engaged passionate and talented people who seek innovation, growth, and opportunity. 

 
 # IJ
   
  
 Ireland: €44,000 EUR Annual
   
  
 At Stryker, we believe transparency helps candidates make confident decisions about their next career step. Compensation is an important part of that process and we want to be clear about how pay is determined. The compensation information posted for this role may be presented as a salary range or a fixed amount depending on the role.  In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation (such as bonus and/or commissions where applicable), along with Stryker’s comprehensive benefits package.
  
 If you’d like to learn more about the salary or the benefits associated with this role, your recruiter will be happy to walk you through the details as you progress through the hiring process.
   
  
Travel Percentage: None

title: Associate Trading Operations Executive - Racing
description:
Are you ready to ignite your career with the World’s largest sports betting and iGaming company? Flutter UKI are on the hunt for passionate individuals to join our dynamic team as Trading Operations Execs! We are seeking an individual who is eager to join and contribute to our high-performing team. If you have a passion for excellence and a collaborative approach to work, then we would love to hear from you! 
 We are the Flutter UK & Ireland Trading Team - we power performance, we think differently, and we drive the best customer experiences to keep our Paddy Power, Betfair and Sky Betting & Gaming brands at number one. Trading Operations is an excellent place to advance your career, offering exposure to all parts of the Sportsbook and wider UKI division. You’ll receive all the support you need to enhance and develop your skills in analytics, product management, people leadership, and beyond! If this sounds like the amazing opportunity you are looking for then please read on… 
 The Role 
   As an Exec in the Racing Operations Team, you will be part of a dynamic team that provides an industry leading product across both the sportsbook and the Betfair Exchange. You will ensure continuous improvement of the UKI Racing product for our 3 UKI brands across the full product lifecycle, from market creation and live management right through to issue resolution, making quality real-time decisions to enhance customer satisfaction and business performance. You will play a key role in driving operational excellence while fostering a customer-obsessed culture. You’ll work closely with teams across the business to continuously improve our product offering and internal processes. 
 What you’ll do 
 Form part of a team that takes responsibility for the UKI Racing products across both Sportsbook and Exchange, spanning market creation, settlement, post-settlement, issue resolution and retrospective reporting & analysis. 
 Customer First Always – The customer is at the heart of everything you do. You’ll make decisions with the customer in mind and deliver amazing experiences. 
 
 Innovate - Actively seek new ideas and collaborate with colleagues to improve internal processes  and offer an innovative and exciting betting experiences. 
 
 Problem Solving - The role demands a critical and solution-oriented problem solver, focused on continuously improving the experience of our customers refusing to accept the status quo. 
 
 Collaborating across various departments, including Tech, Global Trading, Commercial, Customer Service, Product, Premium & Liquidity teams to drive operational improvements. 
 
 The role demands a critical and solution-oriented problem solver, focused on continuously improving the experience of our customers. 
 
 Actively seek new ideas and collaborate with colleagues to offer an innovative and exciting betting experience to over 1 million customers. 
 
 Opportunity to specialise or work across a range of trading operations facets. You don’t need to be an expert. We value curiosity and a desire to learn above all else. 
 
 Constantly seek value add opportunities for our business whilst also looking to deliver more efficient operations for our customers. 
 
   
 What we’re looking for 
 Strong understanding of the Flutter Brands and sportsbook/exchange products or a willingness to rapidly develop expertise. 
 Customer focused, always. Proactive and methodical approach to identifying and resolving issues both for our customers and our business and delivering experiences that delights Betfair customers. 
 
 Analytical. The ability to think critically, solve problems creatively, and understand complex data. You know how to dissect problems and devise effective solutions using technical tooling in the process. 
 
 Outstanding attention to detail, ensuring all aspects of trading operations are meticulously handled. 
 
 Exceptional decision maker. Particularly in fast paced, high-pressure situations. 
 
 Strong organisational skills. Demonstrated ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously which is crucial in delivering projects on time and to a high standard. 
 
 Excellent communicator who actively seeks out and shares knowledge with colleagues across the team and wider department. 
 
 An individual who understands brand & department strategies to allow them to make meaningful contributions as a Trading Operations Executive. 
 
 Solution orientated. Someone who has experience in identifying pain points in current processes and proposes solutions to address these. 
 
 Individual who interacts in an inclusive way with the rest of the team, demonstrating respect for different opinions or viewpoints. 
 
 Growth mindset. A keen interest in personal and professional development. You are committed to expanding your skills within and beyond your current role, demonstrating a dedication to lifelong learning and growth. 
 
 Availability during peak Racing hours, including Evenings & Weekends 
 
 Who we are 
 We are Flutter UK & Ireland. Leaders in betting, gaming, and entertainment. We are the home of big-hitting brands including Sky Betting & Gaming, Paddy Power, Betfair and tombola. We are thousands of colleagues. Across 6 locations. In 5 countries. We play as one trailblazing team. 
 Creating trusted entertainment for millions every week. Sharing ideas, expertise, and technology. Innovating in one of the most Competitive and most regulated markets in the world. 
 As a division of Flutter Entertainment, we all work together to win. 
 What we’ll offer you 
 Flexible ways of working – Hybrid work arrangement that supports your wellbeing. 
 £/€1,000 learning fund Twice-yearly bonus (with part of it guaranteed!) 
 
 Pension contribution scheme 
 
 Private healthcare 
 
 Access to thousands of Udemy courses 
 
 Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme 
 
 16 hours paid volunteering time per year. 
 
 Unlimited holiday 
 
 About Flutter   
 
 Flutter is the world’s leading online sports betting and iGaming operator, with a market leading position in the US and across the world. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better, making use of our significant scale and challenger mentality.  
 
 By Changing the Game, we believe we can deliver long-term growth while promoting a positive, sustainable future for the industry. We are well-placed to do so through the distinctive, global advantages of the Flutter Edge, which gives our brands access to group-wide benefits to stay ahead of the competition, as well as our clear vision for sustainability through our Positive Impact Plan.  
 
 Flutter operates a diverse portfolio of leading online sports betting and iGaming brands including FanDuel, Sky Betting & Gaming, Sportsbet, PokerStars, Paddy Power, Sisal, tombola, Betfair, MaxBet, Junglee Games and Adjarabet.  
 
 About Flutter UK & Ireland   
 
 The UK & Ireland region of Flutter unites some of the biggest brands in the betting and gaming industry; Betfair, Paddy Power, PokerStars, Sky Betting & Gaming and tombola.  
 
 At Flutter UK & Ireland, we strive for the next level and drive innovation to set the pace as leaders, putting our  customers first, always . We  win together  through team spirit and unparalleled dedication. When we’re  free to be ourselves , we thrive and unleash our unique talents —creating a culture that empowers our people to  change the game.  We see opportunity everywhere and there is always more to discover...  
 
 We’re working to be an inclusive employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role.  
 
 If you need any adjustments to make this role work for you let us know, and we’ll see how we can accommodate them.

title: GTM Strategy & Operations Analyst
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Build, improve, diagnose, fix, and measure things. Have outsized impact in your role supporting a rapidly scaling sales organization! The GTM sales team at Stripe works with new and existing businesses of all shapes and sizes. As a member of the Central Sales Strategy and Operations team, you’ll be responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with senior sales leadership and the broader sales team to provide insights and analysis on core business performance metrics and drive key strategic sales initiatives.

What you’ll do

Partnering closely with the GTM leadership team, regional sales leaders to support sales teams, owning the in-depth monitoring and tracking of the business metrics, creation of key intelligence and insights to accelerate growth. 

Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including but not limited to Marketing, Finance & Strategy, Data Science, Seller Systems, and Strategic Operations to streamline and optimize our internal processes and run-the-business and planning deliverables (Stripe Rhythm of Business: Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews). Shape the processes and go-to-market support model for a rapidly growing company, and make a tangible impact on sales and operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the GTM leadership with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth
  • Support Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized
  • Deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance
  • Problem solve and structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight
  • Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership
  • Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning
  • Run analysis on key performance metrics, providing relevant insights for managing the business
  • Oversee implementation of enabling systems and tools, working closely with internal systems teams
  • Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams
  • Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Has 7+ years of sales, strategy and operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, or operational experience in investment banking or management consulting or private equity or venture capital, or business insights / analytics roles
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and other advanced analytics tools
  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools
  • Experience leveraging AI to analyze data / derive insights, automate processes, or create reports / dashboards
  • Has strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving unique business problems. Has experience working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • Works well with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, often ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
  • Prior experience in the payments industry

Job Description:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused Service Desk Analyst to provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support to end users. The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting skills, excellent communication, and hands-on experience supporting Windows environments, desktops, laptops, applications, and enterprise IT systems.
The Service Desk Analyst will be responsible for resolving technical issues, managing service requests, documenting incidents, and ensuring timely resolution while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
Provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support to end users via phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems.
Troubleshoot issues related to Windows 10/11, laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, and peripherals.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and application-related issues.
Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktop applications and system software.
Support Active Directory tasks including password resets, account unlocks, and basic user administration.
Troubleshoot Microsoft Office 365 / Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and OneDrive.
Create, update, prioritize, and close incidents and service requests in an ITSM/ticketing system.
Follow established SLA, escalation, and incident management procedures.
Escalate complex technical issues to appropriate Level 2/Level 3 teams.
Perform basic network troubleshooting including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity issues.
Assist with user onboarding/offboarding, system access, software installations, and equipment provisioning.
Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps and resolutions in the knowledge base.
Monitor open tickets and proactively follow up with users to ensure timely resolution.
Support remote users using remote desktop/support tools.
Follow IT security, compliance, and organizational policies.
Provide excellent customer service and maintain professional communication with end users.

Experience: 1-3 Years .

SAP S/4 HANA Senior Finance Business Analyst
An opportunity has arisen for a  S/4 HANA Senior Finance Business Analyst  within Glanbia Enterprise Solutions. This role will be based in  Kilkenny, Ireland or CityWest, Dublin, with a hybrid working arrangement available through our Smart Working model, offering greater flexibility and work-life balance. The successful candidate will report to the  a Product Owner within our Digital Finance Team and will be voice of technical expertise in the team while interacting with the rest of the Glanbia business.
Key Elements of the Role
Lead end-to-end implementation and enhancement of SAP FI/CO solutions and related Finance systems.
Own design decisions for one or more core finance processes such as:
Record-to-Report (R2R): GL, journals, allocations, intercompany, close, consolidation integration.
Order-to-Cash (O2C): customer accounting, revenue recognition touchpoints, credit management integration (as applicable).
Procure-to-Pay (P2P): vendor accounting, invoice processing, payments, withholding taxes, approvals integration.
Asset Accounting (AA): capitalization, depreciation, transfers, retirements, integration with procurement
Controlling (CO): Margin analysis, profitability reporting, product costing, allocations optimization.
S/4 HANA transformation: Fiori, simplification items, parallel accounting.
Translate business requirements into scope documents, blueprints, functional specifications and collaborate with programming teams for enhancements, forms, interfaces, workflows, and reports.
What background and experience are we looking for?
At least 10 year’s SAP implementation and configuration experience with multiple lifecycle implementations
Ideally a Qualified Accountant with relevant Finance process knowledge & experience.
Strong expertise across the SAP finance domain: FI (GL/AP/AR/AA) and CO (CCA/PCA/IO/COPA, allocations) in either SAP ECC or S/4 HANA.
Basic ABAP coding knowledge, while not essential would be an advantage.
Core competencies
Experience in addressing key business issues with IT solutions
Ability to display a high degree of professionalism in dealing with business managers and users.
Commercially focused, high levels of enthusiasm and energy.
Flexibility to undertake international travel where required.
The energy, enthusiasm and drive to make it happen.
A team player who has the ability to motivate others, making it fun while getting the job done.
Enjoys working in a fast-paced, innovative environment where the focus is on continuous improvement and the challenge to make it better.
Competence in Training is a plus
Excellent communications skills including listening skills a distinct advantage
Our Purpose & Values
At Glanbia we are dedicated to delivering better nutrition for every step of life’s journey. We differentiate ourselves by doing not only what is right for our business, but also what is good for our people and the communities in which we live and work. So if you’re looking to develop your career, stretch your ambitions and work for a company that has the ability to succeed on the world stage, ours is a journey you’ll want to share.
At Glanbia, we celebrate diversity, because we know that our individual strengths make us stronger together. We welcome and encourage interest from a wide variety of candidates, and we will give your application consideration, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
At Glanbia our culture will celebrate individuality, knowing that together we are more.

Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress.
We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Front Office Administrator. Reporting to the Treasury Administrator, this full time and permanent position is based in Prague allowing you to make a significant contribution to our business and its' growth.
Key Responsibilities :
Incoming & Outgoing Mail Processing
Ensure proper distribution of incoming mail and preparation of outgoing correspondence.
Coordinate with internal departments regarding document deliveries and dispatches.
Arrange and monitor courier services within the Czech Republic and internationally.
Track and confirm document deliveries by courier.
Upon receipt of couriered documents, scan and archive them in accordance with internal procedures.
Attendance & Language Training
Maintain employee attendance records in the calendar and timesheet system.
Coordinate language training for employees.
Communicate with language schools regarding course schedules and attendance.
Handle administrative tasks related to employee language courses.
Payroll and Accounting Administration
Prepare payment details for the external payroll accountant.
Ensure the accuracy and completeness of attendance data required for payroll processing.
Prepare documents for the accounting department and manage the office cash register.
Administer employee registration and updates in the internal Multisport system.
Address employee inquiries related to Multisport cards.
Data Mailbox Administration
Monitor and manage clients’ and Vistra’s data mailboxes (approx. 50 mailboxes) on behalf of clients.
Review, briefly translate, and forward messages to clients or relevant internal departments (Accounting, Payroll, MCS).
Recruitment Support
Post job advertisements on job boards and assist in candidate sourcing.
Screen candidates based on their resumes and qualifications.
Coordinate and schedule interviews with selected candidates.
Encode and activate chip cards in the Skyla system.
Set up building and office access cards for new employees.
Facility & Office Supplies Management
Communicate with contractors and service providers.
Order and manage office supplies.
Oversee office printers, including arranging repairs when necessary.
Manage mobile and landline services for employees (activation, changes, and cancellations).
Coordinate the purchase of new phones and resolve technical issues with the operator.
Use O2’s online portal for ordering, invoicing, and managing data tariffs and roaming.
Registered Address Management
Review new registered addresses and forward incoming correspondence as needed.
Arrange for new company signage at registered offices.
Archiving, Health & Safety, and Cash Inventory
Support document storage and archiving processes.
Assist with health and safety (BOZP) and fire protection (PO) documentation.
Perform periodic cash inventory checks.
Treasury for Clients / Daily Banking and Payment Tasks
Manage incoming invoices and forward them to the accounting department for processing.
Ensure correct re-invoicing where applicable.
Download daily bank statements and process them in the internal system.
Upload outgoing payment orders to the bank.
Monitor and verify incoming client payments and account transactions for accuracy.
Support month-end closing activities related to banking transactions.
Invoicing and Dunning Process
Distribute monthly invoices for the Czech Republic and Slovakia in accordance with internal processes and client requirements (transitioning to Helios).
Send reminders to clients for overdue payments (planned via Helios).
Regularly confirm client contact details for invoice distribution (in cooperation with Marika).
Prepare recharges (courier, notary, translation) in coordination with Marika.
Prepare client timesheets.
Attributes / Technical Skills:
Essential
Strong organisational and time management capabilities.
High attention to detail, especially in document and mail handling.
Professional verbal and written communication.
Reliable, adaptable, and proactive.
Ability to work independently and recognise when to escalate or seek guidance.
Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Desirable
Experience in office administration, reception, or facilities support.
Comfortable learning new systems and procedures.
Works collaboratively and supports colleagues.
Shows ownership, accuracy, and pride in task completion.
Acts with professionalism, integrity, and cultural awareness.
Relevant Experience:
Prior experience in administrative or office support roles preferred.
Exposure to mailroom or logistics administration beneficial.
Education and Professional Qualification:
Education Requirements
Secondary education with school-leaving examination (Maturita) or equivalent vocational

title: Health Policy Internship
description:
Job Description
 
 Working in a professional and collaborative health policy environment, you will gain practical experience within the External Affairs team at our Red Oak Campus in Dublin. As part of the team, you will support policy development, stakeholder engagement, advocacy initiatives and strategic projects across the Irish and European healthcare landscape.
 
 Working alongside colleagues from across the business and engaging with a wide range of external stakeholders, you will contribute to initiatives that help improve patient outcomes, inform healthcare policy and strengthen healthcare systems.The team operates at the intersection of healthcare policy, government affairs, stakeholder engagement and strategic communications. We help shape the environment in which patients access innovative medicines and vaccines, while supporting healthcare innovation, public health, research and Ireland's life sciences sector.
 
 The successful candidate will work across a diverse portfolio of healthcare, industrial, economic and EU policy issues, contributing to projects that impact patients, healthcare systems and the wider life sciences ecosystem. The role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders as well as engagement with government departments, healthcare organisations, patient groups, professional bodies, industry associations and other external stakeholders.
 
 During your 9-month placement, you will gain first-hand insight into how policy, government affairs and external affairs supports the objectives of a global healthcare organisation operating in Ireland. You will work alongside experienced policy, communications and public affairs professionals, gaining exposure to senior business leaders, policymakers, healthcare stakeholders and industry representatives while developing practical skills in policy analysis, stakeholder engagement and advocacy.
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop an understanding of the Irish healthcare system, public policy environment and pharmaceutical industry.
 Support the planning, coordination and delivery of policy, government affairs and stakeholder engagement activities.
 Assist with preparing briefing materials, agendas, background notes, stakeholder summaries and key messages for internal and external engagements.
 Help coordinate policy events, conferences, roundtables, stakeholder meetings and site visits, including logistics, attendee tracking and follow-up actions.
 Maintain trackers for policy developments, stakeholder engagements, consultation opportunities and key strategic priorities.
 Monitor political, legislative and healthcare policy developments relevant to patients, healthcare systems and the life sciences sector.
 Conduct research and analysis on healthcare, public health, industrial, economic and EU policy topics.
 Support the development of policy submissions, consultation responses, position papers and stakeholder engagement materials.
 Liaise with colleagues across business to support strategic projects and ensure alignment.
 Support participation in industry associations, policy forums and stakeholder initiatives at both national and European level.
 Prepare appealing PowerPoint presentations, reports and briefing documents for internal and external stakeholders.
 Support compliance with all relevant statutory requirements, industry codes and company policies.
 
 Technical Specifications 
 Working towards a degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Public Health, Health Policy, Communications, Law, European Studies, or a related discipline. 

 Demonstrated interest in healthcare policy, public affairs, government affairs, health systems, public health, politics or the life sciences sector.

 Experience conducting research, policy analysis, stakeholder engagement, communications or project work would be advantageous.

 
 This Role Is Well Suited To Someone Who: 
 Is organised, driven, proactive and can work on own initiative.
 Has an interest in healthcare, public policy, Irish politics, public affairs or communications.
 Wants exposure to healthcare policy, government affairs and stakeholder engagement within a global healthcare company.
 Is curious about how business, government, healthcare and policy intersect.
 Enjoys research, problem-solving and working on projects that have real-world impact for patients and healthcare systems.
 
 Qualities We Look For 
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 • Strong research, analytical and critical-thinking skills.
 • Demonstrates initiative, curiosity and a desire to learn.
 • Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.
 • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 • Excellent attention to detail and ability to produce high-quality written materials.
 • Strong relationship-building and interpersonal skills.
 • Operates with a high level of integrity, transparency and accountability.
 • Demonstrates problem-solving capabilities and a willingness to identify opportunities for improvement.
 • Team player who actively supports colleagues and contributes to a positive working environment.
 • Aligns with and fosters a culture of diversity and inclusion.
 • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
 • Demonstrates a desire to continuously learn, develop and improve through feedback.
 
 Length of Programme: 9 Months
 
 
 Start Date: January 2027
 
 
 PQ20

Analytical Problem Solving, Analytical Problem Solving, Clinical Research, Data Analytics, Database Management, Data Entry, Data Visualization, Diversity and Inclusion (D&I), Document Management, European Studies, Healthcare Policies, Health Economics, Health Systems Strengthening, Life Science, Office Applications, Political Sciences, Process Improvements, Project Management, Public Health, Public Health Research, Reporting and Analysis, Stakeholder Communications, Stakeholder Engagement, Stakeholder Management, Technical Specifications {+ 2 more}

title: Specialist, Supply Chain Operations Associate
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.

 The Role 

 BMS External Manufacturing is looking to recruit a 12 month fixed -term Specialist, Supply Chain Operations. This role can based in Dublin or Shannon. 

 Job Function
 Provide a key link in Supply Chain between Customers and Intercompany and third party supply sites and markets. Order processing and invoicing.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 

 Manage Operations 
 Liaise with Principal’s Purchasing, Finance Departments and Fiscal Reps to perform Supply Chain Operations activities on their behalf
 Provide a key link in Supply Chain between intercompany and third-party supply sites and markets
 Ensure that customer and supply sites comply with Business and Tolling Rules
 Resolve discrepancies in quantity and timing of market orders
 Receipt and entry of market orders as per business rules
 Receipt and process supplier invoices and follow up on price discrepancies, and payment queries
 Accurate receipt and process Tolling Fee invoices
 Perform all activities in accordance to Good Distribution Procedure
 Issue invoices to markets
 Issue required shipping documents, certify with local Chamber of Commerce and legalise with relevant Embassies as required
 Liaise with Freight Forwarder/ Logistics for outbound shipments and update Freight Tracker/ Register if applicable
 Approval or sign off of Redeployment/ Rework on behalf of Principal
 Co-ordinate Redeployments/ Reworks and ensure that the costs are back-charged to the appropriate party
 Liaise with QC for testing, release and generation of CoAs for API if applicable
 Liaise with QC for QP inspection and release of Drug Products
 
 Manage Information 
 Assist and support Master Data related to customers, contracts and BOMs
 Use reports to monitor and ensure data integrity if applicable
 Receive and forward Customer Complaints as per established procedures
 Follow up and expedite for prompt resolution(s)
 
 Manage Financial Activities/ Compile Financial Reports 
 Perform all SAP transactions in compliant manner
 Meet Finance deadline for month-end and year-end sales reporting
 Provide supporting documentation for Financial Audits as requested
 
 Team work 
 Work with External Manufacturing organisation to support implementation of new supply models
 Assist in any ad hoc functions as required and/ or any tasks assigned by the Line Supervisor or Line Manager the tasks associated with these functions should be specified. The statement is too vague.
 
 Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required: 

 Three years’ experience in a Multinational Supply Chain Environment, preferably in an Export department
 Exhibit a strong ability to use computer systems efficiently, workable knowledge of ERP system, ideally SAP
 Supply Chain or Business qualification – Diploma standard
 Knowledge of Supply Chain Operations standards
 Knowledge of order processing and invoicing activities; demonstrate efficiency in Supply Chain administration, accuracy and timeliness of order processing
 Deliver results on time in a pressurised environment while maintaining accuracy and a high level of productivity
 Must be flexible and be able to deal with changing priorities; ability to prioritise, organise and manage multiple tasks to tight deadlines
 Follow through commitments to Customers without detriment to the team or company
 Exhibit strong interpersonal and communication skills when dealing with colleagues and external customers; create and maintain strong working relationships within the BMS organisation and externally with trade customers and suppliers
 Understand BMS Supply Chain, products and markets
 Adapt quickly to the demands of the job and show the ability to learn quickly
 Adhere with all Regulatory/ Finance/ EHS/ Security compliance procedure
 
 Why you should apply 

 You will help patients in their fight against serious diseases
 You will be part of a company that encourages excellence and innovation, respects diversity, develops leaders and values its employees.
 You’ll get a competitive salary and a great benefits package including, but not only, an annual bonus, pension contribution, family health insurance, 27 days of annual leave and life assurance
 
 #LI-Hybrid 

 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

 How We Work 
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working.

Visit  careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility  to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only:  If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information:  https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/ 

 Data Protection

description: Introduction At Gallagher, we help clients face risk with confidence because we believe that when businesses are protected, they’re free to grow, lead, and innovate. You’ll be backed by our digital ecosystem: a client-centric suite of consulting tools making it easier for you to meet your clients where they want to be met. Advanced data and analytics providing a comprehensive overview of the risk landscape is at your fingertips. Here, you’re not just improving clients' risk profiles, you’re building trust. You’ll find a culture grounded in teamwork, guided by integrity, and fueled by a shared commitment to do the right thing. We value curiosity, celebrate new ideas, and empower you to take ownership of your career while making a meaningful impact for the businesses we serve. If you’re ready to bring your unique perspective to a place where your work truly matters; think of Gallagher. Overview At GMIB, part of Gallagher, we're not looking for insurance experts. We're looking for great people. People who enjoy helping others. People who are curious, motivated and eager to learn. People who want to build a career where they can develop new skills, gain professional qualifications and make a real difference to customers every day. As part of Gallagher, one of the world's leading insurance brokerages, we're proud to invest in our people. Whether you're starting your career, looking for a fresh challenge, or bringing experience from retail, hospitality, banking, customer service or another industry, we'll give you the training, support and opportunities you need to succeed. You don't need previous insurance experience. We'll teach you everything you need to know about the industry, provide support towards professional qualifications, and help you build a rewarding long-term career with us. How you'll make an impact As a Customer Service Executive, you'll help customers find the protection that's right for them while delivering a friendly, professional and personalised service. You'll: Speak with customers to understand their needs and help them explore suitable insurance options. Build lasting relationships by delivering excellent customer service and support. Provide guidance on a range of personal insurance products. Prepare and manage quotations, renewals and policy changes. Work closely with insurers and underwriters to find the best solutions for customers. Support customers across phone, email and other communication channels. Maintain accurate customer records and ensure regulatory requirements are met. Continue developing your knowledge and professional skills through ongoing training and development opportunities. description:

Trainee Programme
Our Trainee Programme has been created to give you an introduction to the fast-paced legal world, while ensuring that your path from law student to fully qualified lawyer is interesting, fulfilling and filled with an opportunity to learn. We offer a world-class training programme which includes secondment and travel opportunities in addition to first-hand experience working across the core areas of our full service, global law firm.
Global Secondments
Jurisdictions
Offices Worldwide
Global Staff
Core Programme
As a Trainee in Dublin, you will complete four rotations through our legal services practice areas which include Corporate, Data, Commercial & Technology, Employment, Finance, Funds & Investment Management, Dispute Resolution & Insolvency, Property, and Tax.
Your first rotation or pre-seat will take place in advance of attending the Professional Practice Course (the PPC) in the Law Society in September of each year. This allows you to kick start your career and get to know the other trainees in your intake prior to starting PPC.
It is important for us that each of our Trainees is involved in shaping their own career path and as such your areas of interest will be taken into account when assigning the various departments that you will gain experience in. These rotations will give you an opportunity to build your knowledge, while discovering where your interests and strengths lie.
Learning & Development
Learning and development is a central part of our Trainee Programme. Our Trainee Programme has been designed to supplement the PPC and includes a wide range of department specific workshops, seminars, and practice group insights. As you progress through your traineeship, you will have the opportunity to showcase your talent and creativity by putting your skills into practice. Presentation, drafting and other core legal and business skills sessions are also delivered throughout your traineeship by both internal and external experts.
Throughout the Trainee Programme, you will have an opportunity to share an office with Partners, offering you the chance to become acquainted with senior professionals where you will experience different working styles while learning the key skills required to become a successful lawyer.
Continued professional development is an important aspect of your career with the Maples Group and feedback is a central part of your of the programme. There is a mix of informal and formal feedback and we actively encourage you to ask questions throughout your traineeship.
Support Network
Our Trainee Partner Committee will provide day-to-day support in each of your rotations. This committee is responsible for working with you to ensure that your professional development progresses during the time spent in each department.
Your Training Partner will play an active role from the beginning of your traineeship with the firm right through to qualifying as an Associate in the firm. The role of the Training Partner is to act as a coach and mentor, providing guidance and support throughout your training programme. You will meet with your Training Partner regularly during your traineeship.
Secondments
As a global organisation which values a culture of collegiality, we are keen to allow our Trainees to experience life in our other offices. Each year, our Dublin Trainee Programme allows successful trainees to complete an overseas rotation in one of overseas offices with potential locations including Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, Jersey, Luxembourg and London offices. Further secondment opportunities, including client secondments, may be offered to selected trainees in each intake, depending on the needs of the firm and our global client base.
Here in the Dublin office of the Maples Group, our Trainee Programme continues to go from strength to strength. We recognise that our trainees are fundamental to the future of our Maples office here in Dublin. During your traineeship, you will have the opportunity to experience a truly international legal environment, working with lawyers across our global offices. You will work with a number of our practice groups throughout your rotations.
The opportunity for secondments to our international offices is something which is an invaluable part of our Training Programme, allowing our trainees to experience first-hand what it means to be part of One Firm.
We offer our trainees a well-rounded training experience to allow you to shape your career and ensure you develop and grow to become excellent, commercial and entrepreneurial legal advisors to our outstanding global clients. Here at Maples we recognise that our employees come from a wide variety of diverse academic backgrounds and we welcome and value the input and ideas from all of our employees, including our trainees.
You will benefit from a comprehensive structured training plan, designed to help all of our trainees achieve their potential, as well as regular feedback and mentoring throughout your in-office training to ensure you receive the support you need throughout your trainee programme. We are excited to begin this journey with you.
Lynn Cramer
Partner and Head of the Trainee Programme

title: Customer Service Advisor
description: Join One of Ireland's Leading Health Insurance Providers 📍 Location: Little Island, Cork 📅 Start Dates: October 7th start dates 💰 Salary: €30,850 + 10% Performance Related Bonus 🏡 Hybrid Working Looking for a role where you can genuinely make a difference? At laya healthcare, our Customer Service Advisors are at the heart of what we do. Every day, they help our members navigate important healthcare decisions, answer questions, provide reassurance and deliver exceptional service when it matters most. If you're a people person who enjoys solving problems, building connections and helping others, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Be Doing As the first point of contact for our members, you'll: Handle inbound calls from members in a professional and supportive manner Assist with queries relating to policies, claims, payments, renewals and cover options Simplify complex information and explain it clearly and confidently Resolve member concerns and complaints with empathy and good judgement Maintain accurate records and follow regulatory and business processes Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver outstanding member experiences Help ensure every interaction leaves a positive and lasting impression What We're Looking For We're more interested in your attitude and potential than a perfect CV. You'll thrive in this role if you have: Excellent communication and listening skills A genuine passion for helping people Confidence speaking with customers over the phone Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced environment The ability to remain calm and professional during challenging conversations Previous customer service or contact centre experience is beneficial but not essential. Why Join laya healthcare? We invest heavily in our people because we know great service starts with a great team. From day one, you'll benefit from: Health insurance €250 annual gym or club subsidy Competitive pension contribution Performance Related Pay scheme Hybrid working model following training Wellbeing programmes and employee support initiatives 100% maternity and paternity pay after qualifying service Ongoing development, coaching and career progression opportunities Training & Working Hours We'll set you up for success with a comprehensive training programme designed to build your confidence and knowledge. Training Period: 6 to 8 weeks (hybrid training programme) Please note: Annual leave cannot be accommodated during the initial training period. Working Pattern: Full-time role Rotational shifts Monday to Friday One Saturday shift approximately every five weeks Build a Career That Matters Whether you're looking to develop your customer service expertise, start a long-term career in healthcare, or join a company that genuinely values its people, this could be the opportunity you've been waiting for. Apply today and become part of a team that's helping people live healthier lives every day. Minimum Competency Code This role is classified as a regulated position under the Minimum Competency Code. Successful candidates must complete and maintain the required pre‑employment and ongoing competency assessments in line with regulatory standards.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
  We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:
 UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
 Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
 Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW
 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!

 Arrange and conduct meetings, workshops and presentations for a variety of audiences, demonstrating high-quality communication and requirements elicitation skills.
 Review alternative solutions and make recommendations.
 Document and map complex business processes and solutions using standard procedures, methods and tools.
 Identify areas for improvement, specify requirements and implement recommendations to increase the effectiveness of current business processes.
 Perform root cause analysis of issues and work closely with business users to identify and translate their needs into solution designs and system specifications.
 Produce detailed Business Requirements Specification documents and liaise with stakeholders to ensure requirements are understood and signed off prior to development commencing.
 

 Essential Skills and Experience 
 Experience working as a Business Analyst.
 Working experience of Excel to a high level.
 Agile experience and experience working within a Scrum team.
 Experience producing Business Requirements Documents and Business Process Mapping.
 Experience reviewing Functional Specification Documents to ensure alignment with Business Requirements.
 Experience of technology, IT systems and working within the Information Technology sector.
 Communication skills with the ability to explain complex processes and concepts to non-experts.
 Desirable Skills and Experience 
 Additional experience relevant to business analysis, requirements management, process improvement or business process mapping.
 

 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. 
 Salary Range: €50,000-€65,000
 Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits 
 Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme 
 Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance 
 Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme 
 Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.  
 24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies 
 Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat 
 Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards. 
 Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes. 
 And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more. 
 Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer 
 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity. 
 We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact the recruiter at ekta.bahl@version1.com. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Client Service Advisor (Global)
description:
Description 
 
 Join us as a Client Service Advisor within our Corporate Risk and Broking line of business, based in our Limerick office and working in a hybrid environment. 

WTW is one of Ireland’s leading insurance brokers, risk advisors, pensions and actuarial consultancies. For more than 100 years, we have built a strong reputation for delivering exceptional client service. Within Corporate Risk and Broking, we design innovative insurance programmes for our clients, helping them quantify, mitigate and transfer risk through our specialist industry expertise and deep market knowledge.

We are now seeking a Client Service Advisor to join our team. The primary purpose of this role is to manage a portfolio of clients by performing the broking role and delivering a high standard of client service that supports our objectives across Client, Financials, People and Operational Excellence.

 The Role 

 
 Perform the broking role for an assigned portfolio of clients, managing renewals, claims, mid‑term adjustments and all client queries.

 Deliver excellent client service in a responsive, efficient and friendly manner, ensuring all deadlines and service standards are consistently met.

 Develop an in‑depth understanding of each client's business, culture and insurance needs.

 Identify opportunities to grow and enhance existing client accounts.

 Build and maintain strong and mutually beneficial insurer relationships.

 Follow all company procedures for renewals, new business, documentation and administrative processes.

 Ensure compliance with regulatory, company and market standards at all times.

 Participate in internal project work and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

 Provide technical support to colleagues, assisting in the resolution of client or placement issues.

 Build positive working relationships and collaborate effectively with a variety of local and offshore teams.

 Act as an ambassador for WTW, demonstrating our purpose, values and client‑centric culture.

 

 Qualifications 
 
 What you’ll bring 

 
 Certified Insurance Practitioner (CIP) qualification (or working toward completion).

 Previous experience in insurance broking or within an insurer.

 A strong client‑focused mindset with excellent relationship‑building skills.

 Proactive approach with the ability to take initiative and responsibility early on.

 Interest in expanding knowledge of the insurance industry and market dynamics.

 Strong analytical, organisational and communication skills.

 High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all tasks.

 Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and confidence with IT systems.
 

 
 What we offer 
At WTW Ireland, your wellbeing comes first.  Depending on your role, you'll receive either 23 days of annual leave plus up to 13 flexible days, or 25 days of annual leave with the option to add 5 extra days—giving you plenty of time to rest and recharge. You'll also benefit from a €1,500 health insurance allowance, life assurance, future-focused pension contributions, hybrid working options, educational support, employee assistance programme and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community.  On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including our share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental, critical illness protection, enhanced optical cover, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.

 Equal Opportunity Employer 
We’re committed to equal employment opportunity and provide application, interview and workplace adjustments and accommodations to all applicants. If you foresee any barriers, from the application process through to joining WTW, please email candidatehelpdesk@wtwco.com

title: Technical Revenue Operations Analyst
description:
About Wayflyer Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
 Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
 You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
 
 The challenge RevOps at Wayflyer is a team of builders. We're not just looking for people who can spot what's broken and flag it, that skill matters and we have great people who do it well. We're looking for people who also have the technical range to build the fix themselves, independently, without waiting on someone else's roadmap.
 We sit at the epicenter of an exceptionally fast-growing business running across multiple channels and partners, and it's our job to make sure the systems underneath that growth have the ability to scale. This role is for a builder who wants to see the impact of their work fast, ideally in seconds, while still thinking several steps ahead so today's quick fix doesn't turn into next year's technical debt. We want people who enjoy the instant feedback loop just as much as the long game.
 
 What you'll actually do Integrations & Technical Ownership: Build, maintain and improve the systems, internal automations and integrations that make our sales and CS teams faster and more effective, from the ground up.

 AI-Native Systems: Build, deploy and continuously sharpen AI-native workflows and agents that augment how Sales, CS and the wider Revenue org work, not just automate around the edges.

 Data, Analytics & Problem Solving: Use self-sourced data to diagnose what's actually broken, run root cause analysis, and build the fix yourself, then measure it against real KPIs and keep iterating.

 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Ownership: Work directly with Sales, Partnerships, Marketing and Finance to turn half-formed requirements into systems that actually solve the problem.

 Revenue Data Hygiene: Own regular audits, deduplication, enrichment and the process fixes that keep our data usable across every system that touches it.

 Driving Operational Excellence: Spot inefficiencies before anyone asks you to, prioritise ruthlessly, and build the automated solutions that let the function scale without adding headcount.
 

 What this role could turn into This function sits at the intersection of Revenue, Marketing, Finance, Data and Engineering, so you'll get exposure most people spend years angling for. People who do this well tend to move toward GTM strategy, GTM engineering, product roles, and beyond. The sky is the limit.
 
 Who thrives here You're an AI-native builder who thinks in scale, not one-off fixes, and gets uncomfortable when you spot a manual workaround. You're just as comfortable pairing with Engineering as you are in the room with Sales leadership, translating one for the other without losing anything in the middle. You run towards the hardest, messiest problems, you don't wait for permission, and you don't need a fully-scoped brief before you start. You're always watching what the best GTM teams are building, and you'd rather pitch a bold idea than ship another incremental tweak.
 
 We hire for range 3+ years in RevOps, MarOps, consulting or similar, but tenure isn't the point, trajectory is. Whatever your background, you're an AI-native builder with strong business acumen and a sharp eye for the difference between a good customer experience and a bad one.
 You bring fluency in Python (or Node) and SQL, hands-on experience configuring HubSpot and its developer suite, and comfort with automation platforms like Zapier, Pipedream, n8n or UiPath. You've likely configured CPQ, CLM, sales engagement or customer-success platforms before, and just as importantly, you've driven adoption of something you built, not just shipped it and walked away. Extra credit if you've built and deployed AI agents, integrated AI/LLM-based solutions into existing workflows, or built automated pipelines end to end.
 
 Location and working policy 📍 Dublin or London, Hybrid
 
 The good stuff 25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and pension. Equity, because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.
 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at privacy@wayflyer.com or review our privacy notice at https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice.

Are you ready to apply your engineering or quantity surveying skills to one of the most ambitious and impactful infrastructure transformations in Ireland?
Do you have, or are you about to get, a degree in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/ Structural, Mechanical / Energy Engineering or as a Quantity Surveyor?
If so, the ESB Technical Graduate Programme is your opportunity to work at the forefront of Ireland’s clean energy transition, designing, building, and maintaining the electricity network that connects homes, businesses, and communities across the country.
With over 1000 engineers, quantity surveyors and related technical professionals, ESB is dedicated to investing in engineering related expertise and developing critical skills to support Ireland’s future growth and development.
ESB’s Technical Graduate Programme is designed for STEM graduates with less than two years’ experience, offering structured development, real responsibility, and the opportunity to contribute to our Net Zero by 2040 strategy. At ESB, we believe our people are the driving force behind everything we do - today and into the future. That’s why investing in your growth, development and potential isn’t just part of our strategy, it’s at the very heart of it.
The programme has a wide variety of opportunities:
You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, quantity surveyors and technical professionals on projects that matter.
What You’ll Work On:
Delivering energy infrastructure projects for Ireland, with opportunities to be involved at every stage of the project lifecycle
Designing, planning and building the electricity network of the future
Helping to shape ESB's generation fleet on site, ensuring the safety, reliability and resilience of our thermal and renewable energy facilities
Supporting Ireland's largest private telecoms network, helping keep ESB's infrastructure connected and operating safely
Supporting ESB’s customers to optimise their energy use & develop sustainable energy solutions
Our bespoke Early Career Technical Talent Programme includes:
Structured, timely learning and development through formal as well as on-the-job opportunities
Work assignments giving appropriate breath of learning to facilitate career progression
Performance targets set to challenge & develop you while you contribute to ESB’s strategy
Mentoring & career support to enable you to find the right career in the company
Social networking to develop peer supports & relationships across ESB
In addition:
As an employee on our Technical Graduate Programme, you will enjoy our many benefits including a competitive salary and bonus, performance related promotions and a comprehensive benefits package built on the four pillars of reward, career, community, and wellbeing.
Location
Nationwide
What We Look For:
A Masters, Honours or Ordinary degree (or near completion in 2027) in Electrical/Telecoms, Civil/Structural, Mechanical/Energy Engineering or Quantity Surveying, with a minimum Second Class Honours Grade 1 (2.1) result
Excellent analytical skills combined with the ability to learn quickly
Proven ability to deliver results in a fast-paced team environment
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Flexibility regarding work location (for your development you may need to change work location during the programme)
Your CV should be no longer than 2 pages and clearly outline the following:
Details of ALL your qualifications including titles, institutions, years of commencement and (projected) completion with your results to date
Your relevant modules and academic projects
All your work experience
Any relevant external interests / pursuits
A contact telephone number (with voicemail enabled)
A valid email address to reach you on
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement
ESB is committed to being an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all sections of society and ensure that no one is discriminated against on the grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnicity or nationality, disability, age, citizenship, marital status, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation or gender identity, or any other basis as protected by law.
Applicants who anticipate requiring assistance or reasonable accommodations for any part of the application or interview process may contact, in confidence, recruitment@esb.ie.
About ESB
Join us in our mission to achieve a net-zero electricity system by 2040. ESB is Ireland’s leading energy utility, with activities spanning electricity generation, transmission and distribution, energy supply, energy services and international consultancy. Operating in Ireland, Northern Ireland and Great Britain, we invest over €1 billion each year to deliver a new energy future based on reliable, affordable zero-carbon electricity.

Job Description
Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Customer Service Representative to join our evolving Hong Kong Customer Care Center team and help shape the future of global commerce.
What you’ll own
Handle inbound and outbound merchant calls, resolving inquiries related to authorization, payments, statements, and account maintenance with a high first-call resolution rate
Build strong merchant relationships by delivering consistent, professional, and personalized one-stop service experiences
Collaborate with internal teams to identify and implement timely, effective solutions for merchant issues
Maintain up-to-date product and process knowledge to ensure accurate, compliant, and efficient support
Contribute to customer experience improvements by sharing feedback and participating in call center initiatives
What you’ll bring
Minimum 1 year of customer service or call center experience, with proven ability to meet service KPIs (e.g., response time, resolution rate, customer satisfaction)
Fluency in English and Mandarin (spoken and written) to communicate effectively with overseas banks and merchants
Strong communication skills with excellent telephone etiquette and a professional, customer-focused approach
Demonstrated ability to remain calm under pressure, multitask, and resolve issues efficiently
Willingness and flexibility to work shifts, including weekends and public holidays
It’s a bonus if you have
Experience in payment processing, banking, or financial services environments
Prior exposure to CRM or call center systems and performance dashboards
Ability to speak Cantonese or additional languages
About the team
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
What makes a Globalpayer?
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.
Customer Service Representative
Our Benefits
Explore the benefits we offer in China
My Health
We offer access to medical coverage that supports the health and wellbeing for you and your family.
My Money
In addition to base salary, you may be eligible for bonuses and/or equity awards, determined by role, level, impact, and our policies.
My Lifestyle
We have a dedicated Wellness Week each year – which includes an extra paid day off - so you can take time to relax, recharge and invest in your wellbeing.
My Family
FLEX, our family inclusion community, offers support for all Globalpayers at every stage, from raising families to caring for loved ones.
My Time Off
We offer paid time off and public holidays so you can rest, recharge and spend time on what matters most.
Application steps
Submit Your Application
Here's where we'll learn a little about you, why you want to join Global Payments, and why you'd be a good addition to our team. You'll also need to upload your resume and a cover letter too.
Application Review
Once you’ve submitted your application, Globalpayers will review it and see if you’re a good match for the role, team and culture. If you’re successful, we'll invite you for an interview where we can get to know each other better.
Interview with a Globalpayer
This is the time where we get to know you better, and your opportunity to learn more about us. The best way to thrive is to bring your whole self to the conversation. We’ll ask about your skills and experiences, as well as your career aspirations. Depending on the role, you might have multiple interviews with various Globalpayers.
Offer and Onboarding
The exciting part! If you’re the best candidate, your recruiter will be in touch to confirm your offer. If you accept, we’ll walk you through the next steps of what you can expect during your background check and onboarding process to get you ready to become an official Globalpayer.
