Job Title:       Commercial Finance Analyst
Function:    Ornua Foods Europe
Reports to: Finance Manager
Location: Grattan House, Dublin
_____________________________________________________________________
Ornua is a leading dairy co-operative which sells premium dairy products globally on behalf of its Member Co-operatives, Ireland’s dairy processors and, in turn, Irish dairy farmers.
Ornua has revenues of €3.4 billion and is supported by a global team of approximately 2,800 employees. The Group operates as a commercial organisation across 10 business units, including 12 production facilities located in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
The commercial organisation is responsible for the marketing and sales of Ornua’s consumer brands including Ireland’s most successful food export: Kerrygold. Consumer markets are served by production facilities in Ireland, Germany and the UK and by in-market Sales & Marketing Teams in Asia, Germany, Ireland, MEA, Poland, Spain, rest of Europe and North and Latin America.
It also manages the procurement of Irish and non-Irish dairy products, the sale of dairy ingredients to food manufacturing and foodservice customers globally, and the implementation of de-risking and trading strategies to manage market volatility. These activities are supported by production facilities and in-market teams in Europe, North America, the Middle East and Africa.
WHY THIS ROLE IS VALUABLE
The Commercial Finance Analyst will be based in Dublin, and will report directly to the Finance Manager, Ornua Foods Europe. The ideal candidate for this role would have strong commercial experience and a good understanding of how a P&L works and the key levers that will affect and improve profitability. They would have a proven track record with pricing and optimizing trade expenditure.
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:
Commercial Analyst
Pricing and commercial support
Work closely with Finance manager Foods Europe & team on projects requiring finance support
Enable decision making through evaluation of new business opportunities including new product and market launches
Analyse and advise upon trade investment decisions to help guide the commercial team.
Financial Performance Management
Deliver monthly analysis of results and suggest corrective actions to be taken to deliver EBITA targets.
Prepare periodic (weekly, monthly, quarterly as appropriate) reporting on performance by market, region, product category, customer etc. and provide financial insights
Provide strong balance sheet and working capital management by tracking spend, monitoring Accounts Receivable, highlighting slow moving inventory and tracking accruals and reserves
Perform variance analysis to Budget and provide commercial narrative on causes of variance
Budgeting and Forecasting
Coordinate annual budget process for Foods Europe, delivering a clearly articulated and initiative driven business plan
Lead preparation of detailed quarterly forecast (3+9, 6+6 and 9+3) throughout the year
Lead preparation of 5/6 Year strategic plans
Prepare monthly Flash forecasts
Other
Support for project and other ad hoc task as required
KEY REQUIREMENTS:
Qualified Accountant (CIMA/ACCA/ACA)
Experience operating in a commercial finance role, working closely with non-Finance functions
Demonstratable influencing skills
Ability to oversee and drive change
Good team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Commercial experience with astute well-developed analytical skills
Ornua Core Competencies
Customer Focus: Advocates for the customer, balances customer and business needs, and spots opportunities for growth.
Forward-Looking: Helps others to accept change, implements change, and looks ahead to anticipate change.
Curious: Open to asking questions and willing to learn and continuously improve.
Working Together: Encourages co-operation in own team and supports cross-functional working.

Job Description:
We are seeking a professional DBA with the technical skills and knowledge that extends across Application/ Server/ Storage/ Network technologies to administer a large, complex production DB environment and troubleshoot and provide system level guidance/ solutions. The role also performs effective centralized database administration for multiple databases globally. This includes Oracle databases for production, testing, and staging environments across the company. This opportunity will suit an Oracle DBA who enjoys providing technical guidance and who can play a key role in supporting and driving forward our database developments. We are a passionate, forward-thinking, innovative company where things are always happening. We’re looking for people who work quickly, are competitive self-starters, smart and do what is needed.

Design, develop, implement, and maintain our core Oracle applications. Maintain our SQL / PLSQL processes.
Ensure DB availability. Proactively manage and maintain security standards and controls.
Actively seek to optimize and simplify our architecture.
Take ownership of performance and capacity monitoring aspects of the DB.
Execution of data migration jobs and scripts as required.
Assist the infrastructure team in sizing hardware used for the DB. Support and collaborate with product developers.
Contribute to the creation and maintenance of disaster recovery plans. Create a reliable backup strategy.
Ensure database backups are appropriately. executed and periodic restorations are exercised to ensure backup quality.
Determine and document DB policies, procedures and standards.
Performance testing and evaluation to ensure data security, privacy and integrity. Identification of bottle necks and deadlock issues.

Required skills
Ideally Oracle Certified DB Professional, experience with Oracle, preferably in a lead role. Experience should include
DB design (modelling and normalization), capacity planning, performance tuning, storage management, back-up and recovery, managing schemas,report generation and DB clustering technologies.
Operating system experience in Linux.
Oracle management tools (Data Guard, RMAN, Data pump, Golden Gate).
Partitioning.• Architecture design principles.
Good problem solver focused and dedicated developer with ability to work on your own as well as with a team.
Hands on experience with DB standards and end user applications-translating capacity requirements into infrastructure deployment technology.
Strong practical experience of ORACLE in a production RAC (ASM) environment
Must be a self-starter with a strong attention to detail.

Job Description:
Role/Service Category: Battery Cell Process Engineer, L1 (entry level) - TVC
Experience :1-2 years
The Battery Cell Process Engineer (Pilot Line / Prototyping) will be supporting the
fabrication and prototyping of next-generation battery technology for high-energy
applications. The vendor will support senior process and cell design engineers by
operating and maintaining lab-scale pilot line equipment, building pouch cells
systematically, optimizing cell assembly parameters, and ensuring high manufacturing
quality and repeatability across experimental builds.
Services and Deliverables
• Support end-to-end lab-scale pouch cell fabrication, including slurry mixing, electrode coating, calendering, slitting/die cutting, precision stacking, tab welding, pouch sealing, electrolyte filling, and formation.
• Operate, calibrate, and maintain pilot line equipment, tooling, dry rooms, and glove boxes to maintain baseline process capability.
• Execute Design of Experiments (DOEs) for process optimization, identifying critical process parameters (CPPs) to improve cell yield, uniformity, and energy density.
• Perform in-line quality inspections (e.g., thickness uniformity, loading density, alignment checks, seal integrity) and log fabrication metrics into tracking databases.
• Troubleshoot fabrication defects (e.g., coating pinholes, delamination, stacking misalignment, poor wetting) and work with senior engineers to implement corrective actions.
• Document Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), assembly traveler logs, and safety protocols for new chemistries and form factors.
Minimum Qualifications (Reference only)
• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical
• Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• 1+ years of practical experience operating lab-scale pilot line equipment for pouch cell fabrication.
• Hands-on laboratory or cleanroom/dry room experience handling battery materials, chemicals, and mechanical assembly tools.
• Direct experience or coursework involving lithium-ion cell manufacturing processes (e.g., slurry preparation, slot-die/doctor-blade coating, calendering, stacking, electrolyte filling, etc.).
• Strong documentation skills, attention to detail in handling delicate pouch cell components, and adherence to lab safety/hazardous materials handling protocols.
Preferred Qualifications (Reference only)
• Working knowledge of pouch cell fabrication equipment, including tab welding, and electrolyte filling/sealing equipment.
• Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC), yield analysis, and basic data analysis tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB, JMP, Excel).
• Understanding of how upstream process variations impact downstream cell quality and electrochemical performance.
Mandatory Skills: EV Battery Management System .
Experience: 3-5 Years .
The expected compensation for this role ranges from $60,000 to $140,000 .
Final compensation will depend on various factors, including your geographical location, minimum wage obligations, skills, and relevant experience. Based on the position, the role is also eligible for Wipro's standard benefits including a full range of medical and dental benefits options, disability insurance, paid time off (inclusive of sick leave), other paid and unpaid leave options.
Applicants are advised that employment in some roles may be conditioned on successful completion of a post-offer drug screening, subject to applicable state law.

description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Futureforce University Recruiting 
 Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. Our interns and new graduates work on real projects that affect how our business runs, giving them the opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of our company. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. We offer job shadowing, mentorship programs, talent development courses, and much more. 
 
 Job Category 

Finance

 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 About Finance Pathways: 
As part of our continued investment in early-career talent, our Finance Early Graduate Rotation Program develops future leaders in Finance by giving you structured exposure across multiple functional areas, hands-on project experience, and meaningful mentorship. You will be a member of a small cohort, participating in four six-month rotations in key Finance disciplines, working with senior leaders, and helping to shape how this program continues to grow and evolve.
 
 T his role is only open to those who are current or prior Salesforce interns. All others who do not meet this criteria will not be considered.

 Strong communication skills (verbal and written)
 Proven ability to collaborate across teams and adapt in fast-changing environments
 Intellectual curiosity, growth mindset, and comfort operating in ambiguity
 Strong Interest in using AI tools to optimize, automate, and improve Finance processes
 Preferred (but not required): 
 Prior internship or work experience in Finance or accounting
 Experience with Excel/Google Sheets, financial modeling, or analytics tools
 Involvement in extracurriculars, leadership roles, or projects that demonstrate initiative

 Breadth & depth: Gain broad exposure across multiple Finance domains to find your niche

title: Manufacturing Technician Traineeship
description:
Job Details: 
 
 Job Description:  Manufacturing Technician Traineeship 
 
 Location: Intel Ireland, Leixlip, Co. Kildare   

 Training Partner: Dundalk Institute of Technology (DkIT )   

 Qualification: Higher Certificate in Manufacturing Engineering (Level 6, NFQ)   

 Duration: 23 months (including two x  15 week academic blocks in DkIT )   

 Employment Type: Full-Time Paid Traineeship   

 
 About the Opportunity   

 Intel Ireland, in partnership with Dundalk Institute of Technology ( DkIT ), is offering a unique paid traineeship for individuals looking to launch a career in high-tech manufacturing. This 23-month programme combines full-time paid employment with academic study, leading to a nationally recognised Higher Certificate in Manufacturing Engineering (Level 6, NFQ) .   

 
 No prior semiconductor or manufacturing experience is required . We welcome applications from school leavers and those seeking a career change.   

   

 What You Will Do   

 Working alongside experienced engineers and technicians, you will:   

 Develop practical technical skills within a high-tech semiconductor manufacturing environment   

 
 Support equipment troubleshooting, maintenance and optimisation activities   

 
 Assist with process improvement and problem-solving initiatives   

 
 Learn about automation, robotics and advanced manufacturing technologies   

 
 Work with engineering documentation, procedures and technical drawings   

 
 Collaborate across manufacturing, engineering, quality and operations teams   

 
 Meet all academic and workplace learning requirements throughout the programme   

 
   

 What You Will Gain   

 Competitive salary throughout the programme   

 
 Fully funded Level 6 Higher Certificate in Manufacturing Engineering ( DkIT )   

 

 Hands-on industry experience from day one   

 
 Dedicated mentoring and structured coaching   

 
 Exposure to advanced manufacturing and automation technologies   

 
 Potential long-term career opportunities at Intel Ireland upon successful completion   

 

 
 
 Qualifications: Who Can Apply   

 We believe great talent comes from many different backgrounds . This traineeship is open to three distinct groups of applicants:   
 

 🎓 School Leavers   

 If you have recently completed your Leaving Certificate and are looking to earn while you learn rather than pursue a traditional college route, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.   

 Minimum 160 CAO points   

 
 Five Leaving Certificate subjects at Grade O6/H7 or above   

 
 Mathematics is required   

 ​ 

 🔄 Career Changers   

 If you are ready to take your career in a new direction, we want to hear from you. You do not need a Leaving Certificate to apply. We recognise that life and work experience are valuable, and we welcome applicants who can demonstrate :

Ready to take your career global?
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Senior Dispute Analyst to join our ever evolving Disputes Operations team and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you will play a critical part in protecting clients, cardholders and the business by driving fair, accurate and timely dispute resolutions across the payments ecosystem. Your expertise will help strengthen trust in every transaction, ensure compliance with card network and regulatory requirements, and uncover insights that improve operational performance and customer experiences. Drive successful dispute outcomes by leading complex chargeback and arbitration cases, ensuring accurate resolutions that protect clients, cardholders and the business while meeting critical industry timelines.

Influence business performance through insights and recommendations that enhance compliance, reduce financial exposure and support informed decision-making across dispute operations.

Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 2-3 years of relevant experience in dispute resolution, chargebacks, card payments operations and banking experience .
Proven ability to analyze complex transaction activity, interpret findings and make sound decisions that deliver accurate and compliant outcomes.
Strong working knowledge of card network regulations and industry dispute processes, with the ability to apply requirements confidently in real-world situations.
Demonstrated success managing competing priorities, exercising initiative and maintaining high levels of accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence outcomes, build trust and support colleagues across teams.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Locations- Dublin, London (Bishopsgate), Munich

 

About the role

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our dynamic Underwriting Technical Transformation team within the Health Insurance Line of business. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving innovation and data-driven decision-making in underwriting and pricing.

 

As a Data Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our centralized data analytics function, which supports technical areas such as underwriting, pricing, and commercial. You will work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including Data Science, Data Program, Portfolio Monitoring, Pricing and Underwriting, to design, build and implement robust data pipelines in order to deliver actionable insights that enhance business performance and customer outcomes.

 

What you will do

 

  • Support and participate in the build and delivery of a clear roadmap for the creation and modernization of a robust data environment aimed at ensuring commercial and strategic success for the business
  • Technically support the design, construction and maintenance of data for the business
  • Understand and implement database and data engineering concepts and terminology, design principles and elements in order to deliver data and analytics
  • Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines in order to automate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes
  • Coordination of data projects with different levels of complexity depending on existing methods, processes and tools
  • Collaborate and engage with Data Program and Data Science teams to support the creation, maintenance and enhancement of reports, tools, datasets and dashboards to facilitate analysis and ongoing review of KPIs, e.g. leveraging Power BI
  • Understand the data relationships that exist between the business processes and systems. In turn apply this knowledge when interpreting the information requirements from the business
  • Perform in-depth data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for optimization in pricing & underwriting processes.
  • Deliver data outputs into a format for presentation to senior management
  • Gather, interpret, identify gaps and translate business MI and reporting requirements into solutions
  • Manages and coordinates stakeholders and builds a robust communication structure for data-related projects
  • Advises stakeholders and actively clarifies their expectations and requirements
  • Ability to assume responsibility for change, communication, quality and risk management
  • AI Readiness  Work effectively in an environment shaped by artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, data, analytics and cloud-based tools, using insights responsibly with our standards of data governance, security and ethical use.

 

What you will need

 

  • Bachelor or above in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Computer Science) from top tier university
  • Proven relevant experience (min. 3 years) in data analysis, preferably within the insurance or healthcare sector.
  • Hands-on experience in writing maintainable and testable production-grade Python in a collaborative approach
  • Strong proficiency with direct exposure to SQL/ SQL optimization, Git version control, CI/CD practices as well as data visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). VBA would be useful
  • Excellent analytical skills (capable of understanding complex data structures, organize and structure data extracts) with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Works with little guidance and direction and performs majority of tasks independently.
  • High attention to detail including a commitment to accuracy of work.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complicated processes and concepts to non-experts and to work effectively with diverse cross-functional stakeholders.
  • A proactive mindset with a passion for driving change and innovation through data.

 

Why join us

This is more than just a data analytics role – it’s an opportunity to make a tangible impact on the future of health insurance underwriting. You’ll be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous improvement, all while working in a fast-paced and evolving industry.

If you’re ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role where your expertise in data analytics can truly make a difference, we’d love to hear from you!

 

How We Hire 

Allianz Partners does not accept unsolicited CV’s or approaches from agencies. We only work with partners on our approved supplier lists, under contract. Any unsolicited submission will not be considered.

Fast Track To Consulting
Kick-start your finance consulting career through Capgemini’s Fast Track To Consulting program
Are you looking to embark on an exciting journey of dynamic and challenging projects? Would you like to help craft innovative solutions that drive business success for the world’s largest companies? Do you want to elevate your career through a continuous journey of personal and professional development? Then Capgemini’s Fast Track to Consulting (FTTC) program might be for you.
Make it real
Discover our Fast Track to Consulting program
About the program
Our FTTC program functions as your entry point into the dynamic world of Finance and Accounting (F&A), giving you practical consulting experience that has a real impact for individuals, businesses, and wider society.
As a member of our Intelligent Finance and Accounting (IFAO) team, the FTTC program will enable you to gain transferable skills that will help you to grow into an experienced junior IFAO consultant in just 12 months.
The program also gives you the chance to fuel your own growth through a continuous journey of personal and professional development, empowering you to take on diverse roles and engage with clients according to your preferences and strengths.
It does this through providing ongoing coaching and regular reviews from a dedicated buddy, mentor, and manager who support and guide you through the dynamic and diverse environment of Capgemini’s business world. This will ensure you continue to elevate your career and further enrich your experience at Capgemini long after the program has ended.
Registration opening soon
How it works

Consulting
Project management
Technology consulting
Change management
Transition management

Research and analytics
Processes optimization and continues improvement
Project and team management
Tools and platforms implementation
Solution shaping
Problem-solving
Project tracking
Latest market trends awareness including technology (AI, agentic AI)

“For me, the program created space to make real use of my strengths while trying myself in different types of work, from project management to technical business analysis. It showed me where I add the most value and how my skills carry across consulting work.” – Zuzanna Piwowarczyk

It provides a wide range of foundations to multiple concepts, a clear learning and development structure, and a great network of colleagues. There is plenty of room for specialisation and a clear progression path both during in after the program.” – Joshua Stephens

Who we are looking for

A bachelor’s degree or equivalent, with the capacity to understand, interpret, and translate data into clear insights.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence to speak up, ask the right questions, and clearly articulate ideas to both clients and internal stakeholders.
Exceptional organisational skills, the capacity to work autonomously and an ability to understand a client’s requests and business requirements.

Very good practical knowledge and skills of MS Office package (Power Point, Excel, Word).

Strong commercial awareness, with an interest in understanding business drivers and client value.
Adaptable and resilient/flexible to change
Openness to global travel and variable working hours, as required by project needsst

What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
At Irish Life, our purpose is to help people build better futures. Our company values shape everything we do and underpin our vision of being the driving force behind Ireland’s financial, physical, and mental well-being.
We believe in doing the right thing —acting with integrity and making fair, responsible decisions. We aim high , setting ambitious goals and constantly f ind better ways to innovate and improve. Our customers are at the heart of everything we do , and we are dedicated to understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.  We believe that as a team we work best together , in a supportive, collaborative environment where every idea and contribution is valued.
About us
Keyridge Asset Management Limited (formerly Irish Life Investment Managers), the investment management company part of Great-West Lifeco (GWL) Group, manages assets of over €150bn.  Keyridge provides investment products and solutions to both institutional and retail clients, offering a full range of active and indexed funds together with tailored investment solutions meeting specific clients’ objectives.
The Team
We are looking to appoint a Specialist within the Investment Services area.  This area is made up three smaller teams:
The Pricing Team which is responsible for the production, validation and explanation of daily fund valuations.  The team acts as the last line of defence in fund accounting and a critical function within Group Operations.
The Reconciliations team which is responsible for the completion of cash and holdings reconciliations to ensure that internal records match custody / counterparty records.
The External Managers Team which is responsible for the completion of operational reviews for new external manager fund arrangements and the monitoring and reporting of these arrangements.
Working as part of the wider team, this is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to gain exposure to an array of varied and diverse processes to develop their knowledge and skillset with excellent exposure to various stakeholders within the business.
What you will help us to achieve
Reporting to the Senior Manager – Investment Servicing, this role will work across the Pricing, Reconciliations and External Managers teams to support business change, process improvement and operational resilience. Key responsibilities include:
Working across the Investment Servicing teams to analyse current processes, understand business requirements and support the delivery of practical change.
Partnering with stakeholders to document requirements, map processes, assess impacts and agree clear outcomes for projects, enhancements and smaller change initiatives.
Developing a strong understanding of Investment Servicing processes, systems, controls and products, and using this knowledge to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality and risk management.
Taking ownership of assigned changes from initial assessment through to completion, including planning, tracking actions, managing dependencies, escalating issues and supporting implementation.
Supporting incident reporting, root cause analysis and the implementation of preventative actions to strengthen controls and reduce operational risk.
Acting as a subject matter expert for agreed processes, providing guidance to Analysts and supporting training, onboarding and knowledge sharing across the teams.
Representing Investment Servicing in cross-functional forums and helping ensure that team requirements, risks and operational considerations are clearly understood.
Maintaining and improving procedural documentation, process maps and other key materials for core activities.
Assisting teams with production of daily service, as required.
What you will need to be successful in the role
The ideal applicant will bring a blend of analytical capability, operational understanding and strong stakeholder management skills. They will possess the following skills and knowledge:
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex processes, identify issues and recommend practical solutions.
A proactive approach to identifying, understanding and mitigating operational risks, with a strong focus on controls, accuracy and attention to detail.

title: QC Planning & Laboratory Systems Specialist
description:
Job Description
 
 The QC Planning & Laboratory Systems Specialis t is responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and optimization of Quality Control (QC) Release and Stability laboratory activities supporting manufacturing operations.
 This role combines laboratory planning, capacity management, data analysis, and laboratory systems expertise to ensure efficient sample flow, optimal resource utilization, and on-time execution of testing activities within a regulated environment.
 The successful candidate will manage laboratory demand planning, capacity forecasting, scheduling, KPI reporting, and contract laboratory coordination while leveraging GLIMS and related digital tools to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
 We are looking for a proactive and collaborative individual who can deliver results in a dynamic environment, leverage data to drive decisions, champion quality and compliance, and contribute to continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives across QC Operations.
 
 Primary Responsibilities 
 Laboratory Planning & Scheduling 
 Develop and maintain integrated laboratory plans supporting QC Release, Stability, Validation, PPQ, and ad hoc testing activities.

 Coordinate sample demand forecasts and testing priorities with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality Assurance, Stability, and other stakeholders.

 Create and maintain daily, weekly, monthly, and long-range laboratory schedules.

 Balance laboratory workloads across analysts, instruments, testing streams, and contract laboratories.

 Monitor execution against laboratory schedules and proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and capacity constraints.

 Support prioritization of laboratory activities to ensure critical business timelines are achieved.

 Capacity Planning & Resource Management 
 Develop and maintain laboratory capacity models incorporating analyst availability, instrument utilization, sample volumes, and turnaround time requirements.

 Conduct short-, medium-, and long-term forecasting to support operational and strategic planning.

 Perform scenario planning and risk assessments to support changing manufacturing demands and business priorities.

 Collaborate with laboratory leadership to identify resource requirements and mitigation strategies.

 Laboratory Systems & Data Analytics 
 Utilize GLIMS or equivalent LIMS and associated laboratory systems to support sample management, scheduling, reporting, and operational planning activities.

 Support continuous enhancement of laboratory planning tools, workflows, and digital solutions.

 Develop, track, and analyze laboratory KPIs including turnaround time, throughput, workload, schedule adherence, and capacity utilization.

 Generate reports, dashboards, and performance metrics using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other business intelligence tools.

 Translate laboratory data into actionable insights to support operational decision-making and continuous improvement.

 Contract Laboratory Coordination 
 Coordinate external contract laboratory testing activities and associated deliverables.

 Monitor contract laboratory performance against agreed timelines and service level expectations.

 Identify and escalate risks while supporting the implementation of mitigation plans.

 Support effective workload balancing between internal and external testing resources.

 Quality & Continuous Improvement 
 Ensure planning activities comply with GMP requirements, company procedures, and quality standards.

 Support inspection readiness activities as required.

 Participate in continuous improvement and laboratory digitization initiatives.

 Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning processes.

 Promote a culture of compliance, quality, and operational excellence.

 
 Qualifications, Skills & Experience 
 Required 
 Bachelor's Degree in Science, Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related discipline.

 3+ years' experience in a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, diagnostics, medical device, or laboratory environment.

 Experience supporting Quality Control laboratory operations, planning, scheduling, or capacity management activities.

 Experience using GLIMS or another Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS).

 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

 Strong analytical, planning, and problem-solving capabilities.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Preferred 
 Experience supporting QC Release or Stability laboratories.

 Experience in biologics manufacturing or testing environments.

 Experience with Power BI, dashboard development, or data visualization.

 Experience in laboratory digitization or continuous improvement initiatives.

 Experience with capacity modelling or contract laboratory coordination.

 Knowledge of GMP, data integrity, investigations, and CAPA processes.

 
 Within our Company in Ireland, we work at the forefront of science and technology to advance manufacturing excellence and R&D across our Irish sites and global company network. We’re always looking to make a difference for people, patients, and communities – from our Company in Ireland to the world.
 Our facility in Carlow site broke ground in 2008 and is a filling site for the launch and commercial supply of vaccines, biologics and small molecule drug product. Since its initial launch, the site has attracted significant internal investment and is now home to a number of state-of-the-art production facilities, laboratories and temperature-controlled warehousing units. The Carlow site is a significant employer in the South East region and attracts high performing talent through close collaborations with universities and colleges in the region.

Capacity Planning, Data Analysis Reporting, Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), Laboratory Information Systems (LIS), Laboratory Management, Laboratory Planning, Laboratory Software, Stakeholder Management 
 Preferred Skills: 
Data Visualization Tools, GMP Compliance, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (BI) Data Visualization

title: Recruiting Coordinator Apprentice
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 About Future Pathways 
 At Salesforce, we acknowledge that talent is everywhere, but opportunity is not. Millions of driven young people entering the workforce are disconnected from the economic mainstream, at a time when companies recognize a growing need for diverse and skilled employees. The goal of our Future Pathways programs is to create opportunities for employment at Salesforce or within the Salesforce ecosystem. Since 2009, we’ve supported over 1,400 diverse and ambitious young professionals in launching their careers with Salesforce. The diverse perspectives from our different programs fuel impactful business growth.
 
 Job Category 

Fixed Term & Temporary 
 Job Details 

 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 
 
 
 
 Role Description: 
In the Recruiting Coordinator role you will successfully partner with both our Talent Delivery and Hiring teams in order to provide best in class candidate experience. You will be a subject matter expert in all areas of the interview lifecycle and will use your expertise to influence and drive an optimum interview experience for all partners. This is a high-impact role which will provide exposure to all business units within Salesforce at both a regional and global level. In addition to interview scheduling, this role will provide the opportunity to get involved in high potential projects thus maximising opportunity for internal growth.

 Responsibilities 
 Responsible for the Interview Scheduling Process across multiple business units at both a regional & global level. This includes (but is not limited to) scheduling and coordinating phone, virtual, panel and onsite interviews varying in degrees of complexity.
 Manage all logistics for the interview process, inclusive of coordinating travel (flights & accommodation) & processing candidate reimbursements. This role will also be accountable for greeting candidates for onsite interviews as per the RC’s designated office hub. All will be done whilst ensuring both candidate and hiring team experience remain top of mind.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Database Migration Service
description:
Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate database workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.
In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow.

 Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services
 

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable, serverless microservices that power the migration lifecycle - assessment, schema conversion, data movement;
- Build agentic workflows that integrate with developer tools (Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) and enable natural language-driven database migrations;
- Own operational excellence for your components: define SLAs, build dashboards, create runbooks, and drive root-cause analysis during incidents;
- Contribute to system architecture decisions, write design documents, and participate in code reviews that raise the quality bar for the team;
- Collaborate cross-functionally with solution architects, product managers, and partner teams (RDS, Aurora, AI/ML) to deliver customer-facing features;
- Mentor SDE Is through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
- Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives.

A day in the life
You might start the day with participating in a design review for a new feature: parallel data movement for multi-terabyte databases. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize downtime during cutover windows. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the serverless orchestration layer that surfaces only under high concurrency.

About the team
You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations - they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place.

This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise across three of the most transformative domains in modern engineering: cloud computing, database technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice ( https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page ) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Transition Year Programme
description:

Transition Year Programme
Inspiring Futures: Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s Transition Year Programme
Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland’s Transition Year (TY) Work Placement Programme offers students a unique and immersive introduction to the world of finance and professional services. Designed to inspire, educate, and empower, the programme continues to grow in popularity, earning a reputation as one of the most rewarding TY experiences in the country.
Our programme runs once a year in the spring. The session spans one week and is limited in participants, ensuring a focused and personalised experience. Throughout the week, students take part in interactive workshops, collaborate in project teams, and present their final work to an audience of Cantor Fitzgerald employees, teachers, and family members. On completion, participants receive a certificate of achievement—an excellent addition to any CV and a meaningful way to showcase their experience and skills.
What truly sets the Cantor Fitzgerald TY Programme apart is its emphasis on personal connection and tailored support. Students are placed in small groups and assigned dedicated mentors who guide them through the week. This structure provides a practical, behind-the-scenes view of the financial services sector while fostering meaningful relationships and peer learning. As one student reflected, “We came in as strangers, but left as friends.”
In addition to gaining professional insight, students also develop essential life skills such as communication, public speaking, collaboration, and problem-solving. Parents consistently note the boost in confidence and motivation their children display after the programme, often remarking on the positive impact it has on their outlook and ambitions.
At Cantor Fitzgerald Ireland, we are committed to creating a welcoming, inclusive environment where students are encouraged to step outside their comfort zones, explore new possibilities, and realise their potential—whether in finance or any other field.
Dates for 2026/2027 Academic Year : 12 th – 16 th April 2027
Programme full, cancellation list only
With continued evolution and a strong focus on quality, inclusion, and engagement, our TY Programme is designed to offer an experience that goes beyond careers—fostering confidence, curiosity, and lifelong growth.

Job Details: 
 
 Job Description:  The Role and Impact 
As an AMHS Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will be immersed in hands-on projects that enhance manufacturing processes and support factory operations. You'll contribute to evaluating equipment performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing corrective actions to optimize production efficiency and product quality. This role offers a valuable opportunity to develop skills and gain real-world experience in a collaborative and innovative environment.

 Business group 
You'll join Intel's IFA AMHS engineering and Operations organization, which plays a vital role in ensuring the seamless production of cutting-edge technologies. This group is dedicated to driving operational excellence, advancing AMHS manufacturing capabilities, and ensuring quality and reliability in Intel's products. By joining this team, you'll be contributing to Intel's broader mission of powering the future through innovation.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Evaluate AMHS equipment performance and identify opportunities for improvement.

 Assist in implementing corrective actions for AMHS equipment and process optimization.

 Assist in coordinating equipment installations, upgrades, and commissioning activities. 

 Collaborate with AMHS engineering and AMHS operations teams to enhance production efficiency.

 Collect, analyze, and present operational and engineering data using appropriate tools and software. 

 Support process improvements and contribute to quality assurance initiatives.

 Develop technical documentation to support AMHS manufacturing processes.

 Review engineering drawings, layouts, specifications, and technical documentation. 

 Participate in cross-functional problem-solving activities to address factory challenges.

 
 
 Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications
 Working toward a bachelor's degree in a relevant field ( M echanical-, Electrical- , Mechatronics-, Manufacturing- , Automation Engineering, or a related discipline ) with demonstrated skills gained through internships, academic projects, coursework, or hands-on training.

 Fundamental understanding of manufacturing process control and improvement techniques.

 Familiarity with technical documentation and quality assurance practices.

 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Exposure to PLCs, industrial controls, robotics, or automation systems. 

 Experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar platforms. 

 Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies. 

 Experience with data analysis tools such as Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar technologies. 

 Strong communication skills and aptitude for collaborative teamwork. 

 Enthusiasm for learning and applying best practices in manufacturing engineering.

 Interest in exploring future career opportunities through hands-on experience.

 Understanding of equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, and system performance metrics. 

 Interest in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, and digital transformation technologies. 

 
 You will be required to work both in the office and the fab environment . 
 
 We encourage you to bring your passion for innovation and curiosity about manufacturing processes to Intel. Join us in shaping the future of technology through impactful contributions to our engineering teams.

We look forward to welcoming talented individuals ready to make an impact, learn, and grow with us.

title: Investment Sales Specialist
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Marsh Investment Solutions is Marsh’s investment management arm which manages in excess of $846bn globally.  The European business was established in 2006 and currently manages assets in excess of $200bn. 
 The business has experienced significant growth over the last number of years and with a strong pipeline of activity, this looks set to continue for the foreseeable future. This growth has involved an expansion into segments including insurance and wealth management as well as the traditional pensions market both locally in Ireland and globally. 

 What can you expect: 
 This is a hands-on role focused on developing your sales career with Marsh Investments. The successful candidate will prepare prospect-facing materials, maintain pipeline accuracy and CRM hygiene, support the delivery of pitches and events, and help the team convert opportunities. This is an excellent role for someone looking to build their sales experience and develop their career within the Marsh Ireland sales team. The chosen candidate will be expected to support the Irish Sales Leader to lead and drive sales activity via internal and external distribution channels. 

 We will rely on you to: 
 Produce and update high-quality PowerPoint presentations, pitch decks and supporting materials, ensuring consistency with our brand and messaging. 
 Draft and proofread written materials for meetings (executive summaries, proposals, agendas and meeting notes) with strong attention to detail. 
 Support the sales pipeline: update CRM records, track opportunity stages, prepare weekly reports and help prioritise next actions. 
 Coordinate internal stakeholders (investment, legal, operations, product teams) to pull together materials and responses for pitches and RFPs. 
 Support prospect meetings and pitches (in-person and virtual) — manage logistics, take notes and follow up on actions. 
 Assist with event planning (industry conferences, client roundtables, webinars) to support lead generation. 
 Carry out targeted research to identify potential prospects and prepare concise briefing notes for the sales team. 
 Manage projects and ad-hoc business development tasks as required, ensuring deadlines are met. 
 
 What you will need to have: 
 Strong PowerPoint skills and an eye for clean, professional presentation design. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication; able to draft clear, client-ready documents. 
 High attention to detail and accuracy — strong proofreading and quality-checking habits. 
 Organised and capable of managing multiple tasks with good time management. 
 Practical, driven and resilient — willing to do the groundwork and follow through on actions. 
 Comfortable working with colleagues across functions and levels; good interpersonal skills. 
 Proficient in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) and comfortable using CRM systems; quick to learn new tools. 
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Some exposure to sales support, business development, client services or operations. 
 Basic understanding of investment markets, pensions or asset management. 
 Undergraduate degree or equivalent. 
 
 Why join our team: 
 Learn the sales lifecycle and institutional client engagement from close quarters. 
 Build technical presentation skills and commercial awareness. 
 Supportive team environment with clear opportunities to broaden responsibility. 
 We support your growth through professional development, engaging work, and supportive leadership. 
 We promote a vibrant, inclusive culture where collaboration drives innovation and impact for colleagues, clients, and communities. 
 Our global scale offers diverse career opportunities. 
 
 
 
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Associate, Private Credit/PEP Quality Control Financial Reporting, PFS
description:
About this role 
 
 
 Company Description 

 HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

 HPS was established in 2007 as a unit of Highbridge Capital Management, LLC (“HCM”), a subsidiary of JPMorgan Asset Management (“JPMAM”). On March 31, 2016, the senior executives of HPS acquired HPS and its subsidiaries from JPMAM and HCM (the “Transaction”.[i] Following the Transaction, JPMAM retained a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently redeemed in April 2022. In June 2018, affiliates of Dyal Capital Partners made a passive minority investment in HPS. In February 2022, an affiliate of The Guardian Life Insurance Company of America made a passive minority investment in HPS, which was subsequently increased in August 2024. On July 1, 2025, BlackRock acquired the business and assets of HPS, with 100% of consideration paid in BlackRock equity (the “HPS/BlackRock Transaction”).

 The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets.[ii] This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally,[iii] offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.                
                                                                                                                    
 Position Description 

 The Fund Reporting Associate will support the coordination, execution, and quality of financial and regulatory reporting activities for Private Credit funds. This role works closely with fund accountants to ensure accurate and timely delivery of reporting requirements.

 Responsibilities         
 Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
 Support coordination and execution of the annual financial statement audits for US Credit Funds, consisting of ~100 separate financial statements
 Partner with Fund Accounting, Finance, Operations, Legal, Compliance, Tax, and business teams.
 Coordinate with fund administrators, custodians, and other third-party service providers.
 Maintain and enhance financial reporting processes and controls. Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
 Support strategic projects and business initiatives as required
 
 Candidate Profile 
 5+ years of relevant experience in an accounting role
 Knowledge of US GAAP and investment company reporting requirements preferred
 Asset Management experience preferred
 Accounting degree preferred
 CPA or equivalent preferred
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel
 Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal supervision
 Ability to work effectively across jurisdictions
 Client service mentality toward both internal and external stakeholders
 


The salary range for Dublin is Euro 75,000 - Euro 95,000
The salary range for Luxembourg is Euro 75,000 - Euro 95,000 Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance. 
 
 Our benefits 
 
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
 
 
 Our hybrid work model 
 
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
 
 
Guidance on AI use for candidates 

 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance  on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

 About BlackRock 

 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being.  Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com . We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn , Instagram , YouTube , X , and TikTok .

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

title: Technical Coordinator-Investor AML
description:
About Northern Trust: 
 
 Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889.
 
 Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
 
 
 The Transfer Agency department provides a third party fund administration service to numerous fund management companies covering the full range of shareholder servicing functions including dealing, registration, settlements, distributions, commissions and statements.
 
 The team provides technical support to the operational areas, independent handling of complaints, undertake process reviews, co-ordinate audit visits, providing management information and analysis.
 
 The Technical Coordinator
 Supports the Team Leader in ensuring operational efficiency with respect to workflow distribution and ensuring the effective the use of staff resources.
 Carries out complex activities with significant financial, client, and/or internal business impact. Able to serve as a key subject matter expert and mentor to other more junior level employees.
 May manage daily operational activities and supervise day-to-day work of junior level employees (but not a formal management role).
 Takes responsibility for the timely and accurate completion of workload allocated including tasks processed through Northern Trust’s workflow process. • Actively participates in the review of investor documentation and information in adherence with Northern Trust’s AML processes and procedures.
 Works with colleagues and line management in reviewing such investor documentation and efficiently highlighting outstanding investor due diligence documentation (if any) to the Investor AML Department in Ireland, by agreed modes of communication, with professionalism of approach and timely escalation of material issues arising.
 Escalates and assists with resolution of more complex problems and critical issues, including those received from other Northern Trust partners (including primarily the Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland).
 Works with colleagues and line management to ensure that all queries from other Northern Trust partners (including primarily the Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland) are dealt with efficiently and professionally.
 Takes responsibility for completion of support services for Ireland & UK Investor AML processes and procedures in conjunction with Northern Trust colleagues in Ireland and provides regular, meaningful and accurate periodic updates to his/her line manager and colleagues in Bangalore, Pune and Ireland.
 Maintains strong working relationships with partners in Northern Trust Investor AML Department in Ireland.
 Works with his/her line management and other colleagues to ensure that the Investor AML support teams in Bangalore and Pune meet the required audit, risk and compliance standards as determined, from time to time, in accordance with advised changes in processes and procedures pursuant to amendments in prevailing legislation, guidance and best practice.
 Maintains an up to date knowledge of Investor AML good practice and uses this knowledge to promote enhancements to Northern Trust’s AML processes and procedures.
 Performs additional work where volume or absence requires such workload to be completed.  
 The successful candidate is required to comply, and ensure direct and indirect reports comply, with the global AML regulatory regime in which Northern Trust operates as appropriate to the above role.
 The successful candidate is expected to exercise due care and diligence, and ensure that the responsibilities of the role are organized and controlled within the ambit of regulation, compliance and risk management.
 The successful candidate is required to observe proper standards of market, business and personal conduct, demonstrating integrity in the execution of such duties.
 The ideal candidate should have a fair amount of the following skills and experience:
 Knowledge of day-to-day AML processes and procedures and the wider funds administration business.
 Previous experience in AML
 Strong organizational and communication skills.
 Effective risk management.
 Demonstrated ability to research and understand complex issues and deliver solutions agreed with line management. General knowledge of the global Investor AML regulatory environment.
 General knowledge of Microsoft Office applications relating to designated areas of responsibility.
 Bachelor’s degree with emphasis in Accounting, CA or ICWA Inter/Master degree/IAQ/IOC or equivalent a plus
 Experience in Audit/Operational Control/ Risk, Accounting / financial services/ capital markets work experience or equivalent
 Should be flexible for shifts and extended working hours.
 
 Working with Us: 
 As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability is an asset that emboldens us to explore new ideas.
 
 Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve! Join a workplace with a greater purpose.
 
 We’d love to learn more about how your interests and experience could be a fit with one of the world’s most admired and sustainable companies! Build your career with us and apply today. #MadeForGreater
 
 Reasonable accommodation 
 
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com .
 
 We hope you’re excited about the role and the opportunity to work with us. We value an inclusive workplace and understand flexibility means different things to different people.
 
 Apply today and talk to us about your flexible working requirements and together we can achieve greater.

About Kepak Foods Division 
 Kepak Foods Division have developed a portfolio of brands that are successful in the chilled convenience, ambient and frozen meat categories in the UK, Ireland and chosen European markets for both Retail and Foodservice Customers.  We have 5 Manufacturing Sites supported by shared services, with 1000 people supporting our vision to become a transformed, future proofed, profitable €0.5bn Food Business by 2030. 
  
 We are currently recruiting for a Quality Auditor (Nights) to join our New World Foods site (part of Kepak Group) in York.

 JOB PURPOSE/PRIMARY OBJECTIVE: 
 
 The QA team play a critical role in ensuring the required standards of Food Safety, Quality and Hygiene are met.  You will be required to liaise with all production areas.
 REPORTING RELATIONSHIP: Reporting to the Quality Manager
 SHIFTS Permanent Night Shift (10pm – 6am)

 Responsibilities associated with this role include, but are not limited to the following: 
 Traceability and Paperwork Auditing.
 Equipment calibration and verification.
 Hygiene Auditing of appropriate personnel, equipment and factory environment.
 Product, water and environmental sampling and testing to agreed specifications and to an agreed schedule.
 Cleaning chemical concentration testing.
 Liaising with production and/or hygiene departments to identify non-conformance and instigating corrective action.
 GMP auditing
 Requirements 
 Previous QA experience, ideally in food (2 years minimum)
 Previous night working experience
 Competent IT skills (e.g., Microsoft Office) with ability to complete electronic records accurately.
 English language skills essential
 Knowledge of paperwork and traceability systems is desirable. 
 Experience of GMP and temperature auditing/monitoring preferred.

 Benefits 
 Company Pension Scheme

 Long Service Awards -  We recognise, acknowledge and award the dedication and valuable contribution of long serving employees

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
We are excited to offer you this new opportunity within Wipro Technologies, one of the biggest brands in the industry at this moment with a well-established history in various domains.
As part of this project and a new team, your role as a Buyer will be to build and co-manage a strong relationship with our client organization and perform based on defined SLA and KPIs, within energy and utility client industry.
Responsibilities:
MDM Buyer
•    Ensuring timely and as per expected quality master data creation/modification/deletion;
•    Ensuring timely and as per expected quality SAP contract creation/modification/deletion for each LBU;
•    Assist to improve procurement and stock efficiency;
•    Assist Category Manager to implement in the various SAP systems the result of negotiations conducted globally with Vendors;
•    Price list contract identification, assistance to negotiation and deployment;
•    Responsible for meeting SLA’s as per SOW (Turn Around Time Targets for different business processes)
•    Manages the RPA supervision
•    Uses Winshuttle for mass upload the articles into SAP
•    Responsible for meeting accuracy of data as set by internal operations for the client
•    Proposes initiatives and process development activities
•    Undertake detailed master data analysis activity as directed by Master Data Manager
•    Regularly update managers and project teams with progress reports and dashboards
•    Update process documentation (SOP) whenever there are relevant changes in the process
•    Participates in project activities, testing, implementation and education to business user
•    Provides coaching and training (pre-process and general/process specific) for client and team members/newcomers.
•    Manages ad-hoc requests received from the team leader or client
PR TO PO Buyer
•    Purchasing tasks from the receipt of the Purchase Requisition (PR) through to placing and acknowledging a Purchase Order (PO);
•    Oversee the SLA & overall deliverables management;
•    Improvement upon and ensuring timely PO quality;
•    Assisting to generate savings;
•    Deliver different reports (regular and ad-hoc).
•    Optimization of stock;
•    Ensure on-time processing of Procurement transactions (RFQ, Requisition validation, PO creation, PO Amendments & PO expedites), in order to reach productivity target and keep backlog under control.
o    SAP systems to collect PR and proceed/register RFQ/PO
o    Service Now to clarify technical requests with LBUs
o    Macro Excel for the reporting and Supplier follow-up
RFX and Contract Admin Procurement Specialist
•    Ensure timely and accurate processing of RFx and Contract Management activities in accordance with defined procedures, SLAs, and quality standards.
•    Support sourcing and contract administration activities throughout the procurement lifecycle.
•    Create, manage, and follow up on RFx events, supplier communications, and required documentation.
•    Assist in contract creation, administration, maintenance, and archiving activities.
•    Support stakeholders and suppliers by providing timely updates and resolving routine process-related queries.
•    Monitor assigned requests and follow up on outstanding actions to ensure timely completion.
•    Contribute to savings and value creation initiatives through sourcing and procurement activities.
•    Utilize client systems and tools such as SAP, Ariba eSourcing, Agora, Sequana, ServiceNow, and MS Office.
•    Prepare and maintain regular and ad-hoc reports with a high level of accuracy.
•    Identify process exceptions and escalate issues when required.
Master Data Management Buyer
What will you bring?
•    Good English language skills, written and conversational;
•    Expert level Orientation in Master Data Admin processes/Contract management;
•    MS Office & Key-boarding skills;
•    Experience of working on SAP or Oracle or any Data platform.
•    Procurement Experience: 5-7 years in delivering procurement initiatives.
Nice to have & Trainable Skills:
•    Exposure to Master
