title: Quality Compliance - Quality Services Intern
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 

 Inspire and be inspired. We offer a variety of opportunities for undergraduate and post-graduate students to use your talent, skills, education and passion to help make an impact on patient’s lives – all while growing your career and  
 earning academic credit.  
   
 Our Internship Programme gives you a real opportunity to gain practical ‘hands-on’ experience, training and  shadow the experts of your chosen field. It also provides you with insight into what it’s like to work with us.   
   
 We will place you in a six, nine or twelve month Internship Programme depending on the requirements of your degree course. So, are you ready to embark on a new adventure? We can’t wait to see what you’re made of!  

 The Intern, Quality Compliance, External Manufacturing, will participate in and 
 provide support for a wide range of quality compliance activities within External Manufacturing. This includes contributing to quality compliance, quality services, inspection readiness and risk management efforts, and assisting with general departmental needs as required. The role provides broad exposure to quality practices and supports day-to-day operations in a dynamic, cross functional environment.

 Responsibilities: 
 • Support the compilation, tracking, and follow up of quality and regulatory 
 performance metrics across External Manufacturing. 
 • Where applicable, assist with the compilation of Regulatory Restriction 
 Forms and support regulatory requests received for filing applications. 
 • Work with Virtual Plant Teams to support progression of change controls 
 and other quality system activities, including deviations, CAPAs, product 
 quality complaints, documentation, audits, and inspections. 
 • Support the preparation of regulatory summaries for Annual Product 
 Quality Reports. 
 • Provide quality and regulatory support to Contract Manufacturing 
 Operations within a cross functional team, contributing to the 
 management of CMOs and ensuring alignment with applicable GMP, 
 corporate policies, and regulatory requirements. 
 • Support ongoing quality and regulatory projects, continuous improvement 
 initiatives, and Operational Excellence efforts. 
 • Assist with the progression of GMP and regulatory documents within the 
 Documentation Management System, including review, processing, and 
 authorship of quality or regulatory related procedures. 
 • Support the review and approval of site procedures and associated 
 documents as required. 
 • Engage in Quality Culture initiatives across External Manufacturing. 
 • Provide routine administrative support such as scheduling meetings, 
 preparing presentations, issuing meeting minutes, and maintaining action 
 logs. 
 • Collaborate with relevant departments to support compliance and ensure 
 effective communication across teams. 
 • Perform other ad hoc tasks as assigned by management or relevant 
 quality representatives in support of team and departmental goals.

 Qualifications, Knowledge and Skills Required 
 • Currently undertaking an undergraduate degree in a relevant scientific 
 discipline such as General Science, Biomedical Sciences, Biotechnology, 
 Analytical Science, Pharmaceutical and Biomedical Chemistry, or 
 Pharmaceutical and Industrial Chemistry.
 • Strong time management and organisational skills, with the ability to 
 manage multiple tasks and work independently using initiative.
 • Effective interpersonal, communication, presentation, and teamwork skills.
 • Proficiency in key computer applications including Word, Excel, Access 
 and PowerPoint, with the ability to collect, analyse, interpret and present 
 information clearly.
 • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced environment, balancing 
 several projects at once.
 • Flexible, motivated, energetic and collaborative, with the ability to meet 
 targets and milestones.
 • Confident public speaking skills and the ability to engage effectively with 
 others.
 • Passion for the pharmaceutical sector and innovation in healthcare.

 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

 Compensation Overview: 
2, 213.90 € per month
 Pay for this internship/co‑op position is provided in accordance with local market practices and applicable laws. Pay may be offered as an hourly rate and/or monthly stipend, or other locally compliant structure. Pay is determined based on objective factors such as academic level, relevant experience, skills, and work location.

 Interns and co‑op participants may be eligible for limited benefits depending on program structure, work location, and local requirements. Eligibility and offerings are governed by applicable policies and employment regulations.

 This is a temporary, time‑bound position intended for the duration of the internship or co‑op program and does not guarantee continued or permanent employment following program completion.

 How We Work 
 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working. 

 Supporting People with Disabilities 
 BMS is dedicated to ensuring that people with disabilities can excel through a transparent recruitment process, reasonable workplace accommodations/adjustments and ongoing support in their roles. Applicants can request a reasonable workplace accommodation/adjustment prior to accepting a job offer. If you require reasonable accommodations/adjustments in completing this application, or in any part of the recruitment process, direct your inquiries to  adastaffingsupport@bms.com . Visit  careers.bms.com/eeo-accessibility  to access our complete Equal Employment Opportunity statement.

 Candidate Rights 
 BMS will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, pursuant to applicable laws in your area.

 For roles based in Los Angeles County only:  If you live in or expect to work from Los Angeles County if hired for this position, please visit this page for important additional information:  https://careers.bms.com/california-residents/ 

 Data Protection 
 We will never request payments, financial information, or social security numbers during our application or recruitment process. Learn more about protecting yourself at  https://careers.bms.com/fraud-protection .

 Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Incident Tooling & Response
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Incident Management Service (IMS) team is building the platform that AWS uses to coordinate response during high-severity incidents. When AWS services are degraded, incident responders use IMS to detect, triage, mitigate, and resolve issues, coordinating across dozens of service teams in real time. We are building the next generation of Incident management tooling - a unified platform that must remain available and performant precisely when AWS infrastructure is unhealthy, deployed across three AWS regions with automated failover. You will own significant portions of the service architecture: the data layer, authorization system, API model, and integrations with incident automation systems. You will design and deliver components across the stack, drive cross-team technical alignment, and mentor other engineers. You need to be a strong software developer with a track record of delivering production services, and also excel in communication and technical leadership. You'll use agentic AI development to move fast from concept to production. This is an opportunity to own architecture on a high-visibility platform that is used during AWS's most critical moments.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement service components for a multi-region, multi-tenant incident management platform. Own subsystems including the data layer, authorization, and API surface. Build integrations with incident automation systems, conference bridge providers, and downstream event consumers. Drive technical design decisions, balancing reliability, performance, and delivery speed. Participate in operational support and ensure the service is resilient during the incidents it is designed to manage. Mentor other engineers and lead technical design reviews. Use agentic AI development practices to move quickly from concept to tested, production-ready code.

About the team
We are a high-performing team building the incident management platform for all of AWS. Our software is used during AWS's worst moments, so reliability is not optional. We operate what we build, and every engineer has direct visibility into how their code performs during real incidents. We value high delivery velocity, pragmatic architecture decisions, and engineers who take ownership beyond their assigned scope. We use agentic AI development practices and invest in tooling that lets engineers and agents validate changes locally before they reach the pipeline.

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
- - Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate engineering workflows
- Experience or certifications in API design, cloud architecture/deployment, service-oriented architecture, mobile development, performance optimization, databases design and related fields
- Experience with authorization systems (IAM, RBAC, or attribute-based access control)
- Experience mentoring other engineers
- Experience writing technical design documents and driving alignment across teams

title: Supply Planner ( 12 Months Fixed Term Contract )
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Senior Supply Planner role will make an impact:
 
 Based in Dublin reporting directly to Supply Chain Manager, the Senior Supply Planner is responsible for effectively managing demand and supply for commercially critical molecules for Global Markets and Global Supply Sites.  The Senior Supply planner is responsible for the inventory management and product supply from internal suppliers and working within a larger team of supply planners to service markets in the EU, Australia, New Zealand, and Emerging markets.
 The Senior Supply planner will be responsible for firming supply plans based on market requirements and in line with inventory strategies, monitoring system generated supply plans, avoiding, and minimizing any supply disruptions and maintaining service levels.
 Key responsibilities for this role include: 
 Maintain and update master data and planning parameters in Rapid Response and SAP for Rapid Response to produce best supply plan.

 Monitor and maintain reason codes for out of stocks and maintain commentary on actions plans to resolve the out of stock per SKU.

 Firm market requirements based on planning parameters (demand, safety stock, MOQ, etc) to minimize out of stocks.

 Ensure firmed supply plans/ purchase orders are executed on time by supplier.

 Develop and execute supply plans when there are upstream constraints in the supply chain (Materials, site capacities) along with internal guidelines to give each market the best supply plan.

 Manage bulk inventory in both internal and external packaging sites, making sure there is no bulk obsolescence, market requirements are met, and packaging sites meet all commitments.

 Agreeing and monitoring of suppliers’ delivery dates and escalate where issues arise.

 Manage market inventory in line with inventory strategies as agreed with senior supply chain leads.

 Determine mode of transport for shipments in line with business strategy, minimise amount transported by air and to track and monitor reason for air.

 Monitor market demand changes within managed molecules month on month, recognizing the drivers for changes and if required, to be in position to explain changes to different stakeholders.

 Support and deliver company/department goals and objectives as required.

 The minimum qualifications and experience for this role are: 
 
 Proven relevant supply chain/manufacturing experience.

 Qualification in a Business-Related discipline or Supply Chain.

 Previous Rapid Response and/ or SAP experience a distinct advantage

 Good knowledge of Microsoft Office systems essential especially Microsoft Excel.

 Successful candidates must have strong planning & analytical skills, attention to detail and excellent communication skills. They will need to work on planning process development and roll out. Successful candidates need to be change leaders in Viatris.

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits, and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives, and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.

title: Talent Development & Learning Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems . 
 
 The Purpose of the Talent Development & Learning Specialist is to: 
 Develop and execute Learning & Development strategies, programmes, and systems that build organisational capability, enhance employee performance, and support current and future business objectives. Partner with leaders to identify development needs and promote a culture of continuous learning.
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Partner with business and functional leaders to assess current and future capability requirements, conduct learning needs analyses, and develop learning strategies that support business growth and performance.

 Build strong relationships across site, divisional, and corporate functions to leverage enterprise learning solutions and best practices.

 Develop and maintain multi-year Learning & Development roadmaps that support organisational capability building and High-Performance Organisation (HPO) objectives.

 Support talent development initiatives that support succession planning, leadership capability, and workforce development.

 Develop career pathway resources and provide coaching and guidance to managers and employees on learning and development opportunities.

 Serve as site lead for further education initiatives and external audits from a Learning & Development perspective.

 Manage learning systems, curricula, training records, and learning documentation, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement.

 Manage relationships with external learning providers, educational institutions, and strategic partners to support education outreach objectives.

 Develop communication and engagement strategies that increase awareness, accessibility, and adoption of Learning & Development programmes.

 Measure learning effectiveness, analyse training data, manage the L&D budget, and use insights to continuously improve learning outcomes and business impact.

 Stay informed of industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative learning practices to ensure programmes remain relevant and effective.

 
 EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE 
 A third‑level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Management, or equivalent experience.
 Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Learning and Development role or equivalent; experience within the manufacturing industry is an advantage.
 Experience developing and implementing Learning & Development strategies aligned to organisational objectives.
 Experience conducting training needs analyses and translating business requirements into effective learning and capability-building solutions.
 Experience partnering with managers and senior leaders to identify capability gaps, talent development priorities, and succession planning needs.
 Experience using Learning Management Systems (LMS) and learning analytics to support decision-making, compliance, and continuous improvement.
 Exceptional interpersonal, communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organisation.
 Strong project management with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results independently.
 Experience managing government training grants is desirable.

Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland

In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny

Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 Purpose of the Role
 We are seeking a motivated and analytical Technical Services Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for leading technical investigations into product failures, process non-conformities, customer complaints, and system anomalies to identify root causes and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
 
 Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders including Operations, Quality, Control Systems, Global Engineering, Validation, PMO, and the wider technical teams, you will play a key role in driving product quality, process reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement. This is a dynamic and multidisciplinary position that requires strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working independently.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Conduct detailed root cause investigations using structured methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Analysis, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

 Analyse technical data, performance metrics, and test results to identify trends, determine underlying causes, and support decision-making.

 Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Quality, and other cross-functional teams to gather information, validate findings, and implement solutions.

 Develop, recommend, and support the implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to address issues and reduce future risk.

 Design and execute testing, validation, and simulation activities to replicate issues, confirm root causes, and verify solutions.

 Prepare comprehensive technical reports documenting investigations, findings, risk assessments, and recommended actions.

 Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, systems, and procedures to enhance quality, efficiency, and reliability.

 Ensure all investigations and solutions comply with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal quality systems.

 Support the development and implementation of new processes within the Materials function and ensure effective integration across departments.

 Partner with Operational Excellence teams to develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, trackers, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

 Apply Lean methodologies and continuous improvement principles to drive operational excellence.

 Provide guidance and training on investigation techniques, root cause analysis methodologies, and lessons learned.

 Participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to support safety, compliance, quality, and continuous improvement objectives.

 Identify areas of operational risk and improvement and proactively recommend solutions.

 Develop and maintain a strong understanding of company quality policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.

 
 Education and Experience 
 Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

 Alternative combinations of education and relevant industry experience will also be considered.

 Minimum of 3 years' experience in Engineering, Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, Technical Services, or a related environment.

 Proven experience conducting technical investigations, root cause analysis, failure analysis, or problem-solving activities within a regulated industry.

 Experience working within quality management systems and regulated environments is highly desirable.

 
 Technical Skills 
 Strong knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), 5 Whys, Fishbone Analysis, and Statistical Process Control (SPC).

 Experience analysing technical data and interpreting trends to support investigations and process improvements.

 Familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools, including Power BI or similar platforms.

 Understanding of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Operational Excellence principles.

 Knowledge of relevant quality and regulatory standards, including ISO, FDA, or similar frameworks.

 
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,

 Excellent pension scheme

 Life assurance

 Career Development

 Fantastic new facility

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.

At Vistra Netherlands office, we provide a challenging position in an ambitious organization where no day is the same. A company with a view to the future where you can grow together with and, above all, put your own stamp on. In addition, we offer:
Market conform remuneration and benefits (e.g., allowance to travel to work)

Learning and training, i.e., via our digital learning environment ‘Vistra Skills Platform’
Work laptop;
The possibility to work partially from home and a fee to set up your home office;
Our Well-being program (Open Up)
Employee discounts via Benefits at Work
Bike riding via the bike scheme
Free coffee, tea, soft drinks and fresh fruits in our office
Vistra supports employees’ charitable efforts by encouraging engagement in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives and projects to improve our impact as a company. You could participate in team volunteering activities to support your communities, with one day per year being paid for. Don’t have the time? With Payroll Giving it will be easier and more financially attractive for you to donate to charity.
We value interdepartmental collaboration, work as ONE Vistra throughout the world and of course get to know each other better outside of work at our DoMiBo’s (Thursday Afternoon Drinks). We look forward to getting to know you better as well!
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

description:
Warehouse Associate (24-Month Fixed Term Contract Night Shift) 
 Reports to: Warehouse Supervisor 
 Location: Monksland, Athlone 
 FTC Night Shifts: 8.25 hr. 37.5 hours per week Average Work Week (12x5 Operations) 
 Sunday to Friday (Sunday 23:00-07:00, Monday to Friday 22:45-07:00 to allow for shift handover) 
 
 Introduction to role: The Warehouse Associate is responsible for the day-to-day warehouse activities at the Athlone facility. They ensure that all warehouse activities are completed as per approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), in a safe manner and in compliance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). This role is pivotal in supporting the execution of operational readiness in Alexion’s manufacturing facility. The individual in this position is expected to represent Alexion Pharmaceutical interests, objectives, and policies in a professional and responsible manner.
 
 Accountabilities: Performing day-to-day warehouse activities to meet schedules while maintaining a high level of GMP compliance
 Ensuring all training and safety procedures for equipment, processes, and facility are maintained and up to date at all times
 Maintaining the Warehouse Quality System by adhering to all relevant SOPs, policies, and cGMP requirements
 Aiding with troubleshooting and resolving operational problems as they arise
 Acting as Subject Matter Expert on the Dispensary area and on material Sampling and related activity, demonstrating technical proficiency in all aspects of this area
 Performing routine activities related to the transfer of dispensed materials to the manufacturing environment
 Performing routine material inspection exercises in accordance with agreed procedures and standards to support material release in line with manufacturing schedule
 Supporting continuous improvement initiatives by identifying areas needing improvement, recommending strategies for improvement, and implementing those strategies once approved
 Proactively ensuring that all Environmental, Health, and Safety responsibilities are carried out according to EHS regulations and procedures
 Providing support to Operations, Validation, Engineering, and Quality where required
 Completing training with new/junior Warehouse Associates
 Reporting to Warehouse Associate Lead/Supervisor on a regular basis on area performance and reporting any issues that need to be resolved
 Authoring and revising standard operating procedures, related forms/logbooks, and job roles as the need arises
 Recognising and initiating deviations relevant to the area, performing associated investigations, and ensuring closure in a timely manner
 Representing Warehouse/Operations in cross-functional initiatives and meetings
 Embracing Alexion Core Competencies
 Performing any other duties as required
 
 Essential Skills/Experience Proven experience performing warehouse activities in a cGMP commercial manufacturing environment
 Proficiency in an inventory management system e.g. SAP or equivalent
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel & Word
 Good interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills
 Knowledgeable of regulatory and GMP requirements
 
 Desirable Skills/Experience IATA and ADR training to support sample shipment
 Formal education in logistics/warehousing/supply chain would be an advantage
 
 When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why this essential worker role works fully onsite. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
 At AstraZeneca, you will find a patient-driven, energising culture where people build connections to explore new ideas that profoundly impact patients' lives. Diversity and different thinking are valued here, and inclusion is championed so that life-changing new ideas can come from everywhere. We celebrate and reward each other, ensuring kindness remains as important as our ambition to succeed for those in need. We take pride in giving back to the communities in which we operate.
 Ready to make a difference? Apply now!
 
 Date Posted 
27-Aug-2026 
 Closing Date 
26-Aug-2026 
 
Our mission is to build an inclusive and equitable environment. We want people to feel they belong at AstraZeneca and Alexion, starting with our recruitment process. We welcome and consider applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of characteristics. We offer reasonable adjustments/accommodations to help all candidates to perform at their best. • Ensure adherence to Company’s financial policies and procedures, tax requirements, and regulatory requirements.
• Support audits by maintaining complete and accurate records.
• Monitor and analyze operational costs and expenditures.
• Review invoices to ensure expenses are charged to the correct accounts and cost centers.
• Identify cost variances and investigate unexpected expenses.
• Prepare cost analysis reports for management review.

This position offers a chance to be part of a forward-thinking company that values innovation and a progressive approach to technology. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply and join the team where they can make a significant impact.

title: Graduate Dietitian
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Ireland Commercial Liffey Valley Dublin 

Opened in 1946, this operation, based in Liffey Valley Dublin was the first Abbott business unit to be established in Ireland. This business is responsible for the sales, marketing and distribution of a wide range of diabetes, diagnostic, and nutritional products in Ireland. This role will be office based in The Liffey Valley office.

 Position: Abbott Nutrition Dietetic Graduate (14 Months) Abbott Ireland 

The Graduate Dietitian, referred to as a Nutrition Specialist until CORU registration is complete, is a key member of the Abbott Nutrition Ireland team. This role supports the delivery of high‑quality, evidence‑based nutrition services, ensures the accuracy and compliance of nutrition communication, and contributes to regulatory, clinical, and commercial activities across the organisation. The position offers an excellent opportunity for a newly qualified dietitian to apply clinical and scientific knowledge in a commercial healthcare environment while developing professional expertise in medical nutrition.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Review and approve content for Abbott Nutrition marketing materials to ensure accuracy, scientific integrity, and compliance with relevant standards and guidelines.

 Conduct literature searches to support internal team needs or specific requests from healthcare professionals.

 Translate complex scientific evidence into clear, accurate, and clinically relevant messaging.

 Operate a dietetic helpline providing high‑quality nutrition advice to healthcare professionals across Ireland.

 Respond to enquiries from healthcare providers with evidence‑based, professional guidance.

 Work closely with line manager to support regulatory submissions and reimbursement applications for Abbott Nutrition products available in Ireland.

 Assist in maintaining documentation and compliance aligned with regulatory, CORU, and company standards.

 
 
 Personal Attributes 
 The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

 Strong academic performance combined with extracurricular or voluntary achievements.

 Ability to quickly learn and accurately interpret technical and scientific information.

 Excellent communication skills with the ability to build rapport with internal stakeholders and external healthcare professionals.

 High proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

 Strong organisation, time management, and project management skills.

 Ability to work effectively under pressure and meet deadlines.

 A collaborative, team‑oriented approach.

 Professionalism, discretion, and the ability to maintain confidentiality at all times.

 
 
 Required Professional Qualifications 
 Level 8 BSc (Hons) in Human Nutrition & Dietetics (or equivalent qualification).

 Evidence of CORU application (required at job‑offer stage).

 
 Additional Information 
 The successful candidate will hold the title Nutrition Specialist until a CORU registration number is issued.

 The role provides significant exposure to clinical nutrition, medical devices, product regulation, and commercial healthcare environments—ideal for a graduate seeking broad experience while developing professional dietetic practice.

 
 What We Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes  competitive pay and structure Bonus , as well as benefits such as

 Private Health Insurance for you and your family

 Occupational Pension Scheme with an excellence contribution rate

 Bonus Target

 Life assurance

 Career Development

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits

      
 The base pay for this position is 
N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
description:
Kepak is a leading food company with manufacturing sites across Ireland and the UK. The Group operates across three divisions: the Foods Division, Meat Division UK, and Meat Division Ireland. Guided by our values—Responsibility, Ambition, Passion for Food, and Teamwork—we are committed to operating as a successful, sustainable, future-ready business that is a great place to work. We supply fresh and value-added meat based products to retail and foodservice through private label and our own brands, including Rustlers, Big Al's and John Stone. 
  Kepak Meat Division Ireland operates across multiple manufacturing sites, producing a range of quality meat and protein-based food products for retail and foodservice customers across both domestic and export markets. The division is recognised for its operational excellence, strong customer partnerships, and continuous innovation. 
 
 We are seeking a Continuous Improvement Specialist to lead and deliver continuous improvement initiatives across our Retail Manufacturing operations. In this role, you'll identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce waste, increase profitability, and embed a culture of operational excellence throughout the business.
 
 Working closely with Operations, Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Food Safety & Quality, and Health & Safety teams, you'll lead improvement projects using Lean methodologies such as Lean Six Sigma, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and Root Cause Analysis.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, eliminate waste, reduce costs, and improve operational performance.
 Implementing and embedding Lean methodologies and tools such as Lean Six Sigma, Root Cause Analysis, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, and Kaizen.
 Partnering with site leadership teams to prioritise improvement initiatives and deliver measurable business results.
 Establishing and monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs) to track progress and demonstrate project success.
 Quantifying financial benefits, return on investment (ROI), and cost-saving opportunities from OpEx projects.
 Facilitating workshops and improvement events that engage teams and generate innovative solutions.
 Promoting a culture of continuous learning by designing and delivering training programmes on operational excellence principles and best practices.
 Working closely with project teams to ensure improvement projects are effectively managed from concept through to implementation and sustainability.
 Supporting quality, safety, sustainability, and customer-focused initiatives to strengthen our position as a leading food manufacturer.
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree / Level 8 qualification in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management or related field 
 Proven experience in a operations role and/or continuous improvement role in food manufacturing
 Lean Manufacturing Green Belt certification is desirable 
 Other project management qualifications and experience advantageous
 In depth knowledge of Op Ex tools and techniques and practical implementation experience
 Financial & Commercial Acumen: Understanding of cost drivers, budgeting, and commercial levers in manufacturing. 
 Analytical mindset with ability to use data driven insights to identify areas for improvement
 Benefits 
 What can we offer you? 
 Company Pension 
 Paid Maternity Leave 
 Further Education support - You’ll have clear pathways for advancement, supported by continuous professional development and a range of learning opportunities
 Refer a Friend Scheme - Earn up to Get up to €500 for successfully referring a friend or family member to Kepak Group.
 Bike to Work Scheme - Purchase a bike and safety equipment through a salary sacrifice scheme which reduces your taxable income – meaning you pay less tax!
 Long Service Awards - We recognise, acknowledge and award the dedication and valuable contribution of long serving employees

Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. This organisation is responsible for the strategic relationship management of over 50 Contract Manufacturing Organisations (CMOs) around the world.  The Manufacturing, Science and Technology (MS&T) department provide technical oversight for routine commercial manufacture and Technology Transfers at CMO sites.  
   
 The activities you will be involved in during your placement as MS&T External Manufacturing Intern include:   
   
 Provide technical support to the technical product lead in overseeing CMO manufacturing activities and technology transfers   
 Provide support for process robustness monitoring activities using statistical tools  
 Support development and optimisation of departmental systems within MS&T (e.g. knowledge management)  
 Other ad hoc duties as determined by the relevant MS&T Senior Specialist/ Manager   
  
 What Qualities Are We Looking For?   
  
 We are looking for highly motivated individuals who can collaborate in teams and have the willingness to learn.    
  
 Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Engineering (Chemical/Mechanical, etc.) discipline of study

 Strong communication skills  
 Ability to work as a member of a team  
 Energetic, collaborative and dedicated

title: Cloud Support Associate Internship - April 2027 start, Support Engineering
description:
**This is a 6 month internship starting in April 2027**

We’re on the lookout for the curious, those who think big and want to define the world of tomorrow. At Amazon, you will grow into the high impact, visionary person you know you’re ready to be. Every day will be filled with exciting new challenges, developing new skills, and achieving personal growth.

How often can you say that your work changes the world? At Amazon, you’ll say it often. Join us and define tomorrow.

Would you like to use the latest cloud computing technologies? Do you have an interest in helping customers understand application architectures and integration approaches? Are you familiar with best practices for applications, servers, and networks? Do you want to be part of a customer facing technology team helping to ensure the success of AWS as a leading technology organization? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the market leader and technology forerunner in the cloud business. As a member of the AWS support team you will be at the forefront of this transformational technology, assisting a global list of companies and developers that are taking advantage of a growing set of services and features to run their mission-critical applications. 
As an Amazon intern, you will be interacting with your peers and the AWS global team of full-time professionals as part of our AWS Cloud Support team. You will benefit from the opportunity to gain experience on our cloud services, hands on training, and learning as you go.
If you fit the description, you could be the person we are looking for. We are a group of smart people, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world-class support is critical to customer success. 
Come build the future with us.

Key job responsibilities
Each day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
• Learn and use ground-breaking technologies.
• Complete AWS certifications.
• Work on projects that improve support-related processes with fellow interns in other locations.
• Design, build and deploy tools/applications for AWS Support Engineers.
• Interact with leading engineers around the world.
• Partner with AWS teams.

A day in the life
Why us?
• The Cloud Support Associate Internship Program provides interns with the technical and functional skills training based on Cloud Support Builder standards.
• On a typical day, a Cloud Support Builder will be primarily responsible for solving customer’s cases through customer contact channels (e.g., telephone, email, and web/live chat). They apply troubleshooting techniques to provide solutions for our customers by thoughtfully working with customers to dive deep into the root cause of an issue.
• A Cloud Support Builder may also develop, train, partner with development teams on complex issues or contact deflection initiatives, participate in new hiring, write tools/script to help the team, or work with leadership on process improvement and strategic initiatives.

About the team
If you’re insatiably curious and always want to learn more, then you’ve come to the right place. Depending on your location, country, job status and other requirements, some or all of the following benefits may be available to you as an intern.

• Competitive pay
• Impactful project and internship/role deliverables
• Networking opportunities with fellow interns
• Internships events such as speaker series, intern panels, Leadership Principles sessions, Amazon writing skills sessions.
• Mentorship and career development

The internship is a fixed term program, the start date will be April 2027 for a duration of 6 months.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, and leveraging our unique perspectives to scale our impact and grow. Amazon has 13 affinity groups (https://www.aboutamazon.com/affinity-groups), sometimes known as employee resource groups, which bring employees together across businesses and locations around the world. With executive and company sponsorship, these groups play an important role in building internal networks for creating a community, advising Amazon business units, leading in service projects, and reaching out to communities where Amazonians live and work.

- Basic knowledge of Networking and Databases.
- Basic knowledge of Operation Systems Windows and/or Linux.
- Knowledge of internet fundamentals and cloud computing concepts.

- Knowledge of Networking fundamentals like CIDR notations, OSI model, DNS, HTTP, TCP/UDP, DHCP, routing, switching, subnets, NAT.

- Customer facing work experience.

title: Credit Analyst - Subsidiary Lending Group
description:
Job Description: 
 Job Title: Credit Analyst I 
 Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President 
 Location: Dublin 

 Company Overview 
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.

 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

 The Team 

 The Enterprise Credit Subsidiary Lending Group (EC SLG) is responsible for independent administration of a client portfolio facilitating credit for local subsidiaries of multinational clients, managing the local credit process, and providing dedicated support to the Global Subsidiary Banking business. Based in 12 countries across three regions, EC SLG performs the role of the Local R-Credit Specialist, including completion of credit administration functions for a client portfolio, and coordination of local jurisdictional requirements with key stakeholders and local business partners.

 Responsibilities 
 Independent administration of a client portfolio facilitating credit for local subsidiaries of multinational clients.
 Facilitate preparation, negotiation & completion of credit documents & loan agreements
 Direct interface with global credit teams, local subsidiary banking team & external clients
 Drive through completion of credit deals in a timely manner.
 Help manage and adhere to the local Legal Entity approval and booking process, coordinating with Tax, Legal, Finance, Compliance & local Management teams where requires.
 .
 
 Requirements 
 Actively contribute to the development of the Enterprise Credit Subsidiary Lending business.
 Behaves appropriately, professionally and with integrity, demonstrating high-levels of conduct, in all aspects of work.
 Deliver to our Shareholders by helping the Bank grow responsibly.
 Ability to actively manage Risk.
 University graduate or equivalent and/or track record of relevant experience.
 Credit background with knowledge of Corporate Banking products and services.
 Experience with reading / interpreting loan agreements & related documentation.
 Excellent written skills and ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
 Team player, results oriented, shows ability to adapt and is able to work under pressure.
 Demonstrates time management and can prioritise workload.
 Ability to coordinate with multiple points of contact (internal and external).
 
 Benefits of working at Bank of America 
 Ireland 
 Private healthcare for you and your family plus an annual health screen to help you manage your physical wellness with the option to purchase a screen for your partner
 Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons
 20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum.
 The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness etc.
 Access to an emotional wellbeing helpline, mental health first aiders and virtual GP services.
 Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters
 Ability to donate to charities of your choice directly through payroll and the bank will match your contribution
 Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of the UK’s most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions.
 Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community.
 

 Bank of America

title: Consultant, Training
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Role
 Summary :  As a member of the COO Functional Training Team, the Training Consultant will work collaboratively with team members to deliver training solutions to the assigned business unit.  Under general direction the Training Consultant will assist with defining learning solutions that support the functional requirements.  The Training Consultant role involves designing, developing, and delivering functional training solutions, analysing solutions for continuous improvement, and undertaking appropriate operational and administrative aspects of the training curriculum.
 
  Why Choose this role as a training consultant
 This role is an excellent opportunity for a candidate who is looking to progress a career away from a daily operations/client servicing role.

 This role gives the opportunity to engage with senior leaders and all level of management.      

 This role gives an individual the opportunity to create and own a product which delivers benefits to partners now and in the future. 

 
 Principal Responsibilities
 Work with management, business process consultants and/or subject matter experts to understand desired business outcomes and translate them into learning objectives.

 Work with stakeholders to determine appropriate learning methodologies and functional training solutions.

 Handle all types of analysis.

 Develop project plans including the identification of subject matter experts where appropriate.

 Design, develop, facilitate and deliver learning programs.

 Evaluate training development programs for effectiveness and make recommendations for improvements.

 Maintain an inventory of training development programs/tools and schedules, their use according to management priorities.

 Deliver a work product that requires minimal revision.

 Serve as a key subject matter expert in program design and may mentor more junior staff.

 Acts as a product and marketing manager for training programs

 Responsible for multiple projects of various complexities

 Represent the COO Training team in various meetings.

 
 Area Specific Duties
 
 Design, develop and maintain a training curriculum for the Asset Servicing Custody Servicing function which can be implemented and delivered regardless of geographic location.

 Coordinate/deliver the new hire curriculum within the relevant geographic location.

 Design and deliver training for existing systems and new system roll-outs.

 Ensure that COO Training learning and development interventions are aligned with the Business Unit and/or enterprise-wide needs.

 Consult with Custody Servicing management to provide ongoing support on training needs and business unit initiatives.

 Work collaboratively with other global training teams. Provide backup as necessary.

 
 Skills / Experience
 For this position, we are looking for an individual that fits one of two profiles:
 An experienced funds industry operations professional willing to develop their consulting, writing and presenting skills.
 
 Requirements include: 
 Three to five years of capital markets operations experience, preferably in custody servicing or a similar role in financial services.

 Excellent communication skills.

 Ability to work with all levels of staff.

 Self-starter and team player.

 Attention to detail.

 Willingness and ability to give and receive candid feedback

 
 An experienced training professional willing to quickly learn all aspects of the custody servicing business.
 Requirements include: 
 Three to five years of training consulting experience.

 Excellent communication skills.

 Ability to work with all levels of staff.

 Self-starter and team player.

 Attention to detail.

 Willingness and ability to give and receive feedback

 Can consult with business subject matter experts and translate SME knowledge into step by step exceptions management.

 
 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Associate, Trade Compliance
description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients’ capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world’s largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns.
 
 Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking.  We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients.
 
 
 POSITION DESCRIPTION 
 
 Do you love to learn? Do you enjoy problem solving? Do you like to innovate? Then this is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment alongside a diverse group of highly motivated professionals.
 
 In this role, you will gain exposure to trade activity, investment strategies, portfolio construction, and the implementation of regulatory and client investment guidelines. The Trade Compliance team is responsible for reviewing fixed income and equity transactions on both a pre- and post-trade basis to ensure compliance with applicable restrictions and regulations. You will have broad exposure to the Investment Guideline Compliance process and will partner closely with teams across Legal & Compliance, Technology, Account Management, Product Strategy, Operations, and the Trade Floor. 
 
 As the compliance landscape continues to evolve, the team is increasingly focused on leveraging technology, automation, data analytics, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen risk monitoring, and support continuous process improvement. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to these initiatives while developing deep expertise in investment compliance.
 
 On a given day, your responsibilities might include: 
 
 Analyzing transactions and portfolio holdings against regulatory, client, and internal guidelines, and calculating relevant risk metrics.

 Researching and responding to investment guideline inquiries from the Trade Floor and other internal and external stakeholders.

 Monitoring compliance alerts and ensuring trade activity is reviewed and compliant by the end of each business day. 

 Preparing and distributing compliance reports and management information to relevant internal stakeholders.

 Partnering with Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams to identify opportunities to improve processes, controls, and reporting.

 Participating in initiatives focused on optimizing, automating, and scaling Trade Compliance processes through technology-enabled solutions.

 Leveraging data analytics, workflow tools, and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions where appropriate, to support monitoring, investigation, and reporting activities.

 Contributing to projects that improve data quality, operational efficiency, and the effectiveness of compliance oversight.

 
 You will excel in this role if you: 
 
 Demonstrate a strong sense of integrity and personal accountability. 

 Learn and adapt to new processes, concepts, systems, and technologies quickly.

 Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to quality.

 Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills and enjoy collaborating across functions.

 Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach to problem solving.

 Have a continuous improvement mindset and seek opportunities to enhance processes through technology and automation.

 Are comfortable learning and utilizing new tools, including data analytics and AI-enabled solutions, to improve workflows and decision-making.

 Take initiative and contribute meaningfully to the growth and evolution of the department. 

 
 You will need this experience: 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related discipline.

 2+ years of professional experience within Compliance, Asset Management, Financial Services, or a related field.

 Basic knowledge of global fixed income and equity markets, including financial instruments such as bonds, equities, and derivatives.

 Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

 Demonstrated ability to analyze data and identify trends, anomalies, or issues requiring investigation.

 
 Additional qualifications that are helpful, but not required: 
 Experience monitoring transactions within an investment compliance system. 

 Basic familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to apply AI-enabled capabilities to improve efficiency, research, and problem-solving.

 Experience with Bloomberg or similar market data platforms.

 CFA designation or active progress toward the CFA Program.

 Exposure to automation, workflow, reporting, or data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or similar platforms.

 Familiarity with emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools, and an interest in applying them responsibly within a regulated environment.

 Experience participating in process improvement, digital transformation, or technology implementation initiatives.

 
 
 
 

 
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Statement 
 PIMCO recruits and hires qualified candidates without regard to race, national origin, ancestry, religion (including religious dress and grooming practices), sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity and expression), age, military or veteran status, disability (physical or mental), any factor prohibited by law, and as such affirms in policy and practice to support and promote the concept of equal employment opportunity and affirmative action, in accordance with all applicable federal, state, provincial and municipal laws. The company also prohibits discrimination on other basis such as medical condition, or marital status under applicable laws. 
 
 Applicants with Disabilities 
 PIMCO is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including veterans, in job application procedures. If you have any difficulty using our online system due to a disability and you would like to request an accommodation, you may contact us at 949-720-7744 and leave a message. This is a dedicated line designed exclusively to assist job seekers with disabilities to apply online. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days.

We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
 
 
Insurance Healthcare Trainer 
 
 Job Location: Dublin
 Job Type: Permanent Role
 Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications
 We have a fantastic opportunity for a Health Insurance Trainer in Dublin. 
 Are you passionate about developing people and helping teams perform at their best? We are looking for a dedicated Training and Quality Specialist to drive learning, development and operational excellence across a dynamic, high-performing customer-focused team. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact by equipping colleagues with the skills, knowledge and confidence they need to deliver exceptional customer experiences and achieve business objectives.
 
 Demonstrate reliability, focus and commitment in driving the success of the account by providing training and development to a dynamic and high performing customer-centric team. Deliver training to new and existing colleagues, maintain training documents, monitor agent development, and advise on service techniques. Main point of contact for training matters with operations management.
 Working closely with Operations Management, you will design and deliver engaging training programmes for both new and existing colleagues, covering products, systems, processes and customer service skills. You will create and maintain interactive training materials, ensure compliance with quality and ISO standards, and monitor colleague development through coaching, assessments and ongoing support.
 
 As the key point of contact for all training-related matters, you will identify development opportunities through quality evaluations, root cause analysis and performance insights. You will deliver training on new systems, products and process updates, while supporting continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and customer outcomes. In addition, you will take ownership of training administration, compliance documentation and supervision processes, helping to maintain high standards across the team.
 
 This is an exciting opportunity for an enthusiastic and motivated professional who enjoys developing others, fostering a culture of continuous learning and working collaboratively to support the success of both colleagues and the wider business.
 
 The skills you will have when you apply:    
 · APA Qualification – APA qualified with a commitment to ongoing professional development.
 · Training & Coaching Expertise – Previous experience delivering training, coaching or mentoring programmes within customer service, sales, claims or similar environments.
 · F acilitation Skills – Ability to effectively demonstrate concepts, engage learners and support colleagues in developing new skills and knowledge.
 · Communication Skills – Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to adapt messages to different audiences.
 · Healthcare Knowledge – Experience within the healthcare sector is highly desirable and would be a distinct advantage.
 · Administrative Excellence – Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate training records and documentation.
 · Microsoft Office Proficiency – Competent in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.

 The skills you will have when you apply:

 Holiday allowance.
 Tax Saver Travel Scheme.
 Opportunities for training and development.
 
 Health & Support 
 Employee Assistance Programme.
 Life Cover.
 Permanent Health Insurance (PHI).
 Bike to Work Scheme.
 
 Other Benefits 
 Discounted onsite Gym Membership (Dublin 4).
 Discounted onsite Montessori (Dublin 4).
 Professional and personal development opportunities.
 Support for professional memberships and examinations where applicable.
 This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry   
 At Sedgwick, not only will you be working behind the scenes for some of the UK's most trusted insurance brands helping to resolve millions of claims every year, you'll also be an architect of tomorrow's insurance landscape with Sedgwick University. Our proprietary offering is the most comprehensive training and development program in the industry with more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue your formal education – all available to you starting from your very first day.  
 You'll join a community passionate about making a difference, where every role contributes to a larger mission; protecting people and businesses. This isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to shape the future of insurance.  
 
 Next steps for you:

 If you’re unsure whether you have all the skills needed then do apply – we are looking for all backgrounds from seasoned professionals to those returning to the workforce, and everyone in-between.   
 Not only that, we are proud to have a zero tolerance policy towards discrimination of any kind regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital/ family status, race, religion, sex or sexual orientation.   
 After the closing date we will review all applications and may select some applicants for an interview (which may be virtual, or in-person). 
 
 Sedgwick Ireland is regulated by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI). This role is subject to the Minimum Competency Code (MCC) as set out by the CBI. This code sets out the minimum professional standard for any person providing certain financial services, in particular when dealing with consumers. This role is classified as a Controlled function ( CF7 ) and is subject to Fitness and Probity Standards, including the requirements outlined in the Individual Accountability Framework Act 2023. Successful candidates will receive training in relation to all regulatory requirements applicable to them.

title: Global Finance
description:
We have experienced a very high interest for becoming a graduate at Novo Nordisk starting 1 September 2026. The application period ended 7 December 2026. We are reading applications now and first interviews for selected candidates will take place from 16-23 January 2026. Read more about the  application process.
The Global Finance Graduate Programme is designed to develop the next generation of finance leaders. With three rotations in various finance functions across our global value chain. The programme will provide you with the opportunity to bring your finance and business understanding into play to make a difference to patients and society and bring you on to an accelerated learning curve.
Start your career 1 September 2027. Apply here from November 2026. Until then  follow Novo Nordisk on LinkedIn  to get a better feeling of who we are. We welcome applications from all over the world.
Please note that we also offer our  International Operations Graduate Programme .
The full-time position as a Global Finance Graduate provides you with the opportunity to experience three exciting jobs in just two years . You will work in various finance functions across our global value chain from R&D to sales - ensuring a strong financial toolbox, including knowledge of digital tools, and a holistic understanding of Novo Nordisk and the pharmaceutical industry.
An example of a Global Finance graduate’s journey could look like this:
1. R&D Finance, HQ: Finance partnering supporting the management of investments in our future product pipeline
2. Novo Nordisk, Inc., US: Forecasting sales and analysing the market dynamics in the biggest market
3. Strategic Finance, HQ: Supporting senior management with key strategic projects and financial modelling in connection to our business development activities
Working at Novo Nordisk provides the opportunity to make a significant difference to patients and society while also delivering exciting results from a business perspective.
Throughout the programme you will gain hands-on experience with transforming data into business insights, communicating recommendations and creating measurable business impact. You will work with senior managers and build an international network of colleagues, establishing yourself as one of tomorrow’s key finance leaders at Novo Nordisk.
As you embark on your life-changing career in Novo Nordisk, we will provide you with:
Accelerated personal and professional development through one-on-one sparring with a senior mentor assigned to you from day one and an extensive, custom-built training programme
International experience by working abroad for eight months in one of our many affiliates or regional offices (e.g. USA, Colombia, Malaysia, a European capital or one of many other options)
A unique graduate community spanning across programmes filled with social activities and inspiring colleagues to spare with and learn from.
A competitive entry level salary.
For the positions starting 1 September 2027, we are looking for candidates with:
A Master’s degree from 2026 or 2027 in a relevant subject, for example Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Accounting or Management Accounting with strong academic achievements
Relevant work experience or extracurricular activities
No more than 1 year of full-time work experience between or after completing a Master’s degree
International experience from working, studying or volunteering
An international mind-set with an ability to adapt quickly to change and to relocate internationally as part of the programme
Professional fluency in English
You are welcome to apply for more than one track. However, we recommend you to carefully consider which tracks you will apply for and your motivation for doing so. You will have to make an individual application for each programme track and we encourage you to only apply for the tracks that you would be truly excited to join.
Be yourself and share why Novo Nordisk is the company you want to work for. What motivates you and why do you think being a graduate could be amazing. We would like to know who YOU are.
No, our corporate language is English, so speaking Danish is definitely not a requirement. There may be local language requirements for some International Operations (IO) tracks.
Yes, as long as you plan to graduate before the start of the Graduate programme. It is also accepted if you have not received your official graduate diploma before starting in the Graduate Programme, as long as you have finished your studies and are just waiting for the official papers.
This position is designed as an entry-level role, and while many graduates join the program directly after their studies, we also consider candidates with up to one year of post-graduate experience.
Previous pharmaceutical work experience is not a requirement to apply for the programme.
For the Global tracks you will be employed by our HQ organisation and most of the positions will start in Denmark, except for Global Tax, where you will commence your rotations in either Denmark, US or in one of our International Operations locations globally.
For the International Operations tracks you will be employed in one of our specified hiring countries for 2026, where you will undertake your first rotation.
Upon successful completion of the programme, you will be offered a position in Novo Nordisk, therefore full mobility and flexibility is required as the location is not pre-determined.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland 
 Operating since 1946, Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products. We employ around 6,000 people across ten sites in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford, and Sligo. Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal: Located in Donegal Town, our Diabetes Care division manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and sensors, including the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite, and FreeStyle Libre systems. 
 
 Abbott Ireland Diabetes Care Division Donegal 
 The Abbott Diabetes Care division based in Donegal Town manufactures FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre system.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is   conditional upon the successful completion   of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company 
 
 Job Specification 
 Ability to independently data mine multiple large, complex datasets to answer specific research / investigation questions. Curiosity to dig deeper and access other documentation sources to understand the data.

 Provide real time data analysis support to manufacturing in terms of process adjustments, material performance, investigations, programming and yield analysis.

 The ability to strategically interpret statistical findings into a business significant context.

 Provide consulting on data analysis and statistical tools in support of trend analysis, root cause analysis, failure investigation, risk assessment, data management and data visualization to junior team members and engineers.

 Support technical investigations performed within the manufacturing unit.

 Assist with the introduction of analytical test methods & development trials (analysis of variance, setting acceptance criteria & capability analysis) and support efforts to reduce measurement variability.

 Work with scientists and engineers to introduce new machines, materials and processes, inputting into the design of experiments and analysis of resultant data.

 Independently manages multiple projects working with stakeholders to define business questions, timelines and objectives.

 Highly effective in presenting and communicating statistical results to various levels of personnel is required regularly.

 Bachelor's Degree or higher in a quantitative field (i.e. Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Statistics, Biostatistics etc.) preferred.

 Minimum of 4 years experience in a similar role.

 Proficient in a programming language such as python, R, SAS, JMP or similar.

 An understanding of probability, statistical process control, hypothesis testing, non-parametric statistics, time series analysis, linear and logistic regression etc.

 Experience with relational databases (for example: Oracle Databases, MySQL, Microsoft Access, etc.).
