title: Strategic Initiatives Project Specialist
description:
Company: 
 Description: 
 What can you expect: 
 An exciting opportunity to work in Mercer’s largest and most rapidly-growing business area – Investment Solutions. As part of our strategic initiatives Team the successful candidate will play a key role in supporting Mercer’s Investment Solutions strategic change agenda by helping shape plans, coordinating delivery, tracking progress against outcomes, and supporting change adoption. Mercer is one of the fastest growing investment solutions entities globally, and our client base has grown substantially over recent years and we have an ambitious trajectory for future growth.
 
 The candidate will work closely with business sponsors and business owners, internal stakeholders, senior management, external vendors, clients, and wider colleagues to coordinate and deliver on key strategic initiatives including integration activity (including M&A-related workstreams), development of operational solutions for existing and new client segments, and global alignment activities.
 
 The successful candidate will get to work in and experience a dynamic and rapidly growing area of Mercer’s business driven by strong demand across new markets and segments.
 
 We will rely on you to: 
 Support strategic planning for the Investments platform by partnering with senior leadership to translate priorities into clear goals, objectives, and actionable delivery plans.
 Coordinate the execution of strategic projects and initiatives, supporting definition of scope, deliverables, timelines, and interdependencies.
 Organize and coordinate cross-functional teams, working groups, and governance forums to drive alignment and delivery.
 Establish and maintain project plans, dashboards, and RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) to support effective stakeholder communication.
 Monitor and report initiative performance using agreed metrics and KPIs; analyze trends and identify areas for improvement and performance optimization.
 Facilitate effective communication and coordination across the Investments business, ensuring alignment across teams and departments.
 Build and maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders (including senior leadership, department heads, functional teams, and external partners where relevant) to secure engagement and timely decisions.
 Support change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning to embed new processes and ways of working.
 Identify and help mitigate risks and challenges associated with strategic initiatives; escalate issues appropriately with options and recommendations.
 Ensure delivery documentation is completed to a high standard with messaging tailored to different audiences (for example, steering committee updates, project plans, and status reporting).
 Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize processes, governance, and delivery practices within the strategic initiatives framework.
 
 What you need to have:  
 Strong organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple parallel workstreams and priorities.
 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear written updates and facilitate effective working sessions.
 Strong analytical skills to support KPI tracking, performance monitoring, and evidence based decision support.
 A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders at different levels of seniority.
 Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to identify issues early and support practical solutions.
 A strong commitment to delivery discipline and rigor (planning, governance, documentation, and follow-through).
 Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and deadlines.
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Experience supporting strategic initiatives, transformation programs, or PMO delivery in a complex organization.
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to project coordination and reporting.
 Demonstrated ability to build trust and maintain effective stakeholder relationships.
 A proactive mindset with a drive to learn, improve processes, and contribute to meaningful change.
 
 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can collaborate with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities.
 
 #MercerIS
 
 
Mercer is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Mercer, visit mercer.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Description:
Full Time  Permanent position
Hybrid role based in our Dublin City Centre offices
What we offer
We have embraced a hybrid working model for most of our positions, which means that you can enjoy a balanced approach of working from home for part of the week and working from the office for the remainder of the week.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive salaries and bonuses, robust Learning and Development support, excellent Defined Contribution pension and comprehensive Wellbeing initiatives and support to name but a few.
Further details on our benefits package can be accessed here  Benefits (life-careers.com)
Role Overview
European Technology sits within Canada Life Group and encompasses the technology community across all European entities, including Irish Life Group, Canada Life UK, Canada Life Europe and Central Technology Services – Europe. European Technology supports the delivery of business strategy through strong collaboration, effective governance and modern, resilient technology platforms across Europe.
European Technology is entering a new phase of transformation, with an expanded mandate covering technology strategy, transformation delivery, sourcing and partnerships, data and information governance, and enterprise-wide change enablement. To support this agenda, we are recruiting an Executive Assistant to support the support to the CITO function.
The primary focus of the Executive Assistant is to provide high-quality administrative and organisational support to the CITO function. The role plays a key part in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of executive schedules, meetings and operational activities, enabling leaders to manage their priorities effectively. Working as part of a wider EA network, this role supports coordination across teams and helps maintain efficient and well-organised processes in a fast-paced environment.
What you will help us to achieve
The successful candidate will:
Provide administrative support, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings and supporting effective time management.
Coordinate meetings, including room bookings, materials preparation, minute taking, and logistics to ensure smooth delivery.
Support the organisation of team events such as town halls, leadership meetings and offsites.

 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Logistics Specialist will make an impact:
 
 Key responsibilities for this role include:
 
 Provide Serve as the first point of contact and subject matter expert for logistics operations, SAP transaction support, inventory accuracy issues, system-interface failures and 3PL operational escalations.

 Monitor daily operational flows across SAP, WMS, TMS and EDI, including interface exceptions, IDoc or message failures, order updates, inventory postings and master-data related issues.

 Work closely with third-party logistics providers and internal teams to ensure service delivery in line with agreed SLAs, KPIs, quality expectations and escalation timelines.

 Support high levels of SAP inventory accuracy through timely issue investigation, stock reconciliation, transaction review, batch or lot integrity checks, and proactive defect prevention.

 Use operational data, Power BI, advanced Excel and other reporting tools to identify trends, exceptions, root causes and improvement opportunities.

 Lead or support structured root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, process mapping, standard work updates and Lean continuous-improvement initiatives.

 Support GDP and quality-compliant distribution processes, including SOP adherence, deviation support, audit-readiness activities and quality escalation where required.

 Act as a functional expert for distribution processes, WMS/TMS workflows, EDI/interface management, SAP logistics execution and end-to-end issue resolution.

 Partner with IT, Quality, Supply Chain, Customer Service, Finance and external partners to resolve cross-functional process gaps and prevent recurring operational failures.

 Support system change, testing, user acceptance testing, process documentation and training for SAP, WMS, TMS, EDI or reporting improvements.

 Apply a digital and continuous-improvement mindset, including appropriate use of automation, analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools to improve visibility, control and decision-making.

 
 The minimum qualifications for this role are:  
 
 Degree Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Science or related qualification is beneficial.

 Power BI, Power Query, advanced Excel, data visualisation or dashboard development experience is strongly preferred.

 Experience with WMS, TMS, EDI, IDoc monitoring, interface troubleshooting or logistics control-tower environments is beneficial.

 Knowledge of Good Distribution Practice, regulated pharmaceutical supply chains, temperature-controlled logistics, serialization or track-and-trace requirements is beneficial.

 Exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP EWM, SAP TM or SAP master-data governance is desirable.

 Lean, Six Sigma, process mapping, standard work or structured problem-solving experience is beneficial.

 Comfort using digital tools, automation and AI-enabled productivity tools to improve analysis, reporting, documentation and exception management.

 Ability to turn operational data into clear recommendations, actions and stakeholder updates.

title: Digital & OT Cyber Coordinator
description:
Job Description : 
 Job Role: Digital & OT Cyber Coordinator
 Location:  Nangor Road Dublin, Ireland
 Contract: Permanent
 Work Pattern: Monday – Friday onsite
 Closing Date: 21st September 2026
 
 About Us 
 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate, and innovate to build brands consumers love. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.
 
 Our indulgent blend of aged Irish whiskey and luscious Irish dairy cream, with hints of cocoa and vanilla, is loved the world over and sold in over 160 countries. Produced and bottled exclusively in Ireland, Baileys is enjoyed drizzled over ice cream, swirled into coffee or simply poured over ice.
 
 
 The world's supply of Baileys comes from two production sites; Dublin and Belfast. Over 8 million cases of Baileys Original and Baileys Flavours leave the gates of these two sites every year, destined for over 130 countries worldwide.
 
 
 About the Role 
 
 As a Digital & OT Cyber Coordinator you will play a key role in delivering digital, data and operational technology (OT) initiatives across our Baileys sites.
 
 Acting as a central point of coordination between operations, engineering and digital teams you’ll support the rollout of new technologies, ensure alignment with cybersecurity and compliance standards (including GRMS and NIS2) and help embed digital tools that drive continuous improvement.
 
 
 You’ll also support OT cyber activities, manage documentation and governance and ensure risks, incidents and change activities are tracked and escalated appropriately.
 
 
 A key part of the role will involve enabling better use of data across the site—supporting the development of dashboards, reporting and visualisations that turn data into meaningful insights and support operational decision making.
 
 
 You’ll help identify data gaps, improve data quality and contribute to transformation initiatives while also supporting training, communications and digital capability building to ensure successful adoption of new tools and technologies.
 
 
 About You

You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.

Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation ofcelebrations for consumers around the world.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve Microsoft Purview DLP incidents and alerts.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .

We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

 Job Description: 
 Deployment Process Analyst – J&J IM Transcend 
 
 About Innovative Medicine 
 
 Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
   
 About Transcend 
 Transcend is a global business transformation program that will modernize our foundational transactional processes and harmonize them into one “clean” ERP as a standardized platform for growth and efficiency gains. This program will simplify the Pharmaceutical ERP landscape from 7 to 1, standardizing processes to have a cost-effective, fit-for-purpose digital backbone that will enable us to support the Pharmaceutical business with agility. Additionally, the program will remediate the end-of-life system exposure that we risk towards the end of this decade.
   
 Role Purpose 
 We are seeking a Deployment Process Analyst - Logistics to support the deployment of Manufacturing/Warehouse Execution–related capabilities within the Transcend SAP S/4HANA program.
 
 The role provides hands-on functional support across solution confirmation, testing, and deployment activities, ensuring Manufacturing and Warehouse solutions align with the global template, regulatory requirements, and SAP Clean Core principles.
   
 Key Responsibilities 
 Functional Delivery & Execution 
 Support SAP–MES (PAS-X) integration activities, PLM-driven engineering change processes, master data validity checks, and Manufacture at Risk capabilities.
 Assist with functional validation of Manufacturing master data, process orders, BOMs, master recipes, and production versions.
 Support solution confirmation activities by documenting requirements, reviewing designs, and validating alignment with the global template.
 Execute detailed functional tasks including configuration support, data validation, and integration readiness activities.
 Provide leadership and coaching to external contractors.
   
 Testing, Deployment & Hypercare Support 
 Prepare and execute Business Simulation Testing and User Acceptance Testing activities under the guidance of the Functional Deployment Lead.
 Support defect triage, resolution, and retesting activities.
 Provide functional support during deployment and hypercare periods.
   
 Experience 
 Education
 Bachelors degree or equivalent experience in a relevant business, technical, or scientific discipline.
   
 Required 
 Hands-on functional experience within a regulated (GxP) environment.
 Experience supporting ERP or digital transformation initiatives, preferably SAP S/4HANA.
 Experience in the Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry.
 Fluent in written and spoken English
   
 Preferred 
 Prior involvement in global ERP deployments.
 Experience with MES systems and SAP integration.
 Ability to travel internationally based on role and specific business requirements (-10%).
 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
Agility Jumps, Analytics Insights, Business Alignment, Coaching, Communication, Cost-Benefit Analysis (CBA), Cross-Functional Collaboration, Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL), Persistence and Tenacity, Problem Solving, Process Oriented, Project Management Methodology (PMM), Project Management Office (PMO), Project Management Tools, Project Reporting, Statement of Work (SOW)   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers.

We are looking for curious, organised, and tenacious individuals to work closely with our sales teams, plan smart outreach, and consult prospects on how Salesforce can transform their impact and streamline their services.

This role blends sales development with operational excellence. You will leverage cutting-edge AI tools, like our Customer 360 platform, to streamline workflows and identify opportunities, building the foundational skills necessary to become a world-class Sales Development Representative (SDR).

 A Unique Experience: Work & Qualification Blend 
This 1-year programme is a unique opportunity to combine working towards a recognised qualification with real, hands-on experience in the role.
 80% of your time will be spent on the job, applying your learnings, interacting with customers, and practising the core skills required to succeed in tech sales.

 20% of your time will be dedicated to structured study.

 
In partnership with Skills to Advance, successful completion of this 1-year programme leads to a minimum of a QQI Level 5/6 qualification. You will start by understanding the business and our products before progressing to real customer interaction. Throughout the year, you will join a wide community of programme participants across multiple business units, receiving dedicated mentorship and holistic support to grow both personally and professionally.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Pipeline Development: Qualify inbound leads and prioritise high-potential opportunities within the NGO and Public Sector space using Customer 360 and AI-driven intelligence.

 Strategic Research: Use social media and intent signals to identify business opportunities and craft data-backed outreach strategies tailored to non-profits and government agencies.

 Operational Efficiency: Streamline internal workflows and maintain CRM data integrity to ensure our AI models and sales forecasting run at peak efficiency.

 Customer Engagement: Gain industry knowledge to develop a strong point of view for customers, learning the skills to build and maintain long-lasting relationships.

 Data Management: Support data cleaning and administrative tasks as business needs require, developing strong attention to detail and data hygiene practices

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Sales Driven: A clear desire to build a long-term career in professional sales and a passion for mastering the #1 AI CRM.

 Resilient & Goal-Oriented: A high level of accountability toward hitting targets and the resilience to remain positive through the challenges of high-volume outreach.

 Effective Communicator: Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills with the ability to convey complex value propositions clearly and professionally.

 Growth Mindset: A self-motivated learner who is eager to master new tools, collaborates well as part of a team, and takes ownership of their results and career growth.

 Additional Languages: Fluency in a second language is a strong plus, though not required.

 
 Eligibility 
 No degree required. 

 Minimum QQI Level 5, Leaving Certificate, or a Leaving Certificate alternative.

 Must have the Right to Work in Ireland.

 An openness and commitment to immersing yourself in the full 1-year programme based in Dublin.

 
 What's In It For You 
 A formal qualification, ongoing mentorship, and holistic programme support to build your network, develop your skills, and kickstart your sales career.

 25 days annual leave.

 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.

 Monthly wellbeing reimbursement and an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP).

 Generous Parental Benefits.

 Pension package & Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP).

 
 Location 
This is a hybrid role based in our Dublin hub, with an expectation of 4 days per week in the office. Applicants must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Dublin.
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations

title: Physical Infrastructure Specialist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 109,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 Abbott serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, medical devices and nutritionals products. In Ireland, Abbott employs over 4,000 people across nine sites. We have six manufacturing facilities located in Clonmel, Cootehill, Donegal, Longford and Sligo and a third-party manufacturing management operation in Sligo. Abbott has commercial, support operations and shared services in Dublin and Galway. We have been operating in Ireland since 1946.

 Abbott Ireland Financial Services Cherrywood Dublin 
 Abbott’s EMEA Finance Shared Services centre commenced operations in Cherrywood, Dublin in October 2015. From this location the Finance Shared Services provides processing and expertise, in local languages, to Abbott divisions and affiliate companies across EMEA. The core services are in Record to Report, Order to Cash, Source to Pay and Master data management. The Financial Shared Services hub is part of Corporate Finance and has regional counterparts in the US and in Singapore.
 

 PURPOSE OF THE JOB The successful candidate will support the planning, implementation, and operation of physical IT infrastructure projects across Abbott sites, while contributing to the reliability and continuous improvement of PI IT infrastructure platforms.

 Assist with the planning, design, and implementation of IT infrastructure solutions, including network cabling, fiber optic systems, power, cooling, security, and other technologies that support computer, phone, and communication networks.
 Support compliance with Abbott Engineering and IT standards, industry-recognized standards, and applicable regulatory requirements, including FDA, OSHA, and corporate policies, procedures, and training requirements.
 Assist in the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of IT-managed infrastructure systems, including structured cabling, facility technologies, electrical systems, and related platforms.
 Participate in the installation and deployment of network infrastructure components, including structured cabling, wireless access points, and other network hardware.
 Support project implementation activities by collaborating with contractors, vendors, and project teams during infrastructure installations and site construction activities.
 Develop and maintain professional working relationships with customers, technical teams, and business stakeholders to support project and operational objectives.
 Provide technical support and problem-solving assistance for infrastructure projects and operational activities under the guidance of senior team members.
 Create and maintain accurate technical documentation to support implementation, operations, compliance, and quality requirements.
 Collaborate with suppliers, contractors, and technical partners to support project planning, deployment, and operational activities.
 Assist with project status reporting, documentation updates using approved project management tools and processes.
 Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple assignments concurrently while meeting project timelines and deliverables.
 Strong customer-focused mindset with excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
 Travel of approximately 25% is required to support project execution and operational activities across domestic and international Abbott locations.
 Ability to perform independently while also contributing effectively to a team-oriented environment to support business needs and project objectives.
 
 EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES REQUIRED 1-3 years IT infrastructure support with multinational enterprises.
 
 EDUCATION AND COMPETENCIES PREFERRED Familiarity with the design, installation, and maintenance of Layer 1 physical infrastructure, including structured cabling systems.
 Familiarity with power distribution and supporting infrastructure technologies, including Uninterruptible Power Supplies (UPS), Power Distribution Units (PDUs), Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS), and related electrical systems, is preferred.
 Familiarity with IT service management and ticketing platforms, such as ServiceNow, or similar enterprise support systems, is preferred.
 Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and related business applications, including Outlook, Visio, Word, Excel, and collaboration tools used to support project delivery, documentation, and communication.
 Reliable personal transportation, along with valid and current documentation required for vehicle operation, is a requirement of this position.
 Experience working in healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated environments is preferred.
 Exposure to network infrastructure initiatives supporting acquisitions, divestitures, or business integration activities is a plus.
 Familiarity with data center environments, including critical power, cooling, and physical infrastructure systems, is advantageous.
 

 Connect with us at  www.abbott.com or https://www.ie.abbott/ , on LinkedIn at www.linkedin.com/company/abbott-/ , on Facebook at  www.facebook.com/Abbott  and on Twitter @AbbottNews .

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

Job Description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to design, test, and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which need to be deployed at the client’s end and ensure they meet 100% quality assurance parameters. This role will be part of Wipro's Industry, Cloud, and Digital Service Line Team to explore tech trends, develop domain expertise, and craft solutions for real-world business challenges.
R͏esponsibilities
1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product / software
Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities

Collaborate with global teams and senior leaders on internal initiatives aligned with our strategic partners
Initiatives will offer practical experience and exposure to the Wipro organization
Identify business requirements, translate into an actionable plan, and produce quality work

Job Title:

Job Description:
Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst – Client Data Quality and Governance
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst to focus on Client Data Quality and Governance . Reporting to the Team Lead , this is a full-time and permanent position based in Global Delivery Hubs in Johor Bahru, Malaysia / Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia / Mumbai, India / Foshan, China , allowing you to make a significant impact to our team and its growth.
Key Responsibilities
Section A – Master Data: Master File Creation & Management
Create and maintain Master Files for Managed Entities and General Relations across multiple jurisdictions in the Entity Management System database, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.
Perform quality checks to ensure all Masterfile entries meet established standards.
Store finalized documents in Document Management System in accordance with established naming conventions and filing protocols.
Liaise and coordinate with Finance, Client Acceptance Team, Business Development, Account Management, and relevant teams to ensure smooth Masterfile creation and entity setup.
Conduct periodic data quality audits to identify and rectify discrepancies.
Any other ad-hoc duties as assigned.
Section B – Entity Management System
Monitor and redirect all requests and queries to Entity Management System for request resolutions. Follow up and ensure completion of all requests and queries received.
Identify gaps and areas of improvement in Entity Management System and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution.
Gather, document, and analyse business requirements from stakeholders for Entity Management System enhancements and configurations.
Conduct gap analysis between current system capabilities and business needs.
Participate in system enhancement testing (UAT) related to Entity Management System, Document Management System and integrated platforms.
Support integration activities between Entity Management System and other platforms.
Assist in data mapping, data migration planning, and validation for system integrations.
Key Requirements
Strong attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and completeness.
Good communication skills, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Meticulous and able to work to tight deadlines while managing multiple priorities.
Independent, self-motivated, and proactive in identifying and resolving issues.
Ability to organise and prioritize work with minimum supervision.
Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.
Familiarity with database management concepts and data entry best practices.
Analytical and detail-oriented, with the ability to detect data discrepancies and ensure data integrity.
Relevant Experience
Experience working with entity management systems – ViewPoint experience is a strong advantage.
Relevant experience in KYC requirements and corporate entity structures preferred.
Prior experience in professional services firms, including corporate services and legal firms, preferred.
Experience handling entities across multiple jurisdictions is an advantage.
Education / Professional Qualifications
Degree or Diploma in any relevant field; data management certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
Company Benefits
At Vistra, we believe in putting our employees’ well-being first. We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangement and celebration leave.
Additionally, we provide comprehensive medical insurance and dental coverage, wellness allowance and competitive annual leave entitlement to support your well-being and time to recharge or explore your passions outside of work.
As advocates of continuous learning and professional development, we provide an internal mentorship program and reimburse professional membership fees for certifications like ICSA, ensuring you stay ahead in your field.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey.

title: EHSS Ireland Intern
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
 

 Inspire and be inspired. We offer a variety of opportunities for undergraduate and post-graduate students to use your talent, skills, education and passion to help make an impact on patient’s lives – all while growing your career and   
 earning academic credit.   
   
 Our Internship Programme gives you a real opportunity to gain practical ‘hands-on’ experience, training and  shadow the experts of your chosen field. It also provides you with insight into what it’s like to work with us.   
   
 We will place you in a six, nine or twelve month Internship Programme depending on the requirements of your degree course. So, are you ready to embark on a new adventure? We can’t wait to see what you’re made of!   
   
 During your placement as EHS Intern you will gain real Environmental, Health and Safety experience analyzing data to reduce injuries, reduce risk and maintain compliance.    
 Upon completion of this assignment, you will have experience working in a Biologics manufacturing facility assessing Environmental and Occupational risk, and understanding the hazards that are present in our industry.    
 You will gain practical experience leading an EHS improvement team, participating in numerous EHS and engagement teams, EHS Committees and EHS promotions.    
   
 Activities you will be involved in include:   
   
 Documentation, Auditing, and Investigation   
 Review and revise written EHS programs and procedures   
 Perform relevant EHS inspections and audits   
 Respond to EHS related incidents and participate in incident investigation   
 Identify and correct EHS deficiencies   
 Compliance and Administration   
 Update chemical and hazardous materials inventory   
 Review and update EHS Self Compliance Inventory   
 Review and update EHS Risk Assessments   
 Projects   
 Lead an improvement initiative using the Risk Reduction or Accident Reduction Route   
 Complete EHS projects as assigned   
 EHS Promotion   
 Coordination and scheduling of activities for EHS Week, Sustainability events, Earth Day etc.   
   
 What Qualities Are We Looking For?    
   
 We are looking for highly motivated individuals who can collaborate in teams and have the willingness to learn.     
   
 Environmental Science and Health,  Environmental Science or Health and Safety Systems discipline of study   
 Passionate about the biopharma sector and innovation in healthcare   
 Strong communication skills   
 Ability to work as a member of a team   
 Energetic, collaborative and dedicated . 
 
 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

title: Software Development Engineer, Network Fabric Engineering
description:
Amazon Web Services is looking for talented software engineers to join us in building the software systems that power the world's largest network. You'll work on distributed systems and AI-driven solutions that transform how networks operate, where software makes intelligent decisions and automation handles the mechanics. In this role, you'll take ownership of meaningful technical challenges while collaborating with a skilled team to shape the future of network infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and develop software solutions that integrate seamlessly into our distributed system architecture
- Own the complete development lifecycle for assigned features, including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support
- Collaborate across teams to understand requirements, share technical insights, and ensure solutions align with broader system goals
- Contribute to team growth by sharing knowledge, providing constructive feedback, and supporting the development of other engineers
- Identify and drive technical and process improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and team productivity

A day in the life
As a Software Development Engineer, you'll focus on designing and implementing software solutions within our distributed ecosystem. Your day might include architecting components that integrate with our larger system, writing and reviewing code with teammates, and troubleshooting production systems to ensure reliability. You'll participate in design discussions with colleagues, mentor other engineers on the team, and contribute to our technical strategy. Beyond coding, you'll help identify ways to improve our processes and tools, ensuring our team operates efficiently and delivers value to both internal and external customers.

About the team
We are a collaborative group of 100+ engineers committed to reimagining how networks are operated through software and automation. Our team values shared ownership, continuous learning, and supporting one another's growth. We work in small, autonomous teams where your contributions directly impact our customers and the broader organization. Together, we're building the infrastructure that enables intelligent, automated decision-making at scale. We're excited to welcome someone who is ready to grow with us, contribute fresh perspectives, and help us tackle some of the most interesting technical challenges in the industry.
- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

title: Consultant Financial Crimes Investigator x2
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 About The Role:

 The Consultant Financial Crimes Investigator role will be responsible for utilizing analytical skills and innovative strategies to detect, prevent, and report fraudulent activities at Northern Trust. This role will operate within a fast paced and dynamic global fraud team that is instrumental in protecting our clients against financial fraud.  
   
   
   
 Daily activities include, but are not limited to:   
 • Utilize advanced data analysis techniques to detect and prevent fraud within client facing applications. Review comprehensive daily reports to identify anomalous patterns, transactions, or behaviors that may indicate unauthorized activity or fraud.   
 • Review and verify login anomalies and suspicious transactions to identify or prevent policy violations, identity theft, and financial crimes by means of web-based and internal system research, coordinated efforts through cross-functional partnerships, client and internal partner notifications and interviews.   
 • Analyze datasets from various sources and systems to identify and prevent potentially fraudulent activity. Research complex account movements that may involve multiple transaction channels, accounts, or client relationships.   
 • Review and authenticate alerts generated by the Internal Fraud Detection systems. Validate transactions and activities using data from multiple sources. Escalate cases as needed to managers, HR and Fraud Investigations.   
 • Leverage advanced skills and subject matter expertise to work independently, within an established fraud research and mitigation framework, to detect and respond to identity theft, scams and fraud risks appropriately and effectively.   
 • Conduct thorough and well documented analysis, in accordance with policy and procedures. Consult with cross-functional departments to validate or invalidate suspicious transactions, and take appropriate proactive action to protect clients and the bank from additional fraud exposure.   
 • Maintain the integrity of highly sensitive data, analysis, and confidentiality of systems, policies and case details, and ensure that all fraud prevention efforts are executed in compliance with relevant laws and regulations.   
 • Communicate findings, trends, and potential risks to the fraud team and management, to aid in strengthening the bank’s preventative posture and enhancing the fraud program.   
   
   
 Qualifications: 
 • Strong analytical skills and the ability to work with complex data.   
 • Knowledge of Actimize Xceed / Guardian Analytics preferred.   
 • Current and historical knowledge of malware variants and common attack vectors.   
 • Experience in phone interviewing for the identification of client impersonators and scams.   
 • Understanding of common industry client Authentication processes, tools and Internet Security.   
 • Ability to identify potential fraudulent or suspicious accounts and activities and take appropriate action to prevent loss. Display good judgement in a fast-paced and results-driven environment.   
 • General understanding of commercial web browsers such as Internet Explorer, Firefox, Google Chrome, and Safari.   
 • General understanding of computer networking, including but not limited to; local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), internet service provision (ISP), internet protocol (IP), local machine and group security policies, firewalls, and web proxy/content filtering.   
 • General understanding of end-user operating systems, including Windows and Apple OS.   
 • General understanding of traditional money movement transactions, systems and fintech.   
 • Experience with advanced data analysis tools (i.e. power BI, advanced Excel, link analysis, R / Python, OSINT, etc.)   
 • Several years relevant work experience is preferred. Related Industry qualification (e.g., ACAMS, CFE) or studying towards, is preferred.   

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

title: Data Center Infrastructure Engineer Internship 2027
description:
Join our Field Engineering team and gain hands-on experience supporting the technical infrastructure that powers Amazon Web Services. You'll work alongside experienced engineers to troubleshoot complex systems, contribute to data center optimization projects, and develop expertise in hyper-scale facility operations while learning how cutting-edge technologies keep our data centers running efficiently.

As an intern you will work with leading-edge technologies and equipment and learn how hyper-scale data centers are able to operate efficiently and with minimal downtime. You will work with tenured Field Engineers (FEs), allowing you to learn and experience the day-to-day activities in a fast-paced and high-tech industry. You will support with deep dives into operational events and may also be given your own projects to run, exposing you to internal systems and operational processes. 

Key job responsibilities
• Troubleshoot, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and create Corrective Action (CA) documentation for site/equipment failures.
• Directly support operational issues with ad-hoc training, complex operating procedure reviews, including critical equipment, and event support.
• Own the conceptual design for existing data center upgrades and design-solutions, which add capacity, improve availability, and increase efficiency.
• Interface with internal data center design engineering team, server hardware team, environmental health and safety team to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.
• Work on concurrent projects.
• Support new construction projects during design, build, commissioning, and handover.

A day in the life
As a Field Engineering Intern, you'll immerse yourself in the dynamic environment of Amazon data centers, where you'll collaborate with seasoned Field Engineers on real operational challenges. Your day might include investigating equipment failures and documenting root cause analyses, reviewing complex operating procedures with operations teams, or supporting the design and implementation of data center upgrades that enhance capacity and efficiency. You'll participate in concurrent projects ranging from new construction commissioning to facility optimization initiatives, gaining exposure to internal systems and operational processes. Working across multiple technical domains—from electrical and mechanical systems to environmental considerations—you'll develop a comprehensive understanding of how we maintain reliability and performance at scale.

About the team
We are the Field Engineering team, serving as the technical backbone for AWS Data Center Operations across multiple regions. Our mission is to provide electrical and mechanical expertise throughout the complete lifecycle of our data centers—from initial design through ongoing optimization and maintenance. We collaborate closely with design engineering, server hardware, environmental health and safety, and other partner teams to establish standards that ensure consistency and reliability in the services we deliver. Our team is energized by solving complex technical challenges and supporting our colleagues with the specialized knowledge needed to keep our infrastructure operating at peak performance. Joining us means becoming part of a group committed to continuous improvement and technical excellence.
- Currently enrolled in a BE/BSc in Electrical / Mechanical/ Design Engineering/ Building Services or similar technical focus graduating in 2027
- Experience with problem-solving methodologies and analytical approaches to technical challenges
- Demonstrated ability to manage attention to detail and work with data-driven processes
- Experience building collaborative relationships with diverse stakeholders and teams
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with a commitment to maintaining high quality standards in documentation and reporting

title: Associate Accountant
description:
Associate Accountant (1-3 years' experience) 

 Full-time, Permanent 

 Hybrid - 3 Days Onsite 

 Monday – Friday, 9am – 5.30pm 

 Dublin, Ireland 

  

 In this role, you will work closely with qualified accountants and senior management to provide accounting and financial services for capital market transactions. 

 This role would suit an ambitious, energetic person keen to progress in a dynamic, rapidly growing business and committed to achieving an ACCA qualification. The final salary will be determined based on relevant skills, experience, and role scope, in line with our objective and gender‑neutral compensation framework.

 Key responsibilities: 

 
 Assisting in the preparation of a trial balance and financial statements for a portfolio of Special Purpose Vehicles (“SPVs”);

 Posting journal entries including cash transactions, accruals, prepayments, revenue and expenses; and performing reconciliations;

 Assisting in the preparation of monthly and quarterly management accounts and routine client deliverables;

 Assisting in the preparation and filing of quarterly regulatory returns to the Central Bank of Ireland;

 Assisting in the completion of VAT returns, Corporation Tax returns and iXBRL tagged financial statements;

 Assisting senior accountants and managers throughout the external audit process;

 Liaising professionally with clients, auditors and other third parties providing services to the SPVs;

 Gaining familiarity with a diverse range of capital markets structures and products;

 Liaising and collaborating with colleagues in the client accounting team and across other departments to support process improvement and knowledge sharing;

 Participating in ad hoc administrative tasks and providing general support to the senior members of the team.

  

 
 Required technical skills, experience and qualifications: 

 
 Graduate in business or finance (ideally 2.1 or above).

 Commitment to pursuing an ACCA qualification in the next three years

 A good understanding of basic accounting debits and credits is required

 Strong organisational skills and an ability to meet tight deadlines.

 Team player, with strong problem-solving skills and a solution-based mindset.

 Conscientious and diligent, with high attention to detail.

 Professional, friendly demeanour with enthusiasm for the role.

 Proficient in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint.

  

 
 About Us 

 CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®

 Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.

We encourage candidates to work closely with our talent acquisition partners to convey their specific needs. We specialise in providing innovative unit-linked pension, savings, and protection solutions and have become a trusted partner for life insurance products distributed through independent brokers. It is our priority to support our customers at every stage of life with the best products and service, tailored to their needs - and we’re doing it all in a culture that promotes equality and inclusion for all of our current and future employees.
Role Overview
Based in Dublin, the Finance Test Analyst (Projects) is a permanent role and part of a cross company team that are tasked with the implementation of new code and functionality deliveries for CLE’s administration system, for both new and existing business, and any linkages to existing peripheral systems.
The main purpose of the role is to perform testing, automate existing testing approaches with assistance from the Test automation team, ensure a smooth

•    Re-design, automate and implement aspects of testing process for the business acceptance testing for finance
•    Automate existing testing approaches with assistance from Test automation team and work through backlog of automation activities
•    Perform the testing for regular functionality deliveries along with other team members
•    Review and analysis of testing output of other team members and other teams (e.g. End-to-end testing, Quality Assurance (QA) regression, etc.)

title: Software Engineer (Generative AI and Innovation)
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Excited by the pace of AI and the chance to build something meaningful? Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation. 
 
 You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one.   
 
 This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office. 

 
 THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION   
 

 This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results.   
 

 WHAT YOU'LL DO   
 

 Own medium-scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production-ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it   

 
 Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table   

 
 Build practical applications — AI-powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value   

 
 Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas   

 
 Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work   

 
 Stay hands-on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve   

 
 Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design   

 
 Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently   

 
 Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing   

 

 WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT   
 
 This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well-connected tech hubs.   

 
 What you need to have: 
 
 Solid software engineering experience (typically 2–5 years), with a track record of delivering features independently   

 
 Experience contributing to production-grade applications   

 
 Hands-on experience with modern JavaScript/TypeScript development, including a framework such as React, Vue, or Angular   

 

 Backend experience with Node.js, NestJS, or similar technologies   

 
 Experience using Python to build AI-powered workflows, integrations, or applications   

 
 Good understanding of APIs and integrating AI into real-world products and business processes   

 
 Hands-on experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, tool use, and structured outputs   

 
 Familiarity with RAG, retrieval pipelines, and embeddings   

 
 Exposure to modern agent patterns and multi-step, tool-connected workflows   

 
 Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes, and an interest in how AI applications are deployed and scaled   

 
 Good communication skills, a practical and thoughtful approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work across engineering and business teams   

 

 What makes you stand out:   
 

 Experience taking features from early experimentation through to production use   

 
 Curiosity about emerging standards in the agent ecosystem, including Model Context Protocol (MCP)   

 
 Exposure to vector databases and semantic search   

 
 An eye for the quality, reliability, latency, and cost-efficiency of AI systems   

 
 Exposure to AI evaluation frameworks, testing approaches, and guardrails for reliable and responsible AI   

 
 A willingness to support others and contribute to engineering best practices   

 

 We know that candidates may not meet every listed requirement exactly. If you’re excited about the role and believe you could thrive in it, we encourage you to apply.   
 
 Why join our team: 
 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders. 
 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities. 
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being. 
 
 #MMCIC
 
 

 
 
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit corporate.marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Recruitment Process FAQ, Experienced Professionals
description:
Skip to main content Recruitment Process FAQ, Experienced Professionals
Explore our Recruitment Process FAQs for answers to common questions and insights into what to expect when you apply to join the Azets team.
Here you'll find answers to common questions about applying to Azets, our hiring process, and what to expect as you move through the different stages. We're here to help you every step of the way as you explore career opportunities with us.
Do you accept applications from overseas candidates?
We are typically unable to consider applications from overseas candidates, only in exceptional circumstances. This is due to the complexities associated with visa sponsorship and relocation.
What should I include in my application?
Your application should include a CV tailored to the position you are applying for. Make sure to highlight your relevant experience, skills, and why you are interested in the position. You can start your application directly on our current opportunities page.
Who can I contact if I have questions about my application?
Any enquiries about a role ahead of applying please contact our recruitment team at recruitment@azets.co.uk
What is the recruitment process like?
We believe that a recruitment process should be clear and straightforward. Here's what you can expect:
Application Submission: Submit your application through our careers page, tailoring your CV and cover letter to the role you are applying for.
Initial Screening: Our Talent Acquisition Team will review your application to see how well your qualifications and experience align with the role’s requirements.
Interviews: Our Talent Acquisition team will invite you to a phone call or video call where they will explore your experience and answer any initial questions about Azets and the role. They will also outline the process for the role that you have applied for. The number of further interview stages will depend on the complexity and seniority of the role you have applied for.
Job Offer: You will receive a verbal offer, followed by formal paperwork delivered digitally which will include an offer letter, contract and information about the benefits available to you upon joining Azets.
Onboarding: Once we receive your signed paperwork back, we will begin your onboarding process. During this time, you will received all the details you need to start your journey at Azets smoothly. Our comprehensive onboarding process ensures you’re well-prepared to join your new team and start contributing from day one.
How can I prepare for an interview?
You will be sent additional interview guidance prior to your interview. We recommend using the STAR method to prepare for interviews. The STAR method helps you structure your answers to behavioral interview questions by focusing on the following components:
Situation : Describe the context within which you performed a task or faced a challenge at work.
Task : Explain the actual task or challenge that was involved.
Action : Detail the specific actions you took to address the task or challenge.
Result : Share the outcomes or results of your actions.
By using the STAR method, you can provide clear and concise answers that highlight your skills and experiences effectively.
Do you offer apprenticeships, internships or graduate programs?
Yes, we offer a range of internship, school leaver, graduate and apprenticeship programs. Full information can be found on our (link to) Early Careers page.
Can I apply for multiple roles at once?
Yes, you can apply for multiple positions that match your skills and interests. However, we recommend tailoring your application to each specific role.
How long does the recruitment process take?
Answer: The recruitment process can vary depending on the position and the number of applicants. On average, it takes about 4-6 weeks from a successful application submission to job offer.
What does the onboarding experience look like?
Pre-boarding : Before your first day, you'll receive a welcome message with practical information about your start date, induction information, contact persons, and an overview of your first day. We'll also prepare your IT equipment to ensure you have everything you need.
First Week : During your first week, you'll meet your colleagues, get introduced to different departments, and receive basic training. This helps you get acclimated to your new role and the company culture.
First Month : You'll continue to receive support and training to help you become more comfortable and productive in your role.

title: Electrical Technician
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott Diabetes Care – Kilkenny 
IDA Ireland Kilkenny Business & Technology Park, Kilkenny R95 A02A
 
 Build Your Future. Improve Lives. Grow with Abbott. 
 At Abbott, we don't just manufacture products, we change lives.
 Our Kilkenny facility is one of the most advanced manufacturing sites in Europe, producing FreeStyle glucose monitoring technology that supports millions of people living with diabetes worldwide. As we continue to grow, we're building a team of Technicians at multiple experience levels, offering secure careers, real progression, and meaningful work from day one.
 
 This opportunity may particularly suit qualified electricians, maintenance electricians, industrial electricians, and electrical technicians who are interested in applying their technical skills within a highly automated manufacturing environment while developing expertise in advanced production technologies.
 The Role We are recruiting Electrical Technicians at various experience levels to join our brand-new Kilkenny site. This is a hands-on technical role where you'll play a critical role in ensuring our automated production lines run safely, efficiently, and reliably. You'll work with modern machinery, structured maintenance systems, and cross-functional teams, with strong opportunities for skill development and career progression in a growing operation.
 What You'll Do Perform preventative maintenance, fault diagnosis, and repairs on production equipment
 Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and automated systems
 Monitor machine performance and support OEE and yield targets
 Use data and CMMS systems to identify issues and drive improvements
 Support or lead continuous improvement and root cause analysis activities
 Assist with equipment installation, validation, and upgrades
 Train and support operators on production equipment
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, quality, and operations teams
 Maintain clear documentation, reporting, and compliance standards
 Experience Levels – Where You Fit We are hiring across two levels, recognising both potential and proven experience:
 
 Level A 
 You are early in your career or transitioning into manufacturing.
 Foundational mechanical/electrical knowledge (Level 6+ qualification, electrical apprenticeship, or equivalent)
 Some hands-on experience (education, apprenticeship, or early role)
 Basic troubleshooting skills with a willingness to learn
 Works best with guidance and structured support
 Strong attitude, curiosity, and motivation to grow
 
 We hire Level A for potential and invest in your development. 
 
 Level B 
 You bring strong, proven experience in a technical or manufacturing environment.
 Significant hands-on experience with automated equipment, maintenance, or electrical systems
 Confident in independent troubleshooting and fault finding
 Experience in regulated or high-volume manufacturing (advantageous)
 Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and drive root cause analysis
 Comfortable working autonomously and leading tasks
 Strong communicator, able to train others and drive improvements
 
 We hire Level B for performance. You'll hit the ground running and make a difference immediately. 
 What You'll Bring Level 6 qualification (or higher) in a technical/engineering discipline, or a recognised electrical trade qualification
 Problem-solving mindset with strong troubleshooting ability
 Interest or experience in automation and manufacturing
 A safety-first, quality-driven approach
 Strong teamwork and communication skills
 Experience with CMMS or data-driven systems (advantageous)

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 LOCATION: Ireland > Kilkenny : Kilkenny Business and Technology Park

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Kky4Cya1 (Ireland)

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

 At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

 Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

 Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend)
   
 Department & Team: JM & EDP — Journey Data Team
   
 Location: Galway (Flexible, 2–3 office days per week)
   
 Summary 
 We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Journey Data backend team and help build products and services that bring the benefits of the Genesys Cloud Event Data Platform to our customers. You will work closely with a team of engineers and product managers to ideate, build, operate, and scale customer-facing features across the full development lifecycle. You will get the opportunity to work with modern technologies including a wide array of Amazon Web Services (AWS), Jenkins, New Relic, Sumo Logic, and proprietary Genesys software.
   
 About Our Team 
 Our team is primarily focused on maintaining and expanding the capabilities of:
 
 Customer Segmentation – groups customers by shared attributes and behaviours to provide context and enrichment for agentic orchestration
 
 
 Predictive Engagement – proactively engages with web or mobile app visitors to provide assistance when needed in their customer journ ey 
 
   
 Minimum Requirements 
 - 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering.
 - Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline.
 - Advanced proficiency with Java and Spring Boot for backend systems.
 - Advanced proficiency with multi-layered testing approaches: unit, integration, and user-acceptance testing.
 - Experience with NoSQL database design, access patterns, and data modelling for high-throughput, low-latency workloads.
 - Experience with common resiliency patterns in distributed microservice architectures: circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting, and retries.
 - Experience with event-driven architectural patterns and REST APIs.
 - Experience with AWS cloud-based technologies for deploying and managing software systems.
 - Experience working with CI/CD processes and technologies.
 - Experience designing and owning services end-to-end, from technical design through to production observability.
 - Experience with performance optimisation and troubleshooting production systems at scale.
 - Experience mentoring or providing technical leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.
 - Proactive, self-driven learner with strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills, able to adopt new technologies and navigate ambiguity in an agile environment.
 - Demonstrated awareness of modern AI technologies and their implications (safety, privacy, reliability), with role-appropriate skills developed through training and applied practice.
 - Proven leadership experience with a track record of delivering complex software projects from concept through to production.
 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, able to work effectively with product, design, QA, and other teams to drive shared outcomes.
 - Confident communicator with the ability to present technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 - Drives initiatives to completion with minimal oversight
   
 Desirable Skills 
 - Experience with Amazon Web Services (or similar): EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, CloudFormation.
 - Experience with supporting technologies (or similar): Jenkins, Terraform, New Relic, OpenTelemetry, Sumo Logic, Kafka, Avro, Resilience4j, Swagger/OpenAPI.
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code ownership: designing modules, managing state, and handling multi-environment deployments.
 - Experience with other programming languages used in supporting services: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Groovy.
 - Experience using AI tooling as a co-pilot for developing production-ready code.
 - Contribution to on-call rotations and incident response.
   
 Our Benefits: 
 At Genesys, we’re committed to supporting your well-being, growth, and work–life balance. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
 Flexible work options  – Choose what works for you with hybrid schedules, work-from-home flexibility, and the option to collaborate onsite in our state-of-the-art Galway office.

 Career development & growth  – Access continuous learning opportunities, mentoring, and clear paths for advancement.

 Competitive pension scheme  – Invest in your future with an excellent employer-supported pension plan.

 Annual bonus program  – Be rewarded for your impact and contributions.

 Comprehensive health coverage  – Including private   health insurance, access to   company dental plan,   and wellness supports. 

 Financial protection  – Enjoy Income Protection and Life Assurance, along with  access to dedicated financial planning resources t o help you make confident, informed decisions about your future.

 Family-friendly policies  – Generous paid maternity and paternity

 
 Working at Genesys 
 AI at enterprise scale  – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. 
 A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. 
 Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. 
 Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. 
 Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. 
 Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.
