title: Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Sr. Specialist, Product Experience Design, Crypto 
Overview
The Crypto Solutions team within Mastercard's Financial Crimes organization is driving the next generation of risk, compliance, and security solutions that enable financial institutions to safely participate in the rapidly evolving digital asset ecosystem. As traditional financial infrastructure converges with blockchain-based payment networks, the need for trusted, scalable, and intelligent risk management capabilities has never been greater.
We are seeking a Senior Specialist, Product Experience Design to help shape the future of Mastercard's Crypto Solutions portfolio. This role will be responsible for designing intuitive, customer-centric experiences that simplify complex risk, compliance, and security signals into actionable insights.
You will empathize with our customers to understand their needs and motivations, define user problems, design end-to-end journeys and experiment with these ideas to bring new designs – consistent with Mastercard's design standards – from concept through to development, working closely with Product, PMTs, and Engineers on a regular basis.

Role
• Design end-to-end user experiences for Crypto Solutions products, including onboarding, researching, monitoring, and reporting journeys.
• Apply best-practice UX methods to identify solutions to customer problems, experiment to validate them, and create final deliverables for Engineering partners.
• Work closely and regularly with Product Managers, PMTs, and Engineers to translate product strategy and customer needs into intuitive digital experiences.
• Develop user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, and validate them through user research and usability testing.
• Design communications and decks to pitch new product ideas and concepts to stakeholders.
• Support hands-on product-feature design within initiatives, contributing to timely, quality deliverables that meet stated goals.
• Work as part of a functional team, partnering with senior-level peers to gain experience and grow design skillset over time.

All About You
The ideal candidate for this position should:
• Have hands-on experience in a user experience function, including a tactical skillset in designing and validating solutions that solve user problems.
• Have enterprise software, fintech, payments, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, or comparable industry experience; digital asset or blockchain exposure is a plus.
• Demonstrate the ability to execute tactical design outputs, with support from senior-level peers as needed.
• Develop new designs leveraging Copilot, Figma Make & other generative AI tools.
• Familiarity with design thinking principles
• A passion to be the empathetic advocate for the customer by turning complexity into simple solutions.
• Have proficiency in Figma for UX prototyping and design systems.
• Experience leveraging design systems
• Be proficient in PowerPoint for communicating design concepts and product ideas.
• Be comfortable collaborating across Product, PMT, Engineering, and Data Science in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Career Opportunities in Greece for Foreigners: 2026 Guide

Key Takeaways
Greece is rapidly expanding its BPO, tech, and tourism sectors, creating abundant opportunities for international professionals ready to relocate.
Speaking languages like German, Dutch, or Nordic tongues significantly increases your earning potential and career mobility in the local job market.
Workers in Greece benefit from a highly supportive 14-salary compensation system and comprehensive relocation packages designed to make moving seamless.
Are you a foreigner looking to live and work in Greece?
This guide explores the booming market for jobs in Greece for foreigners 2026. We will walk you through the top industries actively hiring, the specific language skills companies need most, and the fantastic relocation perks available. You will discover exactly what you need to build a sustainable and rewarding life under the beautiful Mediterranean sun.
High-Demand Jobs Greece Offers Right Now
The job market in Greece provides a wide variety of roles for professionals at all stages of their careers. Whether you are an entry-level candidate or an experienced manager, you will find positions that match your skills.
Customer Service and CX Support
The essence of customer service excellence lies in connection; it is the bridge built between understanding a customer's needs and delivering satisfying solutions. Consequently, customer service jobs Greece are among the most accessible and rewarding positions available. You will act as the frontline ambassador for top global brands, helping clients solve problems via phone, chat, and email. These roles offer excellent foundational training and clear pathways into team leadership.
Technical Support and IT
If you have a knack for problem-solving and an interest in technology, technical support roles provide an incredible entry point into the tech industry. Tech companies rely on knowledgeable professionals to help users navigate software issues and hardware glitches. Greece's tech sector is maturing rapidly, meaning these support roles often lead to advanced IT, networking, or cybersecurity positions.
Looking for work abroad in 2026? Explore customer service and multilingual career opportunities in Greece with TTEC Athens.
Sales and Business Development
International sales roles are perfect for confident communicators who enjoy building relationships and driving business growth. Companies look for ambitious individuals to manage accounts, generate leads, and close deals across European markets. These positions typically feature strong commission structures, rewarding your hard work directly.
Tourism and Hospitality
Tourism remains a cornerstone of the Greek economy. Hotels, travel agencies, and tour operators constantly seek international talent to provide exceptional service to global visitors. If you love creating memorable experiences for others, this sector offers dynamic, fast-paced roles that let you showcase the beauty of Greece to the world.
Your job search and application process in Greece as a foreigner will likely be very similar to your job search elsewhere. You can apply online through career sites and job portals. Additionally, you'll be required to process your work visa and permits. Global companies, like TTEC Athens , will provide guidance and assistance throughout your journey, so don't be afraid to ask.
The Power of Languages in Multilingual Jobs Greece
Being able to speak two or more languages is an incredible asset for businesses looking to expand their customer base and reach new markets. While English is the standard corporate language, specific European languages command a premium.
If you speak German or Dutch, your skills are incredibly valuable. Companies serving the vast DACH and Benelux regions constantly recruit talent to support these robust markets. Nordic languages—such as Swedish, Norwegian, and Danish—are equally prized. Because there are fewer native speakers of these languages available locally, companies compete fiercely to hire and retain this talent.
Pursuing multilingual jobs Greece allows you to leverage your native tongue to secure better pay, faster promotions, and greater job security. Your cultural intelligence helps global brands connect authentically with their customers, making you an indispensable part of the team.

Salary Expectations and Relocation Benefits
Understanding your earning potential is a crucial step in planning your move. Greece offers a compensation structure that is both unique and highly beneficial for workers.
The 14-Salary System
When evaluating international careers Greece, you must factor in the 14-salary system . By law, private-sector employees receive their standard 12 monthly salaries, plus additional payments to support them during major holidays. You receive a full extra salary in December, half a salary before Easter, and half a salary before your summer vacation. This structure provides a fantastic financial cushion, making it easier to budget for travel and leisure.
Packages for Greece Relocation Jobs
We know that moving abroad is a massive undertaking. To ease this transition, leading employers offer exceptional relocation packages for Greece jobs . Companies typically pay for your flight to Greece, arrange airport pickups, and cover your hotel accommodations for the first few weeks.
Dedicated support teams also help you navigate local administrative tasks. They assist you in setting up a bank account, securing a tax number, and finding a permanent apartment. This comprehensive support ensures you feel welcomed and settled from your very first day.

description:
Introduction Dentons Business Services EMEA is the operational backbone of Dentons, supporting the world's largest law firm in delivering exceptional service to clients across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. As a crucial component of Dentons' global network, our EMEA business services team plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration. 
 At Dentons Business Services EMEA, we are committed to excellence in supporting legal professionals with cutting-edge solutions. Our dynamic and diverse team collaborates seamlessly to provide a wide range of services, including finance, IT, human resources, marketing, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
 Role The purpose of this role is to support the AML Operations Manager and the Global Head of AML and Sanctions Compliance in implementing the Firm-wide Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and sanctions programme and undertake Client Due Diligence (CDD) checks on clients. 
 The role will involve assessing clients and their matters to ensure compliance with applicable AML legislation and to advise the Firm on financial crime and other risk issues.  
 
 Accountabilities and Responsibilities Undertaking and handling all types of Client Due diligence (CDD) 
 Review and assess the risks of all new clients and matters from AML, sanctions and reputational risks perspective;
 Undertaking client and matter risk assessments
 Undertaking sanctions screening updates;
 Assisting with the ongoing monitoring of clients and matters  
 Advising on sanctions, professional ethical obligations, matter and billing structure, engagement terms and inter-office working arrangements
 Providing a 'concierge' service to partners by liaising with clients directly on AML and sanctions issues, either in person, on the phone or in writing.
 Managing all stages of the matter opening process and escalate any issues as necessary
 Assists with the firm's internal audit processes;
 Dealing with basic data protection queries relevant to AML
 Assisting with AML and Sanctions training to the Firm
 Reviewing and updating Dentons' internal compliance policies and procedures
 Assisting with projects and ad hoc assignments as required
 
 The above list is not exhaustive as the team and the firm continue to evolve and develop with the changing domestic and international legal landscapes and as we identify new ways of improving our service to the firm.
 More important than any particular skill, we are looking for dynamic and flexible team players with highly developed critical thinking who can assess legal and commercial risks presented to the firm and advise on appropriate mitigation strategies.

 - This role operates in Hybrid working model requiring DBSE Warsaw office presence 1-2 times a week
 Requirements 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Relevant University Degree

 Highly effective research skills using all relevant information sources, including IT resources and ability to use them to their full potential
 A good knowledge of relevant compliance rules and regulations, including (but not limited to) client care, conflicts of interest, confidentiality, anti-bribery and corruption, money laundering, sanctions.
 Able to assemble research and produce clear, accurate findings
 Can analyse issues and draw/express conclusions succinctly
 Able to use internal precedents and draft emails in plain English
 PC literate with a good working knowledge of MS Office, e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
 Able to keep all general administration up-to-date and under control
 Experience using new business intake systems e.g Intapp OPEN
 
 Personal skills / attributes 
 Versatile, resourceful and creative thinker who is ready to get involved in whatever task is facing the team
 Proficient written and verbal communication skills
 Can effectively and clearly explain problems and issues to partners and clients and actively contribute to their resolution
 Strong problem solving and analytical skills; can clearly explain and present problems and issues to others
 Able to demonstrate strong customer facing skills
 Able to make incisive decisions and operate efficiently in challenging situations
 Able to effectively manage and prioritise tasks where appropriate
 Able to analyse and recognise the need for improvement to systems and controls and suggest options for improvements to the AML Operations Manager.
 Take an efficient and organised approach to dealing with administration.
 Able to be an ambassador for Dentons, being professional in outlook and attitude
 Benefits 
 
 Private medical healthcare provided by Medicover 
 MultiSport card 
 Benefit Cafeteria system  
 Option to join a private insurance plan 
 An additional day off for your birthday 
 Tailored learning & development opportunities 
 Hybrid work model with a modern office in Warsaw city center

What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.

description:
Airfield Operatives work in the Airside Management Department. The role reports directly to the Airfield Facilities Manager is a shift role with a requirement to work, Days/Nights/Weekdays/Weekends (12hr shift patterns).

 Airfield Operatives carry out both planned and reactive maintenance on a diverse range of airfield & landside infrastructural assets including; runways, taxiways, aprons pavement, airfield paint markings, footpaths, roads, grasslands, drainage infrastructure, security fence, boundary gates at Ireland’s busiest airport to ensure safe and efficient operations at all times.

 This role is a physical role requiring persons to be fit to carry out physical work activities in a highly regulated and safety critical environment.

title: Development Executive - Cyber Specialty Team
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Job Description For Posting

 The Cyber Risk landscape continues to evolve at an accelerated rate, with continued exploitation of 0-day & Edge Devices, as well the use of deepfakes for misinformation and cyber extortion, driven by more sophisticated AI technology. It is widely recognised by Risk Managers as representing one of the most significant threats to the viability and continuity of business operations across the globe.
 
 Marsh’s global Cyber Practice is the World’s Most Trusted and Innovative Cyber Risk Advisor. Servicing clients in 130+ countries, illustrating global reach and local expertise, we pride ourselves on simplifying the complexity of Cyber. Through the application of unique Digital Tooling that is unrivalled within the marketplace, our global proprietary wordings, regional facilities, incident management support, and our global team of Cyber specialists, we provide our Clients with a holistic Cyber service proposition, helping them to Understand, Measure, Manage and Respond to Cyber Risk.  
 
 In a direct response to the increased demand and complexity of Cyber Risk, Marsh Ireland are seeking the appointment of an ambitious, motivated and results-driven Business Development Executive to join our Cyber team.  
 The individual concerned will join an existing team of motivated and enthusiastic technical Cyber specialists that are dedicated in providing Clients with Cyber Risk Service Solutions. Working closely with this team the successful candidate will benefit from comprehensive on the job training and education on Marsh Cyber solutions and services.
 
 This key role will involve maintaining responsibility and accountability for the creation and identification of new business opportunities, building and maintaining existing and prospective client relationships and working in collaboration with colleagues across the wider Marsh business to deliver our Cyber Value Proposition to new and existing clients and to drive new business revenue growth within the Cyber/Specialty practice.
 
 This represents an exciting opportunity for the right candidate with previous insurance experience ( must be CIP qualified ), ideally from a broking background, but not necessarily having significant existing Cyber and/or Financial Lines experience, and who possesses the required growth mindset, to transition themselves into a Trusted Risk and Innovated Cyber Advisor.
 With support from the wider business and the existing Team, the individual will develop strong expertise on Cyber risk, technical Cyber product knowledge and in addition will gain an in-depth understanding of and ability to articulate the Marsh Cyber Ireland Value Proposition.
 
 The role will be based in one of our ROI offices situated in Dublin or Cork or Galway and offers a hybrid working model, with 3 days in the office and 2 days remote. It will require a commitment to travel to colleague, client and prospect meetings.
 The successful candidate will be exclusively focused and dedicated to New & Expanded Cyber/Tech and FINPRO Product and Solution Sales. They will be tasked to support and implement an ambitious growth strategy and to achieve short, medium and long term growth targets.
 
 Main Activities 
 This is a sales function and the individual will be expected to develop and execute a growth strategy and development plan, aligned to our country, region and global value proposition.
 
 What can you expect: 
 To be part of an organisation with a leading global brand, a brilliant and expert team and a positive, vibrant and inclusive culture.
 You will gain the opportunity to excel and further your next career steps through intensive on the job training, interesting & challenging work, further professional development opportunities and supportive leaders.
 A key component of the role will be the Intense Technical Cyber and FINPRO training that will provide unique industry expertise.
 
 We will rely on you to:  
 Gain in-depth knowledge and understanding of Marsh’s CyberTech value proposition and develop technical working knowledge of CyberTech & FINPRO products.

 Actively seek and develop relationships with prospects and client contacts. While maintaining control and oversight of Cyber active client target/prospect list.

 Develop market profile, attend Industry Trade events/shows, compose marketing materials and insights for wider circulation on social media and Company marketing distribution.

 Draft and deliver new business presentations and support colleagues in the creation and development of expanded new business opportunities

 Identify potential growth areas, whitespace opportunities and newly developed cover solutions.

 Review Client Risk Assessments and identify potential opportunities for the provision of additional Marsh Advisory/Consulting and Incident Management services aswell as oversee, manage and coordinate the wider Cyber Advisory and Claims Incident Management services.

 Work with other business stakeholders to create increased Cross-selling opportunities. Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve targets and objectives.

 Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends and opportunities while collaborating with marketing, product, and operations teams to align business development strategies.

 Monitor and report on sales performance metrics and suggest improvements.

 Attend industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to promote the company and generate leads alongside staying up-to-date with industry developments and best practices.

 
 What you will need to have: 
 CIP qualification

 3 - 5 years minimum general insurance experience

 Full drivers licence and access to own car/private transportation

 Eager to learn and to enhance knowledge and technical skills

 Self-motivated and energised  

 Ability to communicate at all levels with clients & colleagues

 Team player and work with other business stakeholders

 
 What makes you stand out: 
 ACII qualification  

 Proven track record of Sales delivery is desired but not essential

 Professional certifications in sales or business development are advantageous

 
 Why join our team: 
 We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work, and supportive leaders.

 We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have an impact for colleagues, clients, and communities.

 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

 

 
 
Marsh Risk is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information about Marsh Risk, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X. 
 
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, Traveller community, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable support to any candidate with a disability/health condition to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. We welcome candidates to contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com to discuss any specific needs. 
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Supporting various Hedge & ManCo Dev Projects

title: Equity Analyst – Fundamental Value Equities - VP1, State Street Investment Management
description:
Equity Analyst – Fundamental Value Equities 
 Location: Dublin, Ireland   
 Team: Active Fundamental Equities  
 Sector: Information Technology & Communication Services
 
 Promoting a Culture of Excellence 

 Our success hinges on attracting the best people. Highly skilled, engaged, and productive teams are our greatest asset — and essential to everything we achieve. We hire talented, diverse professionals who share our commitment to helping clients, and those who rely on them, achieve financial security. We insist on, and reward, performance excellence.
 We are committed to helping you build a fulfilling career. Our aim is to be the employer of choice, offering competitive compensation, meaningful development opportunities, and a work environment that values a diverse range of people, ideas, and skills.
 
 The Company 

 State Street Investment Management is a global leader in institutional asset management, entrusted with more than $6 trillion in assets. We partner with many of the world's largest and most sophisticated investors and financial intermediaries, helping them reach their goals through a rigorous, research-driven investment process spanning both indexing and active disciplines.
 We are passionate about understanding the specific needs of those we serve. By applying deep experience and intellectual rigour across a broad toolkit, we develop and deliver thoughtful, targeted solutions designed to ensure their success — and the success of the millions of people who depend on them.
 
 The Team 

 State Street Investment Management's Dublin-based Fundamental Value Equity Team invests in undervalued equities through bottom-up, value-based stock selection, grounded in rigorous fundamental analysis and a long-term investment horizon. The concentrated nature of our global and regional portfolios ensures that every position is an active, high-conviction investment in what we believe are our most compelling opportunities.
 Role Summary / Purpose

 We are seeking an Equity Analyst to join our Information Technology and Communication Services sector research team. You will be responsible for delivering excess returns through security selection across a global sector, adhering to an investment approach consistent with our long-standing investment philosophy. You will also help advance our research process by thoughtfully integrating AI and other emerging tools to deepen insight, enhance efficiency, and strengthen investment decision-making — while preserving the rigour and independent judgement at the core of our philosophy.
 
 Essential Responsibilities 

 Meet with, analyse, model, and value the equity securities of global publicly listed corporations.

 Collaborate with the global Information Technology and Communication Services sector team to manage the global sector sleeve of our research portfolio.

 Recommend investments for inclusion in our suite of concentrated regional and global strategies.

 Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement across our investment process, models, and tools — including the integration of AI and advanced analytics to enhance research productivity, idea generation, and analytical depth.

 Apply AI-enabled tools to accelerate data gathering, synthesis, and modelling, while rigorously validating outputs to uphold the accuracy and integrity of our research.

 Support client teams and Portfolio Managers with RFPs, presentations, commentaries, and other regular and ad hoc marketing deliverables.

 Partner with the Client Portfolio Manager for Active Fundamental Equity to provide product updates to the EMEA sales teams.

 Become a thoughtful and compelling advocate for our investment approach, both internally and externally.

 
 Basic Qualifications 

 Bachelor's degree, preferably in a business-related discipline.

 CFA, MBA, or an accounting qualification would be an advantage.

 
 Desired Characteristics 

 Significant Information Technology or Communication Services sector expertise — most likely gained as an analyst, or in a corporate strategy or strategic consulting role.

 Excellent financial analysis and valuation skills, combining qualitative and quantitative insight into your research.

 Curiosity about, and openness to, integrating AI and emerging technologies into the investment research process — with the judgement to apply them critically and validate their output.

 Capacity for differentiated thinking and the confidence to challenge the status quo to drive optimal investment decisions.

 A strong collaborator with excellent interpersonal and facilitation skills.

 Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation and to develop and nurture external relationships.

 A genuine passion for investing in companies and markets.

 Initiative and independence, with the aptitude to self-direct and set priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 Curiosity, strong organisation, attention to detail, and a strong work ethic.

 Demonstrated personal and professional integrity.

 
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.
 
 Discover more information on jobs at StateStreet.com/careers

title: Enterprise Operations Engineer II
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Enterprise Operations Engineer II 
- Overview 

• This Job demands L1 Application Support, Alert handling, Monitor application health check and involvement in any Event, Incident and Problem Management Process.
• Deliver world class technical support for MasterCard applications and infrastructures, enabling growth, diversification and new business generation. 
• Provide 24x7x365 support for MasterCard applications; with focus on minimizing impact to Customers and internal users. 
• Monitor the application and infrastructure, and be a key stakeholder in MasterCard Incident and Change Management processes. 
• Regularly perform data analysis to determine MasterCard’s performance and identify areas of improvement. 
• Have you worked in a Production Support Environment? 
• Do you like to triage and drive events to resolution? 
• Do you like to interact with Customers, vendors, and support teams on a global scale? 
 
- Role 

• Perform L1 Application Support services on a 24x7x365 basis. Alert Monitoring - Initial response & triage of alerts using SOP 

• Validation of CRQ’s using Alerts or Dashboards 

• Application Performance and Monitoring using Dashboards 

• Problem Ticket creations & follow-ups for Alerts reductions 

• Alerts/Volumetric reporting (Bi-weekly, Monthly) 

• Participation in TRT/Bridge calls for Critical alert resolution 

• Soft Skills & Situation Management over the phone call 

• Contribution in Knowledge Management - create/update new or existing SOP 

• Assign incidents generated by monitoring tools to corresponding application and support teams using SOPs. 

• Escalate and engage Incident Requests and Change Requests to respective application teams using escalation matrix. 

• Communicate and correlate any events triggered during a change window to corresponding application teams to ensure application availability. 

• Regularly perform data analysis to determine Customer’s program performance and identify areas of improvement 

• Increase quality of work through streamlining of processes, reducing alert counts, innovating wherever/whenever possible, and through various other continuous improvement opportunities. 

• The approved service management tool(s) (e.g., Remedy) will serve all specific incidents, changes and service requests. 

• This job requires working in shifts. So selected Person should be ready to work in Shifts. 

- All about You 
 
• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience. 

• Basic understanding of UNIX scripting 

• Experience on batch scheduling & Monitoring 

• Basic understanding of SQL/Oracle or any other relational database 

• Knowledge on tool monitoring (Splunk, Dynatrace & Omnibus) 

• Effective problem and troubleshooting skills 

• Knowledge of ITSM best practices 

• Effective written and verbal communication skills 

• Effective interpersonal skills. 

- Secondary skills (Good to have) 

• Knowledge of Mainframe skills – JCL, OPC/CA7 (Job Scheduler) 

• Alert Tools – Xmatters , Nagios , Azure Monitor , IPMON, Zabbix, Python 

• Project management fundamentals, including prioritization, ownership, execution, and accountability for delivering results. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Graduate Rotation Programme 2026 - Supply Chain
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Join Viatris' 2026 Graduate Development Programme – Shape the Future of Pharma 
 
 
 Are you ready to kick-start your career in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Viatris is now accepting applications for its 2026 Graduate Development Programme, aimed at developing the next generation of leaders. 
 
 About the Programme: 
 
 Launching in September 2025, the Viatris Graduate Development Programme is designed to equip high-performing graduates with the skills, knowledge, and experience to thrive in a dynamic global healthcare environment. 
 
 Throughout this two-year programme, you will have the opportunity to rotate across three well-structured departments at one of our cutting-edge pharmaceutical sites in Dublin, Cork, Galway, or our Global office in Dublin. Our locations include the manufacturing sites in Damastown (Dublin 15), Baldoyle (Dublin 13), Inverin (Galway), Little Island (Cork) and the corporate office in Northern Cross (Dublin 17). 
 
 What You Will Be Doing 
 During the 2-year program, participants will participate in 3 structured rotations across various site departments such as (Production, Automation, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and OpEx, etc.). 

 Gain exposure to day-to-day operations in a pharmaceutical organisation while being assigned to specific impactful projects. 

 Receive continuous mentorship and training from senior colleagues who will guide your growth and development. 

 Expand your technical abilities and key business skills in a progressive, innovative environment. 

 Graduates will participate in careers fairs, TY & STEM Ireland events. 

 
 What You Will Gain: 
 In-depth knowledge of Viatris business and operations. 

 Practical experience working with cutting-edge pharmaceutical technology. 

 A tailored, comprehensive onboarding program that sets you up for success. 

 A clear pathway for career progression within a leading global pharmaceutical company. 

 Who We Are Looking For: 
 Recent graduates or upcoming graduates with an Honours degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math), 3rd level qualification. A grade of 2.1 or higher is a requirement for the programme. 

 Demonstrated success in previous work experience, placement, or extracurricular activities. 

 Interest in pursuing a career in the pharmaceutical industry; Production, Engineering, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain etc. 

 High achievers who thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. 

 Strong communicators with a passion for making a difference in healthcare. 

 Ambitious individuals eager to take on challenges and make an impact. 

 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others.
 
 Join our team! 
 
 Viatris is more than just a place to work. We are a new kind of healthcare company, one where you can make a difference in the world. If you inspired by our commitment to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, explore our global opportunities and find your team today. Visit Viatris.com/careers.
 
 Why Viatris? 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. You will also have the opportunity to access excellent career progression opportunities and work-life balance initiatives.
 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris 
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
 
 
 
 Sustainability at Viatris 
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility

 From essential vascular devices to next-generation technologies, our products are helping lay the foundation for better health outcomes every day. Minimally invasive treatments help speed recovery and let people get back to their daily activities faster with fewer complications, allowing healthier lives for millions of people worldwide.

And we’re committed to developing innovative technologies that have the potential to change the way physicians treat vascular disease.
 Abbott Ireland Commercial  Liffey Valley Dublin Opened in 1946, this operation, based in Liffey Valley Dublin was the first Abbott business unit to be established in Ireland. This business is responsible for the sales, marketing and distribution of a wide range of diabetes, diagnostic, and nutritional products in Ireland.
 
 PURPOSE OF THE JOB 
 
 Support Abbott customers to deliver best in class implantation and follow-up of CRM devices including Pacemakers, Cardiac Resynchronisation, Implantable Cardiac Defibrillators and Loop recorders across designated Public and Private hospitals.

 To build strong and professional relationships in various hospital settings, showing flexibility and adaptability to changing needs (e.g. varying hospital schedules, etc.)

 Education & Experience

title: Assoc. Spclst, Quality Control (Microbiology)
description:
Job Description
 
 The Company: 
 Within our Company in Ireland, we work at the forefront of science and technology to advance manufacturing excellence and R&D across our Irish sites and global company network. We’re always looking to make a difference for people, patients, and communities – from our Company in Ireland to the world.
 
 Our Commitment to Ireland: 
 Ireland is one of the Ireland’s leading healthcare companies, having first established here over 50 years ago. We have a dynamic
 team of over 3,000 employees currently working across seven sites in Ballydine, Co Tipperary, Brinny, Co Cork, Dunboyne, Co Meath, Carlow, and Dublin, where, in addition, operate substantial Human Health and Animal Health businesses. Through our long-standing footprint in Ireland and over $6 billion invested across our Irish operations, our Irish sites manufacture many of our Company’s top products, helping save and enhance lives in over 140 countries around the world.
 As a cutting-edge, state-of-the-art vaccines facility spanning over 15,500 square metres across three stories, our Dundalk site will focus on qualification, continued product development and expanding its capabilities within our network. Featuring drug substance manufacturing, drug product manufacturing and quality control labs that will support the global supply of vaccine products - strengthening our ability to make an impact on people and patients worldwide by adding new capabilities to our already industry-leading network
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a QC Associate Specialist (Microbiology) to play a key role in ensuring continuous, compliant manufacturing support. This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead a team, provide technical support, and contribute to our mission of saving and improving lives around the world.
 
 
 Bring energy, knowledge, innovation to carry out the following: 
 Act as the primary operational point of contact and shift lead, providing direct guidance, coordinating daily task allocation, and managing analyst workflows to ensure schedule adherence and on-time sample collection.

 Serve as the first-line contact for weekend technical issues, instrumentation faults, or sampling challenges. Coordinate real-time troubleshooting at the bench and execute timely escalations of critical cGMP or safety issues to QC Management.

 Perform microbiological testing, including Bioburden testing, Bacterial Endotoxin testing (LAL), and Sterility testing. Execute cleanroom Environmental Monitoring (EM) and utility sampling (WFI & clean steam) as required to support manufacturing schedules.

 Conduct timely, first-line reviews of laboratory data, analyst testing worksheets, logbooks, and environmental monitoring logs within LIMS to ensure compliance with GDP and data integrity standards.

 Deliver on-the-floor technical coaching and mentoring to junior analysts, resolving routine assay challenges and ensuring strict adherence to aseptic techniques.

 Assist in identifying on-shift deviations, documenting initial event details, and initiating immediate containment and notification steps.

 Ensure the microbiology laboratory is maintained in an inspection-ready state, adhering strictly to cleanroom behavior and cGMP guidelines.

 
 
 What skills you will need: 
 
 B.Sc. degree in Microbiology, Biological Sciences, or equivalent.

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology QC laboratory, with direct exposure to environmental monitoring and core microbiological assays.

 Demonstrated capability or strong aptitude to lead, organize, and guide other analysts in a shift-based environment.

 Strong understanding of aseptic techniques, cleanroom behavior, and clean utility operations.

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively guide the team and handle shift-level escalations.

 Proven troubleshooting and real-time problem-solving skills under manufacturing operational pressures.

 Proficiency in QC data systems (e.g., LIMS equivalent environmental monitoring software).

 Strong knowledge of cGMP, GDocP, and basic regulatory expectation

 
 
 We keep the patient at the very heart of all that we do and strive to find solutions and treatments for some of the world's most challenging healthcare needs.
 
 As an equal opportunity employer, we are proud to be a company that embraces the value of bringing talented, and committed people together.
 
 Please don't hesitate to contact the Talent Acquisition Advisor assigned to this role should you need any support during our recruitment process.
 
 We are committed to flexible working where possible, and this is why our Company has introduced a new hybrid working model for office-based colleagues around the world.
 
 Please feel free to speak to us about what flexibility means to you during your application.
 
 So, if you are ready to: 
 Invent solutions to meet unmet healthcare needs, please apply today. 
 
 
 Required Skills: 
Aseptic Handling, Bioburden, Bioburden Testing, Data Integrity, Deviation Management, Deviation Reporting, Endotoxins, Environmental Monitoring, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Laboratory Analysis, Laboratory Testing

Teamwork

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Job Description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior EDI/Informatica Developer to support a strategic EDI Test Automation and SAP migration initiative. The ideal candidate will serve as a technical and functional Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for understanding, analysing, and documenting end-to-end EDI transaction processing across EDI, Informatica, and SAP systems.
The candidate will work closely with the Test Automation Team, Business Analysts, and Integration Teams to enable business process understanding, trace transaction flows, establish data correlation mechanisms, support defect analysis, and facilitate successful automated validation of EDI transactions.
Key Responsibilities
EDI & Integration Analysis
•    Analyse and document end-to-end EDI transaction flows across trading partners, Informatica, and SAP systems.
•    Understand existing integration architecture, mappings, workflows, and transformation rules.
•    Explain business processes associated with EDI transactions and partner-specific implementations.
•    Support onboarding and analysis of new EDI transaction types and trading partners.
•    Design, develop, document and manage scalable integration solutions for B2B/EDI transactions (e.g., X12 850, 810, and 856 and EDIFACT) and partner onboardings. This can include end-to-end SDLC functions from analysis to development to testing to deployment to hyper care. This can further include project management related aspects such as scope, schedule, and status for these integration solutions. With familiarity, supervise and lead teams to produce such integration solutions.
•    Develop and maintain application and data integration platform workflows using Informatica Integration Cloud Solutions (IICS) and Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) with initial focus on B2B/EDI flows but will also include Cloud Application Integration (CAI), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), and Cloud Data Integration and Replication (CDIR). Support data quality, transformation, and mapping efforts across systems. This would also include scope, schedule, and status for these integration solutions.
•    Review and maintain Informatica mappings, workflows, sessions, and dependencies. Analyse transformation logic and identify business validation rules. Troubleshoot mapping failures, data quality issues, and processing exceptions.
•    Support Informatica performance optimization and monitoring activities.
Test Automation Enablement
•    Collaborate with the Test Automation Team to identify automation opportunities and business validation checkpoints.
•    Help define business equivalence rules between source EDI transactions and downstream SAP outputs.
•    Identify unique correlation identifiers required for automation validation.
•    Support creation of correlation logic between EDI files, Informatica processing, SAP IDocs, and application outputs.
Required Experience
•    8+ years of B2B/EDI experience developing workflows and data mapping - especially within Cloud+SaaS.
•    Familiarity with EDI standards (X12, EDIFACT, TRADACOMS) consumer products or supply chain context.
•    Experience with EDI transactions for Retail/Supply Chain (Transactions such as X12 850, 855, 856, 810, and EDIFACT Equivalents).
•    Experience with SAP and IDOCs in conjunction with Integration Solutions.
•    Informatica integration and data platforms: IICS and/or IDMC, with modules such as: Business to Business (B2B), Cloud Application Integration (CAI), Cloud Data Integration (CDI), and Cloud Data Integration and Replication (CDIR).
•    Experience with EDI for 3PL, Logistics and Transportation (Transactions such as X12 940, 945 and EDIFACT Equivalents).
•    Experience in designing/performing large scale testing for both new processes and regression testing
Mandatory Skills: EDI .
Experience: 5-8 Years .

What we do. State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
 
 
 Who are we looking for: 
 State Street seeks to recruit an Early Career Cyber Security Operations Center (SOC) analyst that will assist in the detection, triage, analysis and response to cyber-attacks. The analyst will join our SOC team which will run a 24/7 coverage, 365 days a year model, with a partner team in the United States.
 
 The SOC team is responsible for analyzing events from multiple sources from across a large enterprise network. The SOC will partner with multiple teams in our Irish Cyber Fusion Center including but not limited to Advanced Threat, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Content & Red/Purple teams.
 Join us in evolving our response capabilities to protect State Street, its customers and partners from the ever evolving and sophisticated global threat actors. State Street’s Fusion Center is responsible for detecting and responding to various cyber threats 24/7 365 days a year, that are directed towards the enterprise.
 
 
 What will you be responsible for: 
 Detection of cyber security events & incidents in real time through centralized monitoring.

 Analyze cyber security events from multiple sources (SIEM, IP/DS, EDR, AV, Firewalls etc).

 Respond and contain cyber security incidents and identify eradication strategies.

 Identify process improvement areas and new opportunities in technologies or capabilities

 Communicate incident status to Lead analysts and Managers

 Creating an environment which drives knowledge sharing with teams across the Fusion Center

 Help developing the Fusion Center mindset and follow the sun model

 Receive mentorship from other Cyber Security analysts across the Fusion Center

 
 What we value: 
 Understanding of networking (TCP/IP networks and protocols)

 Familiar with operating systems (Windows, Linux and MacOS)

 Good all round knowledge of IT architecture including basic scripting ability

 A passion for Cyber Security

 High level understanding of phishing and malware techniques

 Willingness to learn

 Strong time management and communication skills

 Proven ability to work in a team environment

 
 Education & Preferred Qualifications 
 
 Recent Graduates from Bachelors or Masters in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Computer Science or relevant experience

 
 

 
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Job Description:
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Developer L3 to join our team at Wipro Technologies-USA, specifically within the Wipro Engineering unit focusing on Connectivity. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of a critical telecommunications operations platform that supports essential network services. You will work with a well-established, mature codebase using advanced technologies including PHP, Laravel, Vue.js, and TypeScript, ensuring robust performance and operational stability.
This position requires not only technical proficiency but also a deep understanding of telecommunications domain knowledge to translate complex operational requirements into effective software solutions. The successful candidate will take pride in collaborating closely with cross-functional teams such as product owners, quality assurance specialists, and telecommunications experts, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain new and existing features of an enterprise-grade telecommunications operations platform.
Collaborate on architectural planning, technical debt reduction, and application modernization initiatives.
Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to application performance, data workflows, and production environments.
Leverage GitLab workflows for source control management, including code reviews and release management.
Ensure backward compatibility and operational resilience while evolving the software.
Support production deployments and troubleshoot live system issues promptly to minimize downtime.
Utilize AI-assisted development tools responsibly to enhance coding, testing, and documentation efficiency.
Create and maintain high-quality automated tests and comprehensive technical documentation.
Technologies & Tools
The role focuses on PHP and Laravel for backend services, while leveraging Vue.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS to build dynamic and responsive user interfaces. The candidate should be proficient in modern frontend and backend development technologies and experienced with containerization and CI/CD practices is a plus.
Areas of Responsibility
The Developer L3 will have a broad scope of responsibilities encompassing the full software development lifecycle. These include:
Requirements Gathering: Engage with client stakeholders through workshops and interviews to capture detailed business process requirements accurately.
Solution Design & Development: Architect and implement scalable, maintainable code modules that integrate seamlessly into the larger system environment.
Configuration Management: Customize and configure platform components in alignment with client-specific needs and system specifications.
Development Lifecycle Engagement
Coding: Develop high-quality, testable code that meets the requirements specification while ensuring maintainability and scalability.
Testing: Participate actively in unit, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing to verify that software functions as expected and meets quality standards.
Trial Runs & Validation: Execute comprehensive trial runs to validate system interactions and performance before production release.
Implementation Support: Collaborate with the implementation team to deploy software components effectively, ensuring smooth integration and system stability post-deployment.
Documentation & Communication
Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation, including code comments, flowcharts, system layouts, and user guides to support ongoing maintenance and knowledge transfer.
Communicate progress, challenges, and technical details clearly and effectively to stakeholders across various levels of technical proficiency.
Assist in preparing reports and presentations that outline project statuses, milestones, and deliverables.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Integral to this role is the ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment. You will:
Engage regularly with diverse teams

title: Financial Planning Associate
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.  
 At Davy, you are the difference.     
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.  
 About the role  
 An exciting opportunity has opened up in our Financial Planning team, a team responsible for developing and enhancing our digital advice platform. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Support the development and continuous enhancement of our digital advice platform.
 Apply core financial planning knowledge to support platform design and development.
 Use and interpret cash flow modelling outputs and tools to validate planning assumptions and client outcomes.
 Collaborate with Project teams, Advisers, financial planning team and technology teams to deliver digitally led planning solutions.
 Support testing, quality assurance and implementation of new platform functionality.
 Identify opportunities to improve adviser and client experiences through platform and process improvements and innovation.
 Assist in the creation of planning methodologies, templates, training materials and adviser guidance.
 Contribute to project workstreams and squad initiatives, taking ownership of tasks and deliverables.
 Support the creation of client and adviser-facing content.
 Ensure compliance with all relevant Risk and Compliance frameworks, policies and procedures.
 
 This role combines financial planning expertise, project delivery and business innovation. Working closely with Financial Planning Specialists, Product Owners, technology teams and Private Client Advisers,  you will help shape how financial advice is delivered to clients across our key client segments.
 We are looking for a self-starter with strong initiative with an understanding of core financial planning concepts and an interest in technological developments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, and would relish contributing to transformational business projects within a financial planning environment.
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 A degree or master's qualification.
 At least two years’ experience in financial planning, wealth management or financial services with a strong interest in financial planning and wealth management.
 A fundamental understanding of core financial planning concepts and cash flow modelling.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.Excellent attention to detail.
 The ability to manage priorities and work independently.
 Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
 A proactive, self-motivated approach with a willingness to take initiative.
 High proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook. 
 QFA qualification (or willingness to complete).
 CFP qualification (or willingness to complete).
 Desirable 
 Knowledge of pensions, investments and taxation.
 Experience working on business change, transformation or digital projects.
 
 
  
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.    
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.   
 Important Information 
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

 Other ad-hoc activities

We are seeking a proactive and adaptable SOS Tech Coordinator to manage end-to-end device lifecycle operations, technical device provisioning, international shipping, and inventory management.
In this role, you will combine hands-on technical troubleshooting and OS imaging with high-touch, client-facing customer support in a fast-paced, dynamically changing environment. You will be instrumental in executing day-to-day operations within strict Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), while serving as a collaborative peer lead within a distributed team.

Technical Support & Device Lifecycle Management
Imaging & Provisioning: Perform device imaging, hardware setup, initial configuration, and software deployment across multiple operating systems (macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, ChromeOS, iOS, etc.).

Hardware Lab Operations: Handle hands-on physical hardware operations, including receiving, sorting, packing, shipping, organizing storage areas, and managing hardware recycling/disposal.
Operations & Vendor Management

title: Engineering Graduate
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Join Viatris' 2026 Graduate Development Programme – Shape the Future of Pharma 
 Are you ready to kick-start your career in one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies? Viatris is now accepting applications for its 2026 Graduate Development Programme, aimed at developing the next generation of leaders.
 About the Programme: 
 Launching in September 2026, the Viatris Graduate Development Programme is designed to equip high-performing graduates with the skills, knowledge, and experience to thrive in a dynamic global healthcare environment.
 Throughout this two-year programme, you will have the opportunity to rotate across three well-structured departments at one of our cutting-edge pharmaceutical sites in Dublin, Cork, Galway, or our Global office in Dublin. Our locations include the manufacturing sites in Damastown (Dublin 15), Baldoyle (Dublin 13), Inverin (Galway), Little Island (Cork) and the corporate office in Northern Cross (Dublin 17).
 What You Will Be Doing 
 During the 2-year program, participants will participate in 3 structured rotations across various site departments such as (Production, Automation, Engineering, EHS, Quality, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and OpEx, etc.).

 Gain exposure to day-to-day operations in a pharmaceutical organisation while being assigned to specific impactful projects.

 Receive continuous mentorship and training from senior colleagues who will guide your growth and development.

 Expand your technical abilities and key business skills in a progressive, innovative environment.

 Graduates will participate in careers fairs, TY & STEM Ireland events.

 What You Will Gain: 
 In-depth knowledge of Viatris business and operations.

 Practical experience working with cutting-edge pharmaceutical technology.

 A tailored, comprehensive onboarding program that sets you up for success.

 A clear pathway for career progression within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

 Who We Are Looking For: 
 Recent graduates or upcoming graduates with an Honours degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math), 3rd level qualification. A grade of 2.1 or higher is a requirement for the programme.

 Demonstrated success in previous work experience, placement, or extracurricular activities.

Sales & Marketing Operations Associate 
 Join IQVIA and play a key role supporting a dedicated healthcare client team in Dublin. 

 Location: Dublin, Ireland
 Working Pattern: Full-time, with reduced hours or a four-day week considered

 The Opportunity IQVIA is seeking a proactive and commercially minded Sales & Marketing Operations Associate to support a dedicated healthcare client team based in Dublin.

 This is a dynamic, business-facing role that combines sales support, marketing coordination, commercial administration and office operations . As part of the team, you'll work closely with leadership, sales and marketing colleagues, helping to drive commercial effectiveness, support marketing initiatives and ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the Dublin office.
 We're looking for someone who enjoys working at the heart of the business, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering exceptional support that helps teams perform at their best.
 

 What You'll Do Sales & Commercial Support Provide administrative and operational support to sales and leadership teams.
 Prepare sales reports, presentations, dashboards, trackers and customer-facing documentation.
 Support sales planning, pipeline reporting and business performance tracking.
 Assist with proposal preparation, meeting coordination and commercial administration.
 Maintain accurate records, documentation and reporting systems.
 

 Marketing & Events Coordination Support the delivery of marketing campaigns, events, exhibitions and internal communications.
 Coordinate marketing materials, promotional activities and stakeholder communications.
 Assist with event planning, logistics and post-event reporting.
 Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to ensure effective campaign execution and follow-up activities.
 

 Business & Office Operations Manage the day-to-day running of the Dublin office, ensuring a professional and efficient working environment.
 Coordinate facilities, suppliers, workplace services and office administration activities.
 Support onboarding, team meetings, town halls and employee engagement initiatives.
 Manage purchase orders, goods receipting, supplier queries and monthly accrual processes.
 Support health and safety administration, records management, fleet coordination and other operational processes.
 

 What You'll Bring Experience in sales support, marketing support, commercial operations and / or business support role.
 Previous experience supporting sales teams, marketing teams or customer-facing commercial functions.
 Strong reporting, presentation preparation and administrative coordination skills.
 Experience coordinating events, exhibitions, campaigns or business initiatives.
 Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
 High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook.
 Experience with purchase orders, procurement or finance administration would be advantageous but is not essential.
 

 Why Join IQVIA? You will have access to private healthcare
 Competitive salary
 Join a global healthcare organisation with excellent development opportunities.
 Work in a varied position where you can make a visible impact on business performance and team effectiveness.
 Flexible working options, including consideration of reduced hours or a four-day week for the right candidate.
 
 Ready to Apply? If you're passionate about supporting sales and marketing teams, enjoy coordinating projects and events, and take pride in keeping business operations running smoothly, we'd love to hear from you.
 Apply today to join IQVIA and become an integral part of a collaborative and commercially focused team.

 Please note that sponsorship is not available for this role.

title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer – Test Support , Hardware Engineering - Manufacturing
description:
Amazon Web Services’ Hardware Engineering team is looking for experienced professionals to help build the world’s premier cloud computing platform. We are looking for Manufacturing Test Engineers who are capable of operating in a fast paced, ever changing, multi-platform international manufacturing and production environment. Our Test Engineering team works closely with our ODMs, CMs, internal AWS hardware and software development teams, and with upstream component vendors to ensure right Test Flow, tools and test plans are established and validated for a product to launch and scale up across multiple sites world-wide. This role requires the engineer to be a technical contact and take on full ownership of the manufacturing launch and resolution of Test issues. You will be the driver in getting production scaled across a global network. You will own the Test performance as well as the processes that go with them. You will implement standardized test methods & troubleshooting guides world-wide across multiple ODMs and CMs ensuring consistent usage and processes across sites. 
Amazon Web Services’ Hardware Engineering team is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Mainframe Development – Credit Card Systems
Design, develop, and maintain mainframe applications  supporting credit card issuing platforms .
Work across card lifecycle modules , including:
Account setup & card origination
Authorization & transaction processing
Billing, statements, interest & fees
Payments, collections, disputes & chargebacks

COBOL / COBOL II
JCL
CICS
DB2

Fraud & risk systems
Core banking and downstream systems

Provide L2 / L3 production support  for card applications.
Prepare and maintain technical documentation and runbooks .

Knowledge of Agile delivery models
Experience working with global banking clients

z/OS Mainframe
