About the role
The Instructional Design Professional is responsible for designing and developing high-quality, effective learning solutions that address validated business needs. Using a blend of learning approaches, technologies and adult learning principles, they create engaging learning experiences that support the adoption of new systems, products, processes and ways of working.
Working closely with stakeholders, subject matter experts and change teams, they translate business requirements into impactful learning programmes using strong consulting and design skills.
The role is also responsible for maintaining and evolving existing learning solutions, ensuring content remains effective, relevant and aligned with developments in technology, learning practices and business priorities.
Contributing directly to BT's transformation agenda, the Instructional Design Professional creates scalable face-to-face and digital learning content. Working alongside digital design colleagues, they develop simulations, videos and performance support resources that build colleague capability at pace. They utilise modern learning technologies, data insights and AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to enhance the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of learning solutions while maintaining a strong focus on learner experience, accessibility and business outcomes.
What you’ll be doing
•Produce and deliver smart, evidence-based, commercially driven learning solutions that are effective and efficient from both a learner and business perspective.
•Manage the design of learning solutions by producing, communicating, and coordinating plans, updates, and resources to ensure a smooth development and deployment cycle, with great attention to detail and the highest quality standards.
•Demonstrate a customer-first mindset, engaging with stakeholders to ensure both the customer and learner are at the heart of every solution.
•Utilise, promote, and adopt digital approaches to learning that support our long-term digital strategy.
•Maintain and continuously enhance the portfolio of learning collateral.
•Demonstrate an inquisitive mindset and apply the latest learning innovations and industry trends in a pragmatic and impactful way.
•Take accountability for personal growth, as well as supporting the development and success of peers through a high-challenge, high-support mindset.
•Build effective relationships and feedback loops across the Learning & Development team to foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Essential Skills / Experience
•Proven experience in learning and instructional design, creating engaging, blended learning solutions for adult learners using recognised design methodologies.
•Strong performance consulting capability, including learning needs analysis, performance gap identification, solution design and measurement of business impact.
•Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into learning solutions, influence stakeholders and manage multiple projects effectively.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•Experience creating engaging digital learning solutions, including e-learning content, using authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Adapt, or similar platforms.
•Knowledge of designing and delivering learning for virtual environments, with an understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design principles.
•Strong communication, storyboarding, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
•Experience using AI tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, within the learning design process, alongside an understanding of AI-enabled learning experiences and responsible AI principles.
•Knowledge of learning analytics, including the use of data and insights to inform design decisions and measure learner engagement and performance.
•Experience working within agile project environments, organisational transformation programmes, or change initiatives, with an understanding of change management approaches.
•Experience coaching others, leading quality assurance activities, and working within technology-driven environments such as telecommunications, customer service, sales, operational or technical learning functions
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
• 10% on target annual bonus
• Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
• Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
• Equalised maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
• Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
• Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
• Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcar

AI Interview: Due to high number of applications, we're using an AI platform to assist with screening applications. This will involve a 20-25 mins interview via a chat platform, after which you will immediately receive feedback based on your responses. All applications will be reviewed by a recruiter, and you'll be informed whether or not you've been progressed to the next stage - meeting the hiring manager.
Why this job matters
The Commercial Specialist plays a key role in managing contracts throughout their lifecycle, helping to ensure they deliver the right commercial and operational outcomes.
Working closely with commercial, programme, legal, finance, procurement and operational teams, you’ll ensure contractual obligations are understood, risks are identified and managed, and strong governance is maintained.
You’ll coordinate cross-functional activities aligned to the customer strategy and roadmap, assess the impact of strategic plans on contractual services and P&L, and support the effective governance of contract changes.
The role is also responsible for ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, managing commercial risks and protecting the organisation’s commercial interests, while building strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.
This is a key role at the heart of contract delivery, bringing together commercial, financial and operational priorities to drive successful outcomes and deliver value for customers.
What you’ll be doing
Own and manage the P&L performance of Defence contracts, monitoring revenue, costs and financial risks to support successful delivery.
Manage contracts throughout their lifecycle, from contract creation and mobilisation through to delivery, exit and termination.
Complete regular contract reviews and ensure compliance with internal governance and contractual requirements.
Manage financial forecasts in partnership with the contract finance team, identifying and addressing potential risks and opportunities.
Ensure contractual obligations are delivered effectively, with appropriate risk management throughout the contract lifecycle.
Identify, assess and record contractual and commercial risks, taking action to mitigate them.
Work closely with third-party suppliers and partners to support contract delivery.
Support business-as-usual activities, projects and new change proposals across the contract.
Build strong relationships with contract owners, end users and customers, including regular customer-facing engagement.
Create and deliver effective contract exit and termination plans.
Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities to strengthen contract and business development processes.
Support the effective governance of contracts, ensuring the right processes and controls are in place from creation through to execution.
The skills you’ll need
Experience in contract management, ideally across large or complex delivery contracts.
Understanding of contract pricing, P&L, cost allocation and commercial risk.
Experience managing contract changes, transitions, exits and terminations.
Strong commercial and analytical skills, with the ability to assess contractual information and communicate findings clearly.
Experience working across complex environments and multiple functions, with strong stakeholder management skills.
Excellent organisation, attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness and ability to obtain SC Security Clearance.
Here are some of the great benefits we offer
• 10% on target bonus
• BT Pension scheme, minimum 5% Employee contribution, BT contribution 10%
• From January 2025, equal family leave:  receive 18 weeks at full pay, 8 weeks at half pay and 26 weeks at the statutory rate. It’s for all parents, no matter how your family is made up.
• Enhanced women’s health support: including help with menopause symptoms, cancer screenings, period care and more.
• 25 days annual leave (not including bank holidays), increasing with service
• 24/7 private virtual GP appointments for UK colleagues
• 2 weeks carer’s leave
• World-class training and development opportunities
• Option to join BT Shares Saving schemes.
Our working model
Hybrid policy: Three in the office, two remote

Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for a motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as an  Associate – Payroll.  This is a  full-time , permanent role based in Sydney, reporting to the Head of Payroll Services. With regional coverage, this role plays a key part in supporting the growth and success of our payroll services team.
As part of our payroll services team, you will be responsible for delivering accurate and efficient payroll services for our international clients. This is a fantastic opportunity to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, collaborative environment, where your contributions will directly support client satisfaction and continuous improvement.
Key responsibilities:
Manage end-to-end payroll processing for multiple clients using Employment Hero.
Set up new employees in the payroll system and ensure accurate onboarding data.
Prepare and process regular payroll runs, including adjustments and back payments.
Calculate and process employee terminations in accordance with relevant legislation.
Prepare and lodge Payroll Tax, Superannuation contributions, and Workers’ Compensation enrolments and renewals.
Ensure compliance with relevant awards, enterprise agreements, and employment legislation.
Maintain and update payroll system data to ensure accuracy and integrity.
Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies and respond to employee and client queries in a timely manner.
Assist with payroll reporting and audits as required.
Perform other payroll-related duties as needed to support the team
What We’re Looking For:
We are seeking for a motivated and detail-oriented individual who is eager to grow their career in payroll. The ideal candidate will have:
6–12 months of payroll experience (preferred)
Strong organisational skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities effectively.
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with a professional and client-focused approach.
A genuine interest in payroll and a desire to build expertise in a supportive and dynamic team.
Company Benefits:
In our Australian offices, we believe in putting our employees’ well-being first! We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangements, Dress for your Day policy, monthly social activities, and Celebration leave.
As advocates of continuous learning and professional development, we provide an internal mentorship program and additionally have an internal school of more than 500 courses accessible to our employees 24/7.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

About the role
The Risk & Compliance Professional supports the effective operation of the Supply Management Group, Risk and Compliance (GRC) framework by coordinating risk management, control monitoring, assurance, reporting, and third-party risk activities across the procurement and supplier lifecycle.
Working within the Supply Management Risk team, the role helps ensure that supply management activities are aligned with BT's policies, standards, regulatory requirements, and risk framework. The role works closely with Process Teams, Category Teams, Control Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and other stakeholders to support risk assessments, control assurance, audit management, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
What you will be doing (Role Accountabilities)
Risk Management & Third-Party Risk Oversight
Support procurement and third-party risk management activities throughout the supplier lifecycle.
Coordinate and implement processes and controls across various risk categories e.g.; Cyber Security, Data and AI, Business Continuity, Financial Risk, Sustainability, Health & Safety, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Human Rights etc.
Track risk mitigation actions and follow up with stakeholders to ensure timely closure.
Support the identification, assessment, and reporting of enduring, point and emerging risks.
Governance, Controls & Assurance
Coordinate periodic control self-assessments and attestations with control owners.
Monitor control performance, deficiencies, remediation plans, and action tracking.
Support assurance reviews, control testing activities, and deep-dive assessments.
Maintain records of audit findings and actions, ensuring progress is tracked through to closure.
Assist in preparing evidence and documentation for internal and external audits.
Risk Reporting & Data Management
Support the preparation of risk reports, dashboards, and management information for governance forums and leadership reviews.
Monitor risk metrics, key risk indicators, and control status reporting.
Validate and maintain risk, control, audit, and action data within the Risk platform and other governance tools.
Assist with preparation of risk reporting.
Stakeholder Engagement
Work across the Process Teams, Procurement Category Teams and Subject Matter experts to obtain data and evidence required for risk assessments and reporting.
Support engagement with Group Risk, Compliance, Legal, Internal Audit, and Business Unit stakeholders.
Provide guidance and support to stakeholders on risk and compliance processes.
Help promote risk awareness and good governance practices across the Supply Management function.
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve risk, reporting, governance, and control processes.
Support implementation of process improvements and best practices.
Contribute to policy, standard, and process reviews where required.
Assist with data collection, analysis, project activities, and governance initiatives.
What you’ll need to succeed (Skills & Experience)
5–10 years' experience in Risk Management, Compliance, Supplier Risk Management, Procurement, Governance, Audit, or related disciplines.
Good understanding of third-party risk management and supplier lifecycle processes.
Experience supporting risk assessments, controls, audits, and compliance activities.
Knowledge of risk domains including Information Security, Privacy, Business Continuity, Financial Risk, Sustainability, and Regulatory Compliance.
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with risk data, dashboards, and governance reporting.
Strong stakeholder engagement and communication skills.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications.
Experience using risk management systems is desirable.
Success Measures
Timely completion of risk assessments, reporting, and governance activities.
Accurate maintenance of risk, control, audit, and action data.
Effective support of control assurance and audit activities.
Timely tracking and closure of risk and audit actions.
High-quality risk reporting and stakeholder engagement.
Continuous improvement of Supply Management risk and compliance processes.

The F5 Load Balancer Engineer will be responsible for daily administration, configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of F5 BIG-IP infrastructure supporting business-critical applications.

Manage F5 LTM, GTM/DNS, and SSL certificate lifecycle.
Configure and maintain VIPs, Pools, Nodes, Profiles, and Persistence settings.

Experience in F5 administration.

Job Description:
Provider Specialist
Provider Specialist Role Overview:
We are seeking a dedicated Provider Specialist to join Infocrossing INC’s BPS-IHS division, where you will serve as a vital liaison supporting MO HealthNet participants. This role involves handling a diverse range of participant inquiries and service requests, ensuring that all communications are met with professionalism and accuracy. You will be entrusted with upholding the organization’s commitment to superior service standards by delivering detailed, timely assistance via phone and written correspondence.
As a key member of our team, you will operate in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that calls for agile problem solving, effective interpersonal communication, and high attention to detail. Your daily responsibilities will include collaborating with healthcare providers and internal teams to streamline issue resolution, update and maintain participant records, and ensure compliance with MO HealthNet policies and regulatory requirements.
This position is ideal for individuals with a strong foundation in customer service combined with relevant experience in healthcare or social services sectors. We seek motivated professionals who thrive in team-centered settings and embrace continuous learning to contribute to collective success.
Deliver prompt, accurate responses to participant queries across multiple communication platforms, enhancing participant satisfaction and trust.
Maintain comprehensive and precise documentation of all participant interactions to facilitate continuity and quality of service.
Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including healthcare providers and external agencies, to resolve complex participant issues effectively.
Stay informed and compliant with current MO HealthNet guidelines and policies, escalating concerns appropriately and helping to implement process improvements.
Engage actively in ongoing professional development activities to keep abreast of industry trends, standards, and best practices.
Qualifications and Competencies:
The successful Provider Specialist will exhibit the following core competencies and qualifications:
Client Centricity: Demonstrates genuine passion for understanding and meeting participant needs with empathy and respect.
Passion for Results: Exhibits a results-driven mindset with focus on delivering high-quality outcomes in every interaction.
Execution Excellence: Ensures accurate and timely execution of tasks, maintaining high standards of professionalism.
Collaborative Working: Works effectively with multiple teams and stakeholders fostering a cooperative and positive environment.
Learning Agility: Shows eagerness and ability to quickly learn new information, policies, and systems relevant to the role.
Problem Solving and Decision Making: Applies critical thinking to troubleshoot challenges and make informed decisions independently or collaboratively.
Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and respectfully in both verbal and written forms, ensuring understanding across diverse audiences.
Additional preferred qualifications include a minimum of two years of experience in telephone customer service and at least two years in healthcare, public health, managed care, or human services. Familiarity with MO HealthNet policies and related systems is an asset. Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, adaptability to fluctuating workloads, and a commitment to fostering an inclusive work environment.
Compensation and Benefits:
The expected pay range for this position is $18 to $19 per hour, reflective of experience and qualifications. As a valued member of the Infocrossing INC team and under Wipro's benefits umbrella, you will have access to comprehensive benefits including but not limited to:
Medical and dental insurance plans designed to support your health and well-being.
Disability insurance providing financial security in unforeseen circumstances.
Generous paid time off policies that incorporate sick leave, personal time, and other leave options to support

Job Title:

Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Onboarding and Client Services Officer. This full-time and permanent position is based in Luxembourg and has a regional focus enabling the candidate to make a significant contribution to our funds business and its growth.
Purpose of the Role
Take the lead on the onboarding process, including:
coordinating between clients and various team members for the purpose of successfully finalising fund onboarding;
overviewing standard fund documents in order to know who to delegate specific sections for substance review;
preparing standard agreement templates and following through up to execution of the same;
AML/KYC collection (first line of defence);
preparing and presenting onboardings to business committee for approval
map relations at onboarding and keep working parties’ lists up to date
build relations with the client to then act as first point of contact for the business as usual relation after onboarding
Scope
The role will take place in Luxembourg in a growing team of about 30 people. The AIFM’s Onboarding and Fund Distribution and Marketing Team, which is currently made up of 4 wonderful and motivated people.  You will report to the team’s Fund Distribution Marketing Manager and/or Conducting Officer.
Key Responsibilities
Onboarding and document monitoring
Communicate with incoming clients to obtain required fund documents and agreements; Be clients’ point of contact for the purposes of onboarding
Coordinate with various AIFM / ManCo functions to obtain from them the required review of fund documents (including PRIIPs KIDs) and agreements, at onboarding and, as needed, during fund lifecycle
Manage and take-ownership over the exchanges between clients or where relevant, third-party providers of fund documents (e.g. of PPM, LPA, KIDs); and the AIFM functions until successful completion of onboarding, and/or until the finalisation of fund documents and agreements
Fund and GP AML/KYC collection (first line of defence)
Reviewing basic fund documents and standard AIFM/ManCO/fund agreements
Reporting
Updating the AIFM’s business committee as needed on onboarding status during ad hoc or bi-weekly meetings
Client relationship
Mapping the relations between relevant stakeholder and preparing/keeping up to date the working party list
Act as first point of contact for all client requests, coordinate deliverables
Coordinate the timely preparation of the corporate governance reports with the various teams
Attributes / Technical Skills
Essential:
Excellent written and spoken English
Excellent working knowledge of Excel, Power Point and MS Office
Resourceful user of AI tools
Organised; Persistent; Proactive;
Positive; Service-oriented and diplomatic; Comfortable communicating with different stakeholders.
Desirable:
Analytical skills; Eager to learn; Curious mindset.
Relevant Experience
3-5 years’ overall experience in a similar position in the Luxembourg investment fund industry (Central administrator or AIFM);
Experience with regulatory matters concerning AIFMs
Experience coordinating between various stakeholders and documenting for reporting purposes (e.g. due diligence style work in law firms).
Experience in a reputable law firm;
Education & Professional Qualifications
Master’s degree
Relevant professional training, e.g. relating to applicable laws and regulations in relation to UCITS, AIFMD, MIFID, CBDF
Law degree
Relevant university degrees might include EU fund regulation and compliance; business and engineering
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey.

Job Description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of the role is to create exceptional integration architectural solution design and thought leadership and enable delivery teams to provide exceptional client engagement and satisfaction.
1.     Define integration architecture for the new deals/ major change requests in existing deals
a.    Creates an enterprise-wide integration architecture that ensures that systems are seamlessly integrated while being scalable, reliable, and manageable.
b.     Provide solutioning for digital integration for RFPs received from clients and ensure overall design assurance
i.    Analyse applications, exchange points, data formats, connectivity requirements, technology environment, enterprise specifics, client requirements to set an integration solution design framework/ architecture
ii.    Provide technical leadership to the design, development and implementation of integration solutions through thoughtful use of modern technology
iii.    Define and understand current state integration solutions and identify improvements, options & tradeoffs to define target state solutions
iv.    Clearly articulate, document and use integration patterns, best practices and processes.
v.    Evaluate and recommend products and solutions to integrate with overall technology ecosystem
vi.    Works closely with various IT groups to transition tasks, ensure performance and manage issues through to resolution
vii.    Document integration architecture covering logical, deployment and data views mentioning all the artefacts in detail
viii.    Validate the integration solution/ prototype from technology, cost structure and customer differentiation point of view
ix.    Identify problem areas and perform root cause analysis of integration architectural design and solutions and provide relevant solutions to the problem
x.    Collaborating with sales, program/project, consulting teams to reconcile solutions to architecture
xi.    Tracks industry integration trends and relates these to planning current and future IT needs
c.    Provides technical and strategic input during the project planning phase in the form of technical architectural designs and recommendations

About the role
At BT, we're transforming the way data and artificial intelligence are governed across one of the UK's largest and most complex organisations. As part of our Data & AI Governance team, we're looking for a Data & AI Governance Specialist to help embed effective governance practices across BT Group while supporting our ambition to become the market leader in AI-powered connectivity, solutions and services.
This is a highly visible role operating across both customer-facing and corporate units, helping stakeholders understand and apply Data & AI governance frameworks, regulatory obligations and governance controls. You'll play a key role in driving governance maturity, supporting compliance with evolving regulatory requirements, and ensuring Data & AI governance is embedded into the way BT operates.
Working with senior stakeholders across Digital, Compliance, Risk, Legal, Engineering and Business teams, you'll lead governance forums, support working groups, prepare executive-level briefings and help shape the governance agenda across BT Group.
If you're passionate about Data Governance, AI Governance, regulatory compliance and stakeholder engagement, we'd love to hear from you.
What you’ll be doing
Act as the primary Data & AI Governance contact for BT business units, supporting the adoption of governance policies, standards and frameworks.
Partner with data owners, business stakeholders, engineering teams and compliance functions to embed governance controls and best practices.
Lead and coordinate Data & AI Governance Working Groups across supported business areas.
Facilitate unit-level Data & AI Councils and governance forums.
Prepare governance reporting, risk updates, compliance summaries and executive briefings for senior stakeholders.
Monitor governance maturity, control adoption and compliance against agreed governance metrics.
Support implementation of governance controls including data ownership, metadata, classification, retention, quality and AI governance requirements.
Help business units understand and meet obligations relating to data and AI governance regulations and policies.
Support the development and delivery of governance awareness sessions, training and communications.
Collaborate with central governance teams to ensure business requirements are reflected within enterprise governance frameworks.
Track governance risks, issues and remediation activities while driving continuous improvement.
Support governance decision-making through evidence-based reporting and analysis.
Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across BT Group.
Contribute to the ongoing evolution of BT's Data & AI Governance operating model.
Essential Skills / Experience
Proven experience working within Data Governance, Information Governance, Data Management or Governance Risk & Compliance environments.
Strong understanding of Data Governance frameworks, policies, controls and operating models.
Experience working with regulations and compliance requirements such as GDPR, EU AI Act, Ofcom or similar regulatory frameworks.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence across multiple business areas.
Experience preparing and presenting governance updates, reports and briefing papers for senior stakeholders.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to translate complex governance topics into clear business outcomes.
Experience facilitating governance forums, working groups, councils or steering committees.
Strong understanding of governance controls including data ownership, classification, retention, metadata and data quality.
Experience tracking governance compliance, risk and maturity metrics.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities across a complex stakeholder environment.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Experience working within Telecommunications, Technology, Financial Services or other highly regulated industries.
Knowledge of AI Governance, Responsible AI principles and emerging AI regulatory requirements.
Understanding of DORA, regulatory control frameworks or operational resilience requirements.
Familiarity with BT's Key Control Framework (KCF).
Experience supporting organisation-wide governance transformation initiatives.
Knowledge of wholesale, Openreach or telecommunications regulatory obligations.
Experience delivering governance training, awareness programmes or capability uplift initiatives.
Understanding of data management tools, governance tooling or metadata platforms.
Important Information
This role can be based in London, Birmingham or Bristol and follows BT's hybrid working model.
Our Package

Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
Equalised maternity, paternity and adoption leave: 18 weeks' full pay and 8 weeks' half pay
Discounted EE and BT prod

title: Claims Advisor
description:
Company: Marsh 
 Description: 
 Marsh is seeking a Claims Advisor to join our Dublin Claims team, a key role within our broader insurance advisory services. This position offers the opportunity to work across a diverse range of insurance lines including Motor, Personal Injury (PI), Marine, Employers’ Liability (EL), and Public Liability (PL), managing claims for large multinational corporate clients. You will play a vital role in delivering expert claims handling and advocacy, ensuring timely and fair outcomes that add significant value to our clients and support Marsh’s reputation as a leading global risk adviser.

 In this role, you will manage a portfolio of claims from initial notification through to settlement, working closely with clients, insurers, and internal teams. You will be responsible for developing claim strategies, coordinating with external partners such as loss adjusters and legal advisors, and advocating for clients to achieve appropriate outcomes within policy terms. You will also support complex claims and disputes, ensuring clear documentation and escalation where necessary.

 We will rely on you to: 

 Manage a portfolio of Motor, Property & Personal Injury claims end-to-end, from first notification through settlement/closure.
 Set and document claim strategy, timelines, and next steps, maintaining strong diary management and proactive follow-up to drive timely outcomes.
 Advocate for clients by negotiating with insurers and coordinating key stakeholders (clients, insurers, internal teams, adjusters, and legal advisers) to achieve fair outcomes within policy terms.
 Handle complex claims, declinatures, and coverage disputes by producing clear chronologies/summaries, escalating appropriately, and ensuring decisions are well-documented.
 Deliver accurate reporting/MI and audit-ready records to support renewals and stewardship meetings, while maintaining compliance with governance, conduct standards, GDPR, and internal controls.
 
 What you will need to have: 

 Relevant insurance claims experience, ideally including complex and/or high-value claims across multiple insurance lines.
 APA (Accredited Product Adviser) (Commercial) qualified as a minimum.
 Strong IT capability, including proficiency in MS Office.
 Strong communication and relationship-management skills with a client-first mindset.
 Proven ability to work under pressure, manage deadlines, and maintain high-quality, compliant documentation.
 Experience preparing claims reports and coordinating with external partners (e.g., loss adjusters, solicitors, forensic accountants).

 What makes you stand out: 

 3+ years insurance claims experience, including handling complex or high-value claims.
 Experience preparing and presenting claims experience reporting and insights for renewal/claims review meetings.
 Experience coordinating with external vendors (adjusters/legal) and managing contentious matters.
 Qualified Chartered Insurance Professional (CIP).
 Demonstrated coaching/mentoring capability and/or prior people leadership experience (where applicable to the role).
  
 Why join our team: 

 To be part of a company with a strong brand, committed to making a difference in people's lives.

Finance team

External support providers e.g. technology platforms

title: Trainee Actuary
description:
At Ayvens, progress starts with you. 
 
 Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.
 
 Company Background 
 Ayvens Insurance is part of the Ayvens group, a global leader in mobility solutions with circa 3.3 million vehicles under management worldwide. Ayvens Insurance (incorporated name: Euro Insurances DAC) based in Dublin provides fleet insurance solutions to Ayvens entities predominantly in Europe but also in Central and South America.
 
 The Ayvens brand was launched in 2023 following the merger of ALD Automotive and LeasePlan, combining extensive expertise in leasing, fleet management, and insurance services. Ayvens Insurance includes the historic insurance portfolios of both groups and supports Ayvens' broader sustainability and innovation goals.
 
 Ayvens Insurance is part of the Société Générale Group, one of Europe’s largest financial services organisations.
 
 Job Purpose 
 Ayvens Insurance is currently recruiting for an experienced Actuarial Trainee to join the Actuarial team on a permanent basis. This role will be focussed on ensuring the successful candidate develops a broad range of skills including reserving, Solvency II reporting and IFRS 17 reporting. In addition, the person will also be involved in the daily operational activities of the Actuarial team.
 
 This role will likely report to a qualified actuary.
 
 It is expected that the successful candidate will work towards qualification as an actuary (where Ayvens Insurance will provide study sponsorship and support).
 
 
 Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
 Applying best estimate actuarial reserving techniques to prepare quarterly reserve estimates together with accompanying narrative explanations
 Solvency II analysis with particular focus on preparing Technical Provisions (TPs) calculations
 Providing assistance to the IFRS 17 reporting team
 Provide actuarial assistance on internal projects and initiatives including assisting the Analytics area on (inter alia) more granular investigations on claim trends and interacting with the relevant stakeholders on mitigating actions and next steps as required.
 Assist with year-end actuarial certification, audit engagement and Solvency II quarterly & annual Quantitative Reporting Templates (QRTs) to the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI)
 Assisting with upgrades and impprovements to software and systems used within the Actuarial area including reserving software
 Assist in the preparation of material and papers for the quarterly Board and group risk management meetings
 Completing mandatory training, including, but not limited to, IT security and compliance training
 
 Knowledge / Skills 
 Requirements:
 At least two-year’s experience in an insurance actuarial environment preferably with non-life experience
 Ideally some knowledge of Solvency II requirements
 Interest in and /or knowledge of IFRS 17
 Reserving knowledge /experience with ideally previous exposure to one or more of the specialist reserving software packages (e.g. ResQ)
 Previous fleet motor and /or personal lines motor experience would be an advantage
 Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data and statistics to deliver outcomes
 Ability to work on own initiative and willingness to take ownership of tasks
 Ability to prioritise work to deliver results within strict deadlines
 Strong time management and organisational skills
 Team player who can demonstrate good interpersonal skills and ability to work across departmental and organisational lines
 Ability to communicate with international teams at all levels and communicate well with non- actuarial audiences
 
 
 Why Ayvens?   
 
 With over 3.4 million vehicles managed across more than 42 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.
 
 At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.
 
 Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

title: R&D Engineer II ICT
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life At our Medtronic, plc, R&D (Research & Development) Department in Galway,
 Ireland, we focus on the development of cutting-edge medical devices Our R&D Engineers in Galway are directly involved in working on the development of innovative products for use in medical procedures.

 The ICT Integrated operating unit offers minimally invasive approaches to restore proper structure and function of the heart and the aorta. We are focused on the transcatheter replacement or repair of the four heart valves – aortic, pulmonic, mitral, tricuspid – and the placement of stent grafts to treat aneurysms and dissections of the body’s largest artery, the aorta. As an R&D Engineer, you will be tasked with supporting a team in the technical development of new products through early-stage investigation/research and/or translation of that into commercial medical devices.
 Come for a job, stay for a career!

 Contribute to developing products for use in medical procedures as defined / required by the business needs of the company
 Responsible for establishing the most effective, reliable, and cost-effective processing methods for manufacturing operation
 Provide technical support to product and process development and on field related activities such as clinical programs and complaint investigations
 Leading multidiscipline teams in planning and implementing the introduction of new products, in line with marketing plans and undertaking specific projects as designated in support of the business activities of Medtronic
 Support the introduction / implementation of product / process / materials changes to the manufacturing operation
 Participate in sourcing, testing and approving materials
 Effectively represent Medtronic Vascular externally with our customers
 Document design / development / test activities as required in Engineering Laboratory notebooks
 Design, develop, analyze, troubleshoot, and provide technical skills during research and / or product development
 Design studies to investigate specific life science questions within your field of expertise
 Involved in product research and development and / or clinical trials.
 Translate research discoveries into usable and marketable products.
 
 Key Skills & Experience 
 Level 8 Degree in Engineering / Science or related discipline with minimum 2 years relevant direct engineering experience or PHD with 0 years of experience
 Medical device technology experience, ideally in interventional vascular devices would be advantageous
 Experience in biomedical materials, processing knowledge and medical device design procedures
 A proven track record in innovative design, product development and manufacturing
 Dynamic team player who can work effectively and proactively on crossfunctional teams
 Strong interpersonal and team management skills.

title: Account Executive, Small Business - Nordics (English Speaking)
description:
What will you get to do in this Small Business Account Executive role?

As an Account Executive at HubSpot, you use inbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small and mid-sized businesses. This position would be based out of your home office working in an inside sales model, and it is a full closing role.

We are actively hiring for a Small Business Account Executive to sell into the Nordics territory; candidates are eligible to be office, flex or remotely located in the United Kingdom based on individual preference! Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

What are the responsibilities of a Small Business Nordics Account Executive?

In this role, you will get to:

  • Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best inbound marketing solutions for their business
  • Consistently close new business at or above quota level
  • Build relationships with highly qualified prospects at small and mid-sized companies
  • Build relationships with prospects and internal stakeholders to grow new business
  • Work collaboratively with HubSpot's marketing and technology departments to evolve our sales strategy when new features and products are introduced 
  • Help shape the future of HubSpot's mission with your perspectives, ideas, and skills

What are the role requirements?

  • Candidates must be based in the United Kingdom to be considered for a remote opportunity
  • 1+ years of Closing Sales experience
  • Fluency in English
  • Fluency in any Nordic language and / or market exposure would be a plus but it is not required
  • Unmatched consultative selling and closing skills
  • Accurate forecasting and pipeline management
  • Track record of being a high performer (e.g. over quota, President's Club)
  • A sharp focus on your goals and a strong approach for achieving them

Who excels in this role?

Top performers in the Account Executive position usually have:

  • Strong communication, time management and adaptability in order to be set up for success remotely
  • Experience working in a high-growth, "scale up" environment
  • Passion for helping businesses grow and curiosity about the tech industry
  • Humility and enthusiasm in their work

Interested in learning more about our Remote Program? Learn more here! 

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

 experience working with EDIL and Remit processes

title: Account Executive Small Business Italy
description:
Account Executive - Italy - Small Business

What will you get to do in this Small Business Italy Account Executive role?

As an Account Executive at HubSpot, you use outbound selling strategies to find new business and help them grow using HubSpot software. You run online demos of the HubSpot software and successfully sell the HubSpot value proposition. Your target clients will largely consist of small and mid-sized businesses. This position would be based in Dublin in an inside sales model, and it is a full closing role.

We are actively hiring for a Small Business Account Executive; candidates are eligible to be office or flex located in Dublin, Ireland. Please check out this article for more context: The Future of Work at HubSpot: How We're Building a Hybrid Company.

What are the responsibilities of an Account Executive?

In this role, you will need to:

  • Quickly identify challenges that our prospective customers face and discover the best marketing solutions for their business
  • Consistently close new business at or above quota level
  • Nurture relationships with highly qualified opportunities at small-sized companies
  • Build relationships with prospects and internal stake holders to grow new business
  • Help shape the future of HubSpot's mission with your perspectives, ideas, and skills

What are the role requirements?

  • 1+ years of Closing Sales experience
  • Proven track record in exceeding individual sales target, particularly in outbound sales and prospecting  
  • Fluency in both Italian and English
  • Unmatched consultative selling and closing skills
  • Accurate forecasting and pipeline management
  • A sharp focus on your goals and a strong approach for achieving them
  • * Please submit your CV in English

Who exceeds in this role?

Top performers in the Account Executive position usually have:

  • Experience working in a high-growth, "scale up" environment, 
  • Passion for helping businesses grow and curiosity about the tech industry
  • Humility and enthusiasm in their work

 What are some of the benefits of working at HubSpot?

  • Generous and competitive remuneration  
  • Interactive employee training and onboarding 
  • Health coverage for you and your family
  • 25 days holidays 
  • Amazing colleagues to learn from and enjoy company social outings, parties, and events

 

Interested in learning more about our Remote Program? Learn more here! 

 

 

 

 

 

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers. 

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Who Are We? Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.
 
 Job Category 

Claim 
 Target Openings 

1 
 What Is the Opportunity? 

Travelers Europe is looking for a Claims Professional to join our team based in Dublin. We are looking for someone who has strong experience in handling professional indemnity and financial lines claims. 

Working under general supervision, you will provide expert claim handling in areas of investigation, evaluation, negotiation and resolution of assigned claims in accordance with the Company's policies, procedures, best practices and controls at all times. You will support the Claims Management team by providing quality claims handling and superior customer service, ensuring that the Claims function runs effectively and that service standards are maintained. This job does not manage others.

Travelers Europe currently offers flexibility to employees who wish to work on a hybrid basis in accordance with our Hybrid Work Arrangements Policy. This entails full time employees working three days a week in the office and two days at home (or pro rata for part-time employees). This policy may be changed at the Company’s discretion. What Will You Do? Analyses and applies policy coverage accurately to all assigned claims.
 Investigates assigned claims.
 Negotiates and settles claims proactively in accordance with Company guidelines and best practices.
 Reserves claims accurately in accordance with Company guidelines and best practices.
 Ensures that Company service standards are upheld.
 Maintains data accuracy.
 Instructs, liaises with and manages external vendors and monitors the quality and cost of their services, ensuring required technical and service standards are met.
 Authorises claim payments and reserves within agreed claims handling authority.
 Provides technical advice. Develops and maintains effective business relationships both externally and internally.
 Works as a team member providing such support as required by other members of the team and fully participates in individual and shared project work.
 Assists Senior Claim Professionals and others with larger and more complex claims, where required.
 Openly communicates knowledge of his/her actions with manager and colleagues in order to consider and better understand the impact on other technical, operational, sales and financial disciplines.
 Proactively participates in training and other learning and development activities to maintain and enhance technical knowledge and other skills.
 Perform other duties as assigned.
 What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have? Possess and demonstrate a level of general technical knowledge and other skills sufficient to handle assigned caseload of claims within designated handling authority.
 Preferably has experience in claim handling environment.
 Is capable of handling claims competently in line with required technical standards, best practices and service level standards.
 Intermediate communication skills.
 Intermediate business perspective.
 Intermediate ability to build collaborative relationships.
 Intermediate openness to influence, flexibility.
 Demonstrates intermediate accountability and credibility.
 Intermediate ability to think analytically and strategically.
 Advanced customer focus.
 Intermediate ability to exercise sound judgment and decision making.
 Intermediate ability to work effectively as part of a team.
 
 What is a Must Have? Accredited Product Advisor (APA) qualification or above.
 Prior insurance related activity experience (e.g. paralegal, insurance operations, insurance broker).
 
 What Is in It for You? Private Medical Insuran ce:  On commencement of employment, you are eligible for single cover provided by Travelers, with the option to add cover for your dependents, at your expense through payroll deduction.
 Retirement: Travelers will make a core contribution of a percentage of salary to your Pension Plan. Additionally, if you decide to contribute to the plan, you will receive an increased company contribution. 
 Holiday Entitlement:  Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 25 days holiday entitlement annually, plus the opportunity to purchase additional days to allow for up to a total of 35 holidays per year.
 Wellness Programme: The Travelers wellness programme is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health programme provides access to free professional counseling services and other resources that support your daily life needs. 
 Volunteer Encouragement:  We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards programme that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.
 
 Employment Practices Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences. 
 
If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.
 
Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.
 
 To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/ .

title: Apprentice Maintenance Fitter
description:
Kepak Group is a professional, and dynamic business that has grown into one of Europe's leading food processing companies. We are a family-owned, future-facing company.
 Our ambition is to continue to grow through the success of our people. Career development, training, health, safety, and wellness of our Kepak team are at the heart of the company’s culture.
 Kepak Athleague are currently recruiting for an Apprentice Fitter to join the maintenance team in a busy beef & lamb abattoir plant.
 Reporting to the Maintenance Manager, the successful candidate will work as part of a team responsible for all aspects of machine and equipment maintenance, specialising in the repair of industrial equipment.
 What to expect in the job?
 Assist with repair of industrial production equipment such as machines, conveyors, packaging machines, gearboxes, bearings and hydraulics.
 Assist the Lead Maintenance Technician with the implementation of preventative maintenance programmes for all machines in assigned area.
 Assist with the continuous monitoring of all machinery and equipment within the plant.
 Assist in real time repair of machines and equipment to get them back up & running within optimum time frame.
 Document all aspects of maintenance work carried out and keep management informed of potential issues.
 Adhere to company safety policies at all times.
 Requirements 
 Requirements
 Must have a keen interest in learning about machines & conveyors, packaging machines, gearbox repairs, air automation, hydraulics and welding.
 Must have a keen interest in learning the Trade of a Fitter within a manufacturing/industrial setting
 We run a maintenance CMMS system, knowledge on the use of computers would be an advantage, training provided. 
 Must be flexible, open to new ideas and work practices
 Good communication skills, enthusiastic, hardworking and energetic.
 Able to deal with pressurised situations and remain calm and focused.
 Flexibility to meet peak work demands as required
 Basic electrical knowledge an advantage, but not essential
 Benefits 
 Training
 Subsidised canteen
 Access to Pension Scheme
 Free staff car parking
 Onsite health and wellness services
 Bike to work scheme
 Formal recognition initiatives and team awards in place
 A dedicated learning & development team

Robert Matthews
Read other stories from our veterans
What is your name and your role and how long have you been working at Expleo?
This year I’m celebrating my 1 2 th year at Expleo . I started my career at Expleo as a Quality Auditor contractor, and then was offered a Staff position in the Life Cycle Management team, where I became a Deputy Team Lead, after which there was a nother promotion opportunity to an Engineering Manager, and later I was able to join our Marine division where I currently work.
Where and how long did you serve in the armed forces?
I served in the Air Force just shy of 25 years. I started my career as an Aero Engines Mechanic. My first posting was at Brize Norton working on VC 10s, Tri Stars & Hercules Aircraft. Then I went on to a technician’s course and became a Junior Technician, and then progressed into a leadership position as a Sergeant. I left the Air Force as a Senior Non-commissioned Officer.
Rob in 2022 post remembrance parade in his local village. Remembrance day is very important to serving and veterans of the forces as it gives a chance to honor those who have given the ultimate sacrifice in serving their country
What challenges did you have after leaving the Armed Forces?
My main challenge was worrying about Job Security. My manager was very supportive when I was still a contractor at Expleo and he transferred me over from contractor to permanent staff. I remember the conversation I had with him about the opportunities for secure job security and promotion.
And he said: “At Expleo, opportunities are out there for you, so go and get them”. And he was right, there are plenty of opportunities at Expleo. You just have to seize them. And every time I saw an opportunity at Expleo, I just went for it.
I transferred a lot of my skills over to Expleo. For instance, the aircraft and engine experience, experience in fault diagnosis, and more in-depth engineering project management and of course my leadership & Management Skills
How did Expleo help you to transition into your civilian job?
I found it quite an easy transition, as there were a lot of ex-forces colleagues within Expleo when I joined, some of which I knew already. For those that didn’t have a military background they were equally as welcoming.
How do you feel Expleo allows you to use your expertise you gained during your service?
Expleo gave me the freedom to use my transferable skills that I gained in the Air Force. My manager and colleagues had an open mindset for my ideas. I could bring those ideas into the office and illustrate how they could be implemented within a business setting They very much welcomed my ideas about improvements, and there is always an open environment for sharing ideas and previous knowledge. I also completed an Expleo Leadership Management course, which differed to the one I had in the Air Force. Combining the two gave me a much more rounded leadership and management mindset.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services. 
  We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do: 
 UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner 
 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business 
 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK 
 Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW 
 Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW 
 We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!. 

 The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining Azure cloud environments. The role includes infrastructure monitoring, troubleshooting, automation, security, compliance and operational support. The successful candidate will work with architects, engineers and stakeholders to implement and support cloud-based services while ensuring reliability, performance and security.
 Responsibilities 
 Support, monitor and optimise Azure services including virtual machines, storage, networking and databases.
 Diagnose and resolve Azure-related incidents and infrastructure issues.
 Support high availability, disaster recovery and resilience solutions.
 Monitor system performance using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics and Application Insights.
 Implement and maintain security controls including Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Azure Security Centre and role-based access control.
 Administer Entra ID, multi-factor authentication, conditional access and hybrid identity solutions.
 Develop and maintain automation scripts using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python, ARM, Bicep or Terraform.
 Support Azure DevOps pipelines and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
 Support networking services including virtual networks, VPN gateways, ExpressRoute, private endpoints and DNS.
 Implement and maintain backup and disaster recovery solutions.
 Maintain Azure resources through planned patching and maintenance activities.
 Support upgrades associated with Synapse, Apache Spark and Python environments.
 Support Power Platform, Logic Apps and Microsoft 365 integrations.
 Develop and maintain Logic Apps to automate file movement and API integrations.
 Monitor Azure consumption and support governance and cost-management activities.
 Produce and maintain technical documentation and support knowledge sharing across teams.
 Support backup and restoration of Azure environments.
 

 Essential Criteria 
 Degree qualification in a technology-related discipline or equivalent professional experience.
 Experience supporting Azure cloud environments.
 Knowledge of Azure services including compute, storage, networking, security and databases.
 Experience diagnosing and resolving technical issues within cloud environments.
 Proficiency in PowerShell, Azure CLI, Python or equivalent scripting technologies.
 Experience with Infrastructure as Code solutions such as Terraform, ARM templates or Bicep.
 Experience using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or similar monitoring tools.
 Knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, ExpressRoute and network security controls.
 Understanding of cloud security principles, identity management and data protection.
 Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Desirable Criteria 
 Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).
 ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
 Experience supporting Azure DevOps pipelines.
 Experience supporting Power Platform and Microsoft 365 services.
 Experience supporting Synapse Analytics environments.
 Experience within public sector or highly regulated environments.
 Experience mentoring or supporting junior engineers.
 

 At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability. 
 Salary Range: €70,000-€85,000

 Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits 

 Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme 

 Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance 

 Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme 

 Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.  

 24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies 

 Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat 

 Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards. 

 Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes. 

 And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more. 
 Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer 
 We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity. 
 We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact ekta.bahl@version1.com. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: GNI146
description:

GNI146 - Construction Engineer - Leinster
Gas Networks Ireland operates and maintains Ireland’s €3 billion, 14,758km national gas network, supplying reliable energy to more than 720,000 homes and businesses. The network delivers more than 30% of the country’s total energy and 40% of its electricity generation.
We are dedicated to achieving net zero and advancing the energy transition through integrated planning and collaboration with the energy industry. To realise our vision and to be at the heart of Ireland’s energy future, we are committed to transforming our network to achieve net zero carbon emissions onboarding biomethane and green hydrogen.
We have a proud legacy, and our values guide how we work every day - drawing on our experience, doing what’s right for each other and our communities, and staying energised for the change ahead.
When you join Gas Networks Ireland, you become part of an organisation that invests in its people. We are committed to supporting your growth and wellbeing in a workplace where everyone can contribute and thrive.
If your application is successful, your starting salary will be determined within the pay range based on your skills and experience. The market reference point (midpoint) of the range typically represents the higher end of the initial offer and reflects a level at which an individual is considered fully proficient in the role. This structure also allows scope for ongoing salary progression as the employee continues to gain experience and develop in the position.
To apply, email your application, including your CV, to  recruit@gasnetworks.ie , quoting the job title and reference number in the subject line.
The Role
The Asset Delivery function within Gas Networks Ireland is responsible for the end to end planning, designing and delivery of GNI’s portfolio of asset development programmes. The Asset Delivery function brings together all the technical and project support capabilities needed to take high-level projects and programmes from the Portfolio Office and translate these through from detailed design and project planning, to construction delivery and handover to Asset Operations.
Reporting to the Senior Project Delivery Engineer (NSWC / DX Pipelines), the Construction Engineer (NSWC / DX Pipelines) will be responsible for overseeing the construction delivery elements of specific NSWC and DX pipeline projects issued to Asset Delivery by the Portfolio Office. Acting as the primary point of contact for escalations at Gate 3 relating to such work within his/her region.
The Construction Engineer will act as a point of consultation for internal stakeholders across the Connections Coordination, Design Delivery and Project Services teams; to assist with the successful development and delivery of projects.
The Construction Engineer within Asset Delivery is responsible for overseeing the onsite execution of works.
Duties and Responsibilities
Planning and overseeing distribution project work conducted on site as required.
Supervision of works on site and completion of site inspections sheets and audits as required to Distribution OPM.
Out of hours supervision on site on Construction On-Call rota of 1 in 6 weeks approximately, with time in lieu granted for out of hours worked.
Managing project and construction activities to ensure delivery on time, within scope and budget.
Taking accountability for project activities to ensure completion in line with GNI Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental requirements.
Ensure contractors comply with their requirements as PSCS requesting improvement, documenting, and escalating to Senior Engineer where required.
Promoting an improved HSQE culture within the team and with our business partners.
Perform role as site supervisor and/or originator for NRO activities where required.
Review project related contractor documentation as required to ensure compliance with legislation, standards, and specifications.
Liaise with design around construction issues as required, across the full life cycle of the project.
Liaison with the contractor to ensure that the Design Deviation Process is followed, and where a deviation is required ensuring works are not allowed proceed until the deviation is submitted and approved.
Examining the feasibility of projects in conjunction with the design department, as part of the EAC Guidelines.
Undertaking construction approval reviews at Gate 2 as required.
Address issues raised to deliver improvements in Contractor KPI’s.
Liaising with Local Authority representatives and other local utility personnel.
Acting as escalation point for the contractor, resolving any issues as they arise.
Liaising with internal departments including connections coordination team and external stakeholders to progress projects from conception to completion as required, in relation to construction related issues.
Escalating any reoccurring issues, risks or issues that cannot be resolved to the Senior Project Delivery Engineer.
Managing relationships with contractors at the project level, on a day-to-day basis and associated cost controls.
Approving contractor payments in compliance with EAC guidelines and contract documentation.
Ensuring that all relevant Asset Data documentation is returned to GNI prior to payment, E.g., as-laids, test certs etc.
Producing monthly reports on progress of construction projects with strong focus on costs.
Attending meetings to report on projects as required.
Ensuring NSWC contract is carried out in accordance with the rates and specifications.
Ensuring continuous improvement in all areas of project and construction management.
Audit works to ensure cross functional requirements are delivered with key focus on safety and quality.
Performing other duties as assigned from time to time.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
Relevant third level 8 degree in Engineering or equivalent.
Minimum 5 years work experience in the natural gas or similar industry.
Experience of managing

title: Learning & Development
description:
Learning & Development
Fuel your curiosity and unlock your full potential
At SMBC, we empower our employees to drive their own learning journey. We provide continuous support and a flexible mix of online and in-person learning experiences. This ensures our people develop the skills they need to thrive today and stay relevant in a rapidly changing world.
Our different approaches
Skills development
We support our people to build their careers through a range of online and classroom learning and development programmes with a focus on technical and professional skills. Throughout your career journey, you’ll learn alongside supportive colleagues and benefit from guidance from our experienced leaders.
Professional qualifications
SMBC invests in your career growth and helps keep you at the forefront of your profession by providing access to financial and study support for relevant external qualifications and certifications. This will help you excel in your current role and build the technical expertise in your domain to help guide you towards more complex and senior future roles.
Mobility opportunities
We actively encourage you to expand your network and explore how your skills and knowledge can transfer into different roles, areas of the business and locations. As a leading international bank, our global footprint also offers unique opportunities to experience living and working in Japan through our Global Japan Programme.
Leadership development
We offer a range of development programmes for our future leaders to develop global business acumen, build valuable connections and strengthen their skills to be a truly inclusive leader. Programmes take place in Japan, across EMEA and virtually, with all offering the opportunity to build key skills, deepen self-awareness and develop the capabilities to support the journey to enterprise leadership roles.
