title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Maintenance Technician About Your New Employer Join an established electronic manufacturing on an ever growing team. 
 Become part of a technically advanced manufacturing environment focused on quality, reliability, continuous improvement and mission-critical technologies.
 Support products and equipment used by SMEs, multinational organisations and innovative start-ups around the world.
 About Your New Job As the Maintenance Technician, reporting to the Maintenance Manager, you will help ensure the reliability, performance and safety of production and facility equipment.
 Your responsibilities will include:
 Carrying out planned, predictive and reactive maintenance on a wide range of manufacturing and facility equipment.
 Troubleshooting and repairing AC/DC power systems, PLCs, motor and servo drive systems, pneumatic equipment and compressed air systems.
 Interpreting technical drawings and schematics to diagnose equipment faults efficiently.
 Performing internal equipment calibrations and maintaining accurate maintenance and calibration records.
 Supporting the installation, commissioning, calibration and validation of new and existing equipment, including IQ/OQ/PQ activities.
 Applying Lean Manufacturing principles and contributing to continuous improvement activities.
 Communicating equipment issues effectively during shift handovers, particularly those affecting Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).
 Maintaining a safe working environment and complying with all company safety procedures.
 What Skills You Need An NFQ Level 6 qualification, or a recognised trade qualification, in Electrical, Mechanical, Electromechanical or a related Engineering discipline.
 At least three years’ experience in an industrial or manufacturing maintenance environment.
 Practical knowledge of PLCs, motor drives and pneumatic systems.
 Strong electrical and mechanical aptitude, with hands-on experience troubleshooting industrial machinery.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
 What's on Offer The opportunity to work with advanced manufacturing equipment across the medical device, automotive, aviation, IoT and ICT sectors.
 A varied technical role involving maintenance, troubleshooting, equipment commissioning, calibration and continuous improvement.
 The chance to develop your technical expertise while collaborating with Engineering, Quality and Production teams.
 Competitive salary and benefits package, to be confirmed based on experience.
 A structured Monday-to-Friday working schedule with no weekend hours specified.
 What's Next Apply now by clicking the “Apply Now” button. If this role is not quite right for you but you are looking for a similar maintenance or engineering opportunity in Galway, please get in touch to discuss other available positions.

title: Pensions Transfer Associate
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.  
 At Davy, you are the difference.   
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally. of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally. 
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has opened up as a Pensions Transfer Associate in the Private Clients Team. In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Manage the end-to-end pension transfer process from a front-office perspective, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance. 
 Prepare and work closely with advisers and CSEs in relation to documentation, tracking transfer requests, and providing management information (MI) to support business decisions.  
 Manage pension transfer-in (FO)  
 On receipt of signed information mandate, gather pension schedule, to include information on fees, bonus, penalties and underlying investments if available. 
 Liaise with advisers to ensure transfer is in best interest of client. 
 Issue transfer paperwork to advisors and collect same for further transmission to external providers. At the same time, query if PAO exists. 
 Chase and provide weekly updates to advisers on status, even if no progression. 
 Once all paperwork and requirements are met, including the setup of receiving pension scheme, pass file to Pension Operations Team. 
 Manage Pension Transfer Out (FO)  
 Review instructions received and if in specie requested, liaise with adviser and IA. 
 Work with IA and advisor if assets need to be liquidated. 
 Ensure pro rata fees are charged on accounts before transferring out. 
 Keep client informed of process, any requirements and potential timeline. 
 Prepare transfer packs and ensure all documentation is complete and compliant.  
 Draft templates for client signatures and coordinate with advisers for timely execution.  
 
 Track & Report:
 Maintain accurate records of all transfer requests and monitor progress to completion.  
 Provide MI to management on 
 Pension transfer Funds Under Management (FUM) in pipeline.  
 Transfer turnaround times and process efficiency.  
 Stakeholder Coordination:
 Liaise with advisers, operations teams, and external providers to resolve queries and ensure smooth transfer execution.  
 Escalate issues promptly and propose solutions to minimize delays.  
  Compliance & Quality Assurance:  
 Ensure all transfers adhere to regulatory requirements and internal policies.  
 Work closely witb pensions technical team and Client suitability team to ensure consistency of advice on pension transfers. 
 Conduct quality checks on documentation and data accuracy.  
 Requirements 
 About you: 
 Strong understanding of pension transfer processes and regulatory requirements.  
 Proactive and commercially minded ensuring timely transfer of assets into Davy and a smooth client experience. 
 Strong communication skills with both clients and internal stakeholders. 
 Excellent organizational and time management skills.  
 Proficiency in MS Office and knowledge of pension administration.  
 QFA or relevant pension qualification preferred.  
 Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and compliance.  
 Ability to improve processes where needed. 
 Strong communication skills for stakeholder engagement.  
 Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.  
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.  
 Health and Wellbeing  
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection. 
 Reward and Recognition  
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most. 
 Growth and Development  
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy. 
 Positive Workplace  
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy. 
 Values and Culture  
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.  
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland.
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

FBD is Ireland’s largest homegrown insurer, supporting consumers, farmers, and businesses nationwide for over 50 years. With a local network of 34 branches and a commitment to genuine customer service, we are uniquely positioned to meet our customers’ needs.
As an Irish-owned company, we take pride in fostering an inclusive environment, evidenced by our Gold Accreditation from Investors in Diversity (IiD) through the Irish Centre for Diversity. Our culture values work-life balance and creates a friendly atmosphere where our people can thrive, feel valued and contribute to achieving FBD’s strategic goals.
About the Role
The primary function of the Sales Advisor is to deliver sales of Personal Lines, Agri and Commercial Business.   The role will involve assisting in the overall running of the Sales Office to deliver a superior and efficient customer care service that produces agreed sales results while enhancing the local FBD Brand.
Job Responsibilities
Working closely with and reporting to the Branch Manager and Sales Development Co-Ordinator, you will be results focused and your key responsibilities will include:
Being proactive in achieving individual sales targets including prospecting, up selling and cross selling of Personal Lines/Commercial/Agri business.
Dealing with customer queries and referring unresolved/technical queries to the relevant personnel.
Ensuring all systems and procedures as laid down by the Company are complied with.
Accruing and maintaining comprehensive up-to-date knowledge and information of the Company’s commercial product range and compliance requirements and completing relevant industry qualifications and CPD hours as appropriate.
Working flexibly within the Sales Office and participating in various office tasks which may include going to the Mart.
Providing relief to other Sales Offices in the region, as required.
Developing mutually beneficial working relationships and working closely with the local FBD Life and Pension Financial Advisor, to continuously enhance the overall FBD Group service delivery to customers.
Participating in account management initiatives for Commercial and Agri business.
Part taking in on-going renewal follow ups/revisions; identifying sales opportunities, cover/rate improvements, as appropriate.
Assisting customers at the initial notification of claims stage, in line with company procedures.
Taking responsibility for individual outstanding debit/premium collections.
Providing dedicated support to the Sales Executive/Branch Manager, as directed.
Administration of Personal Lines/Commercial/Agri business as required.
Carrying out such duties as management may require from time to time

Sales/customer service experience.
Proactive / energetic approach / positive outlook
Customer focused

title: Marketing and Business Development Specialist (fixed term contract)
description:
MARKETING AND BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT SPECIALIST 
 At Dentons Business Services EMEA, we are committed to excellence in supporting legal professionals with cutting-edge solutions. Our dynamic and diverse team collaborates seamlessly to provide a wide range of services, including finance, IT, human resources, marketing, and more. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of continuous improvement and adaptability.
 Dentons Business Services EMEA serves as the operational backbone of Dentons, supporting the world’s largest law firm in delivering exceptional service to clients across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
 As a crucial component of Dentons' global network, our EMEA business services team plays a key role in driving efficiency, innovation, and collaboration.
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
 This is an exciting role which is an integral part of the UK, Ireland & Middle East Disputes practice. The BD Executive will, together with Disputes BD team, provide support on marketing and business development activity across the Disputes division, which also includes our Litigation & Arbitration and Regulatory & Investigations practice.  The role will be focused on delivering strategic objectives in relation to campaigns, events, sponsorship management, directory submissions, thought leadership, client relationship management and client targeting.
 
 The role is a fixed term contract (15 months maternity cover) and operates in a hybrid working model (2 days/week required in the office). 
 - As this role supports UK region please note that it requires operating within UK time-zone therefore working hours are from 10 am – 6 pm 
 - This role operates in Hybrid working model requiring DBSE Warsaw office presence 1-2 times a week
 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Profile Raising 
 Prepare award entries, legal directory submissions, and explore profile-raising opportunities.
 Maintain and update website and social media content with the Communications team.
 Ensure all materials follow brand and visual identity guidelines.
 Winning Work 
 Support the production of proposals (content creation, editing, team coordination, branding, and pricing compliance).
 Collaborate with the Senior BD Manager to develop high-quality proposal materials and ensure consistent messaging across platforms.
 Act as a proposal process ambassador and ensure proposals are logged and outcomes tracked.
 Conduct research on organisations, sectors, and individuals.
 Events and sponsorship management 
 Assist in planning and executing client events (in-person and virtual).
 Draft invitations, manage logistics, and create targeted mailing lists.
 Leverage sponsorships for client engagement and manage post-event follow-ups, including ROI tracking
 Campaign Management   
 Support the development and delivery of marketing campaigns.
 Draft and design marketing content for internal and external use.
 Work with the Digital Marketing team for online rollout, ensuring brand compliance and tracking ROI.
 REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS 
 Experience:  
 o    Working with legal and/or professional services environment
 o    Broad Marketing and organisational experience
 o    Experience managing the legal directories process preferable
 Education: Graduate calibre with demonstrable and/or professionally recognised marketing or communications qualification (such as CIM, etc.)
 Soft Skills: 
 o    Strong written and oral communication skills
 o    Good attention to detail
 o    Understands the need and has the ability to manage expectations
 o    Willingness to take on additional responsibility and deputise for their line manager when required
 Technical Skills:  
 o    working knowledge of Word, PowerPoint and Excel
 Leadership: 
 o    Builds trust amongst fee earning teams and wider stakeholder community
 o    Understands when to act and when to ask
 BENEFITS 
 Private medical healthcare
 Multisport card 
 Worksmile Cafeteria system 
 Workation, up to 90 days a year
 A private insurance plan 
 An additional day off for your birthday 
 Volunteering days, up to 2 a year
 Hybrid work model with an office in Warsaw city center

You do not need to have your entire career mapped out to start making progress. Exploring careers is about learning more about yourself, researching opportunities, and building an understanding of what might suit you.
Whether you have a clear direction in mind or are still weighing up your options, taking time to explore different careers can help you make informed decisions about jobs, internships, further study and future career paths.
Start by considering:
What interests and motivates you?
What skills and strengths do you enjoy using?
What type of work environment would suit you?
What careers are linked to your course and qualifications?
What opportunities are growing in areas that interest you?
Career exploration is not just about researching jobs online. It can involve talking to professionals, attending employer events, gaining work experience, networking with graduates, and reflecting on what you want from your future career.
Career Exploration Resources
The following resources can help you research careers, industries, graduate opportunities and labour market trends:
Explore graduate careers, employer profiles, sector guides, internships and graduate opportunities on Gradireland.
Research career paths, job sectors and job profiles on Prospects.ac.uk/ .
Research organisations, follow employers and explore areas that interest you on Linkedin.
Use our free Profiling for Success tools to dicover your s trengths and develop your self awareness.
Take Your Research Further
As you explore career options, try to:
Read job descriptions and identify common skills, qualifications and requirements.
Talk to graduates and professionals working in areas that interest you.
Attend jobs and careers fairs, employer events and networking opportunities.
Gain experience through internships, placements, volunteering or part-time work.
Arrange informational interviews to learn more about specific roles and organisations.
Meet with a Career Coach to discuss your ideas and next steps.
Remember, few people find the perfect career path immediately. Career planning is an ongoing process of exploration, reflection and action. The more you explore, the more confident and informed your decisions will become.

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to analyze attack patterns, develop incident response plans, ensure audit readiness, and implement disaster recovery measures, to ensure adherence to cyber security regulatory frameworks.
Areas of responsibility
Monitoring and Incident Detection-Analyse attack trends and correlate logs across systems to identify advance threats. Enhance monitoring processes and implement improvements for faster detection, to ensure compliance with security frameworks and regulatory standards.
Incident Handling and Analysis-Perform root cause analysis, create incident response plans and implement disaster recovery measures to minimize business disruption
Threat Assessment and Analytics-Undertake forensic analysis using advanced analytics tools and implement mitigation measures to align with compliance requirements.
Stakeholder Coordination and Audit Assistance-"Liaise with cross functional teams, external vendors and auditors to ensure compliance with security frameworks.
Maintain audit documentation and ensure its accuracy while implementing processes that support audit readiness and continuous compliance."
Training and Awareness-Assist in creating and delivering cybersecurity awareness sessions, including guidance on phishing and malicious emails.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Lead the implementation, configuration, and onboarding of an SSPM solution across enterprise SaaS and data platforms.
Assess and improve the security posture of data platforms, including cloud-based analytics, data warehouses, and business intelligence solutions.
Identify, prioritise, and remediate security risks, vulnerabilities, excessive permissions, and configuration weaknesses.
Configure security policies, monitoring, alerting, and compliance controls within the SSPM platform.
Integrate SSPM capabilities with existing security tooling, including SIEM, IAM, ITSM, and incident management platforms.
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Governance, Architecture, and Security Operations teams to implement security best practices.
Perform security reviews and risk assessments of SaaS applications and data services.
Develop security standards, operating procedures, and governance frameworks for SaaS and data platform security.
Monitor compliance with regulatory and internal security requirements.
Produce dashboards, metrics, and reports for technical teams and senior stakeholders.
Support security investigations and incident response activities involving data platforms and SaaS environments.
Drive continuous improvement in data security posture and operational processes.
Key Deliverables:
Successful deployment and adoption of the SSPM platform.
Enhanced visibility across SaaS and data platform security risks.
Improved identity governance and access management controls.
Reduction in security misconfigurations and critical exposure risks.
Automated monitoring and reporting capabilities.
Alignment with security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
Established governance processes for ongoing SaaS and data platform security management.
Mandatory Skills: Cloud Security Posture Management .
Experience: 5-8 Years .
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. title: Production Operative
description:
Kepak is a global food company serving international retailers and food service household names with prime cuts of meat, on-trend food concepts and ready-for-market convenience foods. Our meat is sourced primarily from quality assured farms and our beef and lamb are pasture-grazed for most of the year.
 Be it fresh meat crafted by our master butchers (such as McIntosh Donald and St. Merryn) or our famous brands (such as Rustler’s, Big Al’s and John Stone), we offer a total foodservice solution with the premium quality our customer's demand.
 
 Kepak McIntosh Donald are looking for Production Operatives to join our team on a full-time basis, working around 40h/week , Monday to Friday, with a 6am start (need to be flexible with finishing time). 
 
 Role Purpose 
 Responsible for supporting the manufacturing and production process through operating machinery, packing products, monitoring quality standards, and managing stock movement and rotation, while ensuring compliance with health, safety, and quality control procedures.
 
 Key responsibilities include: 
 Moving and handling meat carcasses and products safely within the production and storage areas. 
 Working on a production line packing, labelling, and preparing meat products in line with production and customer requirements. 
 Carrying out quality checks to ensure products meet company hygiene, safety, and quality standards. 
 Operating production machinery and equipment in line with company procedures and safety standards. 
 
 Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we will only be contacting candidates who are shortlisted for the next stage of the recruitment process. We appreciate your understanding and thank you for your interest in the role. 
 Requirements 
 Required Requirements Able to perform physically demanding work involving standing and moving throughout the day on a production line
 Able to lift up to 25 kg
 Able to work in a cooler environment
 Basic conversational English skills
 Has the right to work in the United Kingdom
 Available to start work at 6:00am Monday–Friday, with finish time varying based on production volumes
 Preferred Requirements Experience working in a production-line or factory environment with pace and throughput targets
 Awareness of hygiene and food safety practices in a food production environment
 Experience following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and safety rules in an operational environment
 Benefits 
 Performance Bonus- Opportunity to earn a bonus based on your performance and development.
 Pay Grading system- offering the chance to increase your earnings as you advance in your role.
 31 days annual leave per year  (after probation).
 Annual Holiday Purchase Scheme  - Need a little more time off? Purchase additional annual leave.
 Company Pension Scheme  - Helping you plan for the future with access to our company pension scheme.
 Death in Service Benefit  - Eligible salaried employees are covered by our Death in Service benefit, providing financial support and peace of mind for your loved ones.
 Refer a Friend Scheme  - Earn up to  £500  for successfully referring a friend or family member to join Kepak.
 Free On-Site Parking  - Our site has dedicated staff parking, available free of charge for all colleagues.
 Subsidised On-Site Canteen  - Enjoy a variety of freshly prepared hot meals and food options at reduced prices in our on-site canteen.
 Cycle to Work Scheme  - Save money on a new bike and cycling equipment through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Electric Vehicle Scheme  - Access an electric vehicle through our salary sacrifice scheme.
 Long Service Awards  - We recognise, acknowledge and celebrate the loyalty, dedication and valuable contributions of our long-serving colleagues.
 Discounted Gym Memberships  - Support your health and wellbeing with access to discounted gym memberships.
 Training and Development  - We are committed to helping you grow your career through structured onboarding, regular online and in-person training, and clear opportunities for career progression.
 Mentoring and Leadership Development Programmes  - Whether you're looking to build new skills or take the next step in your career, our mentoring and leadership development programmes are designed to help you reach your full potential.
 GroceryAid Employee Assistance Programme  - Free and confidential emotional, practical and financial support for all Kepak colleagues, including access to counselling, mental health support, legal guidance and a 24/7 confidential helpline.
 Financial Advice & Will Writing -  Access free mortgage advice and a complimentary will writing service as part of your employee benefits package.

title: Sales Development Coordinator (6-Month FTC)
description:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

Our Sales Development organization is a key driver of Fin’s growth, acting as both a talent pipeline and a revenue engine. We identify and engage prospects globally, guiding them through the early stages of the sales process - and laying the foundation for future careers across our Go-to-Market teams.

At Fin, we’re customer-obsessed and driven to transform online customer service through a human + AI approach. We believe in balancing working hard with working smart - using data, strategy, and creativity to drive results and continuously improve.

We’re looking for a Sales Development Coordinator to join our Enterprise Sales team. This is a hands-on, learning-focused role designed for someone looking to build strong foundations in sales development, customer engagement, and account research.

You’ll play a key role in nurturing low-intent prospects, improving the quality of our account and contact data, and enabling Account Executives and Business Development Representatives to engage more effectively with high-potential prospects.

This role is intended as a stepping stone into Sales. Successful candidates may progress into a full-time Sales Development Representative role based on performance, readiness, and business needs. You will receive coaching and enablement to prepare for progression into an SDR position.

What will I be doing? 

As a Sales Development Coordinator, you’ll work closely with the Enterprise Sales teams across several core areas:

  • Follow up on inbound leads and engage with early-stage prospects, helping qualify interest and route opportunities appropriately
  • Conduct account and prospect research to support outbound efforts
  • Build organisation maps for key personas, including roles across Customer Support, Product, AI, and Digital Transformation
  • Prepare call briefs and account summaries to help AEs and BDRs engage effectively ahead of meetings

What skills do I need? 

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Technology, or a related field or early in your career with less than 2 years of professional experience
  • Comfortable engaging with prospects via email and phone
  • Fluency in English, with French or German preferred (Dublin only)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfortable using tools such as LinkedIn and Google Workspace
  • Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to manage tasks independently with light guidance
  • Curious about technology, AI, sales, and customer experience
  • High attention to detail and strong follow-through
  • Motivated to build a long-term career in sales

Prior sales experience is not required, this role is designed for someone early in their career or transitioning into sales.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
Supply Chain Manufacturing

Production Equipment Repair & Maintenance 
 
 Job Category: 
Non-Standard 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 About Innovative Medicine 
 Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow.
 Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way.
 
 Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/innovative-medicine 
 
 We are searching for the best talents for the 4 years Electrical & Instrumentation Apprentice roles to be in Cork, Ireland. 
 
 Purpose: The apprenticeships will provide the opportunity for the suitable candidate to become fully qualified in the relevant discipline through a mixture of on-site work experience and off-site block release with SOLAS (previously FAS) through their Standards Based Apprenticeship Programme. The apprentices will be trained on a broad range of equipment and systems as used in a pharmaceutical production facility.
 
 The Maintenance E&I Apprentice will develop the knowledge, skills and experience required to become a qualified Electrical and Instrumentation Technician within a pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The apprentice will work alongside experienced maintenance personnel, gaining practical hands-on experience in the maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting and repair of site equipment and utilities while completing the formal educational requirements of the apprenticeship programme.
 
 The role provides exposure to a wide range of electrical, instrumentation, automation and reliability activities within a highly regulated GMP environment.
 This apprenticeship consists of four on-the-job phases with an approved employer and three off-the-job phases in an educational organization. Apprentices will be invited to attend their off-the-training phases in accordance with the SOLAS scheduling system.
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Leaving Certificate with a pass in Math and English
 Interest in electrical and instrumentation activities and basic hands-on or practical proficiency.
 A positive mindset and eagerness to learn within the E&I trade, coupled with a strong foundation or interest in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Technical Drawing, Construction Studies, or Agricultural Science.

It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Officer for FA&T. Reporting to the Manager, this full-time and permanent position is based in China and offers regional coverage, allowing you to make a significant impact to our FA&T team and its’ growth.
Key responsibilities:
Track updates on the current changes in accounting standards – PRC and foreign GAAPs.
Understand the filing requirements of Company as “taxpayer” and “employer”.
Apply technical knowledge in the jobs assigned.
Prepare workpapers for each assignment in a complete, accurate, organized, and legible manner with proper cross-referencing, and relevant documentation.
Alert officers or superiors of problems foreseen and of deadline problems, if any.
Maintain proper file records (including accounting file, permanent file and correspondence file, etc.)
Various levels of proficiency in undertaking an accounting and/or payroll outsourcing assignment independently.
Monitor support staff members in producing error-free reports and deliverables.
Take initiatives to propose improvements for tasks and assignments.
Key requirements
About 3 years or more of related work experience in WOFE (Wholly Owned Foreign Invested Enterprise in Mainland China) or with accounting outsourcing team in the accounting/consulting firms.
Bachelor’s Degree in finance-related majors

 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 
 This is how you can make a difference at Abbott: 
 As an Operations Quality Engineer you will Analyse quality standards for components, materials or services. Apply measures, sampling methods, testing methodology and other procedures that ensure that quality standards are met. Provide Quality expertise and guidance to Manufacturing/Operations, Technical/Product Test and Incoming Materials to support the manufacture and delivery of quality and compliant products on time, in full and cost effectively to meet the needs of the business and customers.
 This is a shift based role on 4 cycle shift.

 Apply quality principles, analyses quality records, prepares reports and recommends improvements.

 Conduct inspection, verification and validation of components or materials used in development processes.

 Identify and address recurring problems either with the quality of the product or the reliability of testing procedures. 

 Document quality issues and performance measures for management review. 

 May liaise with external vendors.

 Monitor and maintain the validation status of site products, processes and systems and monitor and maintain process FMEA and Critical Quality Attribute systems. Maintain site validation plans and periodic review process. Support Equipment and Software validation activities and support Process validation activities

 Present and communicate status, report metrics, identify trends potential issues, improvement initiatives and CAPA requirements.

 Investigating customer complaints and forwarding reports to PQA group and responsible for maintaining Corrective and Preventive Action programs.

 Responsible for maintaining an appropriate balance of quality, compliance and business risk and responsible for ensuring teams use appropriate risk management tools to prioritize certain activities and justify the level of effort required.

 Monitor and maintain the quality and compliance status of associated quality records and ensure project teams maintain project records in compliance with Quality System and planned requirements.

 Support DMR change control and calibration activities.

title: Associate In-Play Football Trader
description:
Are you ready to ignite your career with the World’s largest sports betting and iGaming company? We currently have a part- time Football Trader opportunity available in our Football Trading Team. We have two part- time roles available, consisting of shift work which spans weekdays, weekday evenings, and weekends. 
 This is more than just a job, it’s your first step in building career. Our Trading Team are always thinking one step ahead, whether that’s making decisions in the moment during big sporting events, or in the way that we use our combined insights to create innovative data driven solutions for our customers. 
 About The Role Our UK & Ireland Trading Team are the people behind the odds that our Paddy Power, Sky Bet, and Betfair customers bet on. They utilise stats, in-house models, industry news and our opinions to solve problems, manage risks and power performance on all types of sporting events. 
 In this role you will… Put the Customer First: help us deliver the sports betting experiences our customers love, ensuring we stay at the top of our game. 
 
 Adapt and Innovate: in this fast-moving industry, you'll work with your colleagues to create fresh, exciting betting options for over 1 million customers. 
 
 Solve Problems, Manage Risks: this role will teach you how to approach challenges strategically, improving the betting experience and learning risk management on the job. 
 
 Engage with Sports: even if you're new to sports betting, we’ll provide full training to ensure you’re comfortable working with odds, pricing for multiple sports. 
 
 Build Technical Skills: you’ll gain exposure to cutting-edge technical applications and analytics, helping you sharpen your analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
 
 Grow Professionally: we support your development every step of the way, giving you the tools to expand your skill set and advance your career. 
 
 This is a shift-based role requiring flexibility and reliability. We're looking for a candidate who is comfortable working weekends and bank holidays as part of a rotating schedule. As office presence is integral to this position, we expect successful applicants to commit to working on-site as much as possible, which is essential for team collaboration and operational effectiveness. 
 What we’re looking for: No prior Trading experience is required to succeed in this role, we’re looking for curious minds with a drive for continuous improvement. Our Trading Team are equipped to train you throughout your role. 
 
 Analytical Skills: the ability to think critically and solve problems using data. Excel experience is desired. 
 
 Attention to Detail: precision is key to ensure accuracy in all trading tasks. 
 
 Organisation: Strong organisational skills to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines. 
 
 Communication & Teamwork: collaboration across departments is essential to improve customer experience. 
 
 Critical thinking: whether its analysing data or untangling a tricky situation, you always find the logic behind the madness. 
 
 What’s in it for you: Flexible ways of working 
 £/€1,000 learning fund 
 
 Wellbeing fund 
 
 Bonus Scheme 
 
 Pension contribution scheme 
 
 Private healthcare 
 
 Access to thousands of Udemy courses 
 
 Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme 
 
 16 hours paid volunteering time per year 
 
 Unlimited holiday 
 
 About Flutter Flutter is the world’s leading online sports betting and iGaming operator, with a market leading position in the US and across the world. Our ambition is to change our industry for the better, making use of our significant scale and challenger mentality. 
 By Changing the Game, we believe we can deliver long-term growth while promoting a positive, sustainable future for the industry. We are well-placed to do so through the distinctive, global advantages of the Flutter Edge, which gives our brands access to group-wide benefits to stay ahead of the competition, as well as our clear vision for sustainability through our Positive Impact Plan. 
 Flutter operates a diverse portfolio of leading online sports betting and iGaming brands including FanDuel, Sky Betting & Gaming, Sportsbet, PokerStars, Paddy Power, Sisal, tombola, Betfair, MaxBet, Junglee Games and Adjarabet. 
 About Flutter UK & Ireland The UK & Ireland region of Flutter unites some of the biggest brands in the betting and gaming industry; Betfair, Paddy Power, PokerStars, Sky Betting & Gaming and tombola. 
 At Flutter UK & Ireland, we strive for the next level and drive innovation to set the pace as leaders, putting our customers first, always . We win together through team spirit and unparalleled dedication. When we’re free to be ourselves , we thrive and unleash our unique talents —creating a culture that empowers our people to change the game. We see opportunity everywhere and there is always more to discover... 
 We’re working to be an inclusive employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role. 
 If you need any adjustments to make this role work for you let us know, and we’ll see how we can accommodate them.

Job Title:

BT International

Competititive
About the role
The Secure Networking Specialist will play a key role in helping BT grow its strategic Secure Networking portfolio in Japan by bringing together traditional networking, SD-WAN overlay and cloud-delivered security capabilities.
The role is designed for a commercially minded specialist who can understand customer business challenges, shape outcome-led solutions and position BT as a trusted partner across connectivity, secure access and managed services.
The ideal candidate should have the ability to credibly engage in network transformation led conversations, especially where SD-WAN, SSE and SASE are converging.
Broader security knowledge is plus, particularly where it helps customers connect secure networking decisions to resilience, risk reduction and operational simplification.
What you’ll be doing
Qualify and sell BT’s Secure Networking portfolio across Japan-based and regional customer opportunities, including Internet, MPLS, cloud connectivity, and SASE-aligned services.
Act as the subject matter specialist for secure network transformation opportunities, helping account teams position the right mix of underlay connectivity, overlay intelligence and embedded security controls.
Shape solution strategies that combine BT’s global network capability and partner ecosystem into practical, commercially viable customer propositions.
Position single-vendor and hybrid-vendor SD-WAN, SSE and SASE approaches appropriately, helping customers understand the trade-offs across cost, complexity, integration, service model and operational ownership.
Portfolio scope
Networking underlay: Globa Fabric, Internet, MPLS, Ethernet, cloud connectivity.
SD-WAN overlay: Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto/Prisma, Meraki and other vendor-led or hybrid SD-WAN propositions.
Network security and SSE/SASE: managed firewall, secure internet breakout, secure web gateway, cloud access security broker, zero trust network access and firewall-as-a-service.
Optional - Cybersecurity awareness: threat landscape, vulnerability management, endpoint/security ecosystem awareness and how these relate to secure connectivity decisions.
Essential Skills / Experience
Secure networking expertise: Solid understanding of enterprise connectivity, routing concepts, hybrid WAN, internet breakout, cloud access and secure network architecture.
SD-WAN and SASE knowledge: Ability to explain how SD-WAN, SSE and SASE work together, including the strengths and limitations of single-vendor and multi-vendor models.
Customer-led solution selling: Strong ability to translate technical capabilities into customer outcomes such as resilience, user experience, cloud readiness, risk reduction and operational simplicity.
Commercial acumen: Ability to qualify opportunities, shape deal strategy, understand margin drivers and balance customer value with BT commercial objectives.
Partner management: Ability to work productively with technology vendors, local suppliers and internal delivery teams to build credible, deliverable solutions.
Consultative communication: Confidence leading customer conversations, workshops, executive briefings and internal deal reviews in a clear and structured way.
Market awareness: Understanding of enterprise networking and cloud transformation trends, preferably with Japan or wider APAC market exposure.
Growth mindset: Willingness to continuously develop across both networking and security domains, recognising that secure networking requires a blended but realistic skillset.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Experience in enterprise networking, carrier services, managed services, systems integration or technology consulting.
Experience supporting multinational customers, complex RFPs, customer workshops or solution design discussions.
Hands-on or commercial exposure to SD-WAN and SASE solutions
Knowledge of Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Check Point, HPE Aruba or comparable networking/security vendors.
Understanding of Japanese enterprise customers and the ability to operate effectively in a regional or global sales environment.
Business fluent Japanese and Professional English language capability suitable for customer and internal stakeholder engagement.

title: 3D Fit Specialist
description:
3D Fit Specialist 
 Location: Dublin 
 Because we strive to put people first.

Culture, our way. 
 3D Fit at Primark 
 What’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. You’re our inspiration. Embrace what sets you apart, own your career and develop in ways you never expected. Leave your mark. And do it your way

 What You’ll Do as a 3D Fit Specialist 
 You will lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of fit standards across Womenswear, Menswear and Childrenswear, ensuring consistent and customer-focused fit outcomes across all product categories. Working closely with Product, Technical, Sourcing and Supplier teams, you will drive the creation and application of standardised fit blocks, using customer insights and stakeholder feedback to refine fit standards and enhance product performance.
 You will champion the adoption of digital product development technologies, supporting the business strategy to reduce approval lead times, minimise physical fit sessions and increase efficiency across the development process. By leading the implementation of digital fitting solutions and embedding digital ways of working, you will help reduce sampling requirements, lower costs and improve speed to market. The role also holds responsibility for maintaining and governing technical documentation, digital assets and block libraries, ensuring information is accurate, accessible and aligned with business requirements.
  
 Contribute to the creation and implementation of a global block library, ensuring block details are delivered within critical path deadlines to support a fast-moving product strategy, enhance consistency, and improve right-first-time sample accuracy.
 Extensive understanding of apparel grading and its practical application to ensure accurate product fit and size progression.
 Work closely with QA Managers and QA teams to drive the implementation, compliance, and ongoing use of the Global Block Library within head office functions and the supplier base.
 Collaborate with QA and Buying teams to roll out and maintain Fit Expression, Length Guides, and fit standards and fit processes. Ensuring a consistent customer fit experience and adherence to agile ways of working.
 Lead the governance of apparel grading rules, points of measure standards, Fitting and Sealing processes, partnering with stakeholders and suppliers to ensure consistent application, fit integrity, and adherence to best practices.
 Partner with QA teams to lead fit-focused initiatives and the adoption of digital fitting solutions, providing training and technical support to ensure effective utilisation across the business.
 Work cross-functionally with Buying, Design, and the global supply base to drive the implementation of digital product development and fitting technologies, embedding new workflows and supporting the transformation of product development practices across the business.
 Ensure technical fit requirements are aligned to the needs of customers across all retail markets, including growth markets, and are consistently delivered across all product categories.
 Develop and maintain standards documentation and training resources, providing guidance and upskilling opportunities for stakeholders and suppliers as required.
 Champion digital innovation, keeping abreast of evolving technologies and advancements in virtual garment creation while building internal and external networks to drive opportunities across digital product development systems and workflows.
 

 What You’ll Bring   
 Here at Primark, we want everyone to feel valued – so please bring your authentic self to work, of course with some other key experience and abilities for this role in particular:
 Contribute to the creation and implementation of a global block library, ensuring block details are delivered within critical path deadlines to support a fast-moving product strategy, enhance consistency, and improve right-first-time sample accuracy.
 Extensive understanding of apparel grading and its practical application to ensure accurate product fit and size progression.
 Work closely with QA Managers and QA teams to drive the implementation, compliance, and ongoing use of the Global Block Library within head office functions and the supplier base.
 Collaborate with QA and Buying teams to roll out and maintain Fit Expression, Length Guides, and fit standards and fit processes. Ensuring a consistent customer fit experience and adherence to agile ways of working.
 Lead the governance of apparel grading rules, points of measure standards, Fitting and Sealing processes, partnering with stakeholders and suppliers to ensure consistent application, fit integrity, and adherence to best practices.
 Partner with QA teams to lead fit-focused initiatives and the adoption of digital fitting solutions, providing training and technical support to ensure effective utilisation across the business.
 Work cross-functionally with Buying, Design, and the global supply base to drive the implementation of digital product development and fitting technologies, embedding new workflows and supporting the transformation of product development practices across the business.

 Develop and maintain standards documentation and training resources, providing guidance and upskilling opportunities for stakeholders and suppliers as required.
 Champion digital innovation, keeping abreast of evolving technologies and advancements in virtual garment creation while building internal and external networks to drive opportunities across digital product development systems and workflows.
 

 Does this sound like you? Great, because we can’t wait to see what you’ll bring. You’ll be supported within a team of equally capable people, celebrating who you are and aiding you reach your potential. At Primark, we’re excited about our future - and we’re excited to develop yours.
 About Primark  
 At Primark, people matter. They’re the beating heart of our business and the reason we’ve grown from our first store in Dublin in 1969 to over 80,000 colleagues and over 500 stores in 19 countries today and growing.
 So, what’s a career at Primark all about? The positive impact you’re making, the experiences you’re having and the people you’re with. It’s that feeling that turns a job into something more. Celebrating the wins, working at pace, and pulling through the challenging times with passion, courage, and your team by your side. It’s what drives us every day.

title: Alternative Investment Support Associate - 9-12 month FTC
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.  
 At Davy, you are the difference.   
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.  
 
 About the role 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen to join Davy as an Alternative Investment Support Associate on a 9-12m Fixed Term Contract basis. 
 In the role, the successful candidate will be responsible for:
 Prioritising and completing tasks that ensure funds are accurately priced for each valuation point for a portfolio of private equity funds and hedge funds
 Identifying and validating pricing variances and large variation movements
 Studying and reviewing the current pricing system in order to improve productivity, quality and efficiency
 The execution of capital calls and distributions.
 The preparation of annual tax statements for client investments in private equity products
 The preparation and review of financial statements for company investment structures
 Maintaining relationships with Private Equity Firms and Life Assurance Companies
 Understanding client relationships and expectations to ensure client deliverables are timely and accurate
 Ownership of timely resolution of client/investor queries
 Investigating reconciliation differences during the monthly reconciliation cycle
 Requirements 
 About you 
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 Previous experience in fund administration preferred.
 Can demonstrate experience of internal controls, procedures and interaction with internal audit, implementing change and constantly creating efficiencies in operating model.
 Excellent analytical skills with experience working in complex investment structures.
 Must be a team player with the ability to network with co-workers but also have the ability to work independently and prioritise own workflows.
 Demonstrates a willingness to own the full end to end servicing of a fund
 Proactive attitude, ability to multi-task and work to tight reporting deadlines.
 Strong presence and presentation skills.
 Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
 Excellent attention to detail, speed & accuracy is a pre-requisite for this role.
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.   
 Health and Wellbeing   
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition   
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development   
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace   
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.
 Values and Culture   
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.

 As an R&D Engineer, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, prototype innovative solutions, solve complex engineering challenges, and contribute directly to products that improve patient outcomes worldwide. If you thrive in a hands-on, fast-paced environment and enjoy turning creative ideas into reality, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 
 What You'll Do 
 As a key member of our R&D team, you will: 
 Contribute to the design and development of innovative medical devices.

 Drive projects through the product development lifecycle, from concept generation and feasibility through prototyping, verification, validation, and manufacturing transfer.

 Develop and evaluate prototypes using a variety of advanced manufacturing technologies including:
 Injection moulding

 Extrusion

 Polymer and metal 3D printing

 Rapid prototyping technologies

 
 Apply Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles to ensure successful scale-up from development to production.

 Lead and support process development activities that enable efficient and robust manufacturing solutions.

 Utilise Six Sigma and structured problem-solving techniques to investigate technical challenges and implement effective solutions.

 Collaborate closely with Quality, Manufacturing, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, and Supply Chain teams to deliver successful outcomes.

 Support material selection, supplier engagement, and sourcing activities for both prototype and commercial device development.

 Prepare and present technical reports, design reviews, and project updates to stakeholders.

 Contribute to innovation initiatives and explore emerging technologies that can enhance future products and processes.

 Participate in product verification, validation, and risk management activities in accordance with medical device regulations.

 
 What We're Looking For 
 Essential Qualifications & Experience 
 Bachelor's Degree (NFQ Level 7 or higher) in Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Design, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of qualifications and experience.

 2+ years of industry experience, preferably within the medical device sector, with a strong foundation in:
 Product Development

 Design Engineering

 Process Development Engineering

 
 Preferred Experience 
 Experience supporting products through multiple stages of the development lifecycle.

 Strong CAD skills, preferably using SolidWorks.

 Hands-on prototyping and product development experience.

 Knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) principles.

 Process development and optimisation experience.

 Experience applying Six Sigma or structured problem-solving methodologies.

 Experience working with manufacturing technologies such as injection moulding, extrusion, additive manufacturing, or similar processes.

 Experience selecting materials and sourcing components for prototype and manufacturing applications.

 
 Personal Attributes 
 We're looking for someone who is:
 A creative and adaptable problem solver.

 Curious, innovative, and eager to learn.

 Comfortable working in a fast-paced development environment.

 Hands-on and passionate about bringing ideas to life.

 A strong communicator who enjoys collaborating across multidisciplinary teams.

 Motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful difference through healthcare innovation.

 
 Why Join Abbott? 
 At Abbott, you'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in healthcare technology while helping to develop products that improve lives around the world.
 In this role, you'll gain exposure to:
 Innovative and emerging medical device technologies.

 Cross-functional collaboration across global teams.

 Advanced prototyping and manufacturing technologies.

 A strong culture of continuous learning and professional development.

 The opportunity to see your ideas progress from concept to commercial product.

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Assistant. Key Responsibilities:
1. The candidate is required to be involved in Fund Operations by manually setting up / initiating payment, cash management and remittance in the client’s online bank portal or payment platform by adhering to all implemented procedures and policies.
2. Assist and coordinate with client in their treasury bank account management and work closely with the both client and banks to manage end to end process of client bank account which includes bank opening, change of account signatories, I- banking users, bank KYC reviews, bank account closure and other bank related tasks assigned by the Manager/Team Lead.
3. Manage the client’s cash book updates, capital calls and any other tasks that is assigned by the Manager / Team Lead.
4. Manage day to day client relationship by attending to both client and bank queries in a professional and timely manner in accordance with the Service Level Agreement and Turn-Around Time.
5. Provide support to facilitate the on-time completion of internal and external audits.
Key Requirements:
1. Must be willing to be based in Iskandar Puteri, Johor Bahru.
2. Experience in Fund Operations, especially in payments, cash management, and treasury bank account handling (e.g., opening accounts, updating signatories), with solid knowledge of KYC documentation.
3. Skilled in cashbook entries and capital call tracking.
4. Strong time management and multi-tasking skills; able to handle multiple tasks with tight deadlines.5. Details oriented and highly focused.
6. Comfortable working under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
7. A quick learner who is flexible and can adapt to changes easily.
8. Takes full ownership and responsibility for assigned work, with a strong focus on accuracy (zero-error mindset).
9. Must have excellent English communication skills to manage client and bank relationships effectively.
10. Has a positive, problem-solving attitude with the ability to think creatively.
11. A strong team player who works well in a dynamic environment and can collaborate across teams and departments.
12. Degree holder in Business Management or Banking or any other related field of study which is relevant to the key responsibilities.
Company Benefits:
At our Malaysia office, we believe in putting our employees’ well-being first! We offer a flexible hybrid working arrangement, upon completion of the probation period. Additionally, we provide comprehensive medical insurance and dental coverage, wellness reimbursement, and competitive leave entitlement to support your well-being and time to recharge or explore your
passions out of work.
As advocates of continuous learning and professional development, we provide an internal mentorship program and reimburse professional membership fees for certifications like job related such as ICSA, CPA, STEP, ACCA, MIA etc. in ensuring you stay ahead in your field.
If you are excited about working with us, we encourage you to apply or have a confidential chat with one of our Talent Acquisition team members. Our goal is to make this a great place to work where all our people can thrive. We hope you join us on this exciting journey!

About the Role
The primary function of the Sales Advisor is to deliver sales of Personal Lines, Agri and Commercial Business.   The role will involve assisting in the overall running of the Sales Office to deliver a superior and efficient customer care service that produces agreed sales results while enhancing the local FBD Brand.
Job Responsibilities
Working closely with and reporting to the Branch Manager and Sales Development Co-Ordinator, you will be results focused and your key responsibilities will include:
Being proactive in achieving individual sales targets including prospecting, up selling and cross selling of Personal Lines/Commercial/Agri business.
Dealing with customer queries and referring unresolved/technical queries to the relevant personnel.
Ensuring all systems and procedures as laid down by the Company are complied with.

title: CAPA Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: Abbott in Ireland Abbott has maintained a strong presence in Ireland since 1946 and celebrates its 80th anniversary in the country in 2026. The company supports the Irish healthcare sector with a broad portfolio spanning diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. Today, Abbott employs more than 6,500 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.

 About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture Freestyle blood glucose test strips and Freestyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the Freestyle Precision, Freestyle Lite and Freestyle Libre systems.

 MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE 
 Responsible for facilitating and executing to the CAPA process. Support the continuous improvement and effective maintenance of the QMS Ensure the use of appropriate risk management tools to prioritise activities and the level of effort required.
  
 MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 
 • Participate in, or lead, the completion of CAPA projects, assuring compliance, quality and timeliness of records.
 • Collaborate with cross-functional teams using various methodologies (e.g. Six Sigma root cause analysis/problem solving skills).
 • Independently investigate, gathers data, and perform preliminary analysis.
 • Process requests, ensuring owners are assigned, and timely responses and approvals are provided in alignment with quality
 goals.
 • Present and communicate status, report metrics, identify trends potential issues, improvement initiatives, as applicable
 • Execute and provide on-time completion of Quality Assurance engineering deliverables.
 • Support team in the delivery and oversight of CAPA training program.
 • Responsible for identifying projects to enhance and promote the effectiveness and efficiency of the quality system and product
 quality.
 • Support Operations to make Quality / Compliance decisions on product during processing, manufacturing, testing, monitoring
 and packaging
 • Ensuring the site delivers safe and effective products that meet customer needs whilst maintaining compliance
 • Provide support and subject matter expertise during audits and inspections.
  
 Qualifications & Experience  
 Minimum Level 7 NFQ qualification or equivalent in a relevant discipline
 Previous CAPA and/or quality assurance/engineering experience and demonstrated use of
 quality tools/methodologies.
 Prior medical device experience preferred.
 Knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations (21 CFR Part 820), GMP, and ISO 13485:2016.
 Solid communication and interpersonal skills.
 Demonstrated and impactful project management and leadership skills, including the ability
 to lead multi-departmental project teams and resolve quality-related issues in a timely and effective manner.
 Advanced computer skills, including statistical/data analysis and report writing skills.
  
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,
 Excellent pension scheme
 Life assurance
 Career Development
 Fantastic new facility
 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.
   
 Important Information 
 Please note that any offer of employment is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a Company-designated medical practitioner.
  
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
