title: Archivist
description:
Job Description : 
 Archivist Location: Guinness Archive, Guinness Storehouse, Dublin Full-time 2 Years Fixed-Term Contract 
 Closing date: 25th September 2026 

 About us With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

 About the Function Heritage is one of Diageo's greatest assets, helping shape the future of our iconic brands through the stories of their past.
 The Guinness Archive, based at the Guinness Storehouse, is responsible for preserving, protecting and sharing the history of Guinness, Diageo's beer brands and Roe & Co Whiskey. As the only publicly accessible brand archive in Ireland, it supports brand teams, innovation, visitor experiences and cultural storytelling across the business.

 About the Team You'll join a small team of archive professionals and heritage specialists who work closely with Brand Homes, Learning & Development, Brewery Ambassadors and global brand teams to preserve our collections and bring our brands' rich history to life.

 About the Role As an Archivist, you'll help preserve one of Ireland's most important brand collections while making our heritage accessible to colleagues, visitors and stakeholders around the world. Combining archival expertise with storytelling, digital preservation and customer engagement, you'll help ensure our heritage continues to inspire future generations.

 Role Responsibilities Catalogue and preserve archive collections to recognised international archival standards, ensuring our collections remain accessible and protected.
 Support the management and preservation of digital archive collections and contribute to ongoing digitisation projects.
 Deliver engaging heritage inductions and presentations for employees, agencies and visitors, bringing the Guinness story to life.
 Provide archive expertise and support to internal stakeholders, helping colleagues access historical materials and brand heritage.
 Work collaboratively across the business to increase access to collections and support heritage projects that strengthen our brands.
 This is a unique opportunity to combine professional archive practice with one of the world's most iconic brands. You'll contribute to preserving Guinness' remarkable heritage while helping shape how our history informs future innovation, storytelling and visitor experiences.

 Experience / Skills Required This could be the right opportunity for you if you have:
 A qualification in Archives and Records Management (or are working towards one) together with knowledge of archive and cataloguing standards.
 Experience in an archive, museum, heritage or visitor-facing environment.
 Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
 Strong communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to engage a range of audiences.
 A collaborative approach with excellent IT skills and experience using digital collections or archive management systems.
 Experience with Axiell Collections or similar archive management software would be advantageous but is not essential.

 Flexible Working Statement Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

 Competitive salary
 Annual bonus
 Product allowance
 Generous holiday allowance
 Contributory pension scheme
 Career development opportunities within a global organisation

Job Description : 
 Title: People Advisor 
 Location: Dublin (St Jame's Gate) or Littleconnell, Co. Kildare 
 Role Type: Permanent, Full time

 Role requires some travel, as this role will cover a large part of IOI. 
 
 
 About us: 
 With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and setting a higher standard for our brands, our business and each other.
 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
 
 About the Function:  
 Human Resources is about shaping the experience of working at Diageo and helping our people learn and grow everyday.   

 From attracting talent to developing careers, this team plays a central role in building a culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to grow. They work closely with teams across the business, bringing insight, care and commercial understanding to everything they do.   

 You’ll help create an environment where different perspectives are valued and where people can learn new skills and thrive, unlocking potential across a truly global organisation.   

 
 About the role :   
 Provide responsive, practical people related advice to people managers, ensuring consistent and fair application of policies while leading day‑to‑day employee matters and building manager capability to prevent and resolve issues effectively. Join us on our HR transformation and support the change management process.
 
 Key Accountabilities: 
 1. People Manager Advisory & First-Line Coaching 
Provide timely, practical guidance and coaching to people managers on employee matters, building confidence in handling day-to-d/ay people issues.
 2. Case Management 
Manage individual employee cases (informal and formal) up to defined complexity, ensuring consistency, documentation, and appropriate escalation to or consultation with specialized ER resources when required.
 3. Support People-related Change Initiatives

 Implementation of (new) global tools and programmes developed through our COEs within each of our geographies with local nuances as required. 
 4. Employee Lifecycle Advisory (Performance, Absence, Exit) 
Support managers on sick absence management, PIPs, and standard redundancy/exit processes, ensuring fair and consistent application of policies.
Advise on non-standard or complex policy application queries, ensuring compliant and consistent application and issue resolution; escalate risks or exceptions appropriately.
 5. Insights, Prevention & Manager Capability Build 
Identify trends from cases, bring local insights to inform process improvements; support delivery of people manager capability build and guidance
 
 
 Key Competencies: 
 1. Employee Relations & Policy Expertise - Solid understanding of HR policies and processes; applies them consistently and pragmatically to real situations.
 2. Advisory & Coaching Skills - Communicates clearly and confidently; provides practical, solutions-focused guidance to managers.
 3. Judgement, Risk Awareness & Execution Discipline - Applies sound judgement in handling cases, knows when to escalate, and ensures accurate, timely, and compliant execution.
 
 
 Experience/skills required:   
 1. HR Advisory & Employee Relations 
Proven experience providing practical HR advice, build strong partnership with the business and sensitively leading employee relations matters (e.g., performance, conduct, absence) through to resolution.
 2. Policy Application & Manager Coaching 
Solid track record of applying policies consistently and fairly, sound judgment on nuances where required, while building people manager capability to handle people-related matters effectively.
 3. Operational HR Delivery 
Experience working in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple priorities and delivering responsive, high-quality day-to-day HR support.

 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Company Description
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.
Job Description
What you get to do in this role:
We are seeking an experienced, highly motivated, and pragmatic problem solver to serve as Corporate Counsel, Public Sector supporting ServiceNow’s SaaS and professional services sales primarily to customers in Federal, State, and  Local government sectors. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge issues in an exciting, fast-paced environment. This is is a full-time position with flexibility on location, but preference for location in the DC/Maryland/Virginia area. The position will report to the U.S. Public Sector lead counsel for Federal, State, Local, and Higher Education on our US Public Sector Legal team.
Review and negotiate master SaaS licensing agreements, professional services agreements, work orders, statements of work, and nondisclosure agreements that meet the company’s requirements under its policies, including those for risk tolerance, while working collaboratively with the business team, including various executives.
Serve as subject matter expert for channel partner issues and agreements, along with responses to requests for proposals (RFPs), enterprise licensing agreements, and other types of Federal, State, and Local contracting documents.
Collaborate with finance, sales operations, deal desk, product operations, support, security and other business units at all levels throughout the organization to ensure that agreements adequately protect the company’s interests.
Support the continuous improvement of standard forms of agreement and legal processes.
Be a trusted business partner, responding in a timely and productive manner to requests from internal customers.
Counsel and deliver training to internal customers regarding company policies, legal issues, and risk tolerance.
Qualifications
To be successful in this role you have:
Undergraduate degree and law degree from highly regarded schools
Active membership in at least one U.S. State bar
At least 5 years’ relevant experience practicing government contracts at the federal and/or state levels at a law firm, corporation, or government agency.
Extensive experience with Federal, State, and Local government procurement processes, and regulations, including the FAR and DFARS.
Experience negotiating agreements with government customers, including understanding of relevant regulations applicable to commercial item prime contractors and subcontractors
Strong understanding of GSA Schedule Cooperative Purchasing and State and Local Government procurement vehicles such as NASPO ValuePoint.
Familiarity with channel (distributors, resellers) and related practice issues.
Experience working cross-functionally with internal organizations to resolve questions.
Preferred:
Experience supporting due diligence for mergers and acquisitions of government contractors or commercial companies with robust government contracts business portfolios.
Deep understanding and experience supporting commercial contracting under FAR Part 12.
In order to be successful in this role, we need someone who has:
Excellent negotiating and influencing skills, and a talent for non-confrontational, win-win negotiations
Exceptional critical thinking abilities, who possesses strong business acumen and excellent business judgment; must be able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and pivot between responsibilities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to distill complex issues clearly and communicate well both one-on-one and in groups, and in internal and external contexts
Desire for close collaboration with sales and sales support to close deals efficiently, with a practical approach
Proficient drafting and legal technical skills, with keen attention to detail
For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $153,300 - $252,900 , plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

To manage, operate, and assure a large, complex, and highly secure Managed Service supporting critical UK national infrastructure and HM Government Defence operations.
The role operates under the direction of the Operational Service Manager (OSM) and Platform Technical Team and carries direct responsibility during shift for service resilience, security assurance, and operational stability, contributing to a brilliant customer and employee experience.
What you’ll be doing
Whilst on shift, be responsible for ALL 1st and 2nd Line operational activities for a large, complex, highly secure Managed Service.
Operate strictly in accordance with all platform and building SYOPS, processes, procedures, and local work instructions, including any BT or Customer directed sub activities, as authorised and directed by the OSM.
Maintain full awareness of operational priorities, security posture, and live service risk throughout the shift
Core Networking and Routing Technologies Security and Boundary Technologies IT, Server, Virtualisation, and Infrastructure Technologies Voice and VoIP Technologies Environmental systems, including power, cooling, and intruder detection technologies

Identify, escalate, and support resolution of incidents and service degradation in line with operational procedures.
Assist in attaining and maintaining the strictest government and MoD security assurance and accreditation for the Managed Service.
Essential Skills / Experience
Operational Experience: Proven experience supporting secure, highly available Managed Services within regulated or classified environments.
Technology Awareness: Working knowledge across networking, infrastructure, security, virtualisation, and environmental systems within secure operational estates.
Stakeholder Management: Ability to work collaboratively across virtual and on site teams, multiple BT Lines of Business, third party suppliers and contractors, and customer/user authorities.
Procedural Discipline: Demonstrated ability to operate strictly within SYOPS, processes, procedures, and local work instructions.
Teamworking: Commitment to inclusive behaviours, collaboration, and the One Team ethos.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Business Acumen: Awareness of business strategy and the drivers of organisational performance, including people performance and financial literacy.
Experience working within secure Network Operations Centres (NOCs).
Familiarity with incident, problem, and change processes within managed service environments.

title: Content Marketing Specialist (6 Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
About us  
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software—we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game.  
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management—we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries.  
 But we don’t stop there.  
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant—they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations—it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.   
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind.  
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future—together.  
 Overview of role 
 This is a fantastic opportunity to learn new skills and develop an exciting career in content marketing and communications. The Content Marketing Specialist will join a small team focused on owning Fenergo’s corporate voice and creating compelling, persuasive and informative content.
 You will be a highly motivated and enthusiastic individual, who can write across a myriad of mediums and channels, offering key messages to different buyer personas. You will be capable of translating complex technology-based content into compelling stories that fuel our lead lifecycle process.
 Your role will span support content marketing, PR and analyst relations, allowing you to expand your experience and skillset across these critical communications divisions.
 Please note this is a Fixed Term Contract for a period of 6 months.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Content Marketing 
 Manage content calendar to show forward plan of content and alignment to key priorities.
 Support Content and Comms Director with the development of whitepapers, blogs, case studies
 Support with writing landing page and web content (descriptions etc) of videos, case studies and awards.
 Leverage AI tools to summarise webinars and long-form content (research reports etc) for blogs.
 Support in writing and submitting speaking proposals for major events.
 Responsible for collating monthly reports including metrics for content pieces.
   Public Relations and Analyst Relations 
 Manage an annual global awards calendar including writing and submitting award entries, purchasing logos for award wins, publishing of award wins on website and all internal and external promotion.
 Coordinate effective promotion of analyst rankings internally and externally via various channels including social media, website, intranet etc. This includes writing relevant promo content for all channels.
 Support with logistics for annual events in key locations.
 Tracking and reporting of media coverage — partner with PR agency to report on impact of comms activity
 Requirements 
 Experience 
 1–2 years' experience in public relations or content marketing, gained in either an agency or in-house environment.
 B2B technology experience with strong media knowledge is essential.
 Proven experience planning, managing, and launching content and/or PR campaigns across earned and owned channels.
 Experience working with senior stakeholders and contributors.
 Skills 
 Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.
 Excellent time management and organisational skills.
 Highly effective interpersonal and communication skills.
 Outstanding writing ability that informs, educates, and persuades.
 Ability to combine creative thinking with commercial and product understanding.
 Skilled in writing across multiple formats (digital, social, print) and for a variety of audiences and personas.
 Strong attention to detail, with a passion for delivering high-quality, outcome-focused work.
 Nice to Have 
 A degree in communications, journalism, marketing or related field.
 Benefits 
 Our promise to you   
 We are striving to become global leaders across all of the categories we operate in and as part of that we are a high-performing highly collaborative team that works cross functionally to accommodate our client’s needs.   
 Collaboration: Working together to achieve our best 
 Outcomes: Drive Success in every engagement  
 Respect: A collective feeling of inclusion and belonging 
 Excellence: Continuously raising the bar 
 What's in it for you? 
 Health insurance 
 25 days annual leave plus, 3 company days
 Work From Home set-up allowance
 Exposure to our local wide partner community 
 Opportunity to work with clients and colleagues on a global scale for a world leader in Client Lifecycle Management
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work-from-home policy, sports and social committee and much more
 Extensive training programs, through ‘Fenergo University' where you will be certified in all of the Fenergo products 
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest tools and technologies harnessing AI
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you to see and assess your own career development and progress
 
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity
 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.
 Recruitment Safety  
 For information on our recruitment process and how to verify communications from Fenergo, please visit our Careers page.

title: RETAIL ASSISTANT
description:
Because you make the difference 
 Here at Primark, we love to do things our way. Because we help our customers keep up with high fashion at affordable prices. We do everything with passion, high standards and care around here. And if that sounds like you, join us as a Retail Assistant.

 Fully Flexible on weekends and public holidays, they need 2 evenings availability

during the week. Must be fully available for the month of December. 

 Because you matter 
 People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:
 Salary: we offer a competitive salary €13.75 per hour plus premium Sunday rate
 Balance: Enjoy flexibility with accommodating shifts
 Pension: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme
 Discounts: Use your in-store employee discount across our fabulous range
 Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and employee assistance programme.
 Holiday: Enjoy generous holidays, based on your hours
 Opportunity to progress your career internationally
 

 What will I be doing? 
 As a Retail Assistant, you’ll be making our customer’s day, every day. Here’s what this looks like in action:
 Providing customers with an amazing experience as you help them with things like sizes or styles, purchases, or returns
 Setting up a good-looking shop floor with full shelves, tidy fitting rooms and all the latest fashions, as well as keeping a tidy and well-organised stockroom
 Delivering a fast, friendly, efficient experience at till points, processing queries, voids, and returns.
 Receiving, unpacking and checking off new deliveries. Getting our products on to the shop floor and ensuring they’re all correctly priced - all while making sure everything meets our high standards
 

 Who you are:
 We love to delight our customers with amazing in store experiences and that starts with you! Here’s what we need:
 You’re passionate about people and creating those amazing experiences
 You’re honest, a strong communicator who can also listen, share ideas and get involved where needed
 You’ve got good organisational skills and attention to detail
 You’re a team player with high levels of motivation, a positive attitude and willingness to learn
 You’re interested in fashion and the latest looks
 Ideally, you’ve got some experience working within a busy retail environment
 To join us, apply today! 
 
 Our fashion isn’t one-size-fits-all and neither is our culture. Primark promotes equal employment opportunity, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where people can be themselves, access opportunities and thrive together.
 #LI-DNI

About the role
The Network Engineering Professional 2 supports delivery and capacity planning of activities across complex network environments. The role combines data-driven decision-making, stakeholder engagement, and continuous improvement to ensure scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure operations.
What you’ll be doing
1. Supports the delivery of routine activities and is accountable for system design, build, testing, validation, maintenance, and ongoing support of all network infrastructure components.
2. Oversees platform health and performance, coordinating infrastructure capacity and build requirements to meet evolving service demands.
3. Develops and maintains forecasting models using complex datasets to support strategic planning and investment decisions.
4. Identifies opportunities to optimise network scaling and infrastructure deployment, balancing performance, cost, and commercial impact.
5. Applies data science and automation tools to analyse trends, monitor thresholds, and inform platform strategy.
6. Manages the lifecycle of network platforms, including roadmap coordination, delivery planning, and in-life service optimisation.
7. Leads stakeholder engagement across internal teams and external partners, chairing forums and managing escalations to ensure alignment and delivery.
8. Supports the implementation of new technologies and systems, contributing to platform upgrades, service enhancements, and regulatory compliance.
9. Responds to customer support requests and operational incidents, ensuring timely resolution and continuous service improvement.
10. Maintains compliance with safety, quality, and audit standards, contributing to secure and reliable infrastructure operations.
11. Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives, enhancing processes, tools, and methodologies to drive operational efficiency and platform evolution.

Backup and Disaster Recovery Consultant
Closing Date: 14/10/2026
Location: Dublin
Reference #: 2075
Role Title:
Business Area:
Consultancy & Delivery
About This Role:
eir Business is the B2B division of eir and one of Ireland's leading providers of telecommunications, technology, cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT and workplace solutions. Supporting organisations of all sizes, from SMEs to large enterprises and public sector bodies, eir Business delivers secure, end-to-end connectivity and digital transformation services that help customers operate more efficiently, securely and effectively. Leveraging Ireland's largest mobile network, extensive fixed-line infrastructure, cloud capabilities and 24/7 expert support, eir Business partners with customers to design, implement and manage technology solutions that enable innovation, productivity and business growth.
Why This Role:
The successful candidate will report directly to our Head of Infrastructure Practice. The Backup & Disaster Recovery Consultant will have solid technical capability, excellent verbal and written skills and a high focus on the quality of work.
Expectations From The
Role:
Installation, configuration and maintenance of backup & disaster recovery systems
Installation, configuration and maintenance of servers & storage area network
Integration of server infrastructure into SAN
Installation, configuration and maintenance of hypervisor platforms (VMware, Nutanix, HPE VME, OpenShift)
Installation, configuration and maintenance of Linux servers and associated services (RHEL, Ubuntu).
Proactive monitoring of infrastructure and identifying potential problems (bottlenecks, misconfigurations).
Compiling and producing technical documentation for all infrastructure layers.
Requirements For A
Successful Application:
More than 3 years of work experience in similar jobs
Proven experience with Windows and Linux based scripting (PowerShell, bash, Ansible, Terraform, Python)
Experience in working with automation, DevOps or containerization tools
Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Nutanix, HPE VME, OpenShift (Desirable)
Working experience with Linux CentOS (Rocky), RedHat, Ubuntu (Desirable)
Proven experience with Dell server, HPE Server or other relevant vendor servers.
Experience with TCP/IP Networking
Systematism and precision in work.
Proactive approach and providing solutions
Relevant vendor certification (VCP, NCP, RHSCA, VMCE, etc) (Desirable)
Organizational and mentoring skills
Others:
About eir
Our purpose is to connect for a better Ireland.
Our ambition is to be the number one choice for telecommunications and technology solutions, delivering for our customers today and into the future.
Our new values and behaviours reflect both who we are and who we strive to become.  They are the way that we bring our purpose to life in eir.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.
If successful in the interview process, eir reserves the right to conduct appropriate suitability checks in relation to prospective employees including but not limited to reference checking and/or other searches using publicly available information.
Apply Now!

title: National KAM Role
description:
Salary Range: 
€54,096.00 - €100,464.00 
 
 Job Description Summary 
Are you passionate about improving patient outcomes and building trusted partnerships across healthcare systems? As a National Key Account Manager, you will play a critical role in driving the commercial success of Novartis' priority brands across Immunology, Neuroscience, and Cardiovascular therapeutic areas.

In this field-based role, you will engage strategically with key healthcare stakeholders, deliver impactful customer experiences, generate insights, and execute brand strategies that create value for patients, healthcare professionals, and healthcare organizations. You will work collaboratively across multiple functions while ensuring the highest standards of ethics, compliance, and customer focus. 
 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities Lead the national execution of commercial strategies for priority products across the Immunology, Neuroscience, and Cardiovascular therapeutic areas.
 Deliver high-quality, compliant customer engagements aligned with brand objectives and therapeutic area strategies.
 Build and maintain trusted partnerships with healthcare professionals, key decision-makers, and relevant stakeholders through meaningful scientific and commercial discussions.
 Communicate clinical evidence and product value propositions to support appropriate product use and improved patient outcomes.
 Implement the Novartis International Commercial Excellence (ICE) framework, including account planning, customer targeting, segmentation, and engagement planning.
 Leverage digital tools and data-driven insights, including Next Best Action recommendations, to optimize customer interactions and business impact.
 Gather and analyze customer, market, and competitive insights, translating findings into actionable opportunities and strategic recommendations.
 Participate in local meetings, educational activities, and promotional events in accordance with governance and compliance requirements.
 Collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners across Marketing, Medical Affairs, Value & Access, and Execution Excellence teams to deliver integrated customer solutions.
 Operate in full compliance with Novartis policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards.

 What You'll Bring Essential Requirements
 Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Business, or a related field.
 Proven experience in pharmaceutical sales, key account management, or commercial roles within healthcare.
 Strong understanding of customer engagement principles and account management methodologies.
 Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and build long-term professional relationships.
 Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
 Experience working in a cross-functional environment and managing multiple priorities effectively.
 Strong business acumen with the ability to interpret market and customer insights.
 Proficiency in CRM systems and digital engagement tools.
 Willingness to travel nationally as required.

 Desirable Requirements
 Experience within Immunology, Neuroscience, Cardiovascular, or specialty care therapeutic areas.
 Knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and market access principles.
 Experience with omnichannel engagement approaches and data-driven customer planning.

 Why Novartis? Our purpose is to reimagine medicine to improve and extend people's lives. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact on patients around the world.
 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

 Key Success Measures Success in this role will be measured through:
 Achievement of sales objectives and business targets.
 Quality and effectiveness of customer engagement activities.
 Execution excellence across account planning, targeting, and segmentation.
 Delivery against omnichannel engagement and call plan objectives.
 Compliance with reporting, CRM, and governance standards.
 Quality and impact of field insights shared with cross-functional teams.
 Participation in capability-building and field effectiveness programs.
 Adherence to International Commercial Excellence standards and expectations.
 Successful completion of required product and disease area training and assessments.
 
 Benefits & Rewards  
 At Novartis, we’re committed to reimagining medicine together - and rewarding the people who make it happen. 
   
 Expected Annual Base Salary Range for role:  54,096.00 - 77,280.00 - 100,464.00 EUR Annual 
   
 The base salary offered is determined based on gender-neutral objectives, such as relevant skills, competencies and experience in accordance with the Novartis pay setting policy and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. 
   
 In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus depending on certain performance parameters. 
   
 The rewards of being part of our team go far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits in kind to help you thrive personally and professionally, such as insurance plans, retirement plans, wellbeing resources and global recognition programs. In addition, we provide flexible and hybrid working options, where possible, and minimum 14 weeks paid parental leave. 
 You may be eligible for a company vehicle or a car allowance in accordance with the applicable local Novartis policies and guidelines. 
 Pay equity is a fundamental principle of our employment policy and reflects our commitment to create a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment that treats all employees with dignity and respect, as outlined in our Code of Ethics. 
   
 Read our brochure to learn more about our global total rewards offering: 
   
 https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf  
 
 
 Skills Desired 
Commercial Excellence, Conflict Management, Cross-Functional Coordination, Customer Insights, Influencing Skills, Key Account Management, Professional Ethics

title: Vendor Management & Contract/Commercial Governance
description:
About Northern Trust 

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions. 

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide. 

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 Summary 
 Under general supervision, the Commercial Manager is responsible for commercial governance, contract oversight, and financial risk management for Human Resources vendor relationships within a regulated financial services environment. This role partners with HR Centers of Excellence (COEs), Procurement, Legal, Finance, and Risk to ensure commercial terms, pricing structures, and contractual obligations are appropriately managed throughout the vendor lifecycle and aligned with internal governance and Third‑Party Risk Management (TPRM) requirements. 
 The role provides commercial subject‑matter expertise to support informed decision‑making related to vendor selection, negotiations, renewals, amendments, and exits, with a focus on cost saving, value optimization, and risk mitigation. 
 
 Major Duties 
 • Provide commercial oversight for HR vendor contracts, including coordination of negotiations, renewals, amendments, and terminations in partnership with HR COEs, Procurement and Legal. 
 • Ensure commercial terms appropriately address financial, operational, regulatory, and data protection risk, in alignment with TPRM standards and internal policies. 
 • Review and maintain pricing models, fee structures, SLAs, incentives, and contractual remedies to ensure clarity, enforceability, and alignment with business objectives. 
 • Monitor vendor spend, contractual entitlements, and cost drivers, identifying cost optimization opportunities and potential financial risk exposure. 
 • Partner with HR COEs to support renewal strategy, back‑loaded risk assessment, and exit or transition planning for critical vendors. 
 • Provide clear escalation and reporting on commercial risks, issues, and key decision points to senior stakeholders. 
 • Support audits, reviews, and regulatory inquiries by providing commercial documentation, analysis, and risk assessments as required. 
 • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of commercial governance practices, templates, and controls across the HR vendor portfolio. 
 
 Knowledge/Skills 
 · Strong knowledge and experience of commercial contracting, pricing models, and vendor financial management within a regulated environment. 
 · Working knowledge of Third‑Party Risk Management (TPRM) concepts and their intersection with contractual and commercial risk 
 · Ability to interpret and challenge complex contractual language, including financial, operational, and risk‑related provisions. 
 · Strong analytical skills with ability to assess financial exposure, renewal risk, and cost trends. 
 · Proven ability to partner effectively across HR, Legal, Procurement, Finance, Risk, and Compliance. 
 · Strong written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present clear, concise commercial risk assessments to senior management. 
 · High attention to detail, sound judgment, and ability to operate independently in a highly controlled environment. 

 Work Authorization 

 Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland at the time of application and for the duration of employment.

 Please note that Northern Trust is unable to provide employment permit sponsorship for this role. This includes Critical Skills Employment Permits, General Employment Permits, Intra-Company Transfer Employment Permits, Stamp 1G permissions, and other employment permits under Irish immigration frameworks.

 Working with Us 

 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve. 

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities. 

 Reasonable Accommodation 

 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
Key Responsibilities:
- CI/CD Ownership: Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for build, test, and deployment across environments
- Azure Platform Management: Operate and optimize Azure resources (compute, networking, identity) to support scalable and secure services
- Infrastructure as Code: Define and manage infrastructure using IaC (Bicep/ARM/Terraform) for consistent, repeatable deployments
- Automation: Build automation to reduce manual effort and improve deployment reliability and speed
- DevSecOps: Integrate security and compliance controls into pipelines (secrets management, scanning, policy enforcement)
- Platform Enablement: Provide reusable deployment patterns and tooling to enable engineering teams
- Monitoring & Reliability: Implement monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting for pipelines and cloud services
Technical Skills:
- Strong experience with Azure cloud services (compute, networking, identity)
- Experience managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions)
- Proficiency in automation and scripting (PowerShell)
- Experience with C# Dotnet and Node.JS
- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, ARM, Terraform)
- Understanding of cloud networking and security fundamentals
- Experience working within Microsoft internal ecosystem (EV2, OneCert, etc.)
- Familiarity with DevSecOps practices (security scanning, secrets management)
- Prior experience supporting large-scale enterprise pipelines/platforms
Mandatory Skills: Enterprise Platform Devops Tools .
Experience: 5-8 Years .

description:
Job Description: 
 Role: IT CSD Support Associate

 Brief Summary: 
 The IT CSD Support Associate primarily answers hotline calls and responses to IT Incidents and Service Request Tasks from our end-user clients in EMEA and LATAM region.

 Please note the role will require hybrid attendance in the Dublin office (3 days a week) .

 CSD Vision:
 To deliver best in class employee workplace and collaboration experience, enriched by World Class support services and cloud solutions to boost SAP employee’s productivity. 

 CSD Mission: 
 Our workplace offers simple ways of working and collaborating for SAP employees and customers. Employee productivity is augmented by world-class support and high satisfaction. We provide vital IES solutions, rock-solid operations 7x24. 

 Expectations and Tasks 
 • Call handling for inbound IT support hotline.
 • Fully qualify and process all incoming IT support tickets in adherence to the agreed service, quality, and client satisfaction levels
 • Apply solutions, workarounds, patches and fixes as defined in our Knowledge Base.
 • Effective dispatch to the correct organization and resolver group.
 • Ensure compliance with all security and data protection standards, policies and processes.

 SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES 
 • 3rd Level Qualification – Cert, Diploma, Degree in IT related discipline 
 • ITIL process knowledge would be a benefit. 
 • Customer Focus 
 • Quality 
 • Teamwork 
 • Problem Solving 
 • Multitasking 
 • Flexibility to change shift to best ensure coverage for Agents.
 • Availability for working on Public Holidays, expectation is half will be worked.

 
 At DXC Technology, we believe strong connections and community are key to our success. Our work model prioritizes in-person collaboration while offering flexibility to support wellbeing, productivity, individual work styles, and life circumstances. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

Role Purpose
The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
1. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements

Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally

100% on time MIS & report generation

Job Description:
Senior Cloud Security Engineer
Primary Focus: AWS security, IAM, authorization, cloud security controls, infrastructure security, API security, and implementation of security architecture.
Responsibilities
Implement authentication and authorization capabilities using AWS Cognito, Amazon Verified Permissions, and VPC Lattice.
Implement and maintain API security controls, including schema validation, traffic inspection, WAF configuration, and service-to-service security.
Configure and maintain encryption at rest, encryption in transit, tokenization, and other data protection mechanisms.
Implement secure session management, SSO integrations, and machine-to-machine authentication patterns.
Support privileged access management and centralized authorization frameworks.
Implement logging, audit controls, telemetry protection, and immutable audit storage requirements.
Support vulnerability management, cloud security posture improvements, and compliance initiatives.
Work closely with application and platform teams to ensure security controls are consistently implemented.

Authorization Models (RBAC, ABAC, Policy-Based Access Control)
Encryption and Key Management

title: Legal Analyst
description:
About Us 
 At Fenergo, we’re not just building software - we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game. 
 We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management - we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries. 
 But we don’t stop there. 
 At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant - they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations - it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world.  
 Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. 
 Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future - together. 
 
 Who are you?  
 You are a high-achieving, recent Law graduate keen to launch a stellar career as a commercial lawyer. But, right now, your plans may be on hold because you are waiting to finish FE-1s or secure a traineeship. You wish there was a place where you could work now to put your degree to use and get real legal and business experience.  
 
 Why should you join us?  
 If that’s who you are, and you are hard-working, diligent, self-motivating and enjoy being part of an organisation with exciting revenue growth plans, we would like to speak to you. Fenergo is shaping the future of our industry, and you will be afforded an opportunity to significantly impact the revenue growth of a major target market for the company. 
 
 What you will do?  
 As a Fenergo Legal Analyst, you will be a member of our Legal Department reporting directly to our Head of Legal (Sales & Commercial). With training and oversight by our experienced team of lawyers, you will facilitate sales of Fenergo’s technology products to our customers. Many of whom are global financial institutions – names you will know! You will help review contracts, prepare for negotiations with our customers’ legal and procurement teams, and assist with advice to Fenergo’s business leaders. You will also have opportunities to learn how our business operates by liaising with Fenergo’s commercial, technical and financial teams.  
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Assist in all aspects of commercial contract review.
 Prepare for contract negotiations with customers by drafting responses to customer legal and commercial requests.
 Review customer relationship documents and other information to help provide strategic advice to Fenergo business leaders.
 Assist generally with the operations of the Fenergo Legal Department.
 Requirements 
 Key Expectations: 
 High-achieving Law graduate.
 Keen interest in commercial law.
 Intellectually curious.
 Dogged determination to learn.
 Superior attention to detail.
 Excellent writing skills.
 Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues to achieve common goals.
 Benefits 
 What’s In It For You? 
 Healthcare cover  
 Pension
 Employee Assistance Programme   
 Opportunity to earn an annual company bonus   
 23 days annual leave
 3 company closure days  
 Extensive training programs, classroom and online, through ‘Fenergo University’  
 Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work from home policy, sports and social committee and much more  
 Buddy system for all new starters  
 Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest of tools and technologies.  
 Defined training and role tracking to allow you see and assess your own career development and progress.   
 Work From Home set-up allowance   
  
 Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity  
 Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

title: RETAIL ASSISTANT
description:
Because you make the difference 
 Here at Primark, we love to do things our way. Because we help our customers keep up with high fashion at affordable prices. We do everything with passion, high standards and care around here. And if that sounds like you, join us as a Retail Assistant.
 Band A need to be available two evenings and fully flexible on weekends - 11.5 hrs-14 hrs per week 

 Because you matter 
 People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:
 Salary: we offer a competitive salary €14.65 per hour plus premium Sunday rate
 Balance: Enjoy flexibility with accommodating shifts
 Pension: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme
 Discounts: Use your in-store employee discount across our fabulous range
 Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and employee assistance programme.
 Holiday: Enjoy generous holidays, based on your hours
 Opportunity to progress your career internationally

title: Guinness Open Gate Brewery Ambassador
description:
Job Description : 
 Guinness Brewery Ambassador Location: Guinness Open Gate Brewery 
 Permanent, full-time 
 
 Closing date: 2nd September 2026 
 
 
 About us With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
 Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.
 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
 
 About the Team You’ll join a passionate team at the Home of Guinness, working across the Storehouse and St James’s Gate Brewery. Together, we share our expertise and passion for beer with visitors, trade partners and the wider beer community, creating memorable connections with Guinness.
 
 About the Role As Guinness Brewery Ambassador, you’ll become a recognised face of the brewery, bringing our beers, brewing heritage and culture to life. Through tours, tastings, training, events and trade engagement, you’ll inspire everyone from first-time visitors to bartenders, industry partners and beer enthusiasts.
 Role Responsibilities Deliver engaging tours of the Guinness Storehouse and St James’s Gate Brewery for visitors, trade guests and VIPs.

 Host beer tastings and training sessions that bring the St James’s Gate Brewery portfolio to life.

 Act as a senior ambassador and mentor, leading from the front and supporting the wider team.

 Build strong relationships with sales, marketing and trade teams, becoming a trusted source of beer and Guinness expertise.

 Represent Guinness through events, PR and media opportunities where required.

 Engage directly with visitors and the wider beer community, creating genuine connections and memorable experiences.

 This is an opportunity to deepen your beer expertise, build your profile within the industry and represent one of the world’s most iconic beer brands to consumers and trade partners in Ireland and internationally.
 
 Experience / Skills Required We’d love to work with you if you have:
 Strong beer expertise, including knowledge of beer styles, brewing processes, serving, quality and industry trends.

 Experience within the beer industry and a genuine passion for Guinness, beer and Irish beer culture.

 Excellent presentation and storytelling skills, with the confidence to engage and captivate audiences of different sizes and backgrounds.

 The ability to work independently, take ownership and manage multiple priorities while also collaborating effectively as part of a team.

 A relevant beer qualification, such as Cicerone Certified Server, or equivalent industry knowledge and experience.

 

 You’ll need flexibility to work evenings and weekends. As this is a national role primarily based in Dublin, some national and occasional international travel may also be required.
 Flexible Working Statement Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
 
 Rewards & Benefits Statement We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
 competitive salary

 annual bonus

 lunch allowance

 pension scheme, sharepurchase scheme

 product allowance and many more

 Diversity Statement Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.
 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.
 Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
 
 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity. 
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.
 
 Recruitment Scam Warning Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com . In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

 Regular 
 Primary Location: 
 Storehouse 
 Additional Locations :

 2026-08-24

title: Food Technologist
description:
Kepak is a leading food company operating across Ireland and the UK, employing over 4,500 people across its Foods, Meat UK, and Meat Ireland divisions. Guided by our values of Responsibility, Ambition, Passion for Food, and Teamwork, we supply fresh and value-added meat products to retail and foodservice customers through private label partnerships and our well-known brands, including Rustlers, Big Al’s, and John Stone. 
 Within our Foods Division, over 1,000 colleagues across five manufacturing sites are driving our ambition to build a transformed, future-ready, profitable €0.5bn food business by 2030, serving customers across the UK, Ireland, and selected European markets. 
 
 Are you a detail-oriented Food Technologist with a passion for product quality, compliance, and innovation? We're looking for a Food Technologist to join our team. This is a hybrid role which will be 2 days in our site in Kirkham, 1 day in our York site and 2 days from home.
 
 Reporting to the Senior Food Technologist, you will play a key role in managing artwork, packaging specifications, customer requirements, supplier documentation, and technical compliance activities. You will ensure that product information, pack copy, specifications, and technical documentation are accurate, compliant, and maintained to meet customer, legal, and business requirements.
 
 This is an exciting opportunity to work cross-functionally with internal teams and external stakeholders, supporting product launches, audits, food safety systems, and continuous improvement initiatives. You'll also take ownership of customer portal management, ensuring key stakeholders remain informed of any updates or changes.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Product Quality 
 Create, maintain, and verify pack copy information for products manufactured on site.
 Review and approve raw material specifications to ensure compliance with customer, technical, and regulatory requirements.
 
 Planning & Delivery 
 Complete supplier questionnaires (SAQs), customer queries, and technical documentation within agreed timescales.
 Coordinate technical activities to support product launches and artwork approval processes.
 
 Operational Excellence 
 Take ownership of packaging specification management and associated technical documentation.
 Generate and maintain product and packaging codes, including DB, SE, NWF, PK, and other business coding systems as required.
 
 Food Safety & Compliance 
 Support food safety and legal compliance by ensuring specifications and technical information remain current and accurate.
 Manage the artwork approval process, ensuring packaging and labelling comply with all relevant legal, regulatory, and customer requirements across key markets.
 
 Customer Focus 
 Communicate customer requirements effectively across the site and monitor ongoing compliance.
 Respond to technical customer queries and requests in a timely and professional manner.
 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration 
 Work closely with Marketing, NPD, Operations, Procurement, and Technical teams to deliver business objectives and successful product launches.
 Requirements 
 Degree in food science, nutrition or relevant 
 1+ year experience in Quality, Technical, or Labelling within the Food Industry and ready to take next step 
 Have knowledge of of HACCP principles and understand the importance of Critical Control Points (CCPs) and associated monitoring activities.
 Knowledge of legislation, customer standards, food safety requirements and technical systems relevant to the role.
 Able to work to high standards in a fast-paced environment
 
 
 Ready to take the next step in your food technology career? We'd love to hear from you. 
 Benefits 
 What can we offer you? 
 Company Pension 
 Further Education support 
 Dedicated L&D Team 
 Bike to Work Scheme - You can buy a bike and safety equipment through a salary sacrifice scheme which reduces your taxable income – meaning you pay less tax!
 Long Service Awards - We recognise, acknowledge and award the dedication and valuable contribution of long serving employees
 BUPA Cash plan free of charge

title: Red Team Engineer
description:
As a member of the Red Team within the Global Cyber Security group, the Red Team Engineer will serve as a core technical contributor for adversary‑emulation, threat‑informed security testing, and controlled offensive security operations. The engineer will execute activities in accordance with State Street’s standards and procedures, risk‑acceptance, and regulatory expectations, ensuring all work is conducted within approved environments, scopes, and authorization pathways.
 
 The Red Team Engineer will conduct comprehensive, intelligence‑driven assessments of enterprise applications, critical infrastructure components, and associated operational and technical security controls. These assessments evaluate not only the security posture of targeted systems but also the effectiveness of the organization’s detection, prevention, response, and governance capabilities.
 
 The Red Team Engineer will collaborate with technical experts across applications, platforms, and infrastructure, security leadership, and process stakeholders, threat intelligence and defensive analytics teams, security operations personnel, and business system owners to ensure testing scenarios reflect realistic adversary behaviors and enterprise risks. The role requires strong technical expertise and broad knowledge of core security control domains, including identity and access management, data protection, secure software development, cloud and infrastructure security, endpoint and detection technologies, network security, and enterprise vulnerability and threat management. Familiarity with security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident response processes further supports the evaluation of organizational defenses.
 
 What you will be responsible for
 Execute authorized adversary‑emulation activities to assess defenses, security controls, and organizational resilience.
 Perform targeted security assessments across applications, infrastructure, cloud platforms, and enterprise technologies.
 Collaborate with cybersecurity, technology, and risk stakeholders to develop realistic, threat‑informed testing scenarios.
 Evaluate detection and response capabilities and support improvement through coordinated purple‑team activities.
 Operate within defined approval processes, scopes, authorization boundaries, and safe‑testing protocols.
 Develop or adapt tools and techniques to support realistic testing, ensuring secure and compliant usage.
 Produce clear, audit‑ready reporting and support remediation to reduce identified risks and strengthen defenses.
 
 What we value
 Strong proficiency in offensive security techniques, including infrastructure, application, and cloud‑focused penetration testing.
 Deep understanding of adversary behaviors and attack frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK) to inform realistic testing scenarios.
 Familiarity with modern security tooling, assessment utilities, and red‑team‑oriented testing methodologies.
 Ability to develop or adapt scripts and tools using common scripting languages.
 Broad technical knowledge across networks, operating systems, identity systems, cloud services, and security controls.
 Demonstrated analytical ability to identify core issues, interpret risk, and propose practical, evidence‑driven solutions.
 Strong organizational, time‑management, and prioritization skills in dynamic and high‑pressure environments.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
 Commitment to maintaining awareness of emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and offensive security trends.
 High attention to detail and consistent delivery of accurate, high‑quality work.
 Clear and professional communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
 Proven ability to handle sensitive information responsibly and operate with discretion and professionalism.
 
 Experience Desired
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent hands‑on security experience.
 2–4 years in penetration testing or red‑team activities.
 Broad experience with networks, operating systems, cloud, and security controls.
 Familiarity with threat‑informed testing and attack frameworks.
 Experience collaborating with defensive teams to validate detections.
 Ability to script or automate tasks using common languages.
 Strong reporting and communication skills across technical audiences.
 
 About State Street 
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
 
 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
 
 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

Job Title: SWIFT Messaging & Payments Support Engineer

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SWIFT Messaging & Payments Support Engineer with strong expertise in SWIFT payments, messaging gateways, Unix environments, and production support. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SWIFT connectivity applications, SWIFT message flows, payment journey concepts, and Linux/Unix-based environments. Support and manage SWIFT payment processing applications and messaging infrastructure.
Handle SWIFT message types, payment lifecycle management, and transaction troubleshooting.
Work on SWIFT connectivity applications such as SNL (SWIFTNet Link) .
Provide support for SWIFT messaging gateways, preferably GTExchange .
Monitor application and infrastructure health in Unix/RHEL environments.
Analyze logs, troubleshoot incidents, and perform root cause analysis.
Write and execute PL/SQL queries for data validation and issue resolution.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, operations teams, and external vendors.
Prepare technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.
Work within Agile environments using Jira or similar task management tools.
Participate in release deployments, testing, and change management activities.
Mandatory Skills
Strong experience in SWIFT Payments Domain (SWIFT message types and payment journey concepts).
Hands-on experience with SWIFTNet Link (SNL) .
Experience in Unix Shell Scripting .
Expert-level knowledge of Unix Commands .
Experience working in RHEL/Linux environments .
Good understanding of Oracle Database concepts .
Ability to write and analyze PL/SQL queries .
Experience with Jira or other Agile/ALM tools.
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
Experience in creating and maintaining technical documentation.
Mandatory Skills: UNIX SHELL PROGRAMMING .
Experience: 5-8 Years .

Some employers use assessment centres and recruitment assessments to select candidates beyond the application form and interview. They are designed to evaluate how you apply your skills, solve problems, communicate and work with others in situations similar to those you may encounter in the workplace. Assessment centres may take place in person or online and can last anywhere from a few hours to a full day. Assessment centres give employers multiple opportunities to see your skills in action and are often considered a fairer assessment method than an interview alone.
Remember, employers are usually assessing you across a range of activities, so one exercise is unlikely to determine the final outcome.
What Employers Are Looking For
Assessment centres are designed to evaluate a range of skills and competencies, including:
Communication
Teamwork
Problem-solving
Leadership potential
Decision-making
Analytical thinking
Organisation and time management
Commercial awareness
Adaptability and resilience
Employers are not looking for perfection. They want to see how you approach challenges, interact with others and demonstrate your potential.
Remember
You are usually being assessed against the employer's criteria, not against the other candidates. Focus on demonstrating your own skills and making a positive contribution.
Types of Activities
A typical assessment centre may include Introductions, group exercises, case studies, presentations, recruitment tests and interviews. The format varies between employers.
Group Exercises
Work with other candidates to solve a problem, discuss a case study or complete a task. Employers are assessing how you communicate, collaborate and contribute to achieving a shared objective.
Case Studies
You may be asked to analyse information, identify key issues and make recommendations. These exercises assess your analytical thinking, judgement and ability to work under pressure.
Presentations
You may be given a topic in advance or asked to prepare a short presentation on the day. Employers are often assessing your communication skills, confidence and ability to organise information clearly.
In-Tray or E-Tray Exercises
These activities simulate a busy workplace and require you to prioritise tasks, respond to emails and make decisions based on available information.
Many assessment centres include a further interview, which may focus on your skills, strengths, motivation and suitability for the role.
Recruitment Tests
Assessment centres often include aptitude, ability or personality tests as part of the overall selection process.
What Are Psychometric Tests?
Psychometric tests are widely used by employers to assess your abilities, behaviours and workplace preferences. They provide employers with additional information about your potential and suitability for a role.
Many graduate employers use psychometric testing as part of their recruitment process, often before an interview or assessment centre.
Aptitude Tests
These measure your ability to process information and solve problems under timed conditions.
Examples include:
Numerical reasoning
Verbal reasoning
Logical reasoning
Diagrammatic reasoning
Abstract reasoning
Data interpretation
Situational Judgement Tests (SJTs)
You are presented with workplace scenarios and asked how you would respond.
These tests assess areas such as:
Decision making
Professional judgement
Customer focus
There may not be one perfect answer. Employers are usually assessing how closely your judgement aligns with their workplace expectations.
Personality Questionnaires
These questionnaires explore your preferred ways of working, interacting and communicating.
There are no right or wrong answers.
Top tip: Answer honestly. Trying to guess the 'correct' response often creates inconsistent results.
Practice Resources
Many employers will share links to practice tests and assessment tools with you in advance, so make sure you use them. You can also use free practice assessments tools and tests on our Profiling for Success platform.
Preparation & Success Tips
Know your application, the role and the organisation.
Practise tests and assessment exercises.
Be professional, positive and authentic.
Listen, contribute and support others.
Manage your time and stay focused.
If one exercise does not go well, move on and focus on the next.
Assessment centres evaluate your skills across multiple activities, not just one task.

Duration  : 2.5 hours
Course Trainer :  Hilt
Target Participant :  Professional Management Support Managers / Academic Staff
Course Objectives:
To give participants an opportunity to prepare for interviews, anticipate the questions and improve their interview question answering technique.  This is an interactive workshop where partiicpants will get a chance to plan, construct and practise answering a range of competency questions and traditional interview questions.
Course Content:
What is a competency based interview and why are they used?
Identifying and examining the competencies required for the roles under review.
How to ensure your answers on the competency based application form are providing reviewers with the evidence they need.
What are the elements of a "good" example when answering a competency question?
Utilising the STARR method to structure interviw answers.
How do interviewers score interview candidates?
How to prepare for the presentaton section of the interview.
First Impressions - how they are formed and how you can ensure yours is a positive one.
Techniques to help you perform at your best - reducing interview nerves and avoiding "blanking"
In-workshop practice and feedback on how to prepare and delvier andswers to competency questions.
How to approach the typical open questions, e.g. "Tell me About Yourself" "Talk me through your application/ career to date" and "Is there anything else you would like to add"

 Lead supplier engagement related to barcode readiness, including kickoff meetings and implementation tracking.
