description:
The Role 
 The Risk Trader will be responsible for the trading and risk management of all our horse & greyhound racing content for all Flutter UK&I facing brands. The successful candidate will also be tasked with providing an industry leading antepost, specials and extra market offering for our greyhound racing product. They will be responsible for the horse racing risk management tasks and the day to day running of the greyhound desk. 
 What you will be doing : 
 Risk Management 
 To effectively analyse bet information to drive pricing accuracy 
 
 To relay risk information in real time to the horse racing traders 
 
 You will also be required to conduct retrospective risk reports and post trading analysis 
 
 Customer Management 
 To effectively manage our customer base and tailor the product offering to the needs of our customers 
 
 You will be required to manage customer level risk and liabilities including bet clearance 
 
 Greyhound Proposition 
 To price all domestic UK&I greyhound races daily and ensure we have a compelling proposition in the marketplace for all our brands 
 
 To offer industry leading specials and extra markets to drive customer engagement 
 
 To keep up to date on antepost competitions and industry developments   
 
 Effective Communication 
 To work within the high paced trading environment and effectively react to and communicate real time risk information  
 
 You will be required work within the wider racing team liaising on risk management decisions and wider racing projects 
 
 Technical Skills 
 Strong Microsoft office user particularly Excel and Powerpoint. 
 
 Excellent presentation skills. 
 
 Strong report-writing skills, with a keen eye for detail. 
 
 What We're Looking For... 
 Skills & Experience Required: 
 Customer focused – thinks about customers 24/7 
 
 Effective collaborator – works with others within the team and the wider organisation, whilst communicating effectively across a range of channels and audiences 
 
 Ability to work at pace and on own initiative 
 
 Makes quality decisions – makes confident decisions under pressure, which fundamentally drive results and high levels of customer satisfaction. 
 
 Highest levels of integrity 
 
 Drives results 
 
 About PaddyPower 
 Work that makes play jealous 
 Paddy Power has been breaking and re-writing the rules since 1988, from on-track bookmakers to cheeky upstart mischief-makers, to part of the largest betting and gaming technology company in the world. 
 Although we’ve grown to the betting behemoth we are today, we’ve not forgotten our roots. We continue to offer great value and entertainment to our customers and keep them at the heart of what we do.

 We’ve got a growing squad of specialists, and we make the work fun. Sound good? Maybe there’s a spot on the team for you! 
 Plus, PaddyPower is part of the Flutter UK & Ireland family – a collection of big-hitting entertainment brands such as Betfair, Sky Betting & Gaming and Tombola. 
 What we’ll offer you 
 £1,000 learning fund 
 
 Unlimited holiday 
 
 Twice-yearly bonus (with part of it guaranteed!) 
 
 Pension contribution scheme 
 
 Private healthcare 
 
 Flexible ways of working – home or office, it’s your choice! 
 
 Access to thousands of Udemy courses 
 
 Invest via the Company Sharesave Scheme 
 
 16 hours paid volunteering time per year 
 
 We’re working to be an inclusive employer, and we encourage people from all backgrounds, ways of thinking and working to apply. Everyone brings different perspectives and experiences; you don't have to meet all the requirements listed to apply for this role. 
 If you need any adjustments to make this role work for you let us know, and we’ll see how we can accommodate them.

Coverage

View Original Article
Jobs Watch: Tech roles in Eire with Merchant Warehouse and Squarespace
Two technology firms – payment technology and merchant services provider Merchant Warehouse, and online publishing platform Squarespace – are to take on staff in their new international offices in Northern Ireland and the Irish Republic respectively.
Merchant Warehouse
A total of 70 staff in various development and support roles will be hired in the company’s new Belfast office over the next three years.
The US company’s other base is its Boston headquarters.
The base, known as Merchant Warehouse NI [Northern Ireland], was established with the help of investment agency Invest Northern Ireland.
Squarespace
All-in-one website publishing platform Squarespace is to create EMEA headquarters in Dublin with the creation of 100 jobs.
The new roles will be a variety of customer care jobs.
Supported by Irish government agency IDA Ireland, this is also Squarespace’s first office in addition to its headquarters, which are in New York.
Irish Taoiseach [prime minister] Enda Kenny says the move “is a signal of Ireland's growing reputation as the internet capital of Europe”.

About the role
In this role, you will support the delivery of resilient and secure services by maintaining and supporting the customer’s secure global data network. Working as part of a small team of multi skilled specialists, you will help ensure the availability, performance, and resilience of a high profile secure service underpinning critical operations.
Through proactive operational management and effective issue resolution, you will contribute to the stability and protection of key systems, reinforcing customer confidence and BT’s position as a trusted partner.
The successful candidate will need to be eligible for Government Security Clearance to DV Level and must be in possession of a British passport only (dual passports holders will be ineligible for this level of clearance).
What you’ll be doing
•    Resolve technical and service issues across a complex global IP network, coordinating with internal teams and ensuring clear communication throughout.
•    Produce accurate, timely operational and performance reporting to support service availability targets.
•    Provide 2nd line incident support, including fault prioritisation, diagnostics, and escalation of complex issues to operational management.
•    Maintain strong working relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders while ensuring compliance with security, regulatory, and safety policies.
•    Deliver Service Operations activities, ensuring 24/7 coverage on a shift rotation basis and aligning services to customer requirements.
•    Support tactical improvements by contributing to process enhancements, proactively learning new network technologies, and assisting in refining support systems and procedures.
•    Maintain accurate operational, contractual, and security documentation to support effective service delivery and compliance.
Essential Skills / Experience
•    Technical proficiency at CCNA level or equivalent with experience in the configuration and operation of Cisco routers.
•    Experience with DDI platforms (DNS, DHCP, IPAM), Palo Alto and Nokia firewall technologies.
•    Experience with WAN optimisation technologies and devices.
Desirable Skills / Experience
•    Excellent understanding of IP data networks, including WAN technologies, protocols, and firewall principles.
•    Good experience working with cryptographic network devices.
•    Ability to manage workload independently and deliver against agreed targets.
•    Good working knowledge of the ITIL framework.
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
•    10% on target annual bonus
•    Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
•    Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
•    Equalised maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
•    Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
•    Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
•    Holiday purchase scheme
•    You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready
Working Pattern
Fully on-site role with no home working, following a 24x7 shift pattern.

Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

Jobs | How to apply for jobs in DCU
Step-by-step instructions on how to apply for jobs in DCU.
Using DCU's Jobs portal is very straightforward. However, should you encounter any issues, these steps will help.
Click either the External applications or Internal applications tab for instructions.
External applications
Internal applications
How do apply as an External applicant:
Search and view university jobs using the  job search engine
Narrow your search by Vacancy Type or Job Reference Code. To view all jobs, simply click  Search without setting any criteria.
To apply for a specific job, click  Apply on the Current Job Vacancies page and follow the on-screen instructions. This opens our online applicant portal.
If you haven't applied online for a DCU job before, you’ll need to register. Otherwise, log in to your existing account.
Complete the online application form. Fields you must complete are marked with an asterisk (*).
You can save your application and return to complete it later by clicking  Save for Later on the Application Checklist page.
To continue with your application, log back in and click on  My Applications on the left-hand menu.
Check your application thoroughly before you submit it. Once you submit your application, you can’t edit it. You’ll get an email acknowledging your submission.
How do apply as an Internal applicant:
Select Internal Vacancies on the Jobs page
Log in to your Core HR
If you have multiple dashboards, select Employee Dashboard at the top of the screen
Select Vacancies on the left hand menu
You can search for the particular vacancy using the reference number of the position or a keyword
To apply, click the three dots to the right of the Vacancy and select Apply for Position

title: Brewing Technician
description:
Job Description : 
 Brewing  Technician   

 Littleconnell   Brewery,   Co.Kildare   

 Permanent Contract   

 Closing 14/09/2026   

   

 Brewing   Technician -   From €58,500 including shift allowance plus competitive benefits package with pension, shares scheme and bonus.   
 

 About us   

 With over 200 brands sold in   nearly 180   countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray,   Smirnoff   and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.   
 

 Bring your talent,   curiosity   and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge,   support   and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning,   improving   and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.   
 

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more! 
 

 Join our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team.   

 Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.    With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production,   logistics ,   engineering   and supplier partnerships.    
 

 It’s   fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality,   efficiency   and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands,   you’ll   play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.   
 

 A forward-thinking €200 million investment   has brought   an innovative, carbon-neutral brewery to life in Newbridge, Co. Kildare ,   set to open in 2026. This best-in-class facility will be Ireland’s second-largest brewing operation and a powerhouse of sustainability, running entirely on renewable energy.   It’s   where iconic beers like   Rockshore , Harp, Smithwick’s, and Kilkenny will be crafted for a new generation.   
 
 

 About the Role    
 

 As a Brewing Technician you will  safely   operate ,   monitor   and   maintain   end-to-end brewing operations from raw material intake through brewing, fermentation,   filtration   and tanker dispatch, delivering beer safely, to specification and to production plan.   
 

 The role owns process execution, product quality, equipment basic   condition   and   accurate   operational data, using   Zaptic   for digital work management and   ManEx   for performance management and continuous improvement.   
 

 Key Responsibilities   

 Safely   operate   brewing processes and equipment   in accordance with   SOPs, recipes, production plans and site Safety, Quality, Food Safety and Environmental standards.   

 
 Operate across raw material handling, brewhouse, fermentation/maturation, filtration, bright   beer   and tanker filling within   demonstrated   competence.   

 
 Monitor process and quality parameters, respond to   deviations   and escalate abnormalities appropriately.   

 
 Execute CIP, sanitation, Autonomous Maintenance and 5S, taking ownership of equipment condition and performance.   

 
 Maintain   accurate   process, quality and traceability records using   Brewmaxx , Orbis, Harford,   Zaptic   and other site systems.   

 
 Coordinate operational activities, including product transfers and tanker loading/dispatch, to   maintain   safe and efficient product flow.   

 
 Participate in shift handovers, daily performance   reviews   and   ManEx   routines, ensuring clear communication and effective follow-up.   

 
 Identify   and   eliminate   losses through structured problem-solving and continuous improvement activities covering yield, quality, time, energy,   materials   and equipment performance.   

 
 Support trials, process changes, new product   introductions   and improvement projects.   

 
 Develop cross-functional capability, share   knowledge   and work collaboratively with Operations, Quality, Maintenance, Utilities and Logistics.   

 
   

 About you     
 

 We're   looking for a motivated and proactive individual with experience in brewing, food & beverage, dairy, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, chemical, utilities, or other automated process manufacturing environments.   You'll   be passionate about operational excellence, safety, and continuous improvement, with the drive to take ownership, solve problems, and contribute to a high-performing team. While experience is valuable, your ability to learn, adapt, and make a positive impact is what will set you apart.   
 

 What   you'll   bring:   

 Experience working within a manufacturing or process environment, ideally in brewing, food & beverage, dairy, pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, chemical, utilities, or other highly automated industries.   

 
 Strong troubleshooting, diagnostic, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to   identify   root causes and implement effective solutions.   

 
 A good understanding of process operations, equipment performance, and continuous improvement principles.   

 
 Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across production, engineering, and support functions.   

 
 A proactive approach to safety, quality, environmental compliance, and operational excellence.   

 
 Confidence using digital manufacturing and maintenance systems, with the ability to interpret data and use insights to improve performance.   

 
 A growth mindset with a passion for learning, developing new skills, and supporting the development of others.   

 
 The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-performance environment while delivering agreed   objectives   and driving sustainable results.   

 
   

 Working with us   
 

 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And   it’s   our people, with their different experiences,   perspectives   and talents, who make that possible.   
 

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong,   contribute   and strive for their personal best.   You’ll   work alongside people with   different backgrounds ,   experiences   and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.   
 

 Together,   we’re   constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us,   you’ll   have the opportunity to contribute, make an   impact   and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.   
 

 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity!   
 

 I f you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you   submit   your application.     
 

 Recruitment Scam Warning   

 Protecting candidates is   very important   to us. All communications   regarding   your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process,   we'll   never ask for money

description:
You will have the opportunity to shape, mold, and impact how fast we grow, the way we’re viewed, and the candidate experience. We are looking to hire a Recruiter who will be responsible for finding the best talent; you will be the face of recruiting at Datadog! You will be the first point of contact for new candidates in the hiring process, playing a critical role in identifying great candidates, telling the Datadog story and ultimately turning great candidates into great employees.  

 

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our 

 

What You’ll Do:  

  • Find qualified talent for our open roles via sourcing, job posts, referrals, and agencies
  • Screen candidates to ensure their qualifications match the open roles
  • Collaborate with leadership to design or streamline interview processes 
  • Ensure follow up and closure for all interviewed candidates
  • Negotiate compensation with qualified candidates
  • Enhance our recruitment process through training interview teams
  • Leverage Greenhouse to track candidate progress through funnel, resurface existing talent, and keep consistently clean data for reporting 
  • Ensure candidates have an excellent interview experience - regardless of outcome

 Who You Are:  

  • Experienced in full-lifecycle recruiting, with 2-5 years either in-house or in a staffing agency environment
  • A sourcing master in your ability to identify where top talent lives
  • Autonomous with a demonstrated ability to work independently and simultaneously on multiple positions
  • Exceptional at selling value proposition, negotiating and closing great candidates 
  • Skilled at operating with a sense of urgency in all stages of the recruiting cycle
  • Able to successfully navigate an ever-changing process

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth: 

  • Generous and competitive benefits package
  • New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan
  • Continuous career development and pathing opportunities 
  • Product training to develop an in-depth understanding of our product and space
  • Best in breed onboarding
  • Internal mentor and buddy program cross-departmentally
  • Friendly and inclusive workplace culture

 

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Equal Opportunity at Datadog:

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference. 

Datadog endeavors to make our Careers Page accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please complete this form. This form is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. 

Privacy and AI Guidelines:

Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog’s Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice. For information on our AI policy, please visit Interviewing at Datadog AI Guidelines.

title: Maintenance Technician
description:
Mylan Teoranta 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach and better access to treatment.   
   
 For those driven to live their lives with purpose, Viatris helps employees realise their full potential by creating a collaborative culture that fosters courage and resilience. Viatris is more than just a place to work. This is a place to make a difference in the world.   
   
 The Role & What You Will Be Doing 
 Responsible for the set up and maintenance of Viatris (Mylan Teoranta) automated vial and syringe filling equipment. Responsible for maintenance and repair of plant equipment and utilities. The position will help Viatris continue along the maintenance maturity continuum to achieve excellence as defined by best industry practices. 
   
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Maintenance Technician role will make an impact: 
 Responsible for Setup, planned maintenance and fault finding of automated Vial and Syringe filling equipment. 

 Responsible for maintenance of equipment and utilities and documenting work to a GMP standard. 

 Manage external contractors when required during equipment installations and planned service visits. 

 Manage spare parts, consumables, and services to keep equipment schedules compliant. 

 Develop, Implement, and promote a Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) strategy using Failure Mode Effects and Criticality Analysis (FMECA/FMEA) assessments in conjunction with department management, the Engineering dept reliability engineer and the Production department utilizing tools such as Trend’s analysis & Control charts & Data review. 

 Support the creation and modification of documentation to support maintenance and calibration activities (PM, Data Sheets, Work Instructions, troubleshooting guides). 

 Support compliance efforts related to Safety Events, Quality Events, CAPAs, change management and investigations and assist in the investigation and resolution of electrical and mechanical issues on equipment. 

 Ensure maintenance routines, procedures, and work plans are developed to the necessary standards and best practice to ensure compliance with cGMP and EHS regulations. 

 Comply with cGMP & EHS requirements from a local, global, and regulatory perspective. 

 You will be required to be flexible in this position and must be prepared to such undertake overtime; shift cover, on call and other works as may be assigned to your role by the company. 

   
 About Your Skills & Experience 
 For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills and experiences: 
 Minimum of a Certification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering and proven relevant experience. However, a combination of experience and education will be taken into consideration.  

 Excellent Interpersonal / Communication skills 

 Conflict management / Negotiation. 

 Structured decision making. 

 Computer literacy (Word, Excel, PM systems). 

 Report preparation & presentation.       

 Ability to manage multiple projects and activities simultaneously. 

 Proven analytical and problem-solving skills. 

 Ability to read and interpret general business documents and to compile Technical reports. 

 Ability to work with peers and communicate. 

 May be required to stand; walk; stoop; bend; kneel; and climb steps.  May require use of hands and use of arms to lift and scoop.  May be required to lift or maneuver boxes or containers using lifting equipment, as well as physically pushing, rolling or lifting.  May be required to wear personal protective equipment including but not limited to: respiratory protection, safety glasses, hearing protection, safety shoes and protective clothing.  Medium, Heavy lifting requirements. 

   
 At Viatris, we are dedicated to building a truly diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t fully align with every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles. 
   
 Benefits at Viatris 
 At Viatris, we offer competitive salaries, benefits and an inclusive environment where you can use your experiences, perspectives and skills to help make an impact on the lives of others. Some of our benefits include the following on top of a competitive salary: 
 Excellent career progression opportunities 

 Work-life balance initiatives 

 Bonus scheme 

 Health insurance 

 Pension 

   
 Diversity & Inclusion at Viatris 
 At Viatris, diversity and inclusion are essential to our mission. The diversity we foster in all aspects of our business can be one of our greatest strengths in redefining healthcare not as it is, but as it should be. If you would like to know more about what diversity, equity and inclusion means to us, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/Careers/Diversity-and-Inclusion 
   
 Sustainability at Viatris 
 Corporate social responsibility is fundamental to the Viatris mission. We work to advance responsible and sustainable operations and leverage our collective expertise to empower people to live healthier at every stage of life, recognizing that our actions affect the stakeholders and communities we serve. To learn more about our efforts, please visit https://www.viatris.com/en/about-us/corporate-responsibility

description:

About This Role:
eir Business is the B2B division of eir and one of Ireland's leading providers of telecommunications, technology, cloud, cybersecurity, managed IT and workplace solutions. Supporting organisations of all sizes, from SMEs to large enterprises and public sector bodies, eir Business delivers secure, end-to-end connectivity and digital transformation services that help customers operate more efficiently, securely and effectively. Leveraging Ireland's largest mobile network, extensive fixed-line infrastructure, cloud capabilities and 24/7 expert support, eir Business partners with customers to design, implement and manage technology solutions that enable innovation, productivity and business growth.
eir business is seeking a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join a team of network and security infrastructure professionals delivering managed network services to a large Irish enterprise client. The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will be responsible for the design, implementation, operation, and ongoing support of enterprise networking and cloud security components in a hybrid environment including Azure with a strong focus on Check Point and Cisco technologies.
Why This Role:
The role supports business-critical services, ensuring high availability, security compliance, and operational excellence. You will act as an SME, engaging with engineers, management, and customer stakeholders to define solution approaches, agree maintenance objectives, introduce new capabilities, initiate technical improvements, and drive issue resolution.
This is a hands-on role covering solution design and delivery, plus the management and operation of critical infrastructure to a high standard. Strong troubleshooting skills are essential.
Hybrid role, based in HSQ Dublin.
Expectations From The
Role:
Design, implement and support secure network and security solutions on-premises and Azure.
Automate Azure infrastructure, network and security deployments using Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC).
Implement API-driven security automation, including management of Check Point CloudGuard policies and configurations.
Support Cisco networking and security technologies, including routing and switching, BGP, IPSec VPNs, Firepower and ACI, providing proactive monitoring, troubleshooting, capacity planning and service improvement.
Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud and security teams to deliver resilient and secure cloud solutions.
Monitor, troubleshoot and continuously improve cloud network and security services.
Support security reviews, incident response activities and compliance requirements.
Perform planned changes, upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management of network and security platforms.
Manage infrastructure reliability, ensuring availability, performance, resilience, and compliance with agreed SLAs.
Prepare and deliver customer-facing security reports, technical briefings covering firewall operations, threat activity, policy compliance, risk exposure, and remediation recommendations.
Requirements For A
Successful Application:
•Proven experience designing and operating networking and security in on-premise and Azure cloud infrastructure.
Strong understanding of Azure networking and security services, build out of Check Point Security and ExpressRoute with a knowledge of VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Load Balancing and network segmentation.
Hands-on experience with Terraform, Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation of cloud network and security services.
Experience with API-driven integrations and security automation, including Check Point CloudGuard or similar cloud security platforms.
Strong experience with Cisco networking and security technologies, including routing and switching, BGP, IPSec, packet capture and advanced network troubleshooting.
Experience supporting and managing Cisco physical and virtual routers, Firepower Management Centre (FMC) and Firepower Threat Defence (FTD) platforms.
Knowledge of Cisco ACI, including routing, switching and L3Out connectivity.
Experience with firewall management, monitoring, troubleshooting, capacity planning and performance optimisation across enterprise environments.
Strong operational experience in large-scale enterprise and multi-site environments, with proven expertise in solution design, deployment, delivery and ongoing operational management.
Excellent interpersonal skill including relationship development skills influencing, and communications skills with the ability to interact effectively with internal stakeholders at all levels within the business and external customer.
A track record of effectively assessing and managing competing priorities.
Highly motivated, strong attention to detail, team oriented, organised
Others:
About eir
Our purpose is to connect for a better Ireland.
Our ambition is to be the number one choice for telecommunications and technology solutions, delivering for our customers today and into the future.
Our new values and behaviours reflect both who we are and who we strive to become.  They are the way that we bring our purpose to life in eir.
We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive work environment. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.
If successful in the interview process, eir reserves the right to conduct appropriate suitability checks in relation to prospective employees including but not limited to reference checking and/or other searches using publicly available information.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
About Wayflyer 
 Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.
 Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.
 You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.
 
 The challenge 
 We've deployed over $6bn to small businesses that traditional banks were too slow, too rigid, or too disinterested to back. Now we're growing fast, and we need a world-class sales team to continue the momentum, finding the founders who need us before they know we exist.
 
 What you'll actually do 
 You'll be the first voice a lot of founders ever hear from Wayflyer. That matters. Your job is to cut through the noise - smart outreach, real conversations, and get the right businesses in front of our Account Executives. You'll qualify funding needs, build genuine rapport with founders, and figure out pretty quickly that the best reps here aren't order-takers. They're curious, they hustle, and they care about getting it right.
 
 What this role could turn into 
 We'll be honest -this isn't a role we're hiring you to stay in forever. It's a launchpad. Most BDRs move into Account Executive or Customer Success roles within 12–18 months, and we plan for it actively through our Revenue Academy - a structured programme that builds the skills, deal exposure, and commercial fluency you need before you ever step into your next seat. Your manager isn't just hitting you with pipeline reviews; they're invested in where you want to go and what it takes to get there.
 We're building careers here, not just filling headcount. The people who thrive with us are the ones who are hungry to grow - and we take it as our responsibility to make sure the path is there when they are.
 
 Who thrives here 
 You've worked in a target-driven environment before and you didn't just survive it, you wanted more. You're the kind of person who reads a rejection email and immediately thinks about what to try differently. You spot problems outside your lane and you can't help yourself. You'll probably end up doing things that aren't in this job description. That's not a warning, it's the point.
 
 We hire for range 
 We care more about trajectory than tenure. Relevant sales experience is important, but what we're really looking for beyond that is someone who's hungry, commercially sharp, and genuinely excited by the challenge. Fluent English is a must. Startup experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
 
 Location and working policy 
 📍 Dublin HQ, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)
 
 The good stuff 
 25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.
 
 By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Wayflyer Limited will process your personal data for the purpose of evaluating your suitability for the role. Such processing is based on the need to take steps prior to entering into a potential employment agreement. To learn more about how we handle your personal data, you can contact our privacy team at  privacy@wayflyer.com  or review our privacy notice at  https://wayflyer.com/privacy-notice .
 
 #LI-JW1

It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
Purpose of the Role
Own full-cycle recruitment delivery for an assigned portfolio of roles, acting as a trusted advisor to hiring managers on role design, sourcing approach, selection methods and process. Drive best-practice execution, pipeline health, and continuous improvement of the recruitment experience.
Key Responsibilities
Run end-to-end hiring for multiple roles concurrently: intake/kick-off, attraction strategy, sourcing, screening, selection support, offer management and handover to onboarding.
Partner with hiring managers to clarify requirements and success profiles; challenge constructively on scope, salary positioning, and assessment approach.
Build and maintain talent pools for priority job families; proactively pipeline for anticipated demand.
Manage agencies and vendors day-to-day (briefing, feedback, performance, shortlisting quality) within agreed commercial frameworks; escalate exceptions.
Provide market intelligence (availability, compensation ranges, competitor activity) to inform hiring decisions and manage expectations.
Track and report core recruitment metrics (time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, source effectiveness) and recommend improvements.
Support employer branding activity (events, content, referral programme) and represent the organisation as a brand ambassador.
Ensure compliance with recruitment policies, data privacy and right-to-work/selection controls in partnership with HR colleagues.
Attributes/Technical Skills
Strong stakeholder management with the ability to influence and set expectations.
Interviewing and assessment capability (screening calls, competency-based interviewing) and confident candidate closing.
Data literacy to interpret recruitment metrics and translate into actions.
Sound understanding of recruitment marketing/sourcing techniques and candidate engagement.
Proactive problem solving and resilience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.
Confident user of ATS/HR systems and MS Office tools; quick to learn new platforms.
Relevant Experience
Typically 3–5 years’ recruitment experience (in-house or agency/RPO), with demonstrable full-cycle delivery and direct sourcing. Professional services/financial services exposure desirable.
Degree and/or relevant TA/HR qualification desirable.
Experience of using an ATS or CRM with knowledge of Phenom and Success Factors a plus.

If you want to grow your career whilst finding the right balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunity to help you belong and make a real impact.
Role Purpose
The Commercial Solicitor will be a key member of the Legal team, providing commercially focused legal advice and support across Vodafone Ireland.
The role will support a broad range of business activities, including strategic customer, supplier and partner relationships, new product development, commercial initiatives and business transformation projects. While the role is expected to have a focus on supporting Vodafone Business activities, the successful candidate will provide legal support across Vodafone Ireland's operations as business needs require.
The Commercial Solicitor will work closely with stakeholders throughout the organisation to support revenue growth, innovation and strategic objectives, whilst ensuring legal and regulatory risks are appropriately managed. The successful candidate will operate as a trusted advisor, providing practical, solution-oriented advice across a broad range of commercial, technology, procurement, privacy and regulatory matters.
The role requires a proactive and commercially minded solicitor who can work independently, build strong stakeholder relationships and contribute to Vodafone's strategic goals through innovative and pragmatic legal support.
What you’ll do
Essence of Role – Key Accountabilities:
As part of the role, you will have the opportunity to make a significant impact across Vodafone Ireland by:
Commercial & Strategic Projects
Providing legal support for strategic commercial initiatives, customer engagements and business transformation projects across Vodafone Ireland.
Advising on the provision of Vodafone's products and services, including mobile, fixed, cloud, connectivity, IoT, managed services, SaaS and emerging digital solutions.
Supporting major customer, supplier and partner opportunities from inception through to contract execution and implementation.
Supporting key business units across Vodafone Ireland, including Vodafone Business, Consumer, Technology, External Affairs and Corporate Functions as required.
Commercial Contracts
Negotiating, drafting and advising on a broad range of commercial agreements, including:
Enterprise customer contracts
Framework agreements
Master Services Agreements
Managed services agreements
Software and technology licences
Procurement agreements
Partnership and collaboration agreements
Non-disclosure agreements and heads of terms
Strategic Customer & Partner Engagements
Acting as legal advisor on strategic customer, supplier and partner relationships.
Supporting commercial teams in achieving business objectives whilst appropriately managing legal and regulatory risk.
Advising on contractual disputes and escalation matters involving customers, suppliers and business partners.
Technology, IP & Innovation
Advising on intellectual property, software, cloud, technology and IT-related legal issues.
Supporting the development and launch of new products and services.
Assisting product owners in the development of customer-facing terms and conditions.
Procurement & Public Sector
Advising on procurement law and practice, particularly in relation to public procurement and public sector tender opportunities.
Supporting the business in responding to RFPs, framework competitions and public sector contracts.
Corporate Governance & Compliance
Ensuring appropriate governance processes are followed for contractual commitments.
Supporting compliance with Vodafone Group policies and governance requirements.
Acting as a trusted legal advisor on risk management and ethical business practices.
Stakeholder Management
Building strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Vodafone Ireland, including:
Vodafone Business
Consumer
Product & Technology
Finance
Procurement
Regulatory
Customer Operations
Risk & Compliance
External Affairs
Human Resources
Working collaboratively with colleagues across Vodafone Group to leverage best practices and support cross-market initiatives.
External Counsel Management
Managing external legal advisers where specialist advice is required.
Ensuring effective budget management and value from external legal spend.
Training & Knowledge Sharing
Delivering legal and compliance training to business stakeholders.
Promoting legal awareness and commercial contracting best practic

 Our Project, Energy and Infrastructure Team consists of highly industry specialized lawyers, recognized among the best for their areas of expertise. The Project, Energy & Infrastructure business unit is part of the Banking & Finance department and becoming a member of such a team will mean being part of a rapidly growing and dynamic group, as well as receiving specific training and being involved in the most innovative legal issues and market prominent transactions. Our clients are medium and large Italian and international companies belonging to different business areas, lenders, funds, investors, IPP and contractors.
 Dentons offers a diverse range of activities in a dynamic work environment, practice-oriented training in an international context and the opportunity to gain 360 degree work experience. Dentons is not only the largest law firm in the world, providing quality and value to clients, but it is also a world-class firm of high profile professionals.
 Dentons is a leader in the Acritas Global Elite Brand Index, winner of the BTI Client Service 30 Award and recognized by leading business and legal publications for its innovations in client service, including the founding of Nextlaw Labs and the Nextlaw Global Referral Network. Dentons' polycentric approach and talents challenge the status quo to promote client interests. We are always looking for the best professionals.

 Global mindset and enthusiasm.
 You are able to adapt to an international environment and eager to grow both professionally and personally with us.

 Competitive rewarding package.

title: Storehouse Assistant
description:
Job Description : 
 Guinness Storehouse Assistant Closing Date: 20th September 2026 
 Position : Full time 
 Salary : €31,824.02, (Flex allowance - 169.58 EUR Monthly 12) 
 
 About Us With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we're the world's leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you'll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.
 Join us to create a career worth celebrating.
 
 About the Function The Guinness Storehouse is Ireland's number one visitor attraction and the Home of Guinness. Located in the heart of St. James's Gate Brewery, we welcome millions of visitors each year through immersive experiences that bring the story of Guinness to life. From the iconic Gravity Bar to our interactive brand experiences, we create memorable moments for guests from around the world.
 
 About the Team Our Visitor Experience Team are passionate brand ambassadors dedicated to delivering world-class customer experiences. We create engaging, memorable and inclusive visitor journeys while bringing the Guinness story to life through exceptional hospitality and service.
 
 About the Role We are seeking experienced Storehouse Assistants to join our Visitor Experience Team. As a Guinness Ambassador, you will play a key role in creating unforgettable visitor experiences by delivering exceptional customer service, hosting interactive experiences, and ensuring every guest receives a warm, professional welcome throughout their visit.
 
 Role Responsibilities Deliver exceptional customer service and create memorable experiences for every visitor.
 Welcome, engage and assist guests in a friendly, professional and approachable manner.
 Guide visitors through Guinness tasting and pouring experiences with confidence and enthusiasm.
 Deliver engaging orientations and host interactive visitor experiences.
 Act as a proud ambassador for Guinness and the Guinness Storehouse brand.
 Maintain high standards of beer quality, responsible alcohol service, health and safety, and operational excellence.
 Work collaboratively as part of a team committed to creating magical moments for every visitor.
 
 This role offers the opportunity to develop your hospitality, public speaking and customer engagement skills in a world-renowned visitor attraction while working alongside a passionate and supportive team.
 
 Experience / Skills Required We'd love to work with you if you have:
 Previous experience delivering exceptional customer service in a hospitality, tourism or bar environment.
 Experience in public speaking, entertaining, presenting or performing.
 Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with diverse audiences.
 Fluent English, with additional languages such as French, Spanish, Italian, German or Chinese considered an advantage.
 A positive, energetic and collaborative approach to work.
 The ability to build positive relationships and contribute to a high-performing team environment.
 
 Working with Us Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.
 We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:
 Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
 Generous holiday allowance
 Lunch allowance
 Product allowance
 
 Diversity Statement Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. Creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued and that they belong is a crucial part of this.
 We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you'll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You'll be part of and help build an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different genders, ethnicities, abilities, ages, sexual orientations, social classes, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.
 
 Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products company in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we continue to build world-class experiences for visitors from around the globe.
 
 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application. 
 
 Recruitment Scam Warning Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.

 About Guinness Storehouse At Guinness Storehouse, we welcome millions of visitors from around the world each year, sharing the story of Ireland's most iconic brand. 
 We're looking for knowledgeable, passionate, proactive, engaging and assured individuals to join our team as Guinness Experience Specialists.

Through your passion, enthusiasm and expertise, you help create consistently exceptional experiences while contributing positively to the success of the wider team.

 Communicate information confidently, accurately and enthusiastically.

 Share Knowledge and Inspire Others Support the onboarding of new team members through knowledge sharing and practical experience.

 Experience working towards visitor satisfaction, customer service or commercial objectives.

title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
Skip to main content
Open Role
Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
Remote - US: All locations
Remote
Emerging Talent
Full Time
Role Description
Please note: This role will remain open until 10/02/2026. Dropbox currently only offers Summer internships May - September and cannot accommodate off cycle internships at this time. Please inform your recruiter if you have upcoming deadlines for Summer 2027 internships.
As a Software Engineering Intern, you'll work alongside seasoned professionals, diving deep into real-world challenges and pioneering solutions that impact millions. With a focus on the future of collaboration, you'll have the opportunity to work on high-impact projects that define the next chapter of Dropbox. In our Virtual First work culture, you’ll connect with with Dropboxers virtually and in-person to build the foundation of a strong professional network.
As a Summer intern, you will also have the opportunity to attend our Emerging Talent Summit, where participants from our intern and early-career programs come together in person to build lasting relationships, explore learning and development opportunities, and prepare for their career journey ahead.
For Summer 2027, we offer three start dates culminating in a 12-week internship:
May 27 - August 13, 2027
June 22 - September 3, 2027
July 6 - September 24, 2027
Responsibilities
Create Impact: Ship a high-priority project from start to finish, directly contributing to mission-critical software development. Along the way, build AI proficiency by leveraging tools like Copilot to boost productivity and code quality.
Innovative Development: Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and deploy next-gen features for Dropbox's suite of products.
Agile Learning: Immerse yourself in rapid prototyping, iterative development, and harness the power of structured feedback from your host team.
User-Centric Focus: Ensure solutions are designed with the end-user in mind, emphasizing usability and intuitive design.
Tech Exploration: Participate in tech talks, professional development workshops, to explore new technologies and tools.
Team Matching & Mentorship:
Team Matching: You play an active part in the team matching process. Prior to final round technical interviews, we’ll send you a detailed survey to understand your interests and strengths. These criteria as well as current business needs and your location are all factors we consider to match you closely with a host team.
Mentorship: Receive 1:1 mentorship and guidance from your team, a mentor, and a peer mentor. These dedicated industry professionals help you gain insights into the tech world while enabling your success through meaningful work, clear guidance, and a supportive environment.
Continuous Feedback: Receive real time and written actionable feedback and reviews on a regular cadence to help drive your development over the course of the internship.
Here are some examples of the numerous types of roles and teams that you can have an impact on:
Product Engineering - Product Engineers thrive working across technologies and codebases, and are also involved in various product development cycle stages. Along the way they represent users needs through close partnership with product, design, and user research. In this role you will deliver best-in-breed software by building robust systems that power optimized user experiences on marquee projects like Dropbox Paper , Transfer , or Family .
Infrastructure Engineering - The Infrastructure Engineering team designs products for vast scale. We craft components for millions of connections, oversee billions of files, and manage hundreds of petabytes of data. Our rigorous approach addresses edge cases and errors. Through refined code and thorough testing, we prioritize data integrity and security.
Customer Experience (CX) - The CX Technology team enhances our business through innovative technology. You'll convert our service strategy into tools for customers and agents, advancing technical support capabilities. Your role simplifies problem-solving for our team, refines user interaction on our support site, integrates ticketing with internal systems, promotes secure development, and creates self-help tools for users.
Mobile Engineering - Our Mobile team builds products and features that drive the core experience on the Dropbox mobile application. We enable users to easily manage their content, collaborate with their peers and work effortlessly with others. This position will play a key role in building and supporting mobile features.
Security Engineering- People trust Dropbox to keep their data secure, and at Dropbox we rely on our security engineers to make our products safe. You are a software engineer with a deep interest in building software that is secure yet easy to use. Security engineers collaborate with product teams to secure our software, production infrastructure, website, desktop and mobile apps and our corporate infrastructure and devices.
Requirements
Currently pursuing a BS or MS in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), graduating in Fall/Winter 2027 or Spring 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating
Experience writing or shipping software as part of coursework, personal projects, internships, coding competitions or research
Experience coding in programming languages, such as Python, Go, JavaScript, or similar languages
Passion for learning, solving problems, and challenging the status quo
Available for Summer 2027 full-time internship (40 hours per week /12 weeks)
Although this is a virtual internship, interns are expected to work from their designated primary work location throughout the 12-week program. Any request to work from another location, including another country, must be approved in advance and may be restricted based on applicable company, legal, payroll, or security requirements

 Servicing of mechanical, electrical and non-technical equipment.

 Carry out fault finding and repairs to unplanned down equipment, contact and coordinate service engineers where external assistance is required.
 Assist subcontractors as required.

 Assist in the installation of new plant and equipment.
 Maintain appropriate records in line with GMP requirements.
 Maintain a high standard of cleanliness, GMP & EHS adherence, and ensure compliance with the 6S (Sorting, Simplify, Sweep, Standardise, Sustain, Safety) during maintenance work.
 Provide level 1 support of business systems issue resolution.
 Liaise with the IS service desk / Applications Support Team / supervisor and respond to queries in a timely manner to ensure conformance.
 Assist / provide input in the development of hardware and software maintenance and troubleshooting guidelines.

 Ensure any training is completed within the agreed timeframe

 Formal training / certification in any of the above also advantageous

 Strong numerical, investigative & problem solving skills.
 Ability to source materials and generate quotations as required.
 Driven, self-performing contributor, continuously striving for self-improvement.

 Demonstrated flexibility to work in different areas of the business.
 Excellent interpersonal & oral communication skills. Fluent in English.
 Familiarity with EH&S standards and practices.
 Good organisational skills and the ability to maintain accurate records.
 Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
 Strong commitment to Quality, Safety and G.M.P.

 Continuous Improvement and Knowledge Sharing

 Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, Microsoft Security Certifications, TOGAF, CCSP, or equivalent.

title: Software Engineer I
description:
Our Purpose 
 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 
 Title and Summary 
 
Software Engineer I 
Overview: 
Mastercard works to connect and power a sustainable and inclusive global economy. Software engineers at Mastercard build the systems that process transactions, analyze data and detect fraud to gain insight into the direction of the economy on behalf of our customers. We are focused on building simple, safe and smart solutions that instill trust in every interaction. Our industry expertise is enhanced by our commitment to being a force for good in the world and to doing well by doing good. 

Mastercard relies on our global workforce to help us achieve our goal of building a sustainable, inclusive global economy. We cultivate an environment for all employees that respects their strengths, views, and experiences through a global and collaborative culture of inclusion and a sense of belonging. 

Mastercard software engineering teams are obsessed with security, reliability, and performance and driven to deliver solutions that delight our customers. We are looking for talented software engineers to develop advanced technologies and applications that are revolutionizing payments. 

- Are you passionate about software engineering?
- Do you enjoy seeing your code have real-world impact on a wide range of customers and important problems?
- Do you want to join a company that offers a competitive benefits program that attracts and retains the most talented engineers around the world? 
- Do you want to work for a company that offers additional benefits that match our values such as flexible work hours, paid volunteer days, charitable matching, and tuition assistance?
- Do you thrive in a place where you are continuously learning more while growing your skills and career?
- Do you want to join an inclusive culture where employees, in all their diversity, feel valued, respected, and who can bring their authentic selves to work? Learn more at Mastercard’s Corporate Sustainability Report.

Role:
- A hands-on engineer who writes high-quality code with a focus on security, design, and maintainability. 
- Contribute to all phases of software development from design through rollout. 
- Have strong ownership of your team’s software including monitoring, dependencies, build, and deployments.
- Communicate, collaborate and work effectively in a global environment.

About You:
- Currently enrolled in your final year of a bachelor’s or accelerated master’s program
- Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and core computer science concepts.
- Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, C#, Python, etc.
- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong analytical and excellent problem-solving skills. 
 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

 Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

 Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

 Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Due to the sensitive nature of this role, you will be required to undergo DV (Developed Vetting) level Security Clearance ( https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels/national-security-vetting-clearance-levels) . An allowance of £5k per annum may be payable monthly while you hold this DV and continue to work in a role that requires that level of security clearance. The terms of this allowance will be made available if you are successful in being recruited into this role.
Security isn’t always the first thing that comes to mind when you think of BT, but when it comes to keeping everyone safely connected, We Are The Protectors. We deal with thousands of cyber-attacks every day, so that millions of people can safely go about their daily lives and run their businesses.   We deliver vital work at scale, with real breadth and impact. We connect for good.
You'll be joining a specialist security team that is a trusted partner to governments worldwide, protecting critical national infrastructure and committed to the safety and security of our nation and global communities. Our mission focused work is innovative, inspiring and technologically challenging in a way that makes every day different and stimulating. We provide the opportunity to work on rare projects, with exciting tools and brilliant people. Everyone has access to unparalleled professional and personal development opportunities and your contribution is always valued.
About the role
Impact of the role: This role provides critical on-site IT support for Cheltenham-based colleagues and corporate services, ensuring users remain productive through the timely resolution of incidents, requests and technical issues. The role supports service availability, business continuity and operational efficiency by providing local hands-on support that cannot always be delivered remotely.

 Job Description

JOB TITLE
Manufacturing Operator – Limerick
REPORTS TO
Production Team Leader
POSITION SUMMARY
A manufacturing operator at Stryker Limerick is appointed to perform the activities associated with the specific SOP’s for the purpose of manufacturing, inspection or packaging of Medical Devices at Stryker Limerick.
As business requirements change, employees are expected to be flexible and can move throughout the facility. Therefore multi skilling of the workforce is required. Specific tasks may require specific skills. These include the following:
Hand Skills
Machining – semi automatic/automatic
CNC Machining – Milling and or Turning
Product Inspection
General Duties
X-Ray
Zyglo – Non Destructive Testing
Bead Application
Casting / Shell Making
Clean room / Packaging
Warehousing/Stores duties
• Performance Measures
Knowledge and skill is measured by the proficiency demonstrated during training. This measure is assessed by a skills trainer before final signoff of a training record. The effectiveness of the training is subsequently measured through the following performance indicators:
• Unit quantity per hour / shift
• First Pass Yield
• 5 Pillar Score
• EHS Audit / Score
• Line Clearance Audit Score
• Cell Shutdowns
• Lead Time
• Customer Service
Job Description
Effective Date: October 2005 Page 2 of 2
• Core Competencies
The following are the core competencies required irrespective of job specific duties:
• PPE (Personal Protective Clothing) Requirements
• Product Knowledge
• Compliance and understanding of the required / associated Standard Operating Procedure and EHS requirements for the process
• 5 Pillar Standards
• Line Clearance Requirements
• Quality Acceptance Criteria
• Scrap/ Product Disposition Procedure
• Rework Procedure
• Device Defect Awareness
• Bar Coding Scanning System
KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY
The key responsibilities for manufacturing operatives are defined as:
The ability to demonstrate safe working practices, correct use of equipment, product verification and the adherence to EHS, line clearance and 5 pillars compliance.
QUALIFICATIONS KNOWLEDGE SKILLS
• Leaving Certificate or equivalent is required (recognition of prior learning is also considered).
• 12 months experience in a regulated manufacturing machine environment is preferred but not essential.
• Proven Handcraft Skills & Strong Mechanical aptitude
• Technical drawing and experience in the use of measuring equipment an advantage.
• Good Communication Skills.
• Experience in GMP environment is preferred but not essential.
• Basic PC skills necessary.
• Capable of working as part of a multi-disciplined team.
• Good timekeeping and attendance essential..

description:

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .

 Job Description: 
 DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Global Chemical Compliance SME, located in Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland.
 
 Please note that this role is available across multiple countries and may be posted under different requisition numbers to comply with local requirements. While you are welcome to apply to any or all of the postings, we recommend focusing on the specific country(s) that align with your preferred location(s):
 
 Raynham, MA (USA) - Requisition Number: R-074957
 St. Anthony's Road, Leeds, UK - Requisition Number:  R-099916
 Cork, Ireland - Requisition Number: R-100034
 
 Remember, whether you apply to one or all of these requisition numbers, your applications will be considered as a single submission.
 
 The Global Chemical Compliance SME provides subject-matter expertise and leadership to ensure DePuy Synthes products and processes comply with evolving chemical legislation worldwide. The role translates requirements into practical strategies across product development, manufacturing, regulatory submissions, and lifecycle management while partnering cross-functionally to manage risk, strengthen governance, and maintain market access.
 
 Key Responsibilities
 · Serve as the global subject-matter expert for chemical compliance requirements, including EU REACH and REACH-like regulations, US TSCA, California Proposition 65, US FIFRA, GHS, PIC, Biocides, RoHS, and other applicable regulations.
 · Monitor legislation, policies, and stakeholder expectations; assess applicability and translate business, product, and process impacts into implementation strategies.
 · Develop policies, standards, governance, and mitigation plans for restricted substances, product safety, material composition, and other chemical compliance risks.
 · Partner cross-functionally to embed requirements into product development, design changes, regulatory submissions, manufacturing, supplier activities, and lifecycle decisions.
 · Lead the Chemical Compliance Community of Practice and align business and enterprise experts on positions, best practices, and process improvements.
 · Advance materials and chemicals data strategies, compliance tools, data quality, process harmonization, metrics, and program reporting.
 · Lead governance reviews and support internal, supplier, third-party, and regulatory audits and assessments.
 · Represent DePuy Synthes in relevant trade and industry associations and support global advocacy and continuous improvement.
 
 Qualifications and Education:
 · Master’s degree or equivalent in Environmental Health and Safety, Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Environmental Science, Product Stewardship, or a related discipline is required.
 Experience and Skills:
 Required:
 · 10 plus years of relevant experience in product stewardship, chemistry, materials science, chemical compliance, environmental engineering, or a related field within a global regulated industry.
 · Deep knowledge of global chemical compliance requirements, chemistry, materials science, chemical properties, and environmental product regulations, with hands-on experience applying them.
 · Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex problems, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, and deliver accurate, timely outcomes.
 · Excellent written, verbal, analytical, organizational, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate technical and legal information into practical guidance.
 · Demonstrated ability to influence and lead across functions, organizational levels, and global teams while maintaining integrity, confidentiality, and customer focus.
 Preferred:
 · Hands-on experience with chemical and product regulatory programs across major global markets, including Europe, the United States, Canada, Japan, China, and Korea.
 · Knowledge of toxicology, analytical testing, polymers, metal alloys, reactants, synthetic routes, and processing aids.
 · Experience developing requirements for environmental compliance tools and conducting chemical or environmental product compliance audits.
 · Experience with external advocacy, global matrixed organizations, and compliance process improvement.
 Other:
 · Language: English required; knowledge of additional languages is an asset.
 · Travel: Up to 10%, including occasional domestic or international travel.
 · Certifications: Regulatory Affairs Certification or relevant chemical/compliance certifications are preferred but not required.
 
 For more information on how we support the whole health of our employees throughout their wellness, career and life journey, please visit www.careers.jnj.com.

We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. title: Mid Market Account Executive (Italy)
description:
Mid-Market Account Executive

As an Account Executive on our Mid-Market Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across mid-to-large size organizations. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. Mid-Market reps have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You’ll Do:

  • Focus entirely on net-new logo acquisition
  • Convert inbound leads to closed opportunities 
  • Leverage tools such as Sales Navigator and DiscoverOrg
  • Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end users (SRE, DevOps, DevSecOps)
  • Multi-thread into different departments of a complex organization
  • Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity
  • Manage the full sales cycle, including negotiations and on-site technical demonstrations 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced in hunting and closing net new logos
  • Able to strategically map out and break into large scale organizations
  • Curious, motivated, and driven as a sales person
  • Bold on the phones and creative in your emails
  • Able to sit up to 6 hours, traveling to and from client sites via auto, train, or air, up to 30% of the time

 Benefits and Growth:

  • High income earning opportunities based on self performance
  • Opportunity for Presidents Club
  • New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
  • Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing 
  • Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message 
  • Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking 
  • An inclusive company culture, opportunity to join our Community Guilds
  • Generous global benefits

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

About Datadog: 

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

Datadog is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and other characteristics protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.
