Job Description:
It’s never been a more exciting time to join Vistra.
At Vistra our purpose is progress. We believe that our clients have the power to change the world and to do great things for global progress, and we exist to remove the friction that comes from the complexity of global business – to help our clients achieve progress without friction.
But progress only happens when people come together and take action. And we’re absolutely committed to building a culture where our people can do just that.
Your legal career starts here. Grow with Vistra!
Are you interested in law, eager to learn and ready to take your first or next step in your legal career? Would you like to work in an international environment with top notch clients where you can develop your skills, gain hands-on experience and learn from experienced legal professionals?
Then we'd love to meet you!
At Vistra, we help international businesses navigate the complexities of operating across borders. With colleagues around the world, we support clients in achieving their ambitions by making global business simpler.
We are looking for an enthusiastic Legal Officer to join our Corporate Services team in Amsterdam.
Whether you have recently graduated, already gained some legal experience or simply have a strong affinity with law and corporate services, this could be the opportunity for you.
You don't need to be an expert in Dutch corporate law or have years of experience. What matters most to us is your willingness to learn, your attention to detail and your enthusiasm to develop yourself.
What will you be doing?
As a Legal Officer, you will become part of a friendly and collaborative team supporting a diverse portfolio of international corporate clients.
You will work closely with experienced Legal Officers, Legal Services Lawyers, Relationship Managers and financial colleagues, gaining practical experience in Dutch corporate law, corporate governance and international business.
Your day-to-day activities will include:
Assisting with the preparation and review of corporate legal documents, such as board resolutions, shareholder resolutions, agreements and powers of attorney.
Supporting the day-to-day legal and corporate administration of Dutch and Belgium client entities.
Helping maintain accurate and up-to-date corporate records and client files.
Assisting with corporate transactions, restructurings and other legal matters under the guidance of experienced colleagues.
Coordinating with clients, notaries, legal advisors, accountants and other stakeholders.
Supporting compliance and client review processes.
Monitoring relevant deadlines and helping ensure that corporate obligations are met.
Working together with colleagues to provide excellent service to our international clients.
As you gain experience and confidence, you will gradually take on more responsibility and develop your own areas of expertise.
No two days are the same, and there will always be something new to learn!
Who are we looking for?
We are not looking for someone who ticks every box. We are looking for someone with the right mindset, a genuine interest in law and the motivation to grow.
You might be a great fit if you:
Have completed an HBO degree in Law (HBO-Rechten), a university degree in Law or a comparable educational background.
Have an affinity with Dutch corporate law, corporate services or international business.
Are organised, detail-oriented and enjoy working in a team.
Have good communication skills and are comfortable working in English (French is a pre).
Have a proactive attitude and are not afraid to ask questions or take initiative.
Enjoy learning new things and developing your professional skills.
Have a basic understanding of Microsoft Office applications.
Previous working experience is an advantage, but certainly not a requirement.
Knowledge of Dutch corporate law, particularly Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code, is a plus. However, we are more than happy to help you develop this knowledge on the job.
If you have the right attitude and motivation, we encourage you to apply!
What can you expect from us?
At Vistra, we believe that professional growth happens when people are given the opportunity to learn, contribute and develop.
You will join a supportive team where experienced colleagues are happy to share their knowledge and help you build your confidence.
We offer you:
Learning and career development
Hands-on experience in corporate law, guidance from experienced colleagues and access to our Vistra Skills Platform.
International exposure
Work with international clients and colleagues while developing an understanding of cross-border business.
A collaborative environment
Become part of a friendly team where questions are welcomed, knowledge is shared and achievements are celebrated.
Room to grow
Develop your skills and gradually take ownership of more complex corporate legal matters as your experience grows.
Your benefits
In addition to a challenging and rewarding position, we offer an attractive employment package, including:
Competitive salary and travel allowance.
26 days of annual leave, plus one flexible public holiday and the option to purchase up to five additional days.
8% holiday allowance.
Non-contributor

title: GenAI Data Modeler
description:
GenAI Data Modeler 
 
Be part of something groundbreaking  
 At AIG, we are making long-term investments in a brand-new, innovative Generative AI team, designed to explore new possibilities for how artificial intelligence can be applied in insurance and beyond, and we need your help. 
 With the support and investment needed to explore new frontiers in Generative AI, you’ll be working alongside talented colleagues, innovating and contributing to projects that will transform how we manage risk and serve our customers. 
 This team is central to our vision of the future and the core of our business offering. We will incorporate best-in-class engineering and product management principles, and your contribution will be critical to its success. To rapidly advance and innovate, we need your skills and expertise to build world-class products. If you’re excited by the opportunity to create meaningful impact at scale and shape the future of the insurance industry, we’d love to hear from you.
  
 Who we are  
 AIG is one of the leading global commercial and personal insurance organizations, with one of the most far-reaching property casualty networks. We provide world-class products and expertise to businesses and individuals in approximately 190 countries and jurisdictions. 
 At AIG, we’re reshaping how the world manages risk, and we’re inviting you to be a key part of that transformation. As a Data Architect, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, leveraging and further developing your skills to guide groundbreaking AI initiatives. If you’re looking for a place to grow your career and where your contributions will shape the future, AIG is where you belong. 
  
 How you will create an impact 
  As a Data Modeler, you will drive the development of AIG’s data architecture and ontology frameworks, ensuring that our data systems are robust, scalable, and future-proof. You’ll shape how data is modeled, integrated, and governed across the organization, helping business applications deliver faster with greater quality and compliance. Your role will be crucial in creating reusable enterprise information assets, and you will collaborate closely with solution architects, product owners, and engineering teams to deliver high-impact business outcomes. This is an opportunity to play a key role in ensuring data architecture supports innovation, compliance, and improved business performance.
  Creating and managing data models and ontologies for large-scale business applications across multiple geographies 
 Assisting the design and integration of enterprise information assets, services, and business systems to ensure efficient data usage and compliance with governance standards 
 Documenting and continuously improving data architecture systems, while educating teams on data governance standards and best practices 
 Collaborating with product owners, engineers, and the Data Governance team to ensure high data quality, security, and privacy compliance across business applications 
 Monitoring market and industry trends in data architecture and applying them to enhance AIG’s information lifecycle management and data
integration processes 
  
 What is needed to be successful 
 Data modeling and data analysis experience: You bring expertise in creating complex data models, and have a proven track record of modeling with 3NF, as well as dimensional and Data Vault methodologies, as well as contributing to the data architecture strategy at an enterprise level
 Strong data analysis, data profiling and SQL skills
 You have experience with best practices in data governance, security and privacy in modeling and data architecture
 Strong knowledge of data technologies, data design practices and data integration
 Passion for integrity and clarity of data
 Experience with master and reference data management
 Experience across sub-functional data domain areas such as reporting, analysis, conceptualization and design of data assets across warehouses and marts
 You are passionate about using the latest technology for data innovation and are excited to use AI and LLM integration to innovate
 Experience (or certification) with data modeling tools, ETL tools, Snowflake, Dimensional Modeling, Data Vault modeling, ER modeling
 Experience (or certification) working with NoSQL databases like MongoDB, experience with XML / JSON
 Solid communication skills – verbal and written
 AGILE / Rally development experience or training required
 Experience with (or strong enthusiasm about) AI-driven solutions
  
 It would be nice if 
 Experience in Data Warehousing
 Experience using Snowflake platform
 You have a good understanding of ontologies
 Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar tool is highly desired
 Experience in insurance or financial services is desired
  
 Ready to solve bigger problems? We would love to hear from you.
  
 #LI-AIG #AI #GenAI #artificialintelligence #DataEngineering #DataMining
 
 At AIG, we value in-person collaboration as a vital part of our culture, which is why we ask our team members to be primarily in the office. This approach helps us work together effectively and create a supportive, connected environment for our team and clients alike. 
 
 Enjoy benefits that take care of what matters 
 At AIG, our people are our greatest asset. We know how important it is to protect and invest in what’s most important to you. That is why we created our Total Rewards Program, a comprehensive benefits package that extends beyond time spent at work to offer benefits focused on your health, wellbeing and financial security—as well as your professional development—to bring peace of mind to you and your family.
 
 Reimagining insurance to make a bigger difference to the world 
 American International Group, Inc. (AIG) is a global leader in commercial and personal insurance solutions; we are one of the world’s most far-reaching property casualty networks. It is an exciting time to join us — across our operations, we are thinking in new and innovative ways to deliver ever-better solutions to our customers. At AIG, you can go further to support individuals, businesses, and communities, helping them to manage risk, respond to times of uncertainty and discover new potential. We invest in our largest asset, our people, through continuous learning and development, in a culture that celebrates everyone for who they are and what they want to become.
 
 Welcome to a culture of inclusion 
 We’re committed to creating a culture that truly respects and celebrates each other’s talents, backgrounds, cultures, opinions and goals. With global chapters, ERGs are a cornerstone for our culture of inclusion.  Cloud Account Executive – Revenue Cloud | UKI 
 
 Powering the Future of Revenue Operations
  
 Revenue management is more complex than ever, with businesses navigating subscription models, usage-based pricing, and intricate deal structures. Salesforce Revenue Cloud is the industry-leading solution that helps companies unify their revenue processes—from Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) to Billing, Revenue Recognition, and Subscription Management—all on the world’s #1 CRM.
 
 As businesses embrace digital-first sales strategies, Revenue Cloud enables them to close deals faster, automate revenue workflows, and gain real-time visibility into their financials. By eliminating manual inefficiencies and driving data-driven decision-making, Revenue Cloud empowers organizations to scale and optimize their revenue streams with speed, accuracy, and compliance.
 
 We’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to help drive adoption of Revenue Cloud across the UK & Ireland, working with some of the most ambitious companies in the market. This is an opportunity to work at the forefront of digital transformation and revenue optimization, partnering with C-suite leaders to solve their most critical challenges.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Own the full sales cycle—prospecting, strategy, and closing high-value deals with top UK & Ireland companies.
 Act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex revenue operations transformations.
 Engage C-level executives in meaningful conversations about modernizing revenue management with automation and AI.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to showcase the power of Revenue Cloud and the wider Salesforce ecosystem.
 Exceed sales targets while building lasting relationships that drive customer success.
 
 What We’re Looking For 
 SaaS Sales Expertise – A proven track record in CPQ, billing, or revenue operations solutions.
 Enterprise Sales Experience – Skilled in managing complex deals with multiple stakeholders.
 Strategic Thinking – Ability to drive high-impact discussions on revenue transformation and digital sales.
 Excellent Communication – Strong storytelling, negotiation, and closing skills.

 Why Join Salesforce?

About the role
Join our Defence Solution Design Authority team and help create secure, resilient network solutions that support critical defence and government services.
You will collaborate with customers, technology partners and teams across BT to turn complex requirements into practical solutions, providing technical leadership throughout the solution lifecycle.
This is a full-time role with flexible working, based in Bristol, Hemel Hempstead or Oswestry, offering the opportunity to expand your architectural expertise and influence future network services
What you’ll be doing
Lead the design and governance of secure, resilient network solutions, ensuring they meet customer, security and operational requirements.
Partner with customers and colleagues across sales, security, operations and technology to translate business needs into clear technical designs and delivery plans.
Guide solutions through their full lifecycle, from early concepts and bid support through testing, acceptance and operational handover.
Manage technical decisions, risks, dependencies and change requests so that solutions remain compliant, commercially viable and fit for purpose.
Improve future network capabilities by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and identifying technologies that can strengthen performance, resilience and security.
Essential Skills / Experience
DWDM solution design: The ability to design, assess or evolve DWDM-based network solutions within complex operational environments along with a range of cross connect technologies such as SDH,PDH & Ethernet.
IP networking expertise: A strong practical understanding of IP networking and the ability to apply it when developing secure, reliable network designs.
Technical leadership: The ability to lead technical discussions, explain complex information clearly and guide customers and delivery teams towards effective decisions.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Experience in one or more of the following areas would be useful, but you do not need to have all of them to apply:
SDH, PDH or OTN technologies
Network Management Systems
Secure operations centre, testing or laboratory environments
Service provider or highly secure network environments
ATM or FRATM technologies
Architecture documentation, statements of work or technology roadmaps
Our Package
Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life.
You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include:
• 10% on target annual bonus
• 25 days Holiday
• Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family
• Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off
• Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay
• Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband
• Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us
• Holiday purchase scheme
You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready.
Ready to connect for good and help shape the future? Apply now.
Join us at a pivotal moment for BT Business. We are executing a multi-year transformation to restore growth, modernise at scale and unlock new markets beyond connectivity. Our ambition is clear – return to sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth, strengthen our market position, and deliver meaningful shareholder value through disciplined execution and bold reinvention.
We are fundamentally reshaping the business – simplifying our portfolio, digitising our customer experience and building market-leading capability across cyber, AI and managed services, all powered by the UK’s leading fixed and mobile networks. This is a shift from a legacy connectivity provider to a modern, solutions-led, AI-first business that can truly differentiate in a competitive and fast-moving market.
With execution momentum building and a clear path to growth, the opportunity now is to scale what works, accelerate performance and fully realise our potential. This is about delivering against ambitious financial outcomes while transforming how we operate – creating a business that is simpler, faster, more innovative and easier to do business with.
If you want to be part of the team shaping the turnaround of a multi-billion-pound business – and building a stronger, more competitive BT for the future – this is your moment.

description:
Summary:  
Work as an Associate FIX Analyst for Algorithmic Interface Trading within our FIX Support Team. Main objectives of this position would be to streamline our algorithmic interface creation and certification timelines. This individual will also become a subject matter expert in algo interface integration and help advance our trading capabilities across all asset classes. Additionally, serve as a point of escalation to L1 Support team for algo related inquiries in production and help automate the algo deployment process.

 Responsibilities: 
 This role would be primarily responsible for all algorithmic interface creation and certification testing across all asset classes including single-leg and multi-leg workflows.  
 Serve as a Level 2 Support person for our L1 FIX Network Support team who are not algorithmic SME’s.
 This person will also work directly with CRD Product on identifying bugs, enhancements, and algo deployment automation, to ensure we deliver on our clients high expectations.
 Coordinate with clients, internal Charles River colleagues, and network vendor(s) to facilitate the following service-related functions:
 design, specification, and provisioning
 testing and certification
 go-live implementation/onboarding
 on-going changes and enhancements
 problem troubleshooting, support, and resolution
 for straightforward situations, perform the aforementioned tasks
 Follow departmental procedures to ensure timely, high quality delivery of service to Charles River Network clients
 Ensure all Network Services database information and documentation is accurate and current
 
 Requirements: 
 Minimum of Bachelor’s Degree required 
 0-2 years of professional experience coding with Python or SQL or VBA. Java a plus. 
 Proficient in Microsoft Excel 
 Background in trading system applications is preferred 
 FIX experience preferred 
 Proven ability to work in a mission critical operations and support environment 
 Aptitude for technical troubleshooting 
 Excellent customer service skills; attention to detail; and interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills 
 Ability to partner with various internal departments to deliver superior customer service 
 Periodic off-hours support 
 Ability to work independently and within a team

State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world.  From technology to product innovation we're making our mark on the financial services industry.  For more than two centuries, we've been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people.  We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investments research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.

 About AbbVie 
 AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio.  We are looking for a  Production Operator  to join AbbVie North Dublin supporting our production line.

 Following Quality Assessment requirements, GMP standards, and all applicable SOPs for equipment, plant operations, and production processes.

 MS Word, MS Excel, Outlook.

title: Facility Operations Center Engineer, Facilities Operation Center
description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Global Services organization is looking for an individual with proven and tested leadership skills to help bring to fruition a newly developed Facilities Operations Center. The Facility Operations Center is responsible for 24X7 monitoring of the data center’s physical infrastructure and will serve as a facilitator for all Large Scale Events. This team will ensure that the customer experience will be optimal and gratifying by way of consistency, reliability and attention to detail.

The ideal candidate will need to have an understanding of data center IT Infrastructure and data center Facilities infrastructure and how the two entities co-exist. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing assistance and support to the onsite team. The position will help ensure overall availability and reliability to meet or exceed defined service levels. Qualified candidates must also have experience functioning in a large-scale data center and have demonstrated and displayed the ability to think outside of the box. This skill is essential, as the candidate will assist with aligning the Facility Operations Center with the larger objectives of other business and peer organizations. You will need to play a role with growing the team to a standard of operational excellence.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think and act globally; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon Data Centers, then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!

Key job responsibilities
Monitors the global data center Amazon facilities infrastructure platform
Serves as a Point of Contact for internal and external teams
Assists with the development of communication and escalation protocols designed to improve the team’s performance
Contributes to outage post mortem analysis
Ensures records are updated in a timely manner
Assists with coordination and communication during emergency recovery efforts
Assists with the development of tools that will enhance the team’s performance
Ability to support a 24X7 environment (This is shift work which may require that you work weekends and holidays)
Internal job description

About the team

title: Systems Development Engineer, AWS Incident Response (AIR)
description:
AWS Incident Response (AIR) ensures the high availability of Amazon Web Services by making customer-impacting events shorter and less frequent through incident detection, management, and automated mitigation. Our systems monitor AWS infrastructure in real-time, automatically detect impairments, and orchestrate responses to minimize customer impact across regions and services.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the AIR team, you will lead the response to critical customer-impacting events — triaging impact, identifying root causes, coordinating mitigation actions with service teams, and driving resolution in real-time. Not every event is solved by automation; you will use your technical judgment to assess situations, engage the right teams, and direct mitigation strategies when manual intervention is required. Insights from these events directly inform the automation and tooling you build — creating a continuous improvement loop where each event makes the next one shorter or prevents it entirely. 

This role offers a unique combination of systems development and real-time operational leadership, with direct impact on the availability of AWS services used by millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
• Drive the resolution of large-scale customer-impacting incidents as part of an on-call rotation (including weekends and holidays), leading incident calls and coordinating resolver teams across AWS service organizations
• Design, build, and enhance incident detection, triage, and mitigation automation tools
• Author COEs and event deep-dive documents to identify improvement opportunities; create and lead action items that improve processes, tooling, and automation
• Identify recurring platform issues and own projects that eliminate entire classes of operational problems
• Collaborate with teams globally to expand incident response capabilities across AWS regions and services

A day in the life
A Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Incident Response (AIR) team has full visibility on all AWS services! There are limitless opportunities to learn as you will work with all AWS internal teams and have exposure to AWS products and services. 

When on-call, your day may start with large scale event — you join the conference bridge, assess the scope of impact using real-time dashboards, identify impaired services, engage the right teams, and drive mitigation until the event is resolved. After the event, you lead the deep-dive, document findings, and create action items to prevent recurrence. 

When off-call, you spend your time building and improving the tools that make incident response faster and more automated. You might be writing code to improve event detection logic, building dashboards that surface the right signals during triage, or working on automation that reduces manual steps during mitigation. You participate in design / code reviews and collaborate with engineers across AIR to drive operational improvements. You also invest time in learning AWS service architectures — understanding how services fail helps you respond faster when they do.

About the team
AWS Incident Response (AIR) is a globally distributed team responsible for leading the large-scale customer-impacting events across AWS. We operate 24/7, providing incident leadership and coordination for events that span multiple services and regions. Our engineers combine hands-on incident leadership with systems development — we build the automation and tooling we use, and every event teaches us how to make the next one shorter or prevent it entirely. The team values operational excellence, continuous learning, and a bias for action. We work closely with service teams, networking, and infrastructure organizations across AWS, giving our engineers broad exposure to how AWS operates under the hood.
- Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
- Experience handling large enterprise technical customer escalations
- Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

title: Procurement Project Specialist &#8211; Hybrid
description:
Procurement Project Specialist – (€280/Daily)

  • Long Term Day Rate Contract with high likelihood of extension
  • Hybrid working – 2-days on-site
  • Join a major €30M infrastructure project connecting Ireland like never before
  • Join at mobilisation and shape the supply chain from day one

The next chapter of Ireland’s connectivity is being built now.

A major new project is underway to connect some of Ireland’s biggest cities and regions through a resilient national fibre network — creating the infrastructure to support the country’s growing demand for connectivity.

Making that happen is no small undertaking. It’s a complex, multi-party infrastructure build bringing together engineering, third-party infrastructure, civils, fibre deployment and specialist suppliers.

And this is where you come in.

Joining at mobilisation, you’ll help build the supply chain that makes the project possible — finding the right suppliers, running tenders, negotiating the right deals and putting the commercial arrangements in place to keep the project moving.

Your decisions will have a direct impact on what gets delivered, who delivers it and how successfully the project moves from plan to reality. You’ll work closely with Project Managers, Engineering and Commercial teams, with the opportunity to shape procurement from the ground up rather than inherit an established process.

 

Why You’ll Love This Role

  • Work on a National Project: Help build a fibre network connecting some of Ireland’s biggest cities and regions.
  • Shape It from the Start: Join during mobilisation and build the procurement approach from the ground up.
  • Work Across the Project: Source across multiple workstreams, from infrastructure and civils to fibre deployment and specialist suppliers.
  • Own Key Supplier Decisions: Help select the suppliers and agree the commercial terms that will support delivery.
  • Work Closely with Delivery Teams: Partner directly with Project Managers, Engineering and Commercial teams to make sure procurement keeps pace with the project.

What You’ll Do

  • Set the Plan: Identify what needs to be sourced and when.
  • Run Tenders: Manage RFQs and RFPs from scope through to supplier selection.
  • Secure the Deal: Benchmark prices, negotiate terms and manage commercial risk.
  • Build the Supply Base: Find and develop the suppliers and subcontractors needed for delivery.
  • Keep Procurement Moving: Work with project teams to manage requirements, priorities and supplier dependencies.
  • Set Up Delivery: Put the right suppliers and agreements in place for the next stage of the project.

What You’ll Have

  • Procurement Experience: Strong experience at Procurement Specialist, Senior Procurement Specialist, Procurement Manager or similar level. Your current or most recent role should be procurement-focused.
  • Tendering & Negotiation: Experience managing sourcing projects from initial requirement through tender, negotiation and award.
  • Project & Stakeholder Experience: Comfortable working with suppliers, project teams and senior stakeholders in a fast-moving project environment.
  • Relevant Sector Experience: Infrastructure, utilities, construction, engineering or telecommunications would be beneficial. CIPS would be an advantage, but strong procurement experience is the priority.

 

For more information, contact kendra.greasley@archer.ie
For additional opportunities, visit the Archer Recruitment website.

title: Protect yourself from recruitment scams
description:
Skip to main content
Protect yourself from recruitment scams
We are seeing an increase in fraudulent activity involving individuals falsely claiming to represent Bank of America. These scams often include fake job offers, interviews, or requests for financial or personal information. We take these matters seriously and want to ensure you stay informed and protected throughout your job search.
Please keep the following in mind:
Bank of America will never ask for payment or request personal banking information at any stage of the recruitment /career process.
All official recruitment communications will come from a verified Bank of America email address ending in @bofa.com. Be cautious of messages from personal or non-company email addresses.
Do not engage with or respond to suspicious emails or messages. If you're unsure about the legitimacy of a communication, verify the sender’s email address and contact us directly. Hover over the sender’s email address and confirm it ends with @bofa.com—be alert for misspellings or added words.
If you receive a suspicious email, text, or phone call using Bank of America's name, please forward it to the Abuse mailbox .
Interviews
Bank of America does not utilize video chat rooms (e.g., Google Hangouts) to conduct interviews.
Bank of America will only use our approved interview platforms, HireVue, Teams, Webex or Zoom.
Your vigilance helps protect you and supports the integrity of our hiring process.
Recognizing fraudulent communications
Phishing emails often: Do not address you by name.
Create a sense of urgency to prompt quick action.
Contain links that lead to suspicious websites or malicious attachments.
Include grammatical or spelling errors.

 Job Description & Summary 
Our FS Risk & Regulation team works with banks and other regulated financial institutions on the financial (prudential) risk issues that affect how they manage capital, liquidity, regulatory reporting, stress testing, recovery and resolution.

This role is for someone with strong banking prudential risk expertise who wants to use that knowledge in varied, client-facing work, rather than in a purely internal control, policy or reporting role. You will work across a small number of client projects at any one time, using your technical knowledge to understand the issue, analyse the facts, develop clear outputs and help clients progress practical actions.

The work is varied and technical. One project may involve reviewing a bank’s regulatory reporting process, another may involve assessing liquidity risk governance or economic capital modelling, and another may require interpreting new prudential requirements and setting out what needs to change. You will need to be organised, comfortable with competing priorities, able to manage multiple deliverables and able to maintain quality across different topics and deadlines. 
 
 About the Role: 
 Work on concurrent client projects or workstreams, often covering different prudential risk topics, with responsibility for organising your work, tracking actions and delivering agreed outputs. Your focus will be on the execution and delivery of the projects.
 Review client information such as policies, procedures, governance packs, regulatory returns, risk reports, committee materials, models, calculations and management information to understand how the current approach works.
 Use your financial (prudential) risk knowledge to identify issues, gaps, inconsistencies or areas where the client’s approach may not meet regulatory requirements, supervisory expectations or good practice.
 Analyse numerical information, including capital, liquidity, stress testing, regulatory reporting and balance sheet data, and explain what the figures show, what assumptions have been used and where further challenge may be needed.
 Prepare clear deliverables such as findings papers, gap analyses, impact assessments, remediation plans, framework documents, process maps, management reports and materials for senior stakeholders.
 Attend meetings and working sessions with client teams across Risk, Finance, Treasury, Regulatory Reporting and senior management to gather information, test understanding, discuss findings and agree next steps.
 Keep project teams informed on progress, risks and dependencies, and escalate where timelines, scope, data availability or competing priorities need to be managed.

 At least 4+ years of experience working in a related area such as capital management, liquidity, risk or liquidity management, regulatory reporting, recovery and resolution, stress testing and credit risk.
 Capital management: capital planning, capital adequacy, balance sheet management and optimisation. Understanding of the CRR and RWA calculations.  
 Credit risk: credit risk frameworks, credit risk appetite, portfolio monitoring, credit risk data and MI, impairment and provisioning approaches, credit risk model outputs, and the use of credit risk parameters such as PD, LGD and EAD in regulatory capital, stress testing and management reporting.
 Liquidity management: LCR, NSFR, ILAAP, contingency funding planning, intraday liquidity, liquidity governance and risk appetite. Knowledge of the LCR Delegated Act and the CRR.
 Stress testing: internal and regulatory stress testing (supporting the ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery plan), liquidity stress testing, scenario design, modelling methodologies, assumptions, governance, documentation, and use of results.
 Recovery and resolution: recovery planning, wind-down planning, resolution planning, resolvability assessments, dry runs, and related regulatory submissions.
 Regulatory reporting: COREP, LCR/NSFR, ALMM, STE, resolution reporting, data quality, governance and control frameworks.
 Numerical and analytical capability: ability to read, interpret and challenge data, calculations, assumptions, modelling and outputs, and management information. Quantitative skills or experience with modelling approaches would be a plus.
 Business Acumen - use a broad range of tools and techniques to extract insights from current trends in the market and utilise this information to assist your clients in making innovative business decisions.
 Relationship management - ability to read situations and modify behaviour to build quality, diverse relationships.
 Creative - demonstrate an ability to contribute to new ideas and propose innovative solutions to problems. 
 Excellent communication skills both written and verbal.
 Enthusiastic team player and manager with a passion to coach and encourage others to achieve their potential.
 Leadership – demonstrate strong commitment and experience to developing yourself, your team members, your clients and your business.

title: Legal Counsel - Infrastructure & Projects
description:
Join us, be part of more.   
   
 We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that's energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion, and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently - we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it, and mend it.   
   
 About your team:   
   
 We’re the pride of Ireland. Bord Gáis Energy have been powering the nation’s homes and businesses for almost 40 years. But now, we’re so much more than just gas and electric. Through our unique combination of household heroes and energy assets, we’re at the heart of the energy transition in Ireland, strengthening the country’s energy security and helping customers get ready for a net zero future.
 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen to join Centrica’s Legal Infrastructure team for a Legal Counsel - Infrastructure & Projects as the team grows to support significant infrastructure investment across Ireland and the UK.
  
 As Centrica’s Irish infrastructure portfolio expands across generation, storage, renewables, grid and emerging energy technologies, this new role will support projects central to Ireland and the United Kindgom’s energy security, decarbonisation and infrastructure development.
  
 Location 
 This role is ideally based in Dublin, where the successful candidate will work closely with colleagues supporting Centrica's growing infrastructure portfolio in Ireland.
  
 We are also open to considering applications from candidates based elsewhere in Ireland or the UK, provided you are able to travel regularly to Dublin and our Reading, UK, office as required. While we welcome applications from a wider geographical area, there is a strong preference for the successful candidate to be based in or near Dublin.
  
 About the Role 
 As part of Centrica’s Legal Infrastructure team, you will be supporting major infrastructure and energy projects across their lifecycle, working closely with project, engineering, procurement, commercial and operational teams across both Ireland and the wider Centrica group.
  
 Key responsibilities include:
 Advising on the development, delivery and operation of major infrastructure and energy projects.
 Drafting, reviewing and negotiating construction, engineering, consultancy and project-related documentation.
 Supporting procurement, governance, regulatory, planning, environmental and consenting workstreams.
 Advising on construction, project delivery, land, property, infrastructure rights and dispute-related matters.
 Supporting investment approvals, board papers and strategic decision-making processes.
 Managing external legal advisers and supporting effective management of legal spend, precedents, guidance and training materials.
 Monitoring legal and regulatory developments and helping to build knowledge and capability across the Legal Infrastructure team.
 Supporting the development of legal colleagues by sharing infrastructure and construction law expertise and best practice.

 Here’s what we’re looking for: 
 Qualified solicitor or barrister in Ireland, the UK or another recognised common law jurisdiction, eligible to practise in Ireland.
 The responsibilities associated with this position would be suited to an individual with 1 to 4 years of post-qualification experience in private practice, industry or both; however, BGE welcomes applications from all candidates interested in opportunities at this level.
 Experience in infrastructure, construction, energy, engineering or major projects.
 Strong drafting, negotiation, legal risk and commercial advisory skills.
 Able to manage stakeholders and competing priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.
 Collaborative, adaptable and keen to broaden legal expertise and expand AI use.
 Experience in energy, utilities, infrastructure, NEC/FIDIC or other construction contracts.
 Exposure to procurement, planning, environmental, property or land rights matters.
 
 Why this role? 
 In this role you will work on significant energy infrastructure projects supporting Ireland and the United Kingdom’s energy security and net zero ambitions.
 Gain full lifecycle project exposure across generation, storage, renewables and emerging technologies.
 Develop broad expertise across construction, procurement, planning, property, governance and commercial contracting.
 Be part of Centrica’s Legal Infrastructure team, working with senior stakeholders and experienced colleagues across Ireland and the UK, with strong professional development opportunities across the group.
 
 Why should you apply?    
  
We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.  
  
 https://www.morethanacareer.energy/bordgais  
   
 If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.    
 
 Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

title: Associate Auditor - Audit Services
description:
About Northern Trust: 
 
 Northern Trust, a Fortune 500 company, is a globally recognized, award-winning financial institution that has been in continuous operation since 1889.
 
 Northern Trust is proud to provide innovative financial services and guidance to the world’s most successful individuals, families, and institutions by remaining true to our enduring principles of service, expertise, and integrity. With more than 130 years of financial experience and over 22,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
 
 
 Role 
 
 The Associate Auditor is responsible for performing and documenting routine audit examinations across Northern Trust Corporation. Reporting directly to an Audit Team Lead, the role is accountable for completing audit activities in line with established budgets, timelines, and departmental standards. The Associate Auditor also contributes insights and recommendations to improve operational efficiency and to enhance the design and operating effectiveness of the internal control environment.
 
 The key responsibilities of the role include: 
 
 Performs review of various departments by understanding the key risks and controls within the function being reviewed. Develops and executes test steps, documents results and evaluates results to assess the quality of the control and/or control environment

 Responsible for staying current on regulatory rules and changes within the industry

 Manages and performs special projects as assigned

 Participates in meetings with business unit to discuss audit results

 Communicates with partners at all levels, developing and presenting recommendations on operations and controls for the business unit

 Utilizes understanding of various Corporate units to ensure operations, services, and systems have proper audit controls in place (i.e., design of the control environment)

 Evaluates corporate management, business processes, business controls and operating practices during audits and consulting/monitoring engagements

 Applies analytical skills to review information and determine potential control weaknesses

 Develops a thorough understanding of the Northern Trust Audit Methodology and adheres to all applicable Department Standards

 Completes and compiles a high quality summary of findings and recommendations for review in a concise and professional manner

 
 Skills/ Qualifications: 
 
 The successful candidate will ideally demonstrate:
 Knowledge of auditing within the financial services industry, including a sound understanding of basic accounting principles, supported by a college or university degree and/or entry‑level auditing experience within a financial institution

 Professional certifications (e.g. CPA, CISA, CIA, ACA, ACCA) and/or an MBA, with demonstrated technical expertise in areas such as accounting, regulatory compliance, or risk management, preferred

 Strong analytical and organisational skills, with the ability to plan, execute, and support audit activities effectively

 Clear and effective report writing capabilities, alongside strong workpaper documentation skills and attention to detail

 
 Working with Us: 
 As a Northern Trust partner, greater achievements await. You will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture in an organization where financial strength and stability is an asset that emboldens us to explore new ideas.
 
 Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to assisting the communities we serve! Join a workplace with a greater purpose.
 
 We’d love to learn more about how your interests and experience could be a fit with one of the world’s most admired and sustainable companies! Build your career with us and apply today. #MadeForGreater
 
 Reasonable accommodation 
 
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com .
 
 We hope you’re excited about the role and the opportunity to work with us. We value an inclusive workplace and understand flexibility means different things to different people.
 
 Apply today and talk to us about your flexible working requirements and together we can achieve greater.

description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
MedTech Sales 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Clinical Sales – Surgeons (Commission) 
 
 Job Category: 
Professional 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Dublin, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 DePuy Synthes is part of the Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices family and the largest, most innovative, and comprehensive orthopaedic and neurological business in the world. We offer an unparalleled breadth and depth of products, services, and programs in the areas of joint reconstruction, trauma, spine, sports medicine, neurological, craniomaxillofacial, power tools and biomaterials.
 At DePuySynthes Spine, we are inspired by the opportunity to work together with our Doctors, Nurses and Hospitals, to advance patient care. We strive to deliver innovative solutions to help with today's healthcare challenges - advancing patient care and delivering clinical and economic value to our healthcare systems throughout the world.

 Our expansive portfolio of spinal care solutions and treatment options are available in key areas including thoracolumbar, cervical, aging spine, interbody fusion, and arthroplasty, with innovation and new technologies central to the future of surgery, as we move more and more to a Digital and MedTech company.

 Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopaedics business to establish a standalone orthopaedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals.
 Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes. 

 Johnson & Johnson Medical Devices Ireland has an exciting opportunity to join our DePuySynthes Spine team.
 We are looking for someone, who is Passionate about SPINE , and excited about the opportunity to make a difference to peoples lives!

 The role: 
 In this role as a Spine Sales Specialists, you will be a master of your own destiny, responsible for being that central point of contact for Surgeons and Hospital teams to become a trusted support as they deliver the best possible care for their patients.
 You will maintain an existing customer base but also develop new customers, delivering sales in strategic accounts primarily concentrated in Dublin.

 Area of responsibility: 
 Identify and understand customer challenges and requirements and using the full breath of Johnson & Johnson / DePuySynthes resources, help find solutions.
 Lead in exciting new go-to-market opportunities to build long term meaningful relationships with your customers.
 
 To be in a position to achieve these exciting goals, a minimum standard of proficiencies would be required including:
 Procedural & Product understanding to ensure the provision of In-theatre support to consultants & nursing staff during surgery
 Providing first class service and flawless supply to customers including training, stock checks, timely deliveries and supporting the theatre team to ensure the operation proceeds optimally
 Working collaboratively with your Spine Team Colleagues, Business lead, and J&J teams & functions to maximise the benefits of working in a larger organisation
 Achieve Business goals in line with CREDO Values
 Adherence in full to Johnson & Johnson HCC (Healthcare Compliance) Standards, and standards of Business Conduct
 Job Scope: 
 Field position (Dublin based) Sales coverage and case support within Ireland as required
 Overnight stays may be required along with some international travel occasionally
 Desirable: 
 Proven experience in health sciences / anatomy and / or arthroscopy
 Medical Sales / record of delighting your customers
 
 Qualifications: 

 Crucial: Solid understanding of the Irish Hospital environment, both HSE & Private. Astute commercial drive and acuity.
 Desirable. A degree in medical/science/sports science/business/technology or other relevant qualifications e.g. ODP, RGN, Physiotherapy

 Skills and Aptitudes: 
 Engaging interpersonal skills with a positive outlook to make things better
 Excellent communication and team-working skills
 Dynamic and hard-working individual who is excited by new technologies and their developments in medical devices.
 Proactive - anticipates problems, shows initiative for problem-solving and generating new insights
 Resilient -able to work in an ambitious and fast paced environment.
 
 Benefits: 

 Competitive salary with additional significant commission earning opportunities.
 Company Car, Defined Benefit Pension, Private Healthcare Insurance, Lunch Allowance.
 If joining our unique Spine team within the broadest Healthcare company in the world appeals to you, reach out today to our specialist recruitment team – and help us improve Irish patients' lives for the future.

 Johnson & Johnson is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by federal, state or local law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.
 Johnson & Johnson is committed to providing an interview process that is inclusive of our applicants’ needs. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request an accommodation, external applicants please contact us via https://www.jnj.com/contact-us/careers , internal employees contact AskGS to be directed to your accommodation resource.
 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
Business Development, Communication, Customer Centricity, Customer Retentions, Execution Focus, Healthcare Trends, Market Knowledge, Market Research, Presentation Design, Problem Solving, Sales, Solutions Selling, Stakeholder Engagement, Strategic Sales Planning, Sustainable Procurement, Team Management, Vendor Selection   
  
 The anticipated base pay range for this position is: 
€65.700,00 - €105.685,00  
  
 Benefits: 
 In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers.

title: Quantitative Sports Trader
description:
Overview 

 This is a trading and quantitative strategy role focused primarily on trading on prediction markets. You will make fast, informed trading decisions while developing and maintaining the quantitative models, data pipelines, and tools that drive trading performance. The role blends hands-on trading with quantitative research, model development, and product ownership — ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of markets, analytics, and technology.
  
 In this role, you will: 
 Trade using in-house models, data-driven insights, and automated tools to maximize expectancy and meet business objectives. 
 Take ownership of trading strategies and associated models — designing, implementing, and refining logic for execution, pricing, and market-making. 
 Collaborate closely with quantitative researchers and engineers to identify, design, and deploy model enhancements, data features, and trading infrastructure improvements. 
 Perform post-trade analysis of decisions, model performance, and market behavior to inform strategy development and model calibration. 
 Identify opportunities in prediction market dynamics — pricing inefficiencies, liquidity behavior, or reaction times — to strengthen the team’s edge. 
 Drive innovation in trading methodology, tooling, and data usage across the trading and quantitative teams. 
 
 What we're looking for 

 Bachelor’s degree or higher in a technical or quantitative discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics). 

 Deep domain expertise and passion for sports such as Football, Soccer or Golf, including understanding of tactical, statistical, and market aspects of the sport and direct experience trading them.  

 Demonstrated ability in Python, including strong experience with data manipulation (Pandas, NumPy), statistical analysis, and automation. 

 Experience integrating data and models into production trading workflows is a strong plus. 

 Exceptional quantitative reasoning, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 

 Experience trading or modelling in fast-moving, competitive markets (prediction markets, exchanges, or similar). 

 Ability to operate across both trading and quantitative research, bridging analytical insight with execution. 

 Comfort taking product ownership — defining priorities, implementing features, and improving workflows end-to-end. 

 Strong communication skills, both for collaboration and articulating decision rationale. 

 Flexibility with working hours to align with global game/match/tournament schedules.

Our client is a well-established interiors and fit-out company with a strong presence across Dublin. They specialise in commercial interiors, furniture installation, relocation, and fit-out services, working with a range of office and commercial clients.
Due to continued growth, they are currently seeking an experienced Fit-out Operative to join their team based in Baldonnell, Dublin.
This is a semi-mobile role, with regular travel to offices and commercial sites across Dublin. When you are not working on-site, you will be based in the warehouse supporting the day-to-day operation.

 About Your New Job 
As a Fit-out Operative, you will be responsible for carrying out furniture moves, repairs, installations, and general fit-out duties at client offices across Dublin.
You will also spend time working in the warehouse, preparing furniture and equipment for jobs, organising stock, and ensuring materials are ready for delivery and installation.
The ideal candidate will be practical, reliable, physically capable, and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
Your main responsibilities will include:
 Travelling to offices and commercial sites across Dublin to carry out furniture moves, repairs, installations, and general fit-out works.
 Moving, assembling, dismantling, and positioning office furniture.
 Carrying out basic furniture repairs and maintenance where required.
 Loading and unloading furniture, equipment, and materials safely.
 Operating a forklift safely and efficiently within the warehouse and on-site where required.
 Supporting the warehouse team with receiving, storing, organising, and preparing stock.
 Preparing furniture and equipment for upcoming fit-out and relocation projects.
 Keeping the warehouse clean, organized, and safe.
 Ensuring tools, equipment, and materials are maintained and available when required.
 Working professionally when attending client offices and commercial premises.
 Following all health & safety procedures and company guidelines.
 Carrying out general warehouse and fit-out duties as required.
 
 What Skills You Need 
To be successful in this role, you should have:
 Previous experience in a fit-out, furniture installation, warehouse, construction, maintenance, or similar role.
 A valid forklift license – essential.
 Good practical and mechanical aptitude with the ability to carry out basic repairs and furniture assembly.
 The ability to safely lift and move furniture and other materials.
 A full clean driving license would be an advantage due to the semi-mobile nature of the role.
 Good communication skills and a professional manner when dealing with clients.
 The ability to work independently and as part of a wider team.
 A flexible approach to working between the warehouse and various client sites across Dublin.
 Reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.
 A good understanding of health & safety procedures.
 
 What’s on Offer 
 Competitive salary depending on experience.
 24 days annual leave.
 Pension plan.
 Life insurance.
 Health insurance.
 Full-time, Monday–Friday position.
 A varied role combining warehouse and on-site work.
 Opportunity to work across a range of commercial fit-out and office projects throughout Dublin.
 Long-term career opportunity with an established and growing company.
 
 What’s Next 
If you’re an experienced Fit-out Operative, Furniture Installer, Warehouse Operative, or skilled general operative looking for a varied role based in Baldonnell with regular work across Dublin, we’d like to hear from you.
Apply now for more information.
Please send your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your experience and suitability for this role to Mlyons@sigmar.ie or call 086 771 8859 for a confidential discussion.

description:
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution?
 Shape your career with Citi in Dublin. By joining Citi, you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.
 Citi has had a presence in Ireland since 1965, it was one of the first foreign banks to open an office in the country and is the Citibank Europe Plc Headquarters.
 

 The Securities and Derivatives Expert is a senior-level position.The role performs an important function with in the EMEA ASL MO and optimizes EMEA Trade Support operations for Agency Securities Lending (ASL) across 22 markets. This role will be responsible for ensuring seamless and timely recall execution and securities return administration for both equity and fixed income instruments. Beyond core recall management, the role encompasses critical desk support, precise corporate actions desk update bookings and claims management execution and understanding. Exceptional proficiency in timely and effective recall management is essential, directly mitigating risk and ensuring compliance within the highly time-sensitive and complex client sale vs. on-loan review process.

 Responsibilities: 
 Execute securities finance recall transaction processing.
 Formulate procedures, techniques and contribute to the development of new solutions that enhance team productivity, ensuring the entire team meets or exceeds performance goals, including the adoption and utilization of AI-driven solutions
 Serve as an analytical and procedural expert and the first point of escalation for staff members, management, and internal/external clients
 Escalate control gaps and issues to senior management as required
 Identify control gaps during recalls cycle and implement appropriate solutions to mitigate risks and prevent control losses
 Analyze data to identify control deficiencies and resolve discovered issues through the implementation of appropriate procedures
 Act as a mentor and advisor to new and junior staff
 
 Requirements: 
 Extensive relevant experience, preferably in securities transaction processing, with a focus on Securities Finance and/or Securities Lending
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience
 In-depth knowledge of middle office trade lifecycle processes and procedures, with the ability to investigate and resolve issues related to agency lending activities
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders
 
 What we can offer you 
 By joining Citi Dublin, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed) and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well. About Kepak:   
 Kepak Group is a proud Irish company and one of Europe’s leading meat processors. Our well‑known brands — including Rustlers and Big Al’s — are enjoyed in households across the country, and we partner with many of Ireland’s top supermarkets.
 At Kepak, we’re ambitious about growing our business, but equally committed to helping our people grow their skills, careers and job satisfaction. When you join us, you become part of a team that values hard work, development and opportunity.
 Our Kepak Cork site is based in Watergrasshill, Co. Cork — just 35 minutes from Cork City and 20 minutes from Fermoy — offering a strong, supportive workplace in a well‑established facility.
 
 Please note: The factory is situated in a location with limited access to public transport, so reliable private transport is recommended. 

 Positions Available: 
 We are currently seeking motivated individuals to join our team at  Kepak Cork . As part of our multi‑cultural and diverse workforce, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, develop and build your knowledge of the food industry. We are committed to supporting internal growth, offering real opportunities to progress your career within the business.
 Kepak Cork is now recruiting for roles within our  Boning Hall Department , where you will play an important part in our production operations.
  
 Working hours: 
 Boning Hall: Monday to Friday, 7 am to 5 pm (approximately)  
 
 What to expect in the job?   
 The role will involve: 
 As a vital member of the boning team at our factory, you'll skillfully prepare cuts and trims of meat according to Kepak's specifications while keeping pace with our production line.
 You'll be working towards exciting production targets.
 This position will see you based in a chilled area of the factory.
 Your responsibilities will include packaging a variety of meat products such as steaks, chops, burgers, and meatballs.
 We are looking for someone who can manage physical tasks, including lifting, bending, and maintaining a standing position for extended periods.
 You'll operate machinery only after receiving the necessary training.
 From time to time, you may be asked to take on additional responsibilities as outlined by your direct Line Supervisor.
 Requirements 
 What do we need from you?   
 Work on own initiative and as part of a team. 
 Meet production targets and to the speed of the line. 
 Physical role including lifting and standing. 
 Be able to work in a fast-paced environment.
 Attention to detail.
 Willingness to learn and assist with additional tasks as needed. 
 Safety-conscious mindset and adherence to safety guidelines.
 Effective communication skills and ability to work well within a team.
 Further specific role details available on enquiry.
 Benefits

 Wage increases  linked to internal training and skill development
 Career progression opportunities  within the business
 Ability to purchase  cash‑sale company produce 
 Full training  provided for all roles
 Permanent contract 
 Subsidised canteen , including a  free culture‑conscious themed meal once a month 
 Free on‑site parking 
 Flexible holiday planning 
 Paid 20‑minute morning break

Job Title:
Implementation Consultant
Posting Start Date:
8/3/26
Job Description:
Are you a Payroll Professional looking for an exciting opportunity to be a leader within a highly successful global payroll services business? Are you an experienced payroll professional who understands the requirements for building payrolls? Are you looking to take your career to the next level with your expert knowledge and experience and drive success through our values of Respect, Integrity, Teamwork, Accountability, Diversity and Community? Do you have a strong work ethic, global mindset and the desire to help build a great culture?
iiPay has a unique opportunity for a highly experienced and motivated Implementation Consultant who wants to be part of this rapidly expanding business, understanding the client’s requirements to develop their international payrolls and achieve our goal of ‘Paying the Planet’. The role can be based in Hungary, Romania or Poland.
Role Overview
Our highly motivated and engaged team members are at the heart of our success! The implementation team works alongside the project management team to configure and deliver international payroll implementations for our global client base. The role also involves working closely with every department within iiPay to ensure the technical requirements are understood and everyone is aligned for an accurate and timely delivery. The Implementation Consultant may also be required to liaise with our third-party local payroll partners to ensure they are equipped to support us once the implementation passes to live payroll processing.
Key Objectives and Responsibilities
Project Set-up  – working with the internal project team, clients and our local country payroll partners, to organise and run kick off meetings, create project plans and deliver implementation packs.
Client and Project Management  – Support project review calls (internal and external), co-ordinating and delivering on the project streams. Manage any changes to the scope of work and delivery schedule
Payroll Process  – Define and set-up the agreed client payroll processes, establishing all of the payroll and data needs.
Local Registration Management  – Work with the local country payroll partners to conclude all local registration processes for the client.
Payment and Banking Process Definition  – Work with the iiPay treasury team, the payroll partner and client to agree and set-up all payment and banking processes
System set-up and parallel payroll process  – define, agree and configure all interfaces, reports and systems configurations to successfully deliver the parallel payroll processes
Go-live transition  – work with the iiPay operations team and client account manager to transition the payroll at go live to the operations team.
Sign-off and documentation  – Work with the client to sign-off the project and document all of the client specific needs and processes.
What we are looking for in you
Ability to demonstrable data coordination skills
Strong communication skills, with the ability to manage time critical tasks and to assign responsibilities to third party organisations
Experience of using or managing payroll processes and their associated systems,
Experience of working with international clients both small and large (FTSE & Fortune 500), demonstrating the ability to communicate clearly and gain trust with your client contacts.
Highly motivated and driven professional individual with proven track record of delivering projects on time with high levels of customer satisfaction.
Experience of working within a regulated (ISAE 3402 / SSAE 16) service delivery environment
The successful applicant will ideally have experience in payroll or human capital management implementation. They should have the ability to become a systems expert and have experience of managing and prioritising workloads. They should have strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, both verbal and written, and possess a keen attention to detail. They will be required to work in a global environment, with clients that have an expectation of service excellence.
