title: Workday Systems Engineer - Absence & Time Tracking
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 
 
 Job Category 
Software Engineering 
 Job Details 
 
 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
 
 
 
 Digital Enterprise Technology is looking for an experienced Workday techno-functional Systems Engineer to design and deliver scalable solutions across Workday Absence and Time Tracking. This role will join a product and techno-functional team supporting Salesforce’s Global Employee Success organization. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, high-growth environment and brings deep expertise in business analysis, Workday Absence and Time Tracking, and key touchpoints with Payroll, HCM, Benefits, and Financials. As the techno-functional owner for this domain, the Systems Engineer translates business needs into detailed requirements, configuration designs, test strategies, and reliable production solutions, independently leading complex features and releases through post-production validation. This is a hands-on configuration and delivery role focused on accurate and compliant. 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as a technical owner for Workday Absence and Time Tracking. 

 Lead requirements-elaboration sessions with Product Management, Payroll, HR Operations, Employee Relations, Benefits, Compliance, and other stakeholders. 

 Translate business use cases into detailed functional and technical requirements, including user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, validation rules, and configuration specifications. 

 Design, configure, test, and maintain time-off plans, leave rules, accruals, eligibility rules, time-entry processes, work schedules, validations, calculations, and related business processes. 

 Partner with Product Management on prioritization, backlog refinement, sequencing, and delivery tradeoffs. 

 Identify policy, process, security, integration, reporting, and payroll dependencies; provide estimates and surface delivery risks before development begins. 

 Evaluate solution options, make documented configuration tradeoffs, and maintain design decisions, operating procedures, and support documentation. 

 Assess how absence and time configurations affect payroll calculations, payroll inputs, retroactivity, pay periods, cutoffs, and downstream processing. 

 Partner with Payroll to validate time-calculation outputs, paid and unpaid leave treatment, eligibility, balances, reconciliation, and payroll-impacting changes. 

 Define and execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and payroll-impact testing. 

 Coordinate Workday release-impact assessments, production deployments, smoke testing, and post-deployment validation. 

 Lead technical triage and root-cause analysis for complex production issues and time-sensitive payroll incidents. 

 Execute applicable SOX, audit, access, security, segregation-of-duties, and change-management controls. 

 Coordinate with integration and software engineers when changes require custom integrations, services, or coded solutions. 

 Identify and implement opportunities to automate testing, reconciliation, monitoring, and repetitive support activities. 

 Leverage approved AI-assisted tools to improve requirements analysis, solution design, configuration, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting while maintaining security, privacy, and quality standards. 

 Required skill 
 5+ years of hands-on experience configuring Workday Absence and Time Tracking. 

 Strong understanding of absence plans, accruals, eligibility, leave administration, time entry, work schedules, time calculations, validations, and business processes. 

 Practical payroll experience, including understanding how time and absence data affect gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, payroll calendars, cutoffs, reconciliation, and controls. 

 Experience translating business requirements into scalable Workday configurations and detailed acceptance criteria. 

 Experience leading testing, UAT, production deployments, and post-production validation. 

 Understanding of Workday security, reporting, calculated fields, data structures, and integration dependencies. 

 Demonstrated ability to diagnose complex production issues and perform structured root-cause analysis. 

 Strong communication skills and the ability to lead work independently across multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. 

 Ability to manage multiple customers, projects, and tasks simultaneously while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment. 

 Ability to present complex ideas clearly and concisely to non-technical audiences. 

 Demonstrated success collaborating as a team player across virtual, global, and cross-functional teams. 

 Excellent interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills when working with cross-functional stakeholders. 

 Desired skills: 
 Workday certification, Workday Pro accreditation, or advanced training in Absence, Time Tracking, Payroll, or related HCM areas. 

 Experience with multiple countries, complex leave policies, hourly populations, shift workers, or varied payroll schedules. 

 Familiarity with Workday integrations, EIBs, APIs, Studio, Extend, or middleware platforms. 

 Experience with SOX controls, audits, payroll compliance, and sensitive employee data. 

 Experience automating regression testing, operational monitoring, reconciliation, or support processes. 

 
 
 
 
 Unleash Your Potential 
 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and   be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can   do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. 
 
 Accommodations 
 If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form . 
 
 Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 
 
 
 Posting Statement 
 Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
MedTech Sales

Dublin, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 Sales Specialist – Ethicon Biosurgery 
 
 Caring for the world, one person at a time has inspired and united the people of Johnson & Johnson for over 125 years. We embrace research and science -- bringing creative ideas, products and services to advance the health and well-being of people. Every day, our more than 130,000 employees across the world are blending heart, science, and ingenuity to profoundly change the trajectory of health for humanity.
 ETHICON, a division of JOHNSON & JOHNSON MEDICAL LIMITED, is a global leader in developing and marketing patient focused innovation in wound care, surgical stapling, advanced energy, flowable & advanced haemostats.
 
 Role Overview: 
 The role will be responsible for selling the Biosurgery range of Hemostatic products in assigned territory. He / She would also be responsible for establishing the Biosurgery portfolio of Products as the preferred choice of adjunctive hemostats in assigned territory by highlighting Importance of bleeding management, quality, and clinical advantage. The work will involve close coordination with larger team of account managers & supervisors. The role also involves management of existing KOLs and active inclusion of new KOLs to shape the hemostat market and thereby increasing the access, adoption, and affinity to Biosurgery portfolio products.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Sell the Ethicon range of Biosurgery Products using a strategic sales deployment mindset

 Provide weekly and monthly sales action plan to line manager, reflecting the activities required in each account to achieve sales objectives.

 Analyze sales reports to find opportunities, recognize routine problems; analyze causes and recommend solutions

 Negotiate and close sales in routine situations, and with guidance when handling more complex deals

 Take Ownership for account management and have total visibility of account sales across ETHICON.

 Collaborate with other specialist sales resource and commercial resource to deliver coordinated account management approach.

 Leadership of, and assistance with, customer training activities, e.g. Centre’s of Excellence, Preceptorships, In-services, etc.

 Partnering with the Professional Education Managers of Global Surgery to develop and maintain associated KOL relationships as well as championing the effective use of our comprehensive Professional Education Offering.

 Working with the ETHICON marketing team to provide product management assistance and feedback as required.

 Collaboration with others (Business Managers, Commercial team, Marketing) etc.

 Identification and communication of timely and accurate market intelligence on key accounts.

 Keeping up to date on changing healthcare dynamics and trends on a national basis within the surgical market, and provide timely updates to Marketing Management, so that strategies can be developed and modified accordingly.

 
 To be part of this high performing team you will have great attention to detail, have strong verbal and written communication skill with an ability to confidently present complex information alongside
 A proven track record of high achievement and success. 

 3-5 Sales or new business development experience and high achievement in medical devices/pharmaceuticals in secondary care would be advantageous. 

 
 The successful candidate will be confident, ambitious, highly competitive yet customer centric, a good negotiator. Successful candidates will also have a strong affinity for working closely with others in a team and will show entrepreneurial behaviour. In addition, the ability to build strategic partnerships with key customers is essential.
   
 What We’re About 
 We are passionate about our work, and play vital roles across a range of professional disciplines, and care deeply about our customers and communities. At Johnson & Johnson our culture enables dynamic and impactful careers. We share a kind of DNA where we’re each:
 Committed to caring 

 Responsible to our communities 

 Ready to apply our knowledge and know-how 

 Rare in our background and experiences 

 The drivers of our own success 

 Passionate about doing what’s right 

   
 Make a unique mark in your career 
   
 If you want to be seen for the talent you bring to your work, be the driver of your own career, and work with others who share your real passion for caring and success, then we invite you to join the Johnson & Johnson Talent Community by visiting www.careers.jnj.com

title: Quantitative Campus Recruiter
description:
Overview 

 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together. 
  
 Our in-house campus recruiting team is expanding! We are looking for a Quantitative Recruiter to join our quant recruiting team at our European headquarters in Dublin. If you are an individual who is passionate about mathematical problem solving and building social connections, then we want to hear from you! 
  
 You will join a team of recruiters focused on hiring top-tier talent into Susquehanna’s Quantitative Research and Quantitative Systematic Trading internships and grad programmes. Beyond interviewing and hiring, you will assist with the running of our summer internship and use data to refine our recruiting processes and strategies. We are looking for an innovative problem solver who can leverage new tools and ideas to strengthen our brand recognition, diversify our recruiting efforts, and attract the best talent. 
   
 What you’ll do 
 Leverage your mathematical background while interviewing and assessing quantitative campus candidates by working through probability, statistics, and logic questions. 
 Find creative ways to scale our campus efforts and attract top talent from universities across Europe. 
 Build and maintain strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers, and interviewers throughout the hiring process. 
 Attend and facilitate careers fairs, campus events, and on-site events for our programmes. 
 Apply an analytical approach – leverage data to inform recruiting decisions and improve the hiring process. 
 Help onboard your hires and be involved in the running of the summer internship and graduate programmes. 
 
 What we're looking for 

 Bachelor’s degree in mathematics, engineering, physics, or computer science with coursework in probability, statistics, and combinatorics. 
 Experience with Excel preferred, but not essential. Basic programming experience also beneficial.    
 Strong appetite to learn how to interview students by using quantitative concepts. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 Strong sense of urgency and emotional intelligence. 
 Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills. 
   
 What’s in it for you: 
 Our culture enables you to drive meaningful impact, by leveraging your expertise and taking ownership. 
  
 Private healthcare and onsite gym, plus wellness initiatives. 
  
 Fully stocked kitchen, with daily breakfast and lunch. 
  
 Regular social, sporting and community events including annual poker tournament. 
 Matched donations and corporate discounts. 
  
 Seasonal opportunities to travel for recruiting events in Ireland, the UK and mainland Europe. 
   
 About Susquehanna 
 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm powered by scientific rigor, curiosity, and innovation. Our culture is intellectually driven and highly collaborative, bringing together researchers, engineers, and traders to design and deploy impactful strategies in our systematic trading environment. To meet the unique challenges of global markets, Susquehanna applies machine learning and advanced quantitative research to vast datasets in order to uncover actionable insights and build effective strategies. By uniting deep market expertise with cutting-edge technology, we excel in solving complex problems and pushing boundaries together.
   
 What we do 
 Susquehanna’s deep integration of trading, technology and quant research makes us experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives. We handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day as both a market maker and market taker. Our efforts provide liquidity and ensure competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialized to allow for a deep understanding of the unique drivers of each asset class.

title: QC Technical Transfer Analyst (3 Year FTC)
description:
Mylan Teoranta 
 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 

We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making.  

This posting supports ongoing hiring needs and may be used to consider candidates for upcoming opportunities. 
 
 
 
 Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach and better access to treatment. 
 
 For those driven to live their lives with purpose, Viatris helps employees realise their full potential by creating a collaborative culture that fosters courage and resilience. Viatris is more than just a place to work. This is a place to make a difference in the world. 
 
 
 The Role & What You Will Be Doing 
 As Quality Control (QC) Technical Transfer Analyst , you will support the delivery of 3-year commercialization program for a new cartridge-filling product line and will be primarily responsible for the transfer of advanced chromatographic and wet chemistry analysis of raw materials, finished product and stability product samples in support of new product introduction, and completing the relevant GMP documentation
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Quality Control (QC) Technical Transfer Analyst role will make an impact: 
 
 Lead new method transfers to the QC lab and drive the timely performance of complex analytical and chromatographic testing of raw materials, finished product, stability samples, for products being transferred from Product Development on site or from external sites.

 Source and procure all equipment, materials and consumables associated with product transfer methods in a timely manner to ensure analytical work can be executed in line with project plans and day 1 launches.

 Operate as the subject matter expert (SME) in the area of chromatography, and other areas related to analytical techniques, GMP execution, and become the point of contact for technical and troubleshooting assistance to the QC team.

 Liaise with cross functional teams such as analytical development, manufacturing and regulatory affairs to ensure method transfer deliverables are understood and communicated within the QC team.

 Co-ordinate and supervise laboratory investigations to ensure they are captured, documented and actioned with close out in an effective and timely manner.

 Take a senior analytical role within new projects, the analytical lead position, and drive the project towards timely and successful completion.

 Compilation of technical reports to support analytical transfers, laboratory investigations, qualifications, trend evaluations.

 Establish chromatography and wet chemistry training plans for QC analysts to ensure robust and compliant execution of analytical methods and to familiarize Quality reviewers with critical test method attributes.

 Management of QC SOPs, change controls, deviations and IRFs associated with New Product transfers activity in QC laboratory.

 Work closely with the stability program coordinator to ensure new products are placed on stability and that all elements of New Product test methods and specifications are in place for start of program

 
 About Your Skills & Experience 
 For this role, we’re looking for a candidate who has an effective combination of the following qualifications, skills and experiences:
 
 Minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in a Science related discipline ( Chemistry, Biochemistry or Analytical science) relevant industrial experience. Previous HPLC/GC/ peptide analysis experience in method validation / transfer (preferably with Empower software) is essential.

 Must possess strong working knowledge of chemistry / biochemistry (chromatographic, wet chemistry and peptide analysis) techniques.

 Strong technical trouble shooting and writing skills.

 Empower and other lab software systems.

 cGMP

 Computer skills (MS Office, Trackwise, Minitab).

 Excellent career progression opportunities

title: Associate (AI Builder), Growth & Transformation – Sales Strategy & Operations
description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.



Job Description

This role will be based in Dublin, Ireland.

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team. 

Are you a builder who gets a kick out of turning AI into working tools, and who can just as comfortably sit with a customer or a sales leader and talk about what their business needs? As an Associate on the Growth and Transformation (G&T) team, you will design, prototype and ship AI-powered tools and automations for our EMEAL & APAC LinkedIn Talent Solutions business, within the Sales Strategy and Operations team.

This role suits someone a few years into their career who is already hands-on with AI, whether that is building with large language models, agents and copilots or automating workflows end to end, and who wants to learn fast in a high-visibility environment. You will pair that technical curiosity with genuine business acumen: understanding how our sales teams and customers work, so that what you build solves real problems and gets adopted. You will help spot where AI can save time or unlock growth, build the first version, iterate with users and share what you learn.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design, prototype and ship AI-powered tools, such as LLM assistants, agents, copilots and workflow automations, that streamline sales and operations processes and lift sales productivity.
  • Spend time with sales teams and customers to understand how they work day to day, identify where AI and automation can remove friction, and turn those needs into clear, buildable requirements.
  • Communicate confidently with sales leaders, reps and customers, explaining what a tool does, why it matters and how it will change the way they work, in plain business language.
  • Test early versions with users, gather feedback, measure impact and refine, then support the rollout and adoption of new tools across the EMEA & LATAM region.
  • Use available data (Excel, dashboards and, where needed, SQL) to size opportunities, evaluate how tools are performing and tell the story of their impact to stakeholders.
  • Partner with the wider G&T team and global functions (product, technology, marketing and finance) to align on priorities and deliver projects that support LinkedIn’s growth.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in a technical, quantitative or business field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Business, etc.).
  • 4+ years in an analytical, technical or operational role (Engineering, Software Development, Analytics, Product, Sales Operations, Consulting, Business Strategy, etc..)
  • 1+ years hands-on experience building with AI: apps, skill files, prompting and integrating large language models, building agents or copilots, or automating workflows with tools such as Python, LLM APIs, Power Automate, Copilot Studio or similar.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience taking an AI or automation solution from idea to live use in a business setting, for example LLM integration, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows or evaluating model outputs.
  • Working knowledge of SQL.
  • Comfort with Python for scripting, data handling and rapid AI prototyping.
  • Experience building dashboards
  • Exposure to B2B SaaS, digital tech or the Talent/Learning ecosystem.
  • Ability to move between hands-on building and business conversations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage customers and business stakeholders, understand their needs and translate them into solutions.

Suggested Skills

  • Builder mindset: a bias for prototyping, testing and shipping, and the curiosity to pick up new AI tools quickly.
  • Business acumen: an understanding of how a sales organisation works and what customers value, and the confidence to hold a credible conversation with both.
  • Structured problem solving: breaking ambiguous business problems into clear, buildable requirements.
  • Clear communication: explaining technical work simply to non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative influence: working well across functions, taking feedback constructively and bringing people along.

Additional Information

Global Data Privacy Notice and Compliance Posters for Job Candidates

Please use this link to access documents that provide information about how LinkedIn handles the personal data of employees and job applicants, as well as the E-Verify Participation Notice and the Department of Justice Immigrant and Employee Rights Section Right to Work posters: https://www.linkedin.com/legal/candidate-portal.

description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com .
 
 As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
 
 
 Job Function: 
Technology Product & Platform Management 
 
 Job Sub Function: 
Technical Product Management 
 
 Job Category: 
Scientific/Technology 
 
 All Job Posting Locations: 
Latina, Italy, Leiden, South Holland, Netherlands, Ringaskiddy, Cork, Ireland 
 
 Job Description: 
 Job Description
 Functional Analyst – POM / MAKE  
 Transcend | Innovative Medicine 
 About Innovative Medicine  
 Our expertise in Innovative Medicine is informed and inspired by patients, whose insights fuel our science-based advancements. Visionaries like you work on teams that save lives by developing the medicines of tomorrow. Join us in developing treatments, finding cures, and pioneering the path from lab to life while championing patients every step of the way. 
 About Transcend  
 Transcend is a global business transformation program that will modernize our foundational transactional processes and harmonize them into one clean ERP as a standardized platform for growth and efficiency gains. 
 The program will simplify the Pharmaceutical ERP landscape from seven systems to one, standardizing processes to create a cost-effective, fit-for-purpose digital backbone that enables agility and scalability across the business. 
 Additionally, Transcend will remediate end-of-life system exposure expected toward the end of this decade, reducing risk while enabling long-term sustainability. 
 Role Purpose  
 The Functional Analyst – POM / MAKE supports the deployment of Manufacturing Execution–related capabilities within the Transcend SAP S/4HANA program. The role provides hands-on functional support across solution confirmation, testing, and deployment activities, ensuring Manufacturing solutions align with the global template, regulatory requirements, and SAP Clean Core principles. 
 Major Duties & Responsibilities  
 Functional Delivery & Execution  
 Support SAP–MES (PAS-X) integration activities, PLM-driven engineering change processes, master data validity checks, and Manufacture at Risk capabilities. 

 Assist with functional validation of Manufacturing master data, process orders, BOMs, master recipes, and production versions. 

 Support solution confirmation activities by documenting requirements, reviewing designs, and validating alignment with the global template. 

 Execute detailed functional tasks including configuration support, data validation, and integration readiness activities. 

 Testing, Deployment & Hypercare Support  
 Prepare and execute Business Simulation Testing and User Acceptance Testing activities under the guidance of the Functional Deployment Lead. 

 Support defect triage, resolution, and retesting activities. 

 Provide functional support during deployment and hypercare periods. 

 Qualifications  
 Required  
 University degree or equivalent experience in a relevant business, technical, or scientific discipline. 

 Hands-on functional experience within a regulated (GxP) environment. 

 Experience supporting ERP or digital transformation initiatives, preferably SAP S/4HANA. 

 Experience in the Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences industry. 

 Fluent in written and spoken English

 
 Preferred  
 Prior involvement in global ERP deployments.

 Experience with MES systems and SAP integration

 

 
 
  
  
 Required Skills: 
  
  
 Preferred Skills: 
Analytical Reasoning, Coaching, Communication, Cross-Functional Collaboration, Demand Forecasting, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Persistence and Tenacity, Product Costing, Product Development, Product Strategies, Quality Assurance (QA), Research and Development, Researching, Software Development Management, Technical Credibility, Technologically Savvy

title: Supply Scheduler
description:
Job Description : 
 Supply   Scheduler   

 Littleconnell Brewery,   Co.Kildare   

 Permanent   Contract     

 Closing Date:  21/09/2026 

   

   

 Join our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team.   
 

 With over 200 brands sold in   nearly 180   countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray,   Smirnoff   and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.   
 

 Bring your talent,   curiosity   and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge,   support   and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning,   improving   and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.   
 

 Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.   
 

 

 About the Role    
 

 As a Supply Scheduler,   you'll   play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient flow of brewing,   blending   and beer supply operations across our network. Working closely with brewery teams, packaging   sites   and supply chain partners,   you'll   translate production plans into achievable schedules that maximise service levels, optimise inventory and drive operational performance. This is an exciting opportunity to influence a sophisticated and growing beer portfolio while supporting capacity expansion and continuous improvement initiatives.   
 

 Develop and manage short-term brewing, blending and production schedules to meet demand and operational requirements   whilst balancing   customer service, inventory levels, asset   utilisation   and site constraints.   

 
 Maintain   accurate   stock visibility and reporting through SAP and planning systems.   

 
 Coordinate beer movements and tanker planning across breweries, packaging   sites   and third-party partners.   

 
 Support capacity planning activities and network expansion projects to enable future growth.   

 
 Drive continuous improvement by   identifying   opportunities to enhance planning processes,   systems   and ways of working.   

 
 Monitor key performance indicators and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver operational excellence and supply chain performance.   

 
 Work closely with stakeholders across other Diageo sites with close collaborati on with the wider team based in St James Gate.   

 

   

 
 About you     
 

 You'll be a highly organised planning professional with the ability to balance complex priorities, analyse data, and build strong relationships across a wide range of stakeholders. Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, you use insight and collaboration to develop effective plans, improve performance, and drive successful outcomes.   

 Proven experience developing and handling complex schedules across multiple constraints and stakeholders   

 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data,   identify   trends, diagnose issues, and support informed decision-making   

 
 Confident using planning and business systems, with the ability to investigate and resolve system-related issues   

 
 Experience monitoring KPIs and evaluating planning effectiveness to drive continuous improvement   

 
 Excellent stakeholder management skills, building trusted relationships across functions and organisational levels   

 
 Strong influencing and communication skills, with the ability to align diverse teams behind common objectives   

 
 Proactive and collaborative approach, able to drive execution and deliver results without direct authority over stakeholders   

 
   

 Working with us   
 

 Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you so that   you’re   supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.   
 

 Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And   it’s   our people, with their different experiences,   perspectives   and talents, who make that possible.   
 

 We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong,   contribute   and strive for their personal best.   You’ll   work alongside people with   different backgrounds ,   experiences   and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.   
 

 Together,   we’re   constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. 
 
 Wherever you join us,   you’ll   have the opportunity to contribute, make an   impact   and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.   
 

 Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity! 
 

 If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you   submit   your application.   
 

 Recruitment Scam Warning   

 Protecting candidates is   very important   to us. All communications   regarding   your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process,   we'll   never ask for money.

title: Senior Insurance Placement Broker
description:
Company: 
 Description: 
 Marsh Risk Placement Practice: 
 We have a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Broker to join our Dublin based Placement team. The successful applicant will work within Placement who are a dedicated team providing risk marketing support to our RMP, Corporate and Commercial business segments.
 This role will be based in our Dublin office and offers a hybrid working model, with 3 days in the office and 2 days remote.
 Please note, commercial insurance experience will be an essential prerequisite for this position, and the successful candidate must also be CIP qualified at a minimum. 
 
 This highly sought after position will involve working closely with Account Executives and Client teams plus other Marsh International and Specialty Broking teams.
 
 This is a superb opportunity to build upon a career in insurance with exposure to the full spectrum of Marsh clients across Industries and size.
 You will be required to work closely with Marsh colleagues on the implementation of placement strategy for client’s insurance programs. You will build and maintain strong relationships and develop strategic partnerships with key insurance carriers within the region, negotiate with insurers to achieve the best terms whilst delivering a first-class service for clients. 
 
 This position will suit an experienced Commercial or Corporate Insurance professional, ideally from a broking/wholesaling background, however, we will also consider candidates from Commercial / Corporate Underwriting backgrounds, where there is a desire to move into servicing and candidates can demonstrate a high level of relationship management skills. 
 
 What can you expect: 
 To be part of a company with a strong brand, a brilliant team, dealing with a fantastic client base and a vibrant and inclusive culture.
 You will gain the opportunity to excel and further your next career steps through interesting & challenging work, professional development opportunities and supportive leaders.
 Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.
 
 We will rely on you to: 
 Negotiate renewals and new business cases with the insurance market to obtain the best terms possible including complex or difficult cases.
 Understand the business needs, insurance requirements and risk management strategy of our clients and convey to insurers.
 Undertake appropriate research and analysis to select markets and where required assist in the design of insurance programmes to meet the client’s requirements.
 Provide recommendations and advice on placement strategy, programme structure and market conditions including occasional presentations to clients where appropriate.
 Provide regular updates to the Client Service teams on progress of insurer negotiations.
 Fully document all quotations received and advise the Client Servicing team of all conditions.
 Act as a referral point for the resolution of complex insurer queries.
 Host client and insurer meetings in partnership with the client service team as required.
 Support the Team Leader in management functions as required.
 Ensure operational and compliance procedures are followed and can be demonstrated at all times.
 Develop and maintain strong working relationships with insurers and seek feedback on Marsh’s service through ongoing dialogue.
 Working to and meeting tight deadlines for the delivery of insurance terms for clients/prospects.
 
 What you need to have: 
 Ambitious nature and a keen contributor within a team environment
 Articulate with strong client facing and stakeholder management abilities
 Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines
 Ability to maintain clear lines of communication with various internal and external stakeholders
 Accuracy with good attention to detail and ability to check work of self and others 
 Flexible and team player – develops close partnerships with onshore and offshore colleague
 Ability to identify areas to improve efficiency, accuracy and analysis and suggest ways of improvement
 Proficiency in Word and Excel
 
 What makes you stand out: 
 Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, be flexible and work as a team player
 Strong technical knowledge of P&C insurance products
 Ideally hold or be working towards the MDI /ACII qualifications. Must have a desire to undertake studies in industry related qualifications if not already qualified

description:
Career Category Manufacturing Job Description Manufacturing Process Technician – Inspection 
 Amgen Dun Laoghaire  
 
 Live  
 What you will do  
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. As part of Amgen’s Operations Organization, our Manufacturing Function continuously strives to be a differentiated leader in the manufacture of complex, high-quality therapeutics for our patients. 
 As a Manufacturing Process Technician, you will report into the Shift Manager. In this role, you will have responsibility for activities relating to the manufacture of sterile parenteral drugs.  
 The Amgen Manufacturing Site is a fast-paced and evolving environment, focused on continuous improvement of work processes and practices. Flexibility is key. You may be asked to carry out additional work functions, associated with the role, as designated by management, at times. 
 The successful candidate will be required to work a shift pattern.  
 
 Key Responsibilities  
 Set up of manufacturing equipment, processing of parts and components for manufacturing, performing transactions in electronic systems such as EBR, LIMS, etc. and cleaning and sanitization of production areas. 

 Perform duties with due care and in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Safety Regulations and Amgen requirements. 

 Problem solving and troubleshooting, including initiation and documentation of investigations. 

 Performance of self-inspection during Quality & Safety Audits. 

 Support Corporate, FDA, IMB Auditors and other regulatory bodies during company audits. 

 Participate in the learning and development program via the Maximizing Amgen Performance (MAP) process. 

 Support cross functional training across team members. 

 Ownership for the use, review, revision and upgrade of operational documentation and peer review of operations. 

 Play a key role in the development of manufacturing systems 

 Proactively identify operational improvement and continuous improvement opportunities and / or process related issues including escalation & follow up for effective resolution and implementation. 

 Champion safe working practices and safety initiatives. 

 Sampling, testing and inspections as required. 

 
 
 Win  
 What we expect of you  
 The successful candidate for this role will bring the following education, skills and experience 
 Pass Leaving Certificate standard or equivalent - required 

 A third level qualification in a relevant subject area - preferred 

 Minimum 12 months experience of operations within a sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing or similar environment  OR  Minimum 2 years of experience in a GMP and / or equivalent regulated environment. 

 Demonstrated knowledge of GMP principles and aseptic knowledge within GMP areas. Aspectic experience preferred. 

 Drug product manufacturing experience. 

 Experience working with equipment utilized in the manufacture of parenteral products such as autoclaves, filling lines and formulation vessels. 

 Demonstrated understanding and use of Right First Time (RFT) techniques and lean manufacturing concepts. 

 Demonstrated mechanical aptitude 

 Excellent problem-solving and communication skills 

 Experience working in Grade A/B area in Graded Aseptic Areas. 

 Proactive and results-focused with excellent organizational skills. 

 Team player with a demonstrated ability to work effectively with colleagues and peers in a cross functional environment 

 Proven ability to deliver to personal, team and site objectives. 

 Fluent written and spoken English required 

 
 Thrive  
 
 What you can expect of us   
 In addition to a competitive salary structure, Amgen offers a generous Total Rewards Plan for staff and eligible dependents. Comprehensive employee benefits package, including retirement and savings plan with generous company contributions, group medical, life and disability insurance. Discretionary annual bonus program. Exceptional learning, development and career advancement opportunities, empowering employees to grow and build long-term careers. At Amgen, we are committed to nurturing talent and providing meaningful pathways for professional development. 
 
 Amgen is an equal opportunities employer

title: RF Power Engineer - R&D
description:
Work Flexibility: Hybrid or Onsite 
 
 RF Power Engineer R&D 
 
 Who we want: 
 User-focused creators. People who imagine with the user in mind, developing technology that helps change patients’ lives.
 Motivated product launchers. People who bring strategic direction and drive for execution to ensure products are developed and launched with precision.
 Analytical problem solvers. People who go beyond, by identifying root causes, evaluating optimal solutions, and recommending comprehensive solutions to prevent future issues.
 
 What you will do: 
 
 Design, develop, refine and evaluate electrical components, assemblies and sub-systems for electrosurgery medical devices
 Lead the design and implementation of high-energy electrical sub-systems for patient-connected medical devices
 Translate user, clinical and system-level needs into electrical requirements, specifications and system-level designs
 Apply concurrent engineering, advanced prototyping and test methods to reduce product time to market while meeting project, cost and compliance requirements
 Mentor and train team members on technical aspects of product commercialisation, design trade-offs, technology exploration and complex product design issues
 Contribute to voice of customer, customer-centric design, competitive strategy and market understanding in partnership with internal and external stakeholders
 Lead or contribute to engineering documentation, Design History File content, R&D procedures and standards-based development activities
 
 Key Skills: 
 
 Advanced electrical design capability across complex components and electronic subsystems within medical device systems and platforms.
 Deep expertise in power electronic systems operating from hundreds of kHz to low MHz frequencies, including resonant/quasi-resonant topologies, custom magnetics, and design of HV DC/DC converters and power amplifiers
 Strong understanding of RF, electromagnetics, EMC, measurement, sensing and control interfaces, including work in high dv/dt and high common-mode noise environments
 Ability to guide testing, troubleshooting, PCB/cable design, electrical stackups, statistical methods and manufacturing/test methods
 Knowledge of applicable medical device standards, risk management, insulation diagrams, essential performance, MOOP/MOPP, PEMS/PESS and standards-based testing
 Experience with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent tools, dynamic modelling, control algorithms, PID controllers and other control topologies
 
 What you need: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline and 6+ years’ relevant experience
 Direct, hands-on experience designing custom magnetics, including high-frequency isolation transformers
 Experience providing technical guidance to electrical engineers and influencing cross-functional technical teams

description:
About the Team 
 Lightspeed is Citi's flagship CI/CD platform used daily by 10,000+ engineers across the bank. Built using Citi technology and open-source components, it supports the engineering teams delivering technology at scale.
 You’ll join a collaborative UI chapter working on a clean, well-maintained codebase, building the next generation of user experiences for dashboards, pipeline visualisations and configuration editors.
 We value ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement, with AI-assisted development tools forming part of our engineering workflow.
 
 The Role We’re looking for a UI Developer to help build and evolve the user-facing experience of Lightspeed.
 You’ll work across modern Angular and React applications, solving complex engineering challenges and delivering intuitive, reliable interfaces. This is an opportunity to work on a platform used by thousands of engineers, contribute to meaningful technical improvements and develop your expertise within a supportive engineering team.
 You’ll work closely with developers, Product and Design in a hands-on environment where asking questions, sharing ideas and understanding the code you deliver are encouraged.
 
 Key Responsibilities Build, enhance and maintain high-quality UI solutions across Lightspeed, working through a Kanban-based delivery model.
 Develop user-facing features including dashboards, pipeline visualisations and configuration editors.
 Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code across complex frontend applications.
 Work with users and engineering colleagues to diagnose issues and deliver effective solutions.
 Contribute to technical improvements across performance, usability, architecture and code quality.
 Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, ensuring you understand, validate and test the code you deliver.
 Stay curious about emerging technologies and contribute ideas that improve the platform and how the team works.
 Collaborate with Product, Design and Engineering to deliver solutions that meet user and business needs.
 
 Key Skills & Experience Strong professional experience in frontend/UI development, with solid software engineering fundamentals and confidence working in complex codebases.
 Strong hands-on Angular experience, including modern Angular (v18+). The Lightspeed application currently runs on Angular v21.
 Good experience with React (v18+), including hooks, context and state management.
 Strong TypeScript skills, including strict typing and modern development practices.
 Proficiency in HTML5, CSS3 and responsive design, including Flexbox and Grid.
 Experience with Git, including branching, pull requests, rebasing and code review workflows.
 Practical experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests, using tools such as Jest, Karma, Cypress or Playwright.
 Experience integrating with REST APIs.
 Practical experience using AI coding assistants such as Devin, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Cursor 
 Understanding of clean code, SOLID principles and separation of concerns.
 Comfortable working in a Kanban, continuous-delivery environment and collaborating across Product, Design and Engineering.
 Strong communication skills and a willingness to ask questions, share ideas and continuously improve.
 Good working English, both written and spoken.
 
 Additional Experience (Valued, Not Essential) 
 Exposure to CI/CD platforms or developer tooling, such as Tekton, Jenkins, Harness or TeamCity.
 Experience with design systems, shared component libraries or frontend architecture patterns such as Nx.
 Background working in enterprise technology, financial services or regulated environments.

 By joining Citi Dubli n , you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed ) and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits that support you (and your family) to be well, live well and save well. title: Device Equipment Engineer
description:
McDermott Laboratories Limited 
 Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. 
 
 We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. 
 
 Our global portfolio includes best-in-class, iconic brand-name products as well as global key brands; generics, including branded and complex generics; and other offerings across a wide range of therapeutic areas. We are committed to helping create healthier communities worldwide through education, outreach and better access to treatment.
  
 Our Global Device Development organization is an innovative, technically strong, and fully integrated team focused on delivering high-quality, safe, and effective device and combination products to meet evolving patient healthcare needs worldwide. It provides leadership, strategic oversight, direction, support, and hands-on training for medical devices and combination products.
  
 The Device Equipment Engineer will act as the technical owner for assigned equipment workstreams, responsible for supporting specification development, supplier engagement, commissioning, qualification and transfer activities from concept through implementation. Working closely with suppliers, CMOs and cross-functional stakeholders, the successful candidate will execute equipment projects in support of GDD program delivery, ensuring solutions meet specification, quality and timeline requirements.
  
 This global role provides exposure to the full product lifecycle, from development through commercialization, while offering an opportunity to develop advanced technical, project execution and leadership skills within the engineering organization.
  
 Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Device Equipment Engineer role will make an impact:
  
 Key responsibilities for this role include:
  
 Provide Equipment ownership from specification development through delivery, commissioning, qualification and transfer to manufacturing, including equipment specification development and supplier interactions for device program activities.
 Support engineering projects through the development, specification, procurement, commissioning, qualification and transfer of manufacturing equipment and associated systems.
 Develop and implement engineering solutions that meet product and process requirements across device programs, including manufacturing processes, equipment specifications and automation solutions supporting product performance and quality requirements.
 Execute equipment and process development, characterization and testing activities, including process development, process characterization, scale-up and technology transfer activities.
 Execute and own equipment commissioning, qualification and verification activities, including URS, DQ, FMEA, IQ, OQ, PQ, FAT and SAT, from specification through implementation and transfer to manufacturing.
 Lead technical project execution activities associated with external suppliers, equipment manufacturers, Viatris affiliates and CMOs, including assembly, label and pack, supplier and CMO meetings, equipment reviews and project milestones.
 Participate in and support cross-functional project teams, working with manufacturing, quality, validation, supply chain and site engineering teams to execute engineering systems objectives in line with program delivery plans.
 Provide technical input and engineering documentation, including technical reviews, engineering reports, specifications, protocols, risk assessments, change controls and engineering assessments, together with accurate engineering reporting and project status updates.
 Support engineering risk assessments, troubleshooting and investigations, including equipment and manufacturing process issues, change control impact assessments, problem-solving activities, risk management and mitigation, process control alignment and mitigation activities.
 Support technology transfer, site integration and lifecycle activities, including coordination with site engineering teams, technical support to manufacturing sites and external partners, and continuous improvement of quality system processes associated with device development and lifecycle management.
 Support engineering operations and continuous improvement, including budget forecasting, invoice management, purchase order generation, Work Orders and CDAs, data analysis and performance monitoring, while developing technical and project management competencies through increasingly complex engineering projects and cross-functional collaboration.
 The minimum qualifications for this role are:  
  
 Degree in Engineering, Science or equivalent technical discipline.
 3 – 5 years' experience in pharmaceutical, medical device, combination product, automation or related engineering environments.
 Demonstrated experience supporting engineering projects and equipment implementation activities.
 Strong technical documentation and report writing skills within a regulated environment.
 Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams.
 Enthusiastic, motivated and self-directed approach to problem solving.
 Attention to detail and systematic approach to execution of engineering activities.
 Desirable to have experience working with equipment suppliers, CMOs or contract engineering organizations.

 Experience supporting medical device, combination product or pharmaceutical development projects.

title: IT Developer
description:
IT Developer – Private Equity Technology (Dublin) 
 About Citco 
 Armed with superior services, smart people, and strong technology, we tackle our customers’ complicated challenges by developing sophisticated solutions driven directly by their demands. The result? Innovation that generates tangible value and makes a real difference for our clients and their companies. 
  
 About the Team & Business Line 
 Proprietary software solutions and innovation are at the core of what differentiates Citco in the alternative investment space. Through our network of global development centres, Citco invests heavily in technology development, security, and infrastructure to ensure our clients continue to receive award-winning products that underpin our commitment to service excellence. 
 Private Equity IT develops and supports strategic applications across fund accounting, reporting, workflow automation, data integration, cloud services and financial calculations. Our teams work across multiple products and projects, providing broad business and technical exposure while delivering the reliability, scalability and security expected of enterprise financial systems. 
 We are looking for a software engineer who combines strong technical foundations with an enthusiasm to learn and contribute to architecture, software development, technical design and production support while delivering exceptional value to our Private Equity business partners.  
 Our engineers work across multiple products, technologies and initiatives supporting Citco's Private Equity business. This provides excellent opportunities to develop technical breadth while gaining exposure to real-world financial systems operating at global scale. 
 The position is based in our development center in Dublin and may require some international travel to other CITCO locations.   
 About You :  
 You are an enthusiastic software engineer with approximately 2+ years of software development experience who enjoys solving problems, learning new technologies and working collaboratively as part of a high-performing engineering team. You are curious about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted software development, and are committed to continuously improving your technical and professional skills while delivering quality solutions. 

 Key Responsibilities 
 Participate in the design, development, testing and support of enterprise software solutions. 

 Work closely with developers, business analysts, QA engineers and product stakeholders to deliver business value. 

 Contribute to code reviews and technical discussions while learning from more experienced engineers. 

 Assist with troubleshooting production issues and identifying opportunities for system improvements. 

 Utilize modern software engineering tools and practices to improve development efficiency and software quality. 

 Contribute to the documentation of solutions, technical designs and operational processes. 

  
 Required Skills 
 2+ years of professional hands-on experience participating in the design, development, testing and support of software applications. 

 Demonstrated enthusiasm for continuous learning and staying current with evolving software engineering practices, tools and technologies 

 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, AWS Q, Kiro or equivalent tools to improve productivity,  software quality and delivery outcomes. 

 Understanding of the importance of validating and testing AI-generated code before deployment. 

 Interest in emerging technologies including LLMs, Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions. 

 Appreciation of software security, privacy and responsible AI practices. 

 Understanding of object-oriented design principles and software engineering best practices. 

 Familiarity with automated testing approaches including unit and integration testing. 

 Experience working with source control systems such as Git / Bitbucket. 

 Ability to design maintainable, readable and supportable code. 

 Understanding of REST API design principles. 

 Strong hands-on experience with Python, Node and / or C#  

 Practical experience with React 

 Experience with SQL Server, Postgres or similar DB technology 

  
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Exposure to AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, etc.) 

 Experience with CI/CD pipelines 

 Experience working in financial services is advantageous. 

 Exposure to alternative investments, fund administration or accounting platforms is beneficial but not required. 

  
 Soft Skills 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills. 

 Comfortable explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. 

 Comfortable working collaboratively through code reviews, design discussions and knowledge sharing with other engineers. 

 Demonstrates initiative, curiosity and a willingness to ask questions and learn. 

 Able to receive and act on feedback constructively. 

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. 

 Demonstrates ownership and accountability for assigned work.  

 What Success Looks Like 
 Within your first 12 months you will 
 Become a productive contributor within one or more Private Equity technology teams. 

 Deliver high-quality software enhancements through collaboration with senior engineers. 

 Demonstrate effective use of modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development technologies where appropriate. 

 Build a strong understanding of Citco's development practices, technology platforms and business domain. 

 Contribute to the design and implementation of cloud-native solutions. 

 Develop meaningful relationships with colleagues across development, QA, infrastructure and business teams. 

 Establish a reputation for quality, reliability, collaboration and continuous learning. 
  

 
 The successful candidate will be collaborative, self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-paced global environment. They will enjoy solving complex problems, building strong relationships across teams and helping others succeed. They will combine initiative, sound judgement and a strong sense of ownership with a commitment to engineering excellence.

title: Ready to Hire Evaluation Analyst, Data center learning
description:
Are you curious about what makes talent programs truly effective? The Amazon Web Services (AWS) Data Center Learning (DCL) team is looking for a Ready to Hire Evaluation Analyst to join our growing evaluation team within Learning Operations. In this role, you will assess the effectiveness of Data Center Learning programs across multiple geographies, turning raw data into actionable insights that shape where we invest and how we grow our data center workforce. This is a new and rapidly expanding area for DCL — and your work will shift the organization from measuring activity volume to measuring real impact and conversion rates. You will partner with colleagues across the builder readiness continuum, customer success, and Talent Acquisition (TA) teams to ensure our programs are preparing the right candidates for our data centers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the end-to-end evaluation program for Data Center Learning programs, defining success metrics, tracking progress, and delivering detailed analysis reports that recommend where to invest across geographies.
- Baseline current program performance, identify gaps, and surface data-driven recommendations to stakeholders who define pipeline identification strategies, proactively mitigating risks to program timelines and outcomes.
- Use Amazon's internal analytics tools and generative AI capabilities to build insights, automate reporting, and continuously improve evaluation methods.
- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including customer success, TA, and builder readiness teams to align evaluation findings with broader workforce development goals and drive measurable improvements in conversion rates.
- Communicate findings and trade-off recommendations clearly to program leaders and senior stakeholders, clearing blockers and driving timely decisions that keep improvement efforts on track.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing the latest data from ongoing program evaluations, identifying trends and areas that need attention. From there, you will move into collaborative sessions with TA partners and builder readiness stakeholders to discuss findings and align on next steps. Much of your week balances independent, heads-down analysis work with cross-team meetings where you present recommendations and help shape investment decisions. You operate proactively, setting the evaluation roadmap rather than reacting to requests, and you have the autonomy to define what good performance looks like for the programs you assess.

About the team
The Data Center Learning team sits within AWS Infrastructure Services and is dedicated to developing a world-class data center workforce. We create learning experiences for new hires, build career development paths to grow internal talent, and experiment with new technology to improve how adults learn in a data center environment. Our evaluation function is young and growing fast — you will help shape a capability that is rare across the industry and central to how we prove and improve the value of our programs. Join the world-class safety culture at Amazon Web Services (AWS) and be part of building the foundation of a new safety framework across EMEA. As the Construction Safety Manager – New Sites & Regions (EMEA), you will play a pivotal role in establishing and scaling the Health and Safety function for new data center sites and regions across EMEA, working at the forefront of AWS's most ambitious infrastructure expansion efforts.

This is a ground-floor opportunity to architect a safety framework from scratch. You will be the critical link between Pre-Construction and Construction teams, ensuring that Health & Safety is embedded into every phase of site and regional expansion — from site selection through to handover. As AWS expands into new sites and regions, new General Contractors (GCs) are being onboarded with limited safety infrastructure in place. You will be the driving force behind building the pipelines, programs, and resources needed to bring these GCs up to AWS's world-class safety standards, regardless of where in EMEA that site sits.

You will work closely with experts in construction management, senior leadership, operations, corporate counsel, and human resources to build and deliver a robust, scalable safety program that works for both established and entirely new markets. You must be an effective communicator — sending clear, concise, and consistent messages verbally, in written form, and in public speaking forums. The right candidate must be equally comfortable in the field and in the boardroom — influencing without authority, building from scratch, and communicating clearly at all organisational levels. You will report to the Regional H&S Manager (EMEA DCPD) and will be responsible for creating lasting safety infrastructure that protects our people and enables rapid, safe growth across new sites and regions. Some domestic and international travel is required.

Key job responsibilities
Key Job Responsibilities

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service. 

 About the Role 
 
 The HR Advisor acts as a trusted consultant to managers and employees, providing HR guidance and support across EMEA. The role partners closely with leaders to ensure the effective application of HR policies, procedures, and programs while supporting business objectives and mitigating people-related risk.
 Working collaboratively with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and other Centres of Excellence, the HR Advisor helps deliver practical HR solutions, supports employee relations matters, and promotes a positive employee experience. The role requires strong judgement, employment law knowledge, and the ability to manage sensitive and complex situations with professionalism and discretion.
 
 Key Responsibilities Partner with managers and employees on a broad range of HR and employee relations matters.
 Provide guidance on performance management, disciplinary matters, grievances, workplace investigations, and dispute resolution.
 Support organisational change initiatives and advise on the people impacts of business decisions.
 Interpret and apply employment legislation, company policies, and HR programs to ensure compliance and mitigate risk.
 Act as a liaison between managers, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, and other HR functions to ensure a coordinated approach to people matters.
 Support the delivery and implementation of HR initiatives, including performance management, talent development, employee engagement, and workforce planning.
 Coach and advise managers on best practices to foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing culture.
 Partner with Talent Acquisition to support workforce needs and maintain a strong and diverse talent pipeline.
 Participate in HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance processes, efficiency, and employee experience.
 Handle highly sensitive and confidential information with integrity and discretion.
 
 Skills & Experience 
 Experience in an HR Advisory, Employee Relations, HR Business Partnering, or HR Consulting role.
 Strong knowledge of employment law and associated people-related risk.
 Experience advising managers on employee relations matters, policy interpretation, and performance management.
 Ability to manage complex and sensitive employee issues while balancing business and employee needs.
 Experience supporting stakeholders across multiple countries or jurisdictions is advantageous.
 Proven ability to build effective relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
 Degree qualification and/or relevant HR certification preferred.
 
 Valuable Competencies 
 Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Sound judgement and problem-solving capability.
 Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
 Collaborative and team-oriented approach.
 Proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
 High level of integrity, discretion, and professionalism.
 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

 Role Overview 
 The Operational Resilience Risk Specialist serves as a senior subject matter expert within the Operational Risk Management function, providing independent second-line oversight and challenge of the organization's Operational Resilience, Business Continuity (BC), and Disaster Recovery (DR) programs. 
 The role is responsible for assessing and monitoring resilience risks, evaluating the effectiveness of resilience controls and governance processes, and providing credible challenge to business and technology stakeholders. The position supports the organization's ability to prevent, respond to, recover from, and learn from disruption events while ensuring compliance with regulatory expectations and enterprise risk management requirements. 
 The successful candidate will partner with business units, technology teams, and resilience program owners to strengthen resilience capabilities, review resilience risk assessments, evaluate continuity and recovery preparedness, and provide reporting and insight to senior management and risk governance forums.

title: Quality Engineer I
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
 A Day in the Life At our Quality Department in Medtronic, plc, we focus on supporting the product value stream to ensure that customer and patient needs are met every day. Our key focus is on delivering and maintaining a high level of Quality to ensure that business and performance goals are achieved. The Quality Engineer role is critical in supporting key department metrics thus contributing to the global strategy and to deliver on our mission to contribute to human welfare by supporting the manufacture of products that alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.
 Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
 Supports the development, modification, application and maintenance of quality standards and procedures for manufacturing processes and finished products.
 Works collaboratively with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality teams to ensure compliance with quality system requirements.
 Collaborate with required stakeholders in the receive inspection function and across functions ensuring incoming materials and components meet defined specifications and regulatory requirements.
 Assists in implementing and maintaining product control measures to ensure product quality and patient safety.
 Reviews quality data, identifies trends and supports problem-solving activities to address quality issues.
 Supports inspection and testing activities and assists in the analysis of product and process performance.
 Applies and implements methods and procedures for inspecting, testing, and evaluating the precision and accuracy of raw materials and test equipment
 Ensure quality records and documentation are completed accurately and maintained in compliance with applicable regulatory and internal requirements.
 Participate in preparing and facilitating investigations, providing QA technical direction and solutions as appropriate.
 Contributes to continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality, process effectiveness and operational performance.
 Supporting internal and external audits (BSI/MDSAP/FDA etc.).
   
  
 Key Skills & Experience 
 Level 8 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or technical field
 Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to apply a risk-based approach to quality issues.
 A dynamic team player and leader with the ability to work effectively and proactively on cross-functional teams with a high level of enthusiasm and motivation while developing technical and quality engineering knowledge.
 Strong communication, organisational and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver work within established timelines.
 Demonstrated critical thinking skills and ability to independently plan and schedule activities.
 Experience or knowledge of quality systems, equipment IQ/OQ/PQ, validation activities or regulated industries is advantageous.
 Experience with Agile, SAP and/or SAP ME would be beneficial.
 Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  
 
 
 Physical Job Requirements 

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 
 
 ‌
 ‌
