Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a 12 month fixed term contract position.

Location: Dublin / Greater Dublin. Proximity to our Dublin city centre offices in D2. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly organised, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative and operational support to our CEO & COO executives. This role requires exceptional judgment, the ability to manage sensitive information, and the agility to pivot quickly in a high-growth environment. The right candidate will be a strategic partner helping to anticipate needs, streamline operations, and ensure our executive leaders can focus on driving growth and operational excellence.

What you will be doing:

  • Executive Support: Oversee CEO and COO level engagements, calendar management, and complex travel coordination.
  • Board & Governance: Manage end to end logistics, agenda planning, and material preparation for Board meetings.
  • Cross Functional Coordination: Juggle and prioritise multiple streams of work originating from various internal teams to keep the CEO and COO office running smoothly.
  • Executive Team Rhythm: Own the cadence, scheduling, and operational rigour of all Executive Leadership Team meetings. Drive agenda planning, track action items, and ensure accountability across the leadership team.
  • Event Coordination: Provide administrative and logistical support for key company events and leadership gatherings across.

What you bring with you:

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment: Not everything comes with a playbook. Is able to apply good judgment and move forward confidently when the path isn't fully mapped out.
  • Resilience: Experienced in dynamic, evolving environments where flexibility and resilience are part of everyday work.

title: Exposure Analysis and Identification Management Analyst
description:
Job Description: 
 Job Title: Exposure Analysis and Identification Management Analyst 
 Corporate Title: Up to Vice President  
 Location:  Chester or Dublin 
   
 Company Overview : 
   
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. 
   
 Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth.  This includes our commitment to being a diverse and inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve. 
   
 At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.  Join us! 
   
 Location Overview: 
   
 Chester 
   
 Find us in the city of Chester, a destination renowned for its culture, history, and beauty. Working at Bank of America Chester offers a far-reaching global career for a world-renowned organisation, whilst being ideally situated against the backdrop of the rolling North Wales hills and the banks of the serene River Dee. 
   
 Central Park 
   
 Overlooking the spectacular Iveagh Gardens with access to all amenities in the beating heart of central Dublin is our Park Place office. Travel options include the LUAS, Dublin Bus networks as well as the Dublin Bikes station, positioned just outside our front doors. As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier 
   
 Role Description: 
   
 This role will be dedicated to the overall Exposure Analysis and Identification team within EMEA with the role being split between Exposure Analysis and Attack Surface Research. 

 The Exposure Analysis (EA) team is a global function responsible for the evaluation and prioritization of security vulnerabilities and exposures to enable appropriate remediation across the company. This individual contributor role will join a team of Exposure analysts around the globe who support Exposure management activities by leveraging analytic and technical skills to assess cyber security related risks. 

 The Attack Surface Research (ASR) role maintains and performs queries across a wide array of asset enumeration and research toolsets, spanning on-premises and cloud platforms, to effectively map, measure, and report on the topography of the Bank’s network endpoints and other assets for exposure risk. 
 The role requires a highly collaborative, analytical and detail-oriented mindset, with a focus on ensuring conclusions and/or insights reflect innovative thinking as well as accurate information gathering under time pressure to fully answer three core questions as quickly as possible. 
   
 Do we have it? 
 Are we vulnerable? 
 Is it exploitable? 
   
 Persons in this role operate as part of a team developing methods to quickly reference systems of record (SORs), systems of origin (SOOs) and other available data stores to provide a comprehensive, reliable and timely view of the Bank’s Attack Surface, both as it relates to exposure exploitation risk as well as other concerns. 
   
 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

 Exposure Analysis: 

 •        Analyse and triage disclosed exposures, vulnerabilities, threat scenarios, and mitigating controls from a number of workstreams.
 •        Research and evaluate threats and vulnerabilities to assist in prioritization of remediation actions.

Job Description: 
 Job Title: Global Financial Crimes Specialist – MLRO Support
 Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President / Vice President
 Location: Dublin
 
 Company Overview: 
 
 At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection.  Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
 
 One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world.  We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone.  We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
 
 Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees.  We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
 
 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
 
 Location Overview: 
 
Overlooking the spectacular Iveagh Gardens with access to all amenities in the beating heart of central Dublin is our Park Place office. Travel options include the LUAS, Dublin Bus networks as well as the Dublin Bikes station, positioned just outside our front doors. As part of our commitment to supporting staff travel to and from work in the most sustainable way possible, we also provide tax saver tickets as part of our award-winning benefits package which means getting to work has never been easier.
 
 Role Description 
 
 This role is responsible for supporting Global Financial Crimes (GFC) in submitting Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs), through the review of Activity Intelligence Reports (AIRs), preparation of SAR narratives, and quality review of SAR narratives for submission to Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs).
 
 The successful candidate will act as a key partner to MLROs and investigative teams, ensuring SAR narratives clearly articulate suspicious activity, are factually accurate, and comply with applicable regulatory, legal and policy requirements. The role requires the ability to review complex financial crime investigations, assess investigative findings, and communicate conclusions effectively through concise, high-quality written narratives.
 
 Key responsibilities include maintaining adherence to strict regulatory and internal service level agreements, identifying potential quality concerns, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to the effective mitigation of financial crime risk across multiple jurisdictions.
 
 Responsibilities: 
 Draft clear, accurate, and comprehensive SAR narratives that effectively communicate suspicious activity, financial crime typologies, customer behaviour, transactional activity, and investigative findings.

 Perform quality reviews of draft SAR narratives to ensure adherence to regulatory requirements, internal standards, and jurisdiction-specific reporting expectations.

 Partner closely with Money Laundering Reporting Officers (MLROs) to support regulatory reporting decisions and facilitate timely filing of SARs with applicable Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs).

 Challenge and provide feedback on AIR quality, investigative findings, and narrative completeness where additional information or clarification is required.

 Ensure all assigned work is completed within established regulatory and internal service level agreements while maintaining high quality standards.

 Identify trends, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to enhance narrative consistency, investigative outputs, and reporting effectiveness.

 Support governance, quality assurance, and continuous improvement initiatives related to SAR reporting and financial crime investigations.

 Escalate risks, issues, and emerging financial crime concerns through appropriate governance channels.

 Maintain current knowledge of applicable AML regulations, financial crime typologies, and jurisdiction-specific SAR reporting requirements.

 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

 Demonstrable Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crimes, investigations, compliance, intelligence, or sanctions experience.

 Experience reviewing investigations, AIRs, case documentation, or regulatory reporting submissions.

 Excellent written communication skills with the ability to translate complex investigative findings into concise and effective regulatory narratives.

 Experience interpreting financial crime typologies and identifying suspicious activity indicators.

 Ability to analyse large volumes of information and exercise sound judgement in a risk-based environment

 Proven stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with investigators, MLROs, compliance partners, and senior stakeholders.

 
 Desired Qualifications 
 ACAMS, ICA, or equivalent financial crime certification.

 Experience drafting or reviewing Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs).

 Knowledge of global financial crimes regulations and international reporting requirements.

 Experience working with Financial Intelligence Units (FIUs), regulatory reporting teams, or MLRO functions.

 Knowledge of global banking products, transaction flows, and associated financial crime risks.

title: Quantitative Strategist
description:
Virtu is a leading financial firm that leverages cutting edge technology to deliver liquidity to the global markets and innovative, transparent trading solutions to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide 

The firm’s complementary core offerings—market making, client execution services, and trading venues—give Virtu a competitive advantage in developing and applying innovative tools that deliver efficiencies and performance across the organization. 

THE ROLE

As a Quant at Virtu, you will be working on interdisciplinary teams alongside traders, quants and seasoned software engineers.  The environment is collegiate and collaborative, encouraging exposure to many teams across the globe. 

  • Apply your observation skills and modern statistical methods to identify and build predictive models
  • Research and implement new trading strategies
  • Analyze existing strategies to identify potential improvements
  • Develop risk models and frameworks to manage portfolio risks
  • Create tools to automate research tasks and improve visualization of complex data sets

THE CANDIDATE

  • PhD in Science, Math, Engineering or other quantitative field
  • History of diverse, challenging, and interesting coursework paired with a strong grades
  • Exceptional quantitative, mathematical, and problem-solving skills
  • Great communication skills and the ability to collaborate with peers
  • Ability to solve technical and or quantitative problems under pressure
  • Ability to express ideas mathematically and algorithmically
  • Programming skills (strong in Python and/or C/C++ but comfortable in both)
  • Intellectually curious and self-motivated Ability to communicate within and across teams, at a high and low level, on both technical and non-technical subjects
  • Ability to seek guidance and learn new skills from peers
  • Extraordinary mental flexibility and a high tolerance for ambiguity
  • Strong drive for success within a collaborative team

BENEFITS

  • Generous Time Off: 26 days annual leave, plus additional leave for community service, marriage/civil partnerships, and moving house
  • Family Support: Paid maternity leave and enhanced paternity leave
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellbeing: Private health, dental, and optical cover, GP access, and a dedicated wellness programme
  • Financial Protection: Life assurance, income protection, and a competitive pension scheme
  • Active Lifestyle Perks: Gym subsidy/fitness reimbursement and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Commuting Made Easy: Commuter benefit plan
  • Travel Cover: Personal travel insurance
  • Daily Perks: Catered lunches, fully stocked kitchen, laundry service, onsite gym, yoga and HIIT classes, barber, and hairdresser service

THE PROCESS

After passing an application screening, candidates will be sent an online programming test via email from a service called HackerRank as a first step of the process. 
 

Virtu Financial is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, welcoming you for who you are and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. 

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

Tines is looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially minded Legal Counsel to join our growing global Legal team. This is a remote role based in Ireland, with occasional travel to Dublin and other Tines locations.

Reporting to the Head of Legal, you will be a key legal partner to our global Sales organization, supporting commercial transactions across EMEA and the United States. You will work closely with the existing Legal team, Sales leaders, Sales teams, Deal Desk, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance, and Security.

This is a commercial, sales-driven role. You will independently lead customer negotiations, provide practical and timely advice, and help the business close deals while appropriately managing legal risk.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead negotiations for customer agreements across EMEA and the United States, including SaaS agreements, software licensing terms, DPAs, security terms, SOWs, NDAs, and related commercial documents.
  • Partner closely with Sales leaders, Sales teams, and Deal Desk to support transactions from initial review through signature.
  • Provide practical, risk-based advice that helps the business reach workable outcomes and move deals forward.
  • Advise on liability, indemnification, intellectual property, privacy, security, service commitments, and other commercial issues.
  • Review and negotiate reseller, referral, integration, technology alliance, and other partner agreements.
  • Collaborate with Finance, Security, Customer Success, Product, and other teams on commercial and customer matters.
  • Develop and maintain templates, playbooks, fallback positions, and Sales enablement materials.
  • Help improve and scale contracting processes as Tines’ global sales organization grows.
  • Support broader Legal team initiatives as needed.

What You Will Bring

  • 5–8 years of relevant legal experience, including 3–5 years’ post-qualification experience.
  • Qualification as a solicitor or lawyer in Ireland, England and Wales, or another relevant EU jurisdiction.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating commercial technology agreements.
  • Experience directly supporting Sales teams and managing customer negotiations.
  • A strong understanding of the legal issues affecting SaaS and software transactions.
  • Excellent commercial judgment and a pragmatic, solutions-oriented approach.
  • The ability to distinguish material legal risks from issues that can be resolved through practical compromise.
  • The ability to manage multiple negotiations and deliver high-quality work in a fast-moving environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Comfort operating autonomously within a distributed, international organization.
  • Authorization to work in Ireland.
  • Alignment with Tines’ values of speed, simplicity, and soundness.

Experience That Would Be Helpful

  • Previous in-house experience at a SaaS, software, cybersecurity, or other technology company.
  • Experience supporting commercial teams across EMEA and the United States.
  • Experience with self-hosted software, regulated customers, or complex security requirements.
  • Experience negotiating reseller, referral, integration, or other partner agreements.
  • Practical knowledge of GDPR and international data transfers.
  • Familiarity with AI products and the commercial, privacy, and intellectual property issues that arise when customers use them.

#LI-SW1 

 

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Job Title: Service Desk Support Analyst
Location: Dublin 3
Job Type: Contract (12 Months)
Work Type: Onsite
Role Type: Service Desk Support
Overview of Role
We are looking for a Service Desk Support Analyst to join our internal IT team and provide high-quality technical support to end users across the business. The successful candidate will manage day-to-day incidents and service requests, troubleshoot hardware, software, access, and connectivity issues, and work closely with infrastructure teams on escalations. This role is suited to someone with strong customer service skills, good technical troubleshooting ability, and an interest in developing wider infrastructure knowledge, particularly across Cisco Networking, VMware, and Dell Technologies.
Role & Responsibilities:
Assist the Infrastructure and Network teams with any hands-on needs in either the Dublin 3 or Dublin 17 office.
Answer, evaluate, prioritise, and manage service desk tickets from internal users.
Provide first line and second-line support for hardware, software, operating systems, mobile devices, printers, and business applications.
Communicate with users by phone, email, instant messaging, and the service management platform, keeping them updated through to resolution.
Provision users, manage access requests, and support Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, groups, shared mailboxes, and distribution lists.
Troubleshoot end-user issues, perform root-cause investigations where appropriate, and escalate to infrastructure or application teams when required.
Assist with the installation, configuration, and ongoing support of IT hardware and software.
Monitor queues and incidents in line with agreed service levels and ensure tickets are fully documented.
Create and maintain knowledge base articles, support procedures, and troubleshooting documentation.
Support routine IT administration tasks and contribute to continuous improvement across the service desk.
Skills, Qualifications & Experience
Previous experience in a service desk, technical support, desktop support, or IT administration role.
Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify, investigate, and resolve technical issues.
Experience supporting Microsoft Windows environments and Microsoft 365 services.
Knowledge of Active Directory, DNS, user provisioning, permissions, and general IT administration.
Familiarity with Apple macOS support would be beneficial.
Knowledge of, or a willingness to learn, Cisco Networking, VMware, and Dell Technologies.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to support users at all levels of the organisation.
Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Professional, end user-focused approach with the ability to manage issues with sensitivity, tact, and ownership.
Experience:
ITIL Foundation knowledge or experience working within ITIL-aligned service management processes (desirable).
Exposure to Cisco switching, routing, wireless, or network troubleshooting (desirable).
Exposure to VMware environments, including virtual machines, vSphere, or related infrastructure concepts (desirable).
Exposure to Dell server hardware, iDRAC, firmware updates, or hardware diagnostics (desirable).
Meticulous and process-driven approach to support and documentation.
Education & Certifications:
Relevant third-level qualification in IT, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
ITIL Foundation certification (advantageous).
Role Details
Hybrid/home office working arrangements may be available depending on business needs.
The successful candidate must have access to a vehicle and hold a valid driving licence.
Travel may be required for up to 25% of the time.
This role offers the opportunity to develop broader infrastructure skills while supporting a busy internal service desk.
Visa:
Irish/EU Citizen or Stamp 4 Visa holder.

As Ireland’s largest IT Solutions Provider with a growing global footprint, Ergo offers deep expertise across managed IT & hardware services, cloud, applications & software services, IT resourcing, and modern work solutions. Our recent technology awards reflect our commitment to delivering industry-leading IT solutions, highlighting our team’s dedication and expertise.

Sep 20, 2024

Dr.ir. Vijay S. Rao
Research Leader, LTM
In an age where safeguarding digital security and privacy is crucial, a new and formidable challenge is emerging on the horizon: the threat posed by quantum computers. Quantum computers promise to revolutionize computing with their unprecedented processing capabilities and have the potential to solve complex problems and drive innovation across various fields. On the other hand, some of the complex problems they solve pose a significant threat to the cryptographic systems that underpin our current digital security infrastructure. This blog explores the potential impact of quantum computers on digital security and what can be done to mitigate these risks.
The quantum computing revolution
Quantum computers utilize quantum mechanics concepts to perform calculations at unimaginable speeds compared to classical computers. While classical bits are limited to representing either 0 or 1, quantum bits (qubits) can exist in a superposition of both states simultaneously. Additionally, quantum entanglement allows qubits to be correlated in ways that enhance computational power exponentially.
Quantum computers are advancing rapidly due to the significant strides made by IBM, Google, and Intel. In 2019, Google claimed ‘quantum supremacy’ by executing a computation in just a few minutes, which would take thousands of years for classical computers [i] . Recently, IBM demonstrated the preservation of 12 logical qubits using 288 physical qubits for nearly 1 million syndrome cycles, thus showcasing the stability and reliability of computations [ii] .
The quantum threat to encryption
One of the most significant threats posed by quantum computers is their ability to break widely used encryption methods. Modern digital security relies heavily on asymmetric-key cryptographic algorithms such as Rivest–Shamir–Adleman (RSA) and elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) for securing protocols and symmetric-key algorithms such as advanced encryption standard (AES) for data encryption.
RSA and ECC are at risk
RSA and ECC, the most common public-key cryptosystems, are foundational to securing today’s internet communications ranging from online banking to private communications. They are employed in protocols such as HTTPS, VPNs, secure email, etc. Their level of security is primarily based on the computational complexity of factoring large integers and solving the discrete logarithm problem, respectively. Classical computers would take impractical amounts of time to solve these problems, thereby ensuring the security of encrypted data.
However, quantum computers, using Shor's algorithm [iii] , can solve these problems exponentially faster. Shor's algorithm can factor large integers and compute discrete logarithms in polynomial time, rendering RSA and ECC encryption vulnerable. This means that a cryptographically relevant could break RSA and ECC encryption.
AES is not immune to quantum threats
AES is another cornerstone of modern encryption, used extensively for encrypting data. While AES is more resilient to quantum attacks compared to RSA and ECC, it is not entirely immune. Grover's algorithm [iv] , a quantum search algorithm, can reduce the effective strength of AES by half. For instance, a 256-bit AES key would effectively offer 128 bits of security against a quantum attack, which is still formidable but significantly less secure than originally intended.
Algorithm Classical strength Quantum threat
RSA Secure with large keys (2048-bit)   Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm
ECC Secure with shorter keys (256-bit) Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm
Diffie-Hellman Secure with large primes (2048-bit) Vulnerable to Shor's algorithm
AES Secure with 128-bit key Grover's algorithm reduces effective key length
SHA-2, SHA-3 Secure with 256-bit key Grover's algorithm reduces effective key length
The ‘harvest now, decrypt later’ attack
One of the most urgent and alarming threats posed by quantum computers is the "harvest now, decrypt later" attack, which is already happening today. Adversaries are actively intercepting and storing encrypted data, intending to decrypt it once quantum computers become powerful enough. This poses an immediate and severe risk, especially for data that must remain confidential for extended periods, such as government communications, intellectual property, personal information, etc. The threat is not just theoretical; it's a clear and present danger that demands immediate attention.
The domino effect: widespread implications
There are far-reaching implications of quantum computers breaking current . This would set off a potential domino effect of cascading failures across various sectors. A successful quantum attack on these encryption systems could lead to severe privacy and data integrity breaches. If a major sector's encryption is compromised, it could lead to a chain reaction affecting other sectors, resulting in widespread chaos. For example, a breach in the financial sector could undermine trust in online banking and digital transactions, leading to economic instability.

You'll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
 
 The Builder Experience 
 AI-Powered Development: Ship real customer solutions, supported by best-in-class AI tools — Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes — embedded into your day-to-day workflow.

 Collaborative Delivery: You'll work alongside Senior Forward Deployed Engineers and a Deployment Strategist. You'll own real components, benefit from structured mentorship from people who've shipped agentic systems at scale, and have a clear path to leading complex deliveries yourself.

 Frontier Access: Our agentic AI platform is evolving in real time.  You'll work on capabilities most engineers won't touch for months — spanning Agentforce, data, platform, and headless architectures  and your field insight will feed directly to the product teams building them. 

 Continuous Innovation: You'll be expected to stay at the forefront, experimenting with emerging AI tools, models, and frameworks, and sharing what you learn with your team and customers.

 
 What You'll Actually Be Building 
 Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.

 Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform  and current LLM techniques.

 Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.

 Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output

 Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.

 Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.

 Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.

 Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the  product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.

 Partner with the Deployment Strategist  in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

 
 You're Our Forward Deployed Engineer If… 
 You have 3+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you'd be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models

 You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field

 You are fluent in English + another EMEA language

 You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.

 You're fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.

 You've been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you'd change.

 You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.

 You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.

 You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what's coming next.

 You thrive in the group chat that's building something, not just talking about it.

 You're excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

 
 Nice-to-Haves

 Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns

 Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

 Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines.  About Abbott 
 Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 114,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 Abbott in Ireland 
 Abbott has been operating in Ireland since 1946 and serves the Irish market with a diverse range of healthcare products including diagnostics, diabetes care, medical devices and nutritional products. In Ireland, Abbott currently employs about 6,000 people across ten sites located in Dublin, Donegal, Clonmel, Cootehill, Galway, Kilkenny, Longford and Sligo.
 
 Please note any offer of employment for this position is conditional upon the successful completion of a pre-employment medical examination, including drug and alcohol screening, conducted by a medical practitioner designated by the Company.
 
 Abbott Diabetes Care Kilkenny 
 Abbott Diabetes Care has opened  a new site, in Kilkenny, that is  at the forefront of Diabetes care with the latest technology, to manufacture FreeStyle blood glucose test strips and FreeStyle Sensors for use in diabetes management. Among Abbott Diabetes Care leading brands are the FreeStyle Precision, FreeStyle Lite and FreeStyle Libre systems.
 
 This is how you can make a difference at Abbott: 
 As a Controls Engineer, you will apply your expertise in pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes to support the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of automated control systems. Working within a regulated environment, you will leverage your technical knowledge to ensure process reliability, compliance, and operational excellence. You will play a key role in developing and maintaining solutions that enhance manufacturing efficiency, productivity, and performance while supporting business and customer requirements.

 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Apply technical expertise in pharmaceutical and biopharmaceutical manufacturing processes to support operational and project objectives.

 Implement, monitor, and maintain process systems to ensure efficient, reliable, and compliant manufacturing operations.

 Develop, calculate, and organise data for complex process flow diagrams, including instrumentation and control requirements.

 Create and evaluate process and unit operation models to optimise performance and productivity.

 Define process sequences and prepare detailed equipment specifications, operating procedures, and work instructions.

 Conduct process testing, monitoring, and analysis throughout production, evaluating variables such as temperature, pressure, density, and viscosity.

 Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve process and equipment issues, providing effective engineering solutions to minimise downtime.

 Ensure all processes, procedures, and documentation comply with applicable regulatory, quality, and safety standards.

 Support root cause investigations, deviation management, and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs).

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives and enhance operational performance.

 
 Education & Experience 
 Associate Degree, Diploma, or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Process Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related technical discipline.

 Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, biologics, or regulated manufacturing environment.

 Experience supporting manufacturing processes, process improvements, or production operations is desirable.

 Knowledge of process control, instrumentation, troubleshooting, and compliance requirements within a regulated industry would be an advantage.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

 
 What we Offer 
 Attractive compensation package that includes competitive pay, as well as benefits such as
 Family health insurance,

 Excellent pension scheme

 Life assurance

 Career Development

 Fantastic new facility

 Growing business plus access to many more benefits.

 
 Connect with us at www.abbott.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.
 
 Abbott is an equal opportunities employer.

N/A In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

 WORK SHIFT: Ie - Kkyflx (Ireland)

description:
Because you make the difference 
 Here at Primark, we love to do things our way. Because we help our customers keep up with high fashion at affordable prices. We do everything with passion, high standards and care around here. And if that sounds like you, join us as a Retail Assistant.

 This is a fixed-purpose Band B role (15-19 hours per week) . Candidates must be fully flexible Monday through Sunday and available to work any shift, including early mornings, daytime, evenings, and weekends . Due to the operational requirements of the role, only applicants with full availability across all trading hours will be considered. 

 Because you matter 
 People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:
 Salary: we offer a competitive salary €14.65 per hour plus premium Sunday rate
 Balance: Enjoy flexibility with accommodating shifts
 Pension: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme
 Discounts: Use your in-store employee discount across our fabulous range
 Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and employee assistance programme.
 Holiday: Enjoy generous holidays, based on your hours
 Opportunity to progress your career internationally
 

 What will I be doing? 
 As a Retail Assistant, you’ll be making our customer’s day, every day. Here’s what this looks like in action:
 Providing customers with an amazing experience as you help them with things like sizes or styles, purchases, or returns
 Setting up a good-looking shop floor with full shelves, tidy fitting rooms and all the latest fashions, as well as keeping a tidy and well-organised stockroom
 Delivering a fast, friendly, efficient experience at till points, processing queries, voids, and returns.
 Receiving, unpacking and checking off new deliveries. Getting our products on to the shop floor and ensuring they’re all correctly priced - all while making sure everything meets our high standards
 

 Who you are:
 We love to delight our customers with amazing in store experiences and that starts with you! Here’s what we need:
 You’re passionate about people and creating those amazing experiences
 You’re honest, a strong communicator who can also listen, share ideas and get involved where needed
 You’ve got good organisational skills and attention to detail
 You’re a team player with high levels of motivation, a positive attitude and willingness to learn
 You’re interested in fashion and the latest looks
 Ideally, you’ve got some experience working within a busy retail environment
 To join us, apply today! 
 
 Our fashion isn’t one-size-fits-all and neither is our culture. Primark promotes equal employment opportunity, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where people can be themselves, access opportunities and thrive together.
 #LI-DNI

About the role
The role will be Brisbane based and it is a 24- month fixed term role.
The LTE RAN RF Planning Engineer is responsible for monitoring, optimising, and maintaining the RF performance of a private LTE network and associated wireless technologies used to support mission‑critical mining operations. This includes ensuring consistent coverage, mobility, and capacity for autonomous haulage, fleet communications, IoT sensors, control systems, CCTV, rail operations, and Cambium point‑to‑multipoint (PTMP) / point‑to‑point (PTP) wireless links distributed across the mine.
The role focuses on operational RF optimisation, performance troubleshooting, and supporting deployment or relocation of LTE cells and Cambium nodes in dynamic mining environments.
What you’ll be doing
Manage incidents and requests while maintaining high ticket quality and hygiene.
Develop RF propagation and coverage models for open-pit mine environments using tools such as HTZ, Atoll, Mentum, or similar.
Perform advanced root cause analysis for LTE outages.
Maintain and manage LTE macro/small cell hardware (FDD) suitable for dynamic mining operations.
Perform frequency optimization, PCI/RSI planning, link budgets, interference analysis, and EARFCN/channel allocation.
Create RAN capacity plans aligned with AHS (Autonomous Haulage System), telemetry, CCTV, and IoT demands.
Provide remote guidance to field teams performing RF surveys, antenna alignment, and LTE trailer moves.
Use TEMS Pocket / TEMS Discovery for drive‑test data analysis (onsite teams), RSRP/SINR profiling, Layer‑3 message decoding, handover investigations, and KPI trend analysis.
Analyse LTE RAN performance KPIs including throughput, PRB utilisation, accessibility, retainability, and mobility metrics.
Identify and resolve issues such as overshooting, coverage holes, interference, and imbalance.
Produce optimisation recommendations such as power adjustments, tilt optimisations, parameter changes, and azimuth
Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with onsite teams, providing step‑by‑step diagnostic guidance.
Manage and optimise Cambium PTP/PTMP backhaul links using tools such as Cambium  HTZ/ LINKPlanner.
Perform path profile studies, Fresnel zone checks, and availability modelling.
Provide remote alignment assistance and configuration guidance to site teams.
Work with Mining Technology, AHS, Fleet Management, and OT Automation teams to understand coverage/performance needs, adjust designs for pit progression and mine expansion, and ensure stable connectivity for trucks, drills, shovels, LV, and IoT devices
Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes
Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes.
Prepare RF design documents, coverage heatmaps, network design packs, BOMs, and commissioning documentation.
Support acceptance and integration testing remotely.
Maintain version-controlled RF documents and change logs.
Design LTE and wireless systems for high reliability in remote industrial environments.
Ensure designs comply with mining standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational safety guidelines.
Consider resilience, redundancy, and harsh environmental factors when developing plans.
Manage and upkeep of NetAct server and software.
Essential Skills / Experience
Minimum 3–5+ years of LTE RAN planning, RF engineering, or optimisation experience.
Experience with Private LTE / 5G SA networks in industrial deployments.
Experience with common GIS applications eg: Global mapper,ArcGIS
Knowledge of mining technologies (AHS, fleet management, dispatch systems).
Networking knowledge: VLANs, routing, backhaul design, QoS.
Scripting or automation (Python, SQL) for performance reporting is advantageous.
Strong communication and coordination skills.
Preferred :
LTE/RAN certification (nokia,Ericsson,Cisco)
Cambium certification desirable
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.
Desirable Skills / Experience
Strong understanding of LTE RAN concepts (EPC/E-UTRAN architecture, PCI planning, SINR/RSRP/TA, VoLTE, CA, etc.).
Hands‑on experience analysing drive test data using TEMS Investigation or TEMS Discovery.
Experience with RF planning tools (Atoll, HTZ, Planet, Mentum, iBwave).
Experience with Cambium Networks (PTP 670/700, PMP 450i/450m,CnMaestro, cnWave, etc.).
Strong analytical background in interpreting logs, KPIs, layer‑3 messages, and RF statistics.
Experience in ticketing-tools like Service Now, and exposure to ITIL processes in context of service operations is a plus.
Experience supporting remote sites (mining/oil & gas/utilities) is preferred.
Ability to work effectively with field teams from a remote location.

As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
At Flipdish, we’re turning the tables in favour of independent restaurant and takeaway owners by offering them powerful, simple-to-use tech solutions backed by real human support. Everything we do is designed to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple in a world that’s anything but.

About the Role

You’ll be part of the team supporting Flipdish’s mission to make running a restaurant satisfyingly simple. This role is a generalist role with an emphasis on two core regulatory mindset areas - employment law and data protection - alongside an interesting and varied mix of other legal work spanning corporate, M&A, IP and equity. .

You’ll partner closely with our People, Finance, Commercial, Product and Engineering teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide pragmatic, risk-aware guidance, help shape internal processes, and ensure the business stays compliant.

What you’ll own

  • Lead employment law support across the business
  • Lead data protection compliance key data-protection processes.
  • Steward privacy policy and marketing compliance: maintain privacy policy updates and ensure direct marketing practices (including SMS compliance) are handled lawfully.
  • Maintain training and standards for key teams (People, Support, and others) so compliance is practical and repeatable.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working. Constructive challenge is a responsibility - prioritising harmony over truth or progress is a failure of responsibility.

What success looks like

  • You are involved partner to the business who isn’t confined to their legal swim lane
  • You take a proactive approach to employment-law and handle issues consistently, with timely and well-documented advice.
  • You ensure data subject  requests are handled with clear legal triage, governance, and defensible timelines.
  • You strengthen our compliance culture through targeted training and practical guidance that teams can apply.
  • You own Companies Act compliance for our Irish entities alongside third party company secretarial support.
  • You scan for relevant legal changes that will impact our business and take a proactive approach to getting ahead of these.
  • You are a key part of the team managing our employee equity structure.
  • You are well known in the Commercial team for transacting partner contracts and triaging some novel customer queries.

About You

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 3+ years PQE (qualified as a solicitor in Ireland).
  • Can demonstrate strong experience across employment law and practical risk management.
  • Have credible GDPR / data protection experience, including comfort engaging with regulators and leading privacy assessments.
  • Communicate clearly with non-lawyers, translate legal risk into actionable next steps, and manage sensitive situations with discretion.
  • Take high ownership: you don’t wait to be told what to do.
  • Challenge poor decisions and propose better ways of working.
  • Embrace technology to augment your work and build efficient processes

The following would help you stand out.

  • In-house experience in a tech / data-driven environment.
  • Experience with privacy policy governance, marketing compliance, and operational DSAR oversight.
  • Exposure to other EU regulatory areas (e.g., digital or accessibility-related compliance) where privacy intersects.

What You Get

We’re a growing startup and we understand that amazing incentives will attract amazing talent. Alongside a competitive salary, we offer unparalleled opportunities for career growth. If you’re smart, ambitious, and hard-working, we’ll do whatever it takes to make you a Flipdisher!

  • Hub model (hybrid): a healthy blend of hub + home working (2 days per week from our Sandyford office)
  • Time off: 25 days annual leave + public holidays
  • Private healthcare
  • Pension: Retirement savings support (Ireland)
  • Team connection: regular team meet-ups and company events
  • Commuter supports: TaxSaver / travel schemes (where available)

Our Culture

At Flipdish, we’re on the side of independent restaurant and takeaway owners, running busy operations on tight margins with rising costs, staffing challenges, and an increasingly demanding customer base. Our job is to make their lives easier with technology that’s powerful, satisfyingly simple, and backed by real human support.

Our integrated ecosystem, spanning online ordering, marketing, loyalty, point of sale, menu optimisation, and operational automation, helps restaurants grow while staying in control. We’re an AI-first company, and we use it to help our customers get better outcomes, faster ordering, smarter marketing, and smoother operations, so owners and teams can spend more time on what matters.

Inside the company, we value ownership and clarity, with a friendly, people-led culture behind it. We trust our people to help shape what kind of employer Flipdish is, not just follow a script. Transparency is huge for us: we listen to each other, and create the space for people to grow (with balance, not burnout). We’re focused on impact and team energy, not “being seen”. You’ll have meaningful scope, work closely with smart people across teams, and be trusted to make things better as Flipdish scales.

If you’d like to read more about interviewing at Flipdish, please check out our Interviewing at Flipdish guide.

title: Group Leader, Biopharma (Core day shift) - Athlone, Ireland
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

Job Description

Group Leader –Biopharma


At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.


We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services.
Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.
Location/Division Specific Information


Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.


Discover Impactful Work:
The role of Group Leader is to provide support to our Biopharma department by providing management and direction to a group of laboratory staff and resources for project activities and needs, overseeing daily operations to monitor quality and project timeliness, and assist in preparation and implementation of company policies, quality systems and training programs.


A day in the Life
•Management of a team of analysts
•Allocation, scheduling and managing laboratory resources for group's project activities and updates LIMS for project status. Reviews timesheet reports for billing accuracy.
•Preparation, review and approval of study protocols, project status reports, final study reports and other project-related technical documents.
•Designing experimental study and participates in technical troubleshooting.
•Reviewing data for technical quality and compliance to protocols, methods and SOPs. Review and approve laboratory investigations, deviations, QA facility and data audits. Assists in client and regulatory authority audits.
•Responding to client questions and needs; leads client technical meetings.
•Assisting in preparation of proposals, project definition and pricing.
•Coordinating and prioritizing project activities with internal functional groups (physical testing, analytical development, etc.) and support functions (QA, sample management, etc.)
•Assisting senior group leaders and/or managers in their responsibilities.
•Preparation and implementing SOPs and company operational policies. Ensuring adherence and making recommendations for quality system improvements.


Education and Experience
•Educated to a bachelor's degree level in a relevant area, ie chemistry, biochemistry. In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.
•Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years) or equivalent and relevant combination of education, training, & experience.
•1+ year of leadership responsibility

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities
•Management experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech or analytical contract laboratory industries
•Stability/QC/analytical R&D/project and program management.
•Direct supervision of technical staff.
•Full understanding of GMP requirements, client SOPs, ICH guidelines, EP and USP requirements, EMA and FDA guidance's.
•Knowledge and experience of a wide range of techniques, HPLC, UPLC, Electrophoresis (CE, iCE, SDS-PAGE), ELISA, spectrophotometry.


Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
Job Description:
The Mission
As the Exponential Engineering Head, your mission is to drive engineering transformation augmented by AI.  You are expected to decouple headcount from high-velocity software engineering metrics. In this role, you aren’t just managing people; you are architecting an AI-augmented engineering engine. You will be responsible for building the organizational capabilities to leverage Frontier AI tools, transforming the software development lifecycle (SDLC) into a high-leverage system where engineers act as system architects and AI agents handle the heavy lifting.
Key Responsibilities
AI Strategy & Tooling Orchestration: Design and implement a frontier-first AI roadmap. You will curate and deploy a cutting-edge stack (e.g., Factory AI Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code) to automate research, requirements planning, routine coding, documentation, testing and deployment.
Exponential Productivity Scaling: Transition the team from linear output to exponential gains. You will redefine "Engineering Excellence" by measuring AI-driven velocity, aiming for a 5x–10x increase in deployment frequency and feature throughput.
Frontier Capability Building: Act as the lead "Architect of Workflow." You will build internal frameworks for Agentic Workflows, where AI agents manage PR reviews, bug triage, and automated refactoring with minimal human intervention.
Talent Transformation: Evolve the engineering culture. You will mentor senior engineers to become "Prompt Architects" and "AI Orchestrators," ensuring the team remains at the bleeding edge of AI-assisted reasoning and complex problem-solving.
AI-Native Quality & Governance: Establish the "Safety Net" for high-speed output. You will implement AI-driven testing (e.g., QA Wolf, Mabl) and security guardrails (e.g., Snyk AI) to ensure that increased speed does not result in technical debt or security vulnerabilities.
Strategic ROI Tracking: Define and report on the ROI of AI Augmentation. You will use insights from platforms like LinearB or Zenhub AI to visualize productivity gains and adjust strategies based on real-time engineering data.
The "Exponential" Tech Stack
The Head is expected to have deep proficiency in (and provide training for) the following AI tool categories. The toolsets are exemplar and not exhaustive or prescriptive.
AI Development Environments:  Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot Enterprise.
Agentic Coding & CLI: Factory AI, Claude Code, OpenDevin.
Automated QA/DevOps: QA Wolf (for self-healing tests), Harness (for predictive deployments).
Security & Compliance: Snyk AI, GitHub Advanced Security.
Engineering Intelligence: LinearB, Zenhub AI (for AI-powered sprint and health metrics).
Qualifications
Engineering Leadership: 10+ years in engineering, with 5+ years leading high-growth teams. Proven experience in a "Force Multiplier" role. Proven experience in engineering transformation and a high-performance culture.
AI Fluency: Expert-level understanding of frontier AI models, AI based software engineering tools and their application. You should be able to demonstrate how you’ve used AI to solve a complex architectural problem.
Architectural Depth: Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems (AWS/GCP), microservices, and—crucially—how to build AI-ready codebases (clean, well-documented, and modular).
Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS or equivalent; specific certifications or deep-dive projects in AI/ML are a significant plus.
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention. Come to Wipro. Realize your ambitions.
Applications from people with disabilities are explicitly welcome.

title: Packaging & Sustainability Advisor
description:
Your new role 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Packaging & Sustainability Advisor to join a leading Not for Profit organisation focused on sustainability, packaging innovation, and regulatory compliance.
 Reporting to the Packaging Technology Manager, you will provide expert guidance on packaging design, recyclability, waste reduction, and evolving packaging legislation. You will work closely with member organisations and industry stakeholders, delivering technical consultancy, training, and support to help businesses achieve their sustainability goals.
 

 Your responsibilities 
 Partner with organisations to review and assess their packaging portfolios, identifying opportunities to reduce packaging waste and improve recyclability. 
 Conduct technical packaging audits and provide practical recommendations on plastic reduction, lightweight, and the transition to more sustainable packaging materials. 
 Advise stakeholders on Design for Recycling (DfR) principles, helping businesses improve packaging performance within a circular economy framework.
 Provide guidance on packaging regulations, including the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), eco-modulated fees, and plastic levy requirements. 
 Develop and deliver technical workshops, webinars, and best-practice resources to support member engagement and knowledge sharing.
 Keep abreast of industry developments, emerging technologies, and sustainability trends to provide informed technical advice to members. 
 Build strong relationships with stakeholders across industry, supporting organisations on their journey towards more sustainable packaging solutions.
 

 What you'll need to succeed 

 This role would suit an experienced packaging professional passionate about sustainability, circular economy initiatives, and helping organisations make meaningful improvements to their environmental impact.
 
 A degree in Packaging Technology, Materials Science, Sustainable Development, or a related technical discipline.
 At least 3 years' experience in a packaging, sustainability, materials, manufacturing, or related technical role.
 Strong working knowledge of plastic packaging, polymers, recycling technologies, and circular economy principles– not in a laboratory or from a research point of view – but from a commercially working environment. (I.e.in a Manufacturing or an FMCG environment). 
 Knowledge of packaging legislation and regulatory frameworks, including PPWR and wider sustainability initiatives.
 A full clean driving licence and willingness to travel when required. 
 

 What you'll get in return 
 The opportunity to work at the forefront of packaging sustainability and environmental innovation.
 Exposure to industry-leading sustainability projects and initiatives.
 A collaborative and supportive working environment.
 Ongoing professional development and career progression opportunities.
 The chance to influence packaging sustainability practices across a diverse range of organisations and sectors.
 
 What you need to do now 
 If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV.

description:
Because you make the difference 
 Here at Primark, we love to do things our way. Because we help our customers keep up with high fashion at affordable prices. We do everything with passion, high standards and care around here. And if that sounds like you, join us as a Retail Assistant.

 Retail Assistant (Fixed Purpose Contract) 
 We are recruiting for Band A (11.5-14 hours per week) and Band C (20-24 hours per week) contracts.
 This role requires full flexibility across all 7 days of the week , including:  Morning shifts; Midday shifts;Evening shifts; Late evening shifts; Weekends; Bank Holidays and public holidays
 Please note: Candidates applying for a Band C contract must be eligible and available to work more than 20 hours per week. 
 Due to the needs of the business, only candidates who can provide full flexibility across the above shift patterns will be considered. 

 Because you matter 
 People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first:
 Salary: we offer a competitive salary €14.65 per hour plus premium Sunday rate
 Balance: Enjoy flexibility with accommodating shifts
 Pension: Secure your future with our generous pension scheme
 Discounts: Use your in-store employee discount across our fabulous range
 Support: Explore our well-being initiatives and employee assistance programme.
 Holiday: Enjoy generous holidays, based on your hours
 Opportunity to progress your career internationally
 

 What will I be doing? 
 As a Retail Assistant, you’ll be making our customer’s day, every day. Here’s what this looks like in action:
 Providing customers with an amazing experience as you help them with things like sizes or styles, purchases, or returns
 Setting up a good-looking shop floor with full shelves, tidy fitting rooms and all the latest fashions, as well as keeping a tidy and well-organised stockroom
 Delivering a fast, friendly, efficient experience at till points, processing queries, voids, and returns.
 Receiving, unpacking and checking off new deliveries. Getting our products on to the shop floor and ensuring they’re all correctly priced - all while making sure everything meets our high standards
 

 Who you are:
 We love to delight our customers with amazing in store experiences and that starts with you! Here’s what we need:
 You’re passionate about people and creating those amazing experiences
 You’re honest, a strong communicator who can also listen, share ideas and get involved where needed
 You’ve got good organisational skills and attention to detail
 You’re a team player with high levels of motivation, a positive attitude and willingness to learn
 You’re interested in fashion and the latest looks
 Ideally, you’ve got some experience working within a busy retail environment
 To join us, apply today! 
 
 Our fashion isn’t one-size-fits-all and neither is our culture. Primark promotes equal employment opportunity, we strive to create an inclusive workplace where people can be themselves, access opportunities and thrive together.

title: Career Growth Tips From A Customer Experience Veteran
description:
Skip to main content
Career Growth Tips From A Customer Experience Veteran
By Dia Dullas
08/02/2024
As someone who’s worked in the customer service industry for more than a decade, I’ve had my share of wins and losses. Through it all, I’ve gained lots of knowledge and perspective on building a customer experience career. On my journey, I’ve picked up some essential career growth tips that could help you too!
Three things can move a career forward and upward faster:
The drive to continue improving skills
The strength to go beyond your comfort zone
The dedication to working hard
Seems basic enough, right? You’ve probably heard leaders and managers mention these to inspire their teams. But, the devil is in the details. Let me share how each of these tips helped me move up the ranks at TTEC Pampanga.
Willingness to learn
A growing career starts with developing skills. I’ve made it a point to continuously improve my abilities and knowledge through a combination of structured training programs and self-initiated learning.
TTEC offers a variety of free digital training modules for employees. These courses enhance both technical and soft skills and include training in customer service excellence and advanced communication techniques. New knowledge is just a click away at TTEC. It’s that easy!
I’ve completed different courses for Trainers, Lean Six Sigma – White Belt, and more using our digital training tools. Stay updated with industry standards and best practices and you’re ready for any career growth opportunities for employees.
A willingness to learn also means actively seeking out mentorship and guidance from leaders within the company. Mentors have provided me with practical advice, helped me avoid common pitfalls, and offered constructive criticism – all crucial for my development. I just had to be brave enough to ask for guidance from people I admired.
Mentors have also played a pivotal role in expanding my professional network, which opened doors to new opportunities and collaborations. We all need our Mr. Miyagi! We don’t grow alone.
Eagerness to evolve
Moving your career forward means leaving comfort behind and venturing into new scopes of work or responsibilities. Different career opportunities in Pampanga require different skills and experiences. You need to expose yourself to new challenges to be prepared for bigger roles. Training needs teaching skills. Leadership roles require management experience.
My advice for employees who want to achieve the same career growth is to always be proactive in seeking out new opportunities for growth and development. I’ve always shown interest in new challenges and career growth opportunities for employees.
Serve as consultant for another team. Volunteer to lead a project. Be vocal about problems and enhancements you think of. In fact, you can even showcase your professional skills in activities that aren’t work-related.
I’ve volunteered to lead or participate in different company events like our Summer Party, the TTEC Foundation, our Sports League, and more. Show a willingness to go above and beyond your responsibilities. That will position you as a great asset – enthusiastic, proactive, and ready to lead.
I also made sure to network and build relationships with colleagues and leaders across different departments. This helped me gain a better understanding of the company as a whole and opened doors for collaboration and learning opportunities.
Also, that helps you show your value not just with your team, but also across the company. Be visible! A good company will see your potential if you keep shining.
I connected with colleagues from the training department, operations, and business support groups. I learned so many things from the people there. Also, the value of my work and how it connects to the larger success of the company became clearer. Understanding the larger ecosystem of your career can help you clarify the path you want to take.
You can also build connections outside of your company. I participated in BPO networking events, joined industry-related social media groups, and spoke with successful people in the customer experience industry. There are plenty of people who are willing to help you achieve your goals.
Demonstrate hard work
Speaking of going above and beyond, the most important thing to get ahead is to show your dedication and diligence to help your team and company as a whole. I’ve consistently demonstrated a strong work ethic and a willingness to take on responsibilities. That helped me stand out and get consideration for advancement opportunities.
Coordinate tasks. Hit target deadlines. Exceed quality standards. Support colleagues through any challenges. Be punctual. Be prepared. Be accountable. Show consistent commitment. Do those and you earn trust and respect from peers. You become a culture setter. I did those. You can too!
TTEC and your journey forward
I started as an agent for two years. Then, my career was elevated to Training. In roughly the same amount of time, I went back to Operations as a Team Leader. Now, I’m an Operations Analyst and serve as a Readiness Ambassador.
By continuously developing skills, stepping out of my comfort zone, and simply showing a great work ethic, I’ve been able to reach new heights at TTEC Pampanga. Anyone can do that too. Career growth is achievable here through your own dedication, hard work, and a proactive mindset.
Be part of a company where your career can be nurtured! Check out our career opportunities in Pampanga and other openings in the Philippines . Spark your career with a Great Place to Work® certified company!
Join us and thrive
Your next opportunity starts here. Whether you're actively searching or simply exploring what’s next. our Talent Community connects you with opportunities that align with your goals.

title: Test Analyst - 12m FTC
description:
About us  
 At Davy, it’s the unique talents of all our people that have been the foundations of our success for 100 years. As we continue to grow, so do you. Because you are not just part of our team – you are a key player in shaping our future.  
 At Davy, you are the difference.    
 Established in 1926, the Davy Group sits at the heart of wealth and capital in Ireland, providing a broad range of services to high-net-worth individuals, self-directed investors, small-to-medium enterprises, credit unions, corporations, and domestic & international institutional investors.  
 Our culture is shaped around three values, which are at the heart of everything we do: client success, one Davy, and building a proud legacy. Sharing the same goals, we work together to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. As part of a team of over 900, you will be encouraged to learn and to grow, both professionally and personally.  
 Requirements 
 About the role  
 We are seeking an experienced Automation Tester / SDET to join our QA team. on a 12m Fixed Term Contract basis. This role combines automation expertise with hands-on manual testing, including test design, execution, automation framework development, and continuous testing practices.
 In the role, the successful candidate will: 
 Support both manual and automated testing activities
 Ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of business-critical applications
 Work closely with developers, business analysts, product owners, and QA teams to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
 
 About you   
 We are looking for somebody who has the following background and skills: 
 5+ years' experience in a QA role with strong experience in both manual and automation testing. 
 Proven experience updating and maintaining enterprise-scale test automation frameworks. 
 Hands-on experience in designing, executing, and maintaining manual test cases and test suites. 
 Good understanding of Quality Engineering, testing strategy, and governance. 
 Experience implementing and managing testing initiatives across web, API, and desktop platforms. 
 Proven experience integrating testing into Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery models. 
 Experience implementing AI-powered testing capabilities. 
 Strong knowledge of functional, integration, regression, compatibility, and exploratory testing practices. 
 Excellent communication skills within enterprise environments.
 Technical Expertise - MUST HAVE 
 Java-based automation development using Selenium WebDriver and Playwright.
 Relational database query development using SQL, DB2, or equivalent query languages.
 CI/CD tools including Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and Git.
 Cloud technologies including Azure or AWS with experience testing cloud-native applications and microservices.
 Experience working as part of a Scrum team, actively participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
 Experience in Stockbroking, Banking or Finance sector
 NICE TO HAVE 
 API automation using REST Assured or equivalent frameworks.
 AI-driven testing approaches including self-healing automation, AI-assisted test generation, and intelligent defect analysis.
 Contract testing (PACT), service virtualisation, and integration testing methodologies.
 Performance testing and engineering using tools such as JMeter, k6, or LoadRunner.
 Salesforce platform testing across integrated business applications.
 This specification is suitable for a SDET or Automation Tester responsible for designing and implementing quality automation excellence and AI-enabled testing practices.
 Benefits 
 What we offer  
 At Davy, our people are our biggest investment. In today’s fast-moving world, we know it’s important to feel secure and empowered. That’s why Davy benefits support you through all of life’s stages, offering health and wellness, flexible working options, flexible benefits allowance, learning and development opportunities, through to assisted retirement planning.   
 Health and Wellbeing   
 Psychological safety, emotional wellbeing and support are a priority at Davy. We offer a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and mental health first aid. Our Sports & Social teams promote physical wellbeing and social connection.  
 Reward and Recognition   
 We offer a competitive remuneration package to include salary, bonus, pension and a host of additional benefits to protect you and your family when it matters most.  
 Growth and Development   
 Our award-winning L&D function supports you and your growth at Davy. We offer a comprehensive range of professional and personal development opportunities. Our culture supports learning, and we encourage you to explore more at Davy.  
 Positive Workplace   
 Our workplace is inclusive, diverse, and offers everyone a sense of belonging. We are flexible and continue to support a hybrid working model. You will get to be your best at Davy.  
 Values and Culture   
 Exceptional client outcomes delivered by a world class team, underpinned by our core Davy values – One Team, Client Success, and Proud Legacy.    
 Important Information  
 Davy is an equal opportunities employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We value diversity in both background and experience, and even if you don’t meet all of the requirements outlined in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We review all applications received. As part of our commitment to creating an accessible environment, we want to ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to participate in the interview process. If you require any reasonable accommodations, please let us know, and we will do our best to make the necessary arrangements.  
 Appointment to this role is subject to the candidate's eligibility to work in Ireland. 
 Where agency assistance is required, our Recruitment Team will engage directly with suppliers. Unsolicited CVs / profiles supplied to us by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this role. 
 Davy Group is a member of the Bank of Ireland Group.
